dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugasakyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs phur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i — dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par dum bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dgatso dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes —— 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad kur stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhinasnyelegs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung sha'i bod rig dzodape snan khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyisanas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo brgya'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nor te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam bto ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang /deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang /dgon sdodang /spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhugate/rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang /mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing /lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du masang tsho'i las kar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang /ma nor lam ston/ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtsho ni/nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang /snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang /zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang /slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang /nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o//ser ka khuganang pas dpe rnying 'tshos ba phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 00/lo'i zla ba pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdusgrig gsal bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tsho gos pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs la su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir sa spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mjad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang /lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la chib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags(ka༄6)(gnakhong )ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang /deb ldanas7bar pod rtags 6)'a)(ja)ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/deb shas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum nye pod rtags la ( ja she(ja3)(ja4)bkod yod/deb 11pa la pod rtags6)stergyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan/khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/deb 12pa la pod rtags rta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/nyang ston khra tshang pa/tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos 'a drug cu re gsum/deb 14pa la pod rtags lda)gdam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang /chos mdzo rin ོ 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos gsum/deb 8pa la bod rtags6)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcugacig deb 19nas21bar bod rtags6)yo'i64ga sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang bod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags rto po ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs cho me tshan gsum/deb 24pa la pod rtags3)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs so gos chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma yo)ste tshe bdag go yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma (0 ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang /gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su 'khu lang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang /'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags2na ba 'di'i nang bkod yod/

zhu dag byed skabs/thog ma'i zhu dag dang /bskyar zhus/yang zhus/zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing /tshig phrad dang /lhag bcas/rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /myong kha pa la btsong kha pa/mtshams la 'tshams/mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/med la smad/byung la 'byung /rang rkya la rang skya/grwa la gra klong la slong /rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzan/rig gnas la rigs gnas/rigs pa la rig pa/gcod la spyod/ rdzong bde la rdzong sta/rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang /nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang /shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor zhabrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad skar ram/yig thogazhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang /pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang /mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o//sgogs nang bod ༷ /shiX//zla ba'iXn//

mdzad ba po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyalapo'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sdo lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sgrul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'bon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nasadagung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/g.yin yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang /dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/chos gzhis ma rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang /de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang /pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang /lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang /mdzod la chos mngone rin wo 'dren pa'i shing rta/'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang /rdzogs wo 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung /de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chagazhal gdams/snyan mgur/snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/lam yigabasko 'ja'/grwa tshang 'don cha/dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o//meXgs khang gas dpe rdzing 'chos ba phyogs ga khar/

dkar chagabyang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal lung / (1)mar brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (1)sngon 'gro'i rim pa bshes gnyen bsten tshul sogs bshad pa/ (5)skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong tshul/ (28)skyes bu tshong dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong tshul/ (54)skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong tshul/ (75)mjug byang / 5141)zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba nyams su len tshul 'jam dpal snying po'i zhal lung / (147)bstan bcos chen po dbu ma la 'jug pa gsal bar byed pa theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings/ (158)mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (158)mas gyi don bshad pa/ (161)'gyur gyi phyag bshad pa/ (165)gzhung gi don bshad pa/ (166)'dir bstan chos gsum bshad pa/ (166)sa dang po rab tu dga' ba bshad pa/ (191)ring song dang rigs pa gsum bshad pa/ (198)sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa bshad pa/ (219)1

sa gsum pa 'od byed pa bshad pa/ (225)sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba bshad pa/ (239)sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba bshad pa/ (241)sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa bshad pa/ (244)dgag bya ngos 'dzin dang / thal zlog /chos can mthun snang ba bcas kyi skor/ (251)bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/ (274)chu 'bab bshad pa/ (294)rang rig bshad pa/ (299)tshad 'gog bshad pa/ (303)sems tsam 'gog tshul bshad pa/ (311)bdag 'gog bshad pa/ (317)stong nyid kyi rab dbye bshad pa/ (333)sa bdun pa ring du song ba bshad pa/ (339)sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba bshad pa/ (340)sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros bshad pa/ (342)sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin bshad pa/ (343)stobs bcu bshad pa/ 4350)mjug gi don bshad pa/ 4355)dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīk+ka nyams len dang 'brel ba tshig don rab gsal/ (359)lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi mchan 'grel/ (373)lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi dgongs 'grel lung rig gter mdzod/ (377)2

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gtam mchog dman gyi blo sna tshogs dang mthun par bkod pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / (413)bder gshegs bdun gyi mchod pa'i chog bsgrigs yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ (429)rgyud sde rgya mtshor rab 'byams smra ba rnams kyi bshad pa'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ (511)gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ (536)

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenar༅༅//byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄༅//thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i tsho gos gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las//legasa'akhrungs mthong na mi mthun med pa'i mtshan dpe'i yal 'dab rab rgyas rtser//2na sgom pa thamasacad mkhyen par byed pa'i bla med ro brgya'i 'bras smin pa//'gro ba'i bla ma nyi ma'i gawo gyur yongasa'adu'i dbang pos dge legs stsole//2bzab rgyas chos tshul kun bzang dman pa'i mtshor//bying tshe 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rus sbal gyis//'degs mkhas shing rta chen po rnam gnyis zhes//gragasadakar srid pa'i khong las brgal de bsngags/khor yug gangs kyi ra ba'i bsil ldan ljongs//theg chen chos kyi nyi ma 'od po ches//log rtog mun pa sel dang lhan cig par//thub bstan snang bas khyab mdzad a ti sha/gang gi gsung rab yid bzhin nor bu mchog/thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas//gtan 'dun 'dod pa'i re skong bka' gdams zhes//phyogs kun khyab pa'i ring lugasa'adi ko mtshar//phra zhib rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros rab tu yangs spro 'i rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis//dri bcas 'khrul ldan gzhung lugs bye ba'i log smra'i nyes bshad sa 'dzin bgrod pa bcom pa dang //lhan cig rgol ngan spobs pa'i sbyin skyes lus phra ma yi mngal khur mtha' dag lhung byed pa'i//sngon med lha dbang mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags pa rab 'bar kun mkhyen btsong kha pa de rgyal//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)rgyal ba'i nyi (3na)ma las nyen sgrib pa yi/ /nub rir bag la zha tshe dman pa'i blo'i/ shar phyogs sa 'dzin las thon yongs 'dzin rje/ /'khon ston kun da'i gnyen khyod gtsug gi rgyan/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i dpal ldan pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'dzad med 'byor ba la/ /'jam dbyangs mgrin par zhugs pas dbang sgyur bar/ /lhun grub sku bzhi'i 'byung gnas dge ba'i bshes/ /gang gi rnam dkar phrin las bsil zer gyis/ legs bshad zla ba'i ma ma rab rgyas las/ /'di phyi'i phan bde'i rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /srid zhi'i dbul phongs sel ba'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ khyad par lnga brgya'i dpung gnyen mar me mdzad/ /yab sras ma dros chu bo las 'ongs pa'i/ /sne zur pu to spyan snga rnam gsum gyi/ /gdams pa'i klung chen blo yi rgya mtshor babs/ /de'i tshul rnam par lci ba'i bka' drin khur/ /yid byed gzhal nus byang chub snying po yi/ pha mtha' rnyed pa de srid ches dka' ba/ /bsams kyin lag pad snying ga'i ngos su zum/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i ngang (3bskos mkha' ltar yangs/ /gnas lugs dgongs don rdul phran bzhin du phra/ /de phyir bdag 'dras brjod pa'i khur 'khyer ba/ /a mra'i tshi gus chu gter wol ba bzhin/ /wo te dpe mthong tsam dang klog lung la/ /'khrid du btags min brgyud ldan dam pa'i gsung/ /rang gi nyams myong tshad ma'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /glegs bam rin chen za ma tog tu 'khyil/ /de la 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi gnad ma lus pa gcig tu bsdus te skal pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid 'di nyid nyams su len par byed pa la nyams su len pa po'i gang zag des kyang brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig las thos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas ja skad du/ shing rta chen po gnyis las legs brgyud pa'i/ /zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod pa'i lam /zhes dang / chos khungs btsun par bstan pa'i phyir mdzad pa po'i che ba bstan pa zhes dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung ste dam pa bar ma chad pa las brgyud pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa zhes gsungs pa'i tshig 'di dpyad na nus pa shin tu che ba yin no/ /de yang bdag cag gi ston pa zas —2

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenagatsang gi sras po nas bzung ste chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bar du brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams lam rim gsol 'debs su gsal ba ltar 'khrul med kyi go rim du bzhugs pa de ltar yin la/ de phyin chad nas rje bla ma'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa phyogs kun tu spel pa'i mkhas grub kyi slob ma gnam gyi skar ma dang sa'i dreg pa lta bur khyab par gyur pas brgyud tshul yang de snyed du (4na tshe(nga ba'i tshod tsam du gda' na'ang / deng sang ni rang rang gi dgon pa'i bla rabs 'dren pa tsam dang / bar skabs kyi brgyud pa'i khungs med par gzhan la ston pa sogs snang tshul mtha' yas so/ /'on te chos 'di'i tshig don gyi cha la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i bshad bka' dang / dmar 'khrid du nyams su blang pa'i tshul sogs la kho bos 'bad pa chen pos thos bsam byas pa'i brgyud tshul so sor yod pa'i 'khrid kyi skor rje btsun shes rab seng ge nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i phyag bzhes su gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs zhes bshad pa ltar yul dus dang bstun pa'i gnas khang sogs byi dor legs par byas/ rgyal ba'i yum las ston pa dang chos la rim gro bskyed par gsungs pa ltar chos ston pa po la seng ge'i khri la sogs pa'i stan mthon po bsham pa sogs sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar bsnyen bkur pa'i 'du shes bskyed dgos te/ sa'i snying po'i mdo las/ gcig tu dad cing gus pas chos mnyan gyi/ /de la 'phya zhing skur bar mi bya'o/ /chos smra ba la mchod pa bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas 'dra bar de la 'du shes bskyed/ /ces pa'i don yin pas rten 'brel gyi sgo dang po 'di nas ma 'phyugs shing brnyas stabs su ma song ba zhig dgos gsung / thog mar bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags bton nas dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du bdud rigs kyis glags lta bar mi nus par blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las bshad la/ sngags de gdon pa 'grub mi 'grub 'byung bas de'i tshang tu mdo tshar gsum nges par gsung / de rjes sangs rgyas nas bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar yongs su tshang ba'i lam rim brgyud pa'i (4ba)gsol 'debs dag maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i bar rnams go rim phyugs med du bya/ blo gsar pa rnams la sbyor gzhung gi mdzub 'khrid dge rgan gyis gtong ba lta bu'i bcas bde dang sla chos kyis mi 'ong gsung bas —3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()thog mtha' bar gyi phyag len che phra mtha' dag la rang bzo'i dri mas ma sbags pa'i blo gros kyis zhib mor dpyod pa gnad du che'o//nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du/ston pa bde bar gshegs pas gsungasapa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi phung po kun rgyal tshab rnam pa gnyis kyi bka' drin la brten nas/slob dpon gzhan la ltos pa med par rang stobs kyis shing rta'i srol legs par phye ba'i mgon po klu sgrub dang 'phags pa thogs med gnyis kyi gdams pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa dpal mar me mdzad kyi gsung rab theg pa chen po'i chos kyi tshul thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa ni srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sel bar byed pa'i phan pa dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas yin la/de yang thos pa'i tsho mos las/thos pas cho me rnams shes par 'gyur//thos pas sdig las ldog par byed//thos pas don ma yin pa spong //thos pas mya ga 'das pa 'thob/khes pa ltar thog mar thos pas gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la mdo las/legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung zhig/ces kha bub pa dri ma can zhabs rdol ba lta bu'i snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te/rang la nad pa/chos smra ba po la sman pa/rjes su bstan pa la sman/nan tan nyams su len pa la ldan jid gso ba/de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa/chos kyi tshul la ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes drug sogs mdor na chosanyan pa'i kun slong kun spyod sogs spyi bye brag mtha' dag gsal btab nas gsan par 'tshal/gsan bya dam pa'i cho ge ni nyams mgur las/'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan//snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba//klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du//legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di//skye rgu'i 'dod don ma lus stong bsan//gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste//gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir//dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtshor yin//bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang /4/gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang //

byang chung la ma gyi rim pa'i 'khrid mig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 6)rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang srung / /de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni/ /skal ldan du mas bsten pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis/ /yid rab mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su zhig yod/ /sngon 'gro'i rim pa bshes gnyen bsten tshul sogs bshad pa/ces dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam po che/ 'dren pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras pos legs par bka' stsal pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnad 'gag ma lus pa shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyis dgongs pa'i don rang dbang du bkral ba de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i pa rdzita rnams kyis bshad pas gtan la phab/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rnamasakyis thugs nyams su bstar ba thams cad 'khrul pa med par dpal (5ba/lha gcig di paṃ ka rasaskyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa zhes man ngag nyams len gyi tshul du dril nas byang chub lam gyi sgron ma la sogs pa mdzad de spel bas tshul de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i jo bo bka' gdams pa grags pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi brtul zhugs ma nyams par 'dzin pa gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bus gangs can gyi ljongs 'di yongs su khyab par gyur pa las/ slar yang dus kyi bskal pas ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i dri mas sbags pa rnams sel ba'i slad du shing rta chen po gnyis pa ltar 'jam dbyangs mi'i srid pa'i gar mkhan chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos byang chub lam gyi rim pa che chung du grags pa'i sngon med legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos chen po 'di dag nyid theg pa gong 'og gi lung rtogs kyi bstan pa phyogs re tsam la zhen nas nyi tshe ba'i blang dor la 'jug pa ma yin par/bshes gnyen ston pas/ bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis sur shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes pa'i don dang mthun pas/ skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs nas bshad pa'i ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la snying —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)thag pa nas 'jigs te de las thar 'dod kyi blo nyes can btson ra la skyugs log pa lta bu'i bsam pa rgyud la ma skyes pa'i gang zag la skyes bu 'bring gi skabs nas bstan pa'i mtho ris lha mi'i phun tshogs kyi bde ba kun la mngon 'dod kyi srid pa med pa'i srid pa 'khor ba'i ngang tshul mtha' dag me 'bar pa'i klong ltar mthong nas 'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi bsam pa bcos ma ma yin pa skye ba'i go skabs med cing / 'khor ba las yid 'byung ba'i myong ba cung zad kyang med par sems can gzhan la dmigs pa'i bcos (6na nyan gyi snying rje chen po mtshan nyid pa ni skye ba ga la srid/ snying rje chen po rgyud la ma skyes par bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed spyod pa phyin drug la slob pa'i byang chub semasadapa' de nam mkha'i pad+mo dang chos mtshungs pas na/ dngos bstan rang nyid ngan 'gro las thar pa'i thabs kyi chos skor lta bu dang / rang don dor nas gzhan phan lhur len pa'i skor rnams tshig la 'gal ba ltar som nyir gyur pa rnams kyang don gyi cha la rgyu 'bras sam lam gyi gtso bo dang yan lag gi tshul gyis gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du gsung rab thams cad gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba zhig dgos pas bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i che ba/ de ltar gyur pa'i don rnams nyams su len pa'i tshe rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ mang du thos kyang chos kyis phongs pa ni/ /gsung rab gdams par shar ba med pas nongs/ /zhes lung gi bstan pa gtan la phab pa'i rgyu las 'bras bu rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgrub pa'i gnad ma go ba de 'dra min pa'i/ rnal 'byor pa chen pos/ gdams ngag la nang byan chud pa ni be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la mi zer gyi gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba la zer/ zhes mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i bde ba sna gcig yan chad sgrub pa'i thabs sangs rgyas kyi bka' dri ma med pa rnams las dngos shugs gang rung gi sgo nas ma bstan pa med na'ang de dag zab cing brling bas blor chud dka' ba rnams la dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen mo rnams las gsal bar bstan pas gsung rab dang dgongs 'grel nas ma bshad pa'i nyams su len tshul (6ba〉ban ngag zur pa cung zad tsam yang —6

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 6)med la/ de dag nas rgya cher bshad pa'i don thams cad lam gyi rim pa 'di nyid kyi skabs su sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi mjug gi rim pa gsum du hril gyis 'du zhing tshang ba la nges pa rnyed pa ni gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char ba'i che ba/ de lta bu'i gdams ngag tu gsung rab thams cad rdzogs par 'char na/ bshad ma thag pa'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel thams cad thos bsam gyisagatan la phab chog pa la lam sgron bstan rim lam rim sogs su ming gis btag bas pa'i glegs bam logs su byed pa ci zhig snyam na/ dus kyi dbang gis gdul bya rnams kyang blo gros kyi mthu je dman du gyur pa'i tshe don rtogs dka' ba dang tshig gi cha ha cang mang ba la sgro 'dogs gcod par mi nus pas/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung ste dam pa bar ma chad pa'i man ngag la brten nas lam gyi rim pa'i bstan bcos sogs su bsdus pa yin la/ de ltar na cho ge phung brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa'i tshig don rgya chen po dag der ma 'dus pas lhag chad du 'gyur ram snyam du mi sems te/tshig gi cha mtha' dag ni yongs su rdzogs par 'du mi dgos shing don thams cad 'dus pas dper na ga bur nyer lnga ba'i sman gyi phung po shin tu che ba dag las sman sna thams cad tshang ba'i thun chung ngu zhig gis gang zag gcig gi tsha ba'i nad sel ba yin gyi/ des sman gyi phung po yongs rdzogs za mi dgosapa bzhin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i che ba/ des na gsung rab dgongs tshol dang bcas pa nas ma bstan pa'i gang zag gcig so skye (7na skos sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du bgrod pa'i spang bya sgrib gnyis kyi gnyen po ni cung zad tsam yang mi srid la/ bstan bcos 'dir gsung rab thams cad kyi don 'dus pa'i phyir na tshul 'di nyams su bstar bas nyes pa'i sgo thams cad khegs par 'gyur zhing / khyad par rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal dam pa'i chos spong ba'i las kyi sgrib pa ni phra'o/ /'jam dpal gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i bka' la la ni bzang bar 'du shes la/ la la ni ༅ par 'du shes pa ni chos spong pa'o zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gyi chos spong ba pa brten pa'i —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)nyes pa mtha' dag khegs par 'gyur bas na nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba'i che ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i gdams pa 'di nyams su len par byed pa la sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i gong ma gong ma rnams 'og ma 'og ma'i sngon 'gro yin pas skyes bu chen po nyid dngos gzhir byas nas 'bring yan sngon 'gror bsdus kyang blo sbyong sogs kyi 'khrid tshul gzhan rnams dang cha mthun pas mi rung ba med mod/ spyod pa spyi bslab kyi sa bcad du/ theg chen spyi la bslab tshul/ khyad par du rdo rje theg pa la bslab tshul lo zhes pa ltar na sngags kyi skabs su spyod pa phyogs kyi skor rnams kyang sngon 'gror 'gro bas 'khrid dmigs gtso bo ngos zin par byas nas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i dbye ba phyed dgos kyi/ gzhan du na pha ri la ltos nas tshu ri dang tshu ri la ltos nas pha rir 'jog pa bzhin du skabs don gyi ngo bo ngos ma zin pa'i 'khrul ba'i lam du (7ba〉chun pa mang ba'i phyir/ brgyud ldan dam pa'i zhal lung nyams su myong pa'i phyag len mthong brgyud la ltos pa gal che bas dal 'byor rnyed dka'i skor nas bzung lhag mthong gi bar thams cad lugs 'di la lam gyi dngos gzhir bya dgos pa yin no/ /smras pa/ ma dag stod kyi skyon spangs gzur gnas kyi/ /rna bar dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs snyan po/ /yongs 'dzin zhal gyi sgo las nyer thos pa/ /bskal par bsgrub pa'i bsod nams zong gis rnyed/ /khyad par rgya bod mkhas grub ma lus pa'i/ /thugs kyi nying khu che ba bzhi ldan chos/ /mchog dman 'gro la ris med phan pa'i sman/ /bdud rtsi'i skrun zla gnyis pa rnyed dka'i lam/ /lam mchog 'di 'dra thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ /nyams su blang byar yod pa'i skal bzang rnams/ /mnog chung tshe 'di'i 'dun ma rgyang bsrings te/ /zhen log skyo shas drag pos rgyud bskul nas/ /'du 'dzis dben pa'i sa 'dzin mthon po'i ngos/ /spang ljongs nags tshal me tog khor yug can/ /rdo ba'i spyil chung rang shong khang bu sa /grib ma gnyis pa'i grogs dang lhan cig par/ /lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i nyal 'gro dang / /bag phebs ri dwags rgyu ba'i skad gnyis las/ /gzhan du dug gsum bskyed pa'i long gtam —8

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenagyis/ /bsam gtan tsher ma'i byed po dmigs su med/ /phyag dar khrod pa'i gos dang bsod snyoms kyis/ /nyer 'tsho dkor nag dug chus ma sbags pas/ /rnam dkar dge la skul nus lusang ga yid/ /gtan gyi bde sgrub 'dun ma'i yang rtser son/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//des na dang po sngon 'gro lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul la sngon (8na 'gro skyabs sems dang / dngos gzhi bshes gnyen bsten pa'i lam nyams su len tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni mkhas pa kha cig /chos thams cad kyi thog ma bshes gnyen bsten tshul kho na yin pas de'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos gzhan med par 'chad cing de la dag khungs su byed pa mang du snang yang / de ltar na bshes gnyen bsten pa'i chos skor la blo sbyong ba'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yang yin la/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su ma song ba yang yin pa zhig khas len dgos par 'gyur zhing / de lta bu'i gdul bya de skyabs su ma song ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gral du mi oṃ de/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed par jo bo rje dang shā na ti pa bzhed cing / bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo dam pa skyabs 'gro yin pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sa bcad las gsungs pas so/ /la la dag skyabs su 'gro ba tsam la 'gal ba med na yang / /sems bskyed pa mi rig bka)/ bshes gnyen bsten pa'i 'og tu skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor rnams 'byung bas so/ /zhes 'chad pa ni 'thad par mi sems te/ skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor la skyes bu chung ngu dngos dang de dang thun mong ba'i chosaskor gnyis su gsungs pa las skabs 'dir nyams su blang bya ni skye ba phyi ma mngon mtho'i lus rten tsam don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu chung ngu'i skor ma yin par skyes bu che 'bring gi lam gyi rten gzhir gyur pa'o chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i chos skor yin pas/ sems can dang po'i las can rnams/ /dam pa'i don la 'asdug pa la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa/ /skas kyi rim pa (8ba /rto bur gsungs/ /zhes dang / gal te skyes bu chung 'bring gi chos skor rnams skyes bu chen po'i sngon 'gro yin na skyes bu chen po'i lam rim du byas pas chog mod/ chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam rim zhes tha snyad bya ci 9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānedagos she na zhes gsungs pas skabs 'dir 'chad pa'i yul ni skyes bu chen po'i gdul bya yin la/de la sngon 'gro'i tshul du skyes bu chung ngu bstan pa yin pas na sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin par skyon med par ma zad shin tu legs pa'o/ khyad par bdag gi bla ma dam pa'i khrid gzhung bdud rtsi gser zhun la gzhi mdzad/ lam gyi rim pa gnyis nabs kha bskangs te gnang bas der skyabs sems kyi gsal kha yod do/ /gzhung chen mo rnams su 'di'i skabs skyabs sems byed pa'i gsal kha ma byung bas rang gis nyams 'khrid zhu ma myong ba'i dbang gis gsung rgyun dang phyag len mthong thos med pa'i rtsal bshad mkhan po rnams sdus pa'ang thugs med do/ /des na thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod kyis gang las 'gro ba dag /ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ /gang dang 'jig rten ma sprad pa'i/ /phun tsho gos de yang gang zhig mchis/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi mthu las ma byung pa'i rgyu g.yin gyis 'gro ba rnams srid zhi'i rgud pa las thar ba dang / gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la longs spyod du yod pa ni cung zad tsam yang med cing / yon tan khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid dam pa'i chos 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden pa las byung la/ de tshul bzhin du sgrub par byed pa yang slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge 'dun rnams la rag lus pa'i phyir na skyabs yul dam pa de rnams la bdag dus deng nas bzung ste (9na)sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen zhu snyam pa'i dad pa lhang lhang ba zhig sngon du btang la skyabs mgon de rnams dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bdag gi mgon skyabs su mngon sum du byon yod snyam pa'i mos pa dung dung ba zhig byas pa'i mthus skyabs gnas de dag mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan khyad par can mnga' bas bya nam mkhal la 'phur ba ltar gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i don du 'byon pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas/ gang zhig mos pa gtsor byed pa/ /de yi mdun du thub pa bzhugs/ /zhes mos ngo tsam ma yin pa'i don dang mthun pa zhig nges par 'ong gsung / gsang sngags kyi 'khrid gzhung rnams ltar dmigs skor spros pa can mi —/snyo

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / smyon)mdzad mod/ mdo lugs dang 'brel ba'i nyams su len tshul 'di tsam zhig med par skyabs 'gro'i tshig mang du brjod pa ngag 'chal gyi sgo khegs pa tsam du zad do/ /de ltar skyabs yul ngos bzung ba de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i mkhan po rang nyid kyis ji ltar skyabs su 'gro na/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis mtha' med cing gting zab pa'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po 'dir chud nas sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar pa'i tshul la dgra mi sha 'os da lta rang gsod du cha ba tsam gyi 'jigs skrag dang / 'jigs pa de las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog gsum la yod par shes nas dad pa dang yon tan khyad par can de rang rgyud la mngon du bya 'dod pa dang / skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang khyer shes snyam pa'i yid ches kyi blo lings bskyur dang / sems can rnams la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i dbang gis/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i nus pa (9ba)rang la med kyang dkon mchog la gsol ba btab ste rgyab rten bcol na yod par nges pa rnams kyi sgo nas 'di ltar brjod dgos pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa 'phreng ba lta bur brtsis te nyung mtha' nyer gcig nas mang mtha' sum brgya tsam du brjod pa ni thun che chung 'tsham pa yin/ thog ma nas dge sbyor la 'jug mdog byed pa de nyams len byed mi shes pa'i rtags yin pas/ ji skad du/de yang dang po yun rings na bying rgod kyi dbang du 'gro sla zhing / de la goms na blo 'chos dka' bas thun chung la grangs mang bar bya/ sgom 'dod pa'i 'phro la bcad kyin byas na phyi ma res kyang 'jug snying 'dod/ gzhan du na mal mthong ba'i tshe skyugs log log 'ong zhes thog ma nas sna brdabs pa'i chos dred du ma song ba gal che'o/ /skyabs 'gro'i nyams len zin pa'i mjug tu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog —11—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 60rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob tu gsol/khyad par du yang skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobe tu gsol/zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs skabs dang sbyar ba gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas brjod do/ /'di ni zhing khyad par can dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus 'og nas 'byung ba'i dmigs skor (10na sgoms rgyud la skye ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod pas/ ji skad du/ bzung na tshig mi zin/ bsams na don mi go /bsgoms na rgyud la mi skye ba'i blo mthu shin tu chung ba'i dus su zhing gi mthu la brten pa ni man ngag yin no/ /zhes thog mar skyabs 'gro dgos pa'i shes byed shin tu che zhing / 'di nas bzung ste skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya mdor bsdus tsam la bslab dgos pa'i phyir mchod pa'i sgo nas tshogos gsog pa yang shugs kyis thon no/ /'ur rdo gcig gis bya brgya dus gag tu 'ded pa ltar thog mar skyabs su song ste gsol ba btab pas zhing khyad par can gyi mthus lam rnams rgyud la skye ba yin gyi/ dmigs skor tshan pa re re bzhin gyi mjug tu gsol 'debs kyi tshig brjod dgosapa ni min no/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa rnams nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i don yid la dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas tshig ngag tu lan gsum mam bdun gang yang rung ba brjod de sems bskyed pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i dge ba mtha' dag sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul dngos ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten/ zhes bsten bya dge ba'i bshesaganyen de nyid kyang lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum gyi (10ba〉sgo nas rgyud legs par dul zhing / mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa khyad par ba/ slob ma rnams—12

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 6)las ches lhag pa'i yon tan khyad par 'phags pa/ lung don rigs pas 'byed nus pa'i rnam dpyod kyis gdul bya'i rna bar snyan zhing yang dag pa'i lam la bkri bar mkhas pa/ rnyed bkur sogs la ltos pa med par 'gro ba nyam thag pa la brtse ba'i snying rje can/ gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la rtsol ba dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus/ yang yang 'chad pa la skyo ngal med pa'i dka' spyad khur du bzod pa'i yon to rnams mnga' ba'i bla ma dam pa des dam pa'i chos ston pa'i snod du gyur pa'i gdul bya ni bzhi brgya par/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad/ /smra po yon to rnam gzhan du/ /mi 'gyur nyan pa po la'ang min/ /zhes rang phyogs la chags shing gzhan phyogs la zhe sdang ba'i phyogs lhung dang bral zhing / nyes bshad dang legs bshad kyi blang dor 'byed nus pa'i blo gros can/ dam pa'i chos la don gnyer chen po dang ldan pa/ chos smra ba la gus shing yid legs par gtod pa ste yon to lnga dang ldan pa'i slob ma zhig dgos la/ de lta bu'i slob dpon dang slob ma zung du 'brel na gshog pa gnyis ldan gyi bya mkha' la 'phur ba la tshegs med pa bzhin rnam grol sgrub pa la de tsam gyi dka' ba min pas mtshan nyid de ldan gyi slob ma des kyang bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul la bsam pas bsten pa'i tshul dang / sbyor bas bsten pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ /dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /(11na skogs pa bsel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin/ /dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dang byed/ /nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsab yin/ /dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mi phyed pa'i dad pa zhig nges par sngon du 'gro ba gal che/de la yang bshes gnyen de skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan zhig tu mthong dgos pa la/ rtsod ldan dbang gis bla ma skyon dang yon tan 'dres/ /zhes 'o skol las ma dag pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang ba la skyon yon 'dres mar 'ong bas thog mar skyon rtog gi blo de dgag dgos/ de khegs na yon 13—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)tan kun dang ldan pa zhig shugs kyis 'ong ba las 'os med/ skyon rtog gi blo sel ba la yang dper na sman pa mkhas pas sman nus pa can btang bas tshe nad bag la zha ba rnams kyang bslang ste nad zug cung zad bskyed nas zhi 'gro ba ltar thog mar bla ma de'i mdzad pa skyon ltar snang ba rnams kyang ched du gnyer nas gsal 'debs dgos pa ni/ dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba sngar nas rang nyid la rgyus yod pa zhig gi spyod tshul rnams ched du ma brtags pa'i tshe lam me zhig las mi 'byung zhing / de la brten pa'i dug gsum gyi rtog pa rnams kyang mngon gyur du mi skye la/ de'i snang tshul la rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i tshul gyis dpyad pa na de dag gi bya byed bzang ngan rnams sngar 'das zin pa ma yin pa'i da lta byed bzhin pa lta bu'i snang ba 'char zhing / de la brten pa'i dga' sdug gi rtog pa lhan skyes su 'char ba bzhin/ ga re bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de'i sku'i dbyibs (11ba tshe gsung gi gdangs thugs dkyel che chung / mdor na 'byon bzhud na bza' bzhes tshul sogs phra mo rnams kyas mtha' brten pa'i mdzad pa bzang ngan 'bring gsum ci 'dra zhig yod pa thams cad yang yang gsal gdab cing rang babs su 'char bcug pa na snang tshul legs nyes mngon sum du da lta mdzad pa ltar lhang lhang gi 'char bas de ma byung gi bar du bsam/ de nas 'di ltar snang ba de bla ma la skyon yong nas snang ba yin nam med bzhin du snang ba gang yin snyam pa'i the tshom zhig shar byung ba na/ bla ma dam pa 'di nyid la nyes pa'i skyon de 'dra ga la mnga'/ rang nyid tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas las nyon gyi sgrib pas ha cang sbags ches pa'i mthus med bzhin du snang bar 'dug /dbang shes zhabrul pa'i ngor shin tu dkar ba'i gangs ri sngon por 'char ba dang / mkhris pa'i nad kyis gtses pa'i mig shes kyis dung ser por mthong ba dang khyad par ga la yod/ rang re dug gsum gyi gzhan dbang kho nar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams dang rigs mthun pa'i tshul gyis don mdzad pa la ma dag pa'i snang tshul de 'dra ched du gnyer nas ma bstan pa'i nges pa ci yod snyam du yang yang bsam/de yang blun sgom mos pa tsam gyi sgom gyis rkyen mi theg pas dpe dang gtan tshigs las nges —/4

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / smyon)pa rnyed dgos pa'i phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skyon kun zad yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa de la'ang legs skar dang lhas byin dang mu stegs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi skyon dang nyes pa'i gong bur mthong zhing / 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa khyi mo khog smad 'bus g.yengs par gzigs pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis slob dpon (12na〉ri jam dpal bshes gnyen khyim btsun rgyad po chos gos kyis thod byas nas rmo rmod cing rol nang gi sems can mang po chu nang du 'tshod pa/ nā ro pas te lo pa nya gson sreg byed pa/ dge tshul tshem bu bas rdo rje phag mo mdze mor mthong ba dang / yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las de bzhin gshegs pas bdud du sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par yang bshad pas rgyu mtshan de dag dang rang gi mthong tshul la khyad par med snyam du bsams pa na de'i gong du bla ma'i mdzad pa rnams la yid mi bde ba'i nag yor re ba'i rnam pa 'dra ba zhig yod pa de dpyad sgom gyi nyams len 'di dag la brten nas mun pa'i khung bur nyi ma'i zer zhugs pa bzhin du bla ma de skyon dang bral ba'i gsal sing nge ba'i rnam par 'char gsungs pa ni bsgoms na nges par las dang po ba la'ang nyams su myong nges su gda'/ de ltar nges pa'i don du bla ma de skyon dang mi ldan par yid ches rnyed pas yon tan kun tshang du shugs la rtogs na'ang rang gi blo shugs gang drag pa de'i nus pas de'i 'gal zlar gyur pa'i skyon yon mtha' dag zil gyis non 'gro ba chos nyid yin te/ bshes gnyen de la mkhas pa btsun pa grub pa bzang ba sogs tha na dngos po la zhen chags chung ba klog bzang lta bu'i yon tan sna re yod na'ang yon tan khyad par can 'di dang 'di 'dra ba mnga' snyam pa'i blo shugs drag pos yang yang bsams na ser sna'i dngos 'dzin che ba'am thos pa nyung ba sogs skyon gyi rigs yod tshe mnan te mi mngon pa lta bur 'gro ba ni gnam stong gi dus su zla ba mkha' la shar yang nyi ma'i 'od kyis bltar mi mngon pa dang mtshungs pas skyon gyi cha phra mo yang dgag gang thub (12brkong yon tan chung ngu la yang dad pa ci 'phel du bya ba ni rang la legs tshogs dngos grub thams cad gyi rtsa bar yod pas gnad shin tu che/—15—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)de ltar mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pa khyad par can ni rang nyid la dngos su bka' drin gyis phan par gyur pa min na'ang snyan pa'i grags pa thos pa tsam la yang 'byung mod/ gus pa chen po skyed par byed pa la bka' drin rjes su dran pa gal che bas skyon dang bral zhing yon tan ma lus pa dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa yod na'ang rang nyid skal pa dman pas de dag las bka' drin nod sa med la/ bdag gi bla ma dam pa 'dis dmu rgod gdul dka' ba'i 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i slad du dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi rang gzugs tha mal pa'i rnam par sprul nas byon pas skyon zad cing yon tan dang ldan pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas rnams dang khyad par ma mchis kyang / rang ngos nas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag ste/ spyir sangs rgyas rnams chos sku bde ba chen po'i ngang las g.yo ba med bzhin du byang sems 'phags pa gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi don du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam par ston/ sku de nyid yi rang dang so so skye bo rnams kyi yul du ma gyur pas 'dzam bu'i gling du mchog gi sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ sangs rgyas de rnams la nye ring yod pa'i dbang gis rang re rnams ched du gnyer nasayal bar dor ba ma yin yang brag phug kha byang bstan la nyi ma mi 'char ba bzhin rang nyid las dang skal ba med pa'i dbang gis sangs rgyas de rnams dngos su mjal ba dang gsung gi bdud rtsi myang ba'i snod du ma gyur pas (13na〉5tha' med kyi 'khor ba 'dir 'khor te sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa 'dir zad/ da res mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir bshes gnyen dam pa 'di rnams dang ma mjal na dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra tsam yang mi thos pa'i mi khom pa'i gnas su 'khyam dgos pa la/ sangs rgyas dposasu mjal yang de phan chad las 'gro rgyu med pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis legs par bstan cing thos/ rang gis nyams su len par nus na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob par ni the mi tshom/ tshe 'dir dgra dang nas sogs kyi 'jigs pa las skyob cing zas gosa'abyor ba ster bar byed pa la yang drin che bar byed na 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal sel ba —16

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenadang gtan gyi bde ba bla na med pa ster bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin 'di ni stong gsum gser gyis bkang yang gzhal bar ga la nus/ rang ngos nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad las bla ma dam pa bka' drin che zhing lhag par gdon mi za snyam pa'i gus pa dang dad pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nasabasam zhing / lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba dang mig nas mchi ma ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ spro bar 'dod na sdong po bkod pa las 'byung ba'i/ 'di ni bdag gi dge bshes chos smra ba/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gdangs snyan pos gsal 'debs kyi tshul du byed par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sbyor bas bsten tshul ni bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ 'dir mang smos pa ci zhig dgos/ /bla ma dgyes byed gang yin bya/ /mi mnyes byed kun spang ba ni/ /de dang de la 'bad de brtag /ces bshes gnyen dam pa de mnyes pa rnams bsgrub cing mi mnyes pa (13bsgoms spong ba zhig dgos pa yin pas sngon bdag cag gi ston pas tshigs bcad gcig thos pa'i don du sku lus la mar me stong btsugs pa/ lcags gzer stong btab pa/ bu dang btsun mo mnga' 'bangs longs spyod thams cad phul ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus 'phags pa chos 'phags/ nā ros te lo/ jo bo chen posabla ma gser gling pa la byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i don du rgya mtsho chen por dka' ba sbyad pa/ 'byom gyis jo bo/ bses 'byog mi/ mi las mar pa bsten pa sogs dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa la lus longs spyod thams cad la ltos pa med par dka' ba spyad pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ bla ma de zang zing gi dngos po sogs la gzigs pa min na'ang / gnas skabs su de dag la ltos pa ltar mdzad pa ni gdul bya tsho gis rdzogs pa la dgongs pa yin pas/ de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu phul ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de phul bsod nams tsho gis yin te/ /tsho gos las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che bsgrub pa'i slad du rang nyid kyi gces nor yod rgu mtha' dag dbul zhing / bya bar dka' ba'am byed du mi rung ba 'dra zhig gyis gsung yang 'di bdag la phan pa zhig yod par gor ma chag snyam du tsham tshom med par 'jug pa'am/ ye nas mi 'grub cing —17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)mi rung ba zhig 'dug na/ rigs pa yis ni mi nus na/ /mi nus de la tshig gis sbyang / /zhes bshad sbyang legs par byed pa zhig dgos kyi ji mi snyam par 'jog pa ye mi rung / gtso bo ni sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par gsungs pas ji ltar bstan pa'i chos rnams thos bsam sgom gsum gyis(14na)gtan la 'bebs dgos par gda'/ de ltar tshul bzhin ma bsten na nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang /bsten na legs tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su 'gyur bar sdong po bkod pa'i mdo dang lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs pa gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las gsungs pa la nges shes rnyed nas tshig tsam du ma lus par lag tu len pa zhig dgos na'ang rtag tu ngu ltar lus srog la ltos pa med par gtong ba sogs ni las dang po ba rnams kyis dngos su sgrub mi nus pas smon lam gyi yul du bya zhing / sgrub par nus pa rnams kyang yul dus gnas skabs dang bstun te lag tu blang ba las 'khrid dmigs kyi lag len la nges par sbyor mi dgos pas de dag gi don bsdus te nyams su blang ba ni byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sa bcad du/ skyong tshul mdor bsdus te bstan pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi don yin pas sbyor ba'i nyams len dngos gzhi la ngos 'dzin dgos shing / 'khrid gzhung rnying pa na 'di la bshes gnyen bsten pa'i sngon 'gro zhes ming 'dogs mdzad de thog mar byung na'ang / gong gi dpyad sgom de rnams rgyud la skye ba'i sngon 'gro'i tshogs gsog tu dgongs par snang la/deng sang go rim de ltar phyag len du mi mdzad do/ /de yang mgon po gser gling pa'i rnam par thar pa yin pas gnas khang byi dor byas la dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram/ ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham/ bde ba'i stan la bag med pa'i 'dug tshul ma yin pa'i skyil mo krung ngam skyil krung phyed pa sogs kyi spyod lam gang yang rung bas 'khod de nyams su len pa la 'khrid yig rnying pa na/(14ba)su bhā wa'i sngags kyis sbyangs te dam tshig pa bskyed par gsungs pa 'jam dpal dbyangasastag lung brag pa blo gros rgya mtsho'i gsung rgyun du rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po 'jam dbyangs su bskyed de gsol 'debs kyi tshul du dhī mang du bgrang ba/ 'khrid yig la la na bla ma thub dbang dang rdo rje 'chang —18

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 6)du bskyed pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma phyi nang mang por byas te de'i steng tu bla ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha ltar dgod pa/ g.yas g.yon du gral chig sbreng ba'i byas pa'i tsho gi bka'atsho gis pa'i rnam pa lta bu sogs phyag len mang du 'dug pa rnams gsang sngags kyi shan shor bas lugs srol 'di ga'i phyag len dang cung zad mi mthun par gda'/'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i tshogs zhing rnams sman bla'i mdo chog las khrung ba bzhin gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab cing mgron thabs su spyan 'dren pa yin pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing chos dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / bdag gi dad mos kyi mthu las sag dang khri sogs byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /ces sogs brjod cing / gnas dang khamasabyin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'i rin po che'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar khod snyoms pa'i steng du seng shes bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yid du 'ong ba g.yas g.yon rnams su rin po che'i khri rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa rgyab mdun dang mtho dma'i rnam pas bang rim gyi dbyibs lta bu bkod bsamadzes pa zhig gsal gdab/ gser zhun ma las 'byung ba ltar/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes tshad (15na〉ped 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis spyan drangs pas chos 'di ston pa'i drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la rgya chen spyod brgyud dang zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ de'i mtha' theg pa gsum gyi slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge 'dun sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa lta bus bskor te ma ga dha bzang mo'i gtam rgyud las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin byon nas stan bshams pa rnams la bzhugs par mos/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /sogs kyis khrus khang bskyed/ rang gi lus brgya stong khri 'bum sogs blos gang —/9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lcogs su sprul nas dri bzang po'i chus bkang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa thogs te/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni//zhes sogs dang /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang //sogs dang phar phyin drug spur ba'i tshigs bcad so gos rgya sdus skabs sbyar gyis khrus gsol/ de yang tshogasazhing rnams la mi gtsang ba'i dri mas sbags pa don la med kyang 'gro ba ma dag pa'i snang ngor yod pa ltar snang ba rnams sel ba'i ched du yin la/khrus bsku mnye grib phyi bsnyung g.yog sogs dang de'i yon to brjod pa sogs zhes ba bla ma'i drung du yod na de dag dngos su bya dgos pas 'dir de'i dod thub dang 'og nas yang ba phal cher yang sngar bshad pa'i zang zing gi mchod pa'i sgo nas mnyes par byed pa'i thabs yin no//stong 5bsko sum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi//zhes sogs kyis dri bzang /srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos//zhes so gos kyis na bza'/bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir//sogasakyis tshogis kyi zhing du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/de nas bsag sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa'i thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/skyabs yul gyi dmigs pa rnams ma dor ba'i nga nas phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas te/'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das//zhes sogs rgya chen spyod brgyud dang zab mo lta brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs so sgo rje bla ma'i bar yongs grags ltar la/mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge'i zhabs//thams cad ma' dngos dge 'dun grub pa dang //sku gsum gong 'phang ma' gyur nor bu bzang //dpal ldan bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs//dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sde//smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po/ mkhas grub lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang ste/ /bshes gnyen dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs//phyag na pad+ma bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs//zab don gdamasapa'i bka' babs cho med pa la bzang //rigs kun bdag po snang mdzad rdo rje'i zhabs//mkhas grub chen po gsum la gsol ba 'debs//bka' drin mnyam med shrī bhū ti'i mtshan//ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde//zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi ༷nga mdzod can//dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin tshogs

byang chus lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenal gsol ba 'debs//zhes pa gsol 'debs phyag 'tshal du 'don pa bsgyur/ji snyed su dag cesasogs kyis rgyal pa sras bcas spyan drangs pa rnams la phyag bya/mchod pa'i thog mar maṇ+ḍal ni/ 16namaṇ+ḍal gyi rgyu rin po che nas bzung /ma 'byor na g.yam pa sogs la tshom bu dgod rgyu'i 'bru sogs sta gon byas la/thog mar tshom bu sgo bdun la grangs ji ltar 'dod pa dang /mang khyad tshom bu bdun mgatso bor byas te grangs nyer gcig nas brgya'i bar sogs tshig dang dmigs pa bstun nas dbul/bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i dus 'dir dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa nas 'bru gcig tsam yang med cing lus ngag gi ngal ba cung zad tsam yang mi bsten par mos pa dang ting 'dzin kho nas byed pa skad du smra ba ni/po to ba'i zhal nas/dung phor dri ma can zhig tu spang spos re btab nas/tsan dan ga bur spos kyi chu//zhes dmus long gis mig ldan la mgo skor byed gsungs pa dang mtshudas la/'byor ba yod bzhin du ser sna dang snyom las kyi dbang gis ga pa dang nyung ngu dang gtan med du byed pa ni snying thag pa nas chos dang gang zag la dad pa ma thob pa'i nang rtags phyir shar bar zad do//deng sang ni chos lag tu blangs te nyams len rnal ma byed pa nyin mo'i skar ma lta bu dang /gal te byed pa srid mtha' tsam la yang tsū dal yul gyi rkang gnyis pa ltar mi gseb tu mi 'gre zhing /nged rnams de 'dra'i lag len gti thug khrigs kyi bar bkab byed kyin med zer ba dang /chos kyi bla ma brgyud pa yang gcig nas gnyis su bgrang rgyu med pa la kha po dang ngo sor khyer te gnyi'i yul gyi rgyal phran 'ga' zhig gis pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga rdung ba lta bu ches mang bas ci brtol gyi snying khams bskyed pa de 'dra ye mi rung /mchod pag rnams kyang /mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang //16bzhes sogs kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang /gzhan yang tshigs bcad ci rigs pa'i sgo nasa'adod yon lnga dang rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa rnams kyang dbul/thun je mang du song ba dang rgyun gyi nyams len la cung zad 'byer bde bar byed tshe/me lha go dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang //zhes sogs tsam gyis mchod pa'i yan lag ste dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa gang phul ba mtha' dag mchod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)pa'i yul rnams la sred pa med na'ang rang gi tshogs rdzogs pa'i slad du dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas longs spyad par bsam/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /zhes sogs kyis sgo gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /zhes sogs kyis skye 'phags thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la rjes su yi rang ba'i dga' ba bsgoms pas de dag gis dge ba byas pa'i bsod nams la mnya 4 por longs spyad du yod do/ /gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /zhes sogs kyis chos 'khor bskor ba dang / mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /zhes sogs kyis mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ste/ 'di gnyis ka la tshogs zhid rnams la gsol ba btab pa bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes byung snyam pa'i mos pa brtan po dgos gsung / phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /zhes sogs ni gong du bshad pa'i yan lag drug po mtha' dag gi dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'i yan lag yin pas/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi (17nasgo dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces dge ba chud mi za zhing rgya cher 'phel ba'i gnad zab pa zhig 'dir gda' 'o/ /'khrid gzhung rnying pa na spyi bshags sogs bya bar gsungs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur na'ang 'og tu rgyas par 'byung bas 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te deng sang phyag len du mi mdzad do/ /bshad ma thag pa'i sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i dmigs skor 'di nas bzung ste lhag mthong gi bar gyi dmigs rim mtha' dag go rim ma 'chol zhing snga phyi la ltos pa'i rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba sogs phyag len dang gsung rgyun nges par mthong ba brgyud pa la ltos dgos pas deng sang sbyor gzhung gi ṭī ka thal 'dzin pa ltar rang gang 'dod kyi hor khongs sogs byas na dge sbyor mtha' dag skyon can du 'gro ba lam rim che chung las gsungs pas blo ldan rnams zhib mor spyod pa gnad du che mod/ 'on kyang deng dus dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis dmar 'khrid bstan pa la ma bltos pa'i dpe cha la bla ma —22

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 6)bcol nas nyams su len pa skad byed pa mtha' dag ni skyon can gyi dge sbyor rang nyid ngal ba'i 'bras bu tsam du zad do/ /de yang shes bzhin gyi bya ra brtan pos spyod lam mtha' dag dman lhag tu ma song ba'i sgo nas thun dngos gzhi la dmigs skor dngos/ thun mtshams su de dag rgyas bshad lam gyi rim pa che chung sogasabalta dgos kyi/ sems rgya yan la btang na yon tan gyi bogs shin tu chung gsung / de yang bshes gnyen bsten pa nas byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i bar rnams dpyad sgom gtso che ba dang zhi (17ba〉gnas sogs la 'jog sgom gtso che yang / dper na bshes gnyen bsten pa'i chos skor lta bu'i tshe bla ma'i yon tan bsam pa sogs dpyad sgom dang / de'i mthar rtog pa g.yin rnams bag la zha ste dad pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni 'jog sgom dang / zhi gnas sgom tshul gyi gnad la yang yang sems pa ni dpyad sgom dang rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni 'jog sgom yin pas gnad de dag ma go bar der dpyad pa mi byed par sgom pa kho na byed zer ba sogs ni rang la tshad ldan gyi sgom med pa gsal bar byed pa ste/mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las kyang yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /zhes pas mtshon te gzhung chen po rnams las rgya cher bshad do/ /smras pa/ kye ma bkres skom gdung bas nyam thag par/ /zas gos lor bas phan pa bsgrub pa dang / /'gal zla'i dgra yis gtses las skyob byed dpon/ /drin can yin par sems shing smra byed na/ /mtha' med 'khor bar sdug bsngal rnam gsum gyis/ mnar ba'i 'jigs pa kun las rab bsgral te/ /gtan bde'i nor bu lag mthil rdzas bzhin du/ /ston byed yongs 'dzin bka' drin gzhal nus su/ /zhi bde'i go 'phang tsam yang rnyed dka' na/ /skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes/ /grangasaring bskal par 'thob dka'i sgra bo cher/ /'god mdzad dus gsum rgyal pa'i spyi gzugs dngos/ /rang sems log par 'brul ba'i shes ngo la/ /rang skyon bla ma'i mdzad par shar ba kun/ /rang snying gting —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)nas rul bar nges pa yis/ /rang mtshang yin par (18na〉ko nas dug bzhin spongs/ sgyu mdzad legs par mthong ba'i dag snang dang / /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mos gus kyis/ /ci byas chos su 'gro ba'i zab gnad de/ /ci bsams ba pa'i phan bde'i rtsa bar go /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsten nas blo ji ltar sbyang ba'i rim pa la dal pa'i rten la snying po blang ba'i phyir du bskul ba dang / snying po ji ltar len pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la dal 'byor ngos gzung ba/don che bar bsam pa/ rnyed dka' bar bsam pa dang gsum/ dang po ni bshes springs las/ log par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro dang / /yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba dang / /rgyal pa'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu/ /kla klor skye dang glen zhing lkugs pa nyid/ /tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung bar ni/ /skye ba zhes bgyi mi khom skyon brgyad bo/ /de dag dang bral khom pa brnyes nas ni/ /skye ba bzlog pa'i slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /ces log lta can/ ngan 'gro gsum/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ yul mtha' 'khob/ glen lkugs/ lha tshe ring po ste mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral ba'i dal ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /ces mir skyes pa/ yul dbus su skyes pa/ dbang po tshang ba/ las mtha' ma log pa/ gnas la dad pa ste rang 'byor lnga dang /sangs rgyas byon dang dam chos ston/ /bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas byon nas mya ngan las ma 'das pa/ sangs rgyas de'am (18bti'i nyan thosakyis cho rtsi/ston bzhin pa/ sangs rgyas bzhugs dus kyi sgrub pa'i bstan pa ma nyams par gnas pa/cho ge bstan pa des gang zag dman pas 'bras bu thob pa mthong bas rkyen byas te gzhan rjes su 'jug pa/ gzhan gyis snying brtse bar byed pa ste gzhan 'byor lnga dang bcas pa'i chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus 'di bdag gis thob 'dug snyam pa'i g.yam la rgyug tsam ma yin par kha nang du bltas te dpyad pa na/ rang nyid mir skyes pasang na song gsum dang lha yin min gyi rtog dpyod ma dgos kyang / 24

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenatshe snga phyi las 'bras dkon mchog rnams la nges shes yod na log lta can ma yin zhing / bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i bstan pa gnas na rgyal ba'i bka' yang yod/ bod gangs can 'dir 'khor rnam bzhi ma tshang yang dge slong pha yod na don gyis yul dbus yin/ gsung rab kyi tshig don cung zad go na glen lkugs min pa ste dal ba brgyad/ sbyin mi lus thob pa/ khyad par cho me tshigs kyis phye ba'i yul dbus su skyes pa/ dbang po sgo lnga tshang ba/ mtshams med lnga ma byas pa/ sde snod gsum la dad pa thob pa/ gzhan 'byor dang po bzhi dngos bstan dka' yang don gyis tshang ba sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ des dam pa'i chos gsungs pa/ gsungs pa'i bstan pa ma nyams par gnas pa/ bstan pa de la rang nyid zhugs pa/ spyin bdag sogs kyis rang la zas gosakyis mtsho ni pa'i mthun rkyen ster ba ste 'byor ba bcu dang bcas pa'i dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad po da lta rang gis thob pa'i mi lus 'di la tshang ngam ma tshang snyam du bsams nas tshang 'dug na de la yid dga' ba lhang ba zhig (19nasgo skyes kyi bar du bsgom dgos te/ da lta ma brtags pa'i dus na dal 'byor dang ldan pa'i mir rlom pa mtha' dag brtags shing dpyad na ma tshang ba ni shin tu mang gsung /gnyis pa ni/ dal 'byor gyi rten tshang ba la yid dga' ba thob na'ang yid dga' ba'i rgyu mtshan de nyid ma bsams na rang la mi phan pa'i dngos po zhig rnyed kyang ser sna can spro ba 'phel ba dang 'dra ba'i dga' ba tsam du zad la/ 'di de lta bu dang mi 'dra ba'i don ldan du nges par bya ba la slob spring las/bde gshegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa/ /lam de lha dang klu yis rnyed min lha min dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyesamin/ /zhesang na song gsum ni mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin la gtso bor spyod/ rten de la las gsog pa'i nus pa ha cang mi che/ lha rnams ni dge ba'i rnam smin la longs spyod kyang las gsog pa'i mthu chung /mi rnams ni las dge sdug gsog pa'i nus pa stobs che zhing khyad par rang cag 'dzam bu gling pa rnamasani las kyi sa pa yin pas blang dor ma nor ba'i 'dun ma zhig byas tshe mngon mtho lha mi'i lus rten/ nyan —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)rang gi myang 'das/ 'gro ba rnams bde bar gshegs pa'i sar 'khrid pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyasakyi go 'phang rnams phul du byung ba 'grub pas bdag gis thob pa 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu las kyang ches lhag pa zhig rnyed 'dug go snyam du bsams pa na sngar ma grub pa'i don chen zhig 'grub bo snyam nas dbul pos gter rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' ba lhang gis ma byung gi bar du (19ba tha sgom mo/gsum pa la dpe/ rgyu/ ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyod 'jug las/ rgya mtsho cher g.yengs gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /zhes rgya mtsho chen por gser gyi gnya' shing bug pa gcig pa zhig rlung gis bskul te phyogs kun tu g.yeng ba'i tshe lo brgya brgya tsam na rus sbal long ba zhig mtsho'i steng du 'ong ba na mgrin pa bug pa der chud pa srid pa tsam du gsungs shing de las gsal ba'i dpe mngon sum gyis grub pa gyang logs kyi ngos su sran ma sbar gang gtor na der chags pa shin tu dkon/ gal te re re tsam chags pa byung tshe bdag gis lus grangs med cing blangs pa'i mi khom pa'i gnas su skyes pa ni sran ma sa la lhung ba rnams dang / dal 'byor gyi mi lus ni gyang logs la chags pa'i sran ma dang tshul mtshungs par 'dug go snyam nas dpe don rgyud thog tu 'phrod nges shig sbyar te bsgoms pa na/ da res stes cung zad legs pa ma gtags g.yang la de'u lhung zer ba lta bu'i dus su 'char ba'i dga' 'jigs kyi blo gnyis ka bcos min du skye ba yin no/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/ spyir bde 'gro tsam 'thob pa la tshul khrims sna gcig yan chad srung dgos/ khyad par dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'thob pa la/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyisabade/ /zhes tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyor dgos pa la/ de rnams sgrub pa'i rten ngan song gsum la dge sems mngon gyur tsam yang skye dka'/ lha rnams kyang ting nge 'dzin dang (20na 'dod pa'i bde bas g.yel/ mi la yang chos ma dar ba'i yul du dge ba'i sgra tsam yang thos pa min zhing / yul de nas kyi phung po tsam gyi tshod du byas pa'i chos dar ba'i yul ni nas lū gcig tsam du snang / da lta rang re bod kyi yul la mtshon —26

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / (na)na skye bo khri phrag mang po tshogs pa'i khrod du tshul khrims bsrung bar khas 'che ba ni shin tu nyung / de'i nang nas kyang gong gi phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu gsum ga tshang ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam du 'dug /de ltar kha phyir bltas kyi shes pa de kha nang du log ste rang la bltas pa na chos byed pa'i mos blo yam me ba zhig las blo bde nges pa'i dge ba'i grangs 'dren rgyu ni shin tu nyung / sdig pa mi dge ba ni zhar byung du'ang bsags pa'i rgyu 'dis da res kyi tshe 'khas 'di la btsan sa zhig ma zin na slad nas mi lus 'thob par mi 'dug /'thob tu re ba'i blo 'di dpyid ka nyungs kar btab nas ston nas bsdu rtsis byed pa dang 'dra bas col re chung snyam du myong ba ma thon bar du bsgom/gsum pa ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ dbyar dus kyi srin bu shin tu mang ba'i sa phyar ba tsam gyi steng du rang nyid dngos su yod pa lta bu'i 'du shes dang bcas te/ ga re dud 'gro 'i las ya dwags kyi 'gro ba mang / de las dmyal ba'i 'gro ba mang / dud 'gro la yang byings na gnas pa/ gling bar gyi mun pa na yod pa lta bu'i tshod na kha 'thor ba'i dud 'gro ni ches nyung mod/ 'on kyang sa phyar ba tsam gyi steng du dud 'gro chung ngu bgrang gis mi langs pa lta bu yod na'ang mi bcu skor tsam las mi shong ba dang / yul grong re la mi ji ltar mang yang 'bum phrag brgal ba cher mi 'ong la srog chags phra mo ni bgrang (20ba〉bar mi nus pa sogs rjes su dpag pa'i tshad mas gzhal mi dgos par mkhas blun kun la mngon sum du grub pa dang / bde 'gro'i lus rten la ltos te yang mi lus/ de'i nang nas kyang chos dang mjal ba'i mi lus dkon/ mjal du zin kyang nyan na tshig mi zin/ bsams na don mi go /bsgoms na rgyud la mi skye ba'i gang zag mang / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi blo gros dang ldan yang tshe 'di'i 'dun ma kho na sgrub pa ches mang
