'di nas phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba med par chad par lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can de mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ 'jig lta mthar lta log lta gsum po gang rung dang / de dag gang la brten nas 'byung ba'i phung po la dmigs nas mchogo tu 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa/ rang gi blo ngor (46bsko rna tshul spangs pa'i tshul khrimasadang / skra bregs pas g.yang gzhi dang keng rus 'chang ba/ zas gcod pa me lnga bsten pa rkang pa gcig gis 'greng ste nyi ma la blta ba/ gcer bu lus la thal ba byugs shing ngag mi smra ba lta bu'i brtul zhugasadang / de dag gang la brten nas khrung ba'i phung po la dmigs nas grol ba thob par 'dod pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ de yang 'di ni tshul khrims rnam dag la rlom pa'i mchog 'dzin min gyi/ so skye tha mal ba mngon shes thob nas tshe snga ma khyi phag gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa lta bu mthong bas rgyu des mi lus thob par bzung nas da lta brtul zhugs de 'dzin pa sogs log lta zhig dgos gsung / las 'bras dang tshe snga phyi med ces skur ba 'debs shing / 'jig rten 'chags 'jig tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug sogs kyis byas par 'dod pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de log lta yin no/ /de ltar nyon mongs pa gzhan rnams kyang tshig bshar dang skyor sbyang tsam du song ba yin pa'i re re bzhin nas rang rgyud la mngon gyur tu skyed bcug nas/ rjes su 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par skyes ma thag nas ngos 'dzin pa la dka' ba med pa sngar 'dris kyi mi khrom khri phrag tshogs pa'i khrod nas kyang —66

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 'on)mthong ba tsam gyis ngo shes pa lta bu zhig ma byung na dgra ngo ma shes par khroms gseb tu long mda' 'phen pa dang 'dra gsung/ de yang nyon mongs pa bcu po gang rung re mngon gyur tu skyes na cung zad ngo 'phrod pa sla na'ang / ldan pa dang 'dus pa'i nad sman pa rnams kyis ngos 'dzin cung dka' ba ltar nyon mongs pa gnyis ldan (47na〉gsum ldan gyi tshul du mngon gyur tu skyes na nyams 'og tu chud dka' ba shing rta lta bu la 'dod chags kyi blo mngon gyur bas thob tu re ba'i tshe gzhan gyis btsan thabs su khyer na de la zhe sdang skye/ zhe snang che chung gi rgyu shing rta la dmigs pa'i 'dod chags che chung gis byed cing /yan lag bdun tsam tshogs pa la kho rang gi ngos nas shing rtar 'dzin pa'i bden lta/ de la mchog tu 'dzin pa sogs dus gcig la nyon mongs pa bzhi tsam mngon gyur tu skye bas zhib mor dpyad de ngo 'phrod pa byed dgos la/ nyen mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa dang 'jig lta gnyis gcig tu byas kyang 'gal ba med mod/ spu ris khed tshe so sor bya ste/ dper na thag pa'i gnas lugs mi gsal bar byed pa'i mun pa de ma rig pa dang / de la brten nas thag pa la sbrul du 'dzin pa'i blo de 'jig lta lta bu yin pas 'di gnyis kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba byas nas chags sdang gi dbang gis nyes pa thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir/ rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes/ /bdag gzhan cha las won dang sdang / /'di dag dang ni yongs 'brel las/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar nyes pa ma lus pa bskyed pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa 'di da lta cung zad 'go gnon pa'i lugs su byas kyang/ rtsa ba nas drungs 'byin par ma nus na me long la 'char ba'i gzugs brnyan ltar bag la nyal ba des nyon mongs pa 'phel ba'i rten byed/ me long dang byad bzhin phrad pa na de ma thag (47ba〉gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin dgra gnyen sogs yul sna tshogs la brten nas mngon gyur tu skye ba'i dmigs pa'i sgo nas nyone mongs pa 'phel bar byed/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang grogs chos byed las ring du 'gyur zhing nyon mongs pa shin tu che ba'i grogs ngan pa'i gtam dang kun spyod —67—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)sogs kyi 'du 'dzi la brten nas nyon mongs pa 'phel bar byed/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogasakyis nyone mongs pa ma spangs bzhi du thar pa thob pa skad kyi bshad pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa 'phel bar byed/ kha rtan sogs shin tu byang ba zhig sems rgya yan du btang yang ngag nas thogs med du 'gro ba bzhin sngar nas ha cang 'dris pas goms pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa 'phel bar byed/gang zag 'dis phan gnod 'di ltar byas snyam pa lta bu'i chags sdang gis sgro sna tshogs 'dogs pa dang / mi 'dis sdig pa chen po byas song yang da lta skyid par 'dug pas las 'bras mi bden snyam pa lta bu'i tshul min yid byed kyi sgo nas nyon mongs pa 'phel bar byed pas rgyu drug po 'di dag ngos zin par byas nas ldong dam sar dgra la bsgugs rgyag pa lta bu'i nyams len zhig ma byung bar nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur na 'di phyi thams cad du sdig pa sna tshogs pa bskyed nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la sbyor zhing mya ngan las 'das pa las ring du byed par gda' bas sngon chad 'di la grogs su bzung bas bdag rgud pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar song 'dug /tshe 'di'i gnod pa cung zad byas pa la'ang dgra zhes snying na na ltar byed na/ tshe rabs thog ma med (48na)pa nas da lta'i bar sdug bsngal kho na la sbyor pa'i dgra nyon mongs pa 'di la nus pa thon pa zhig ci'i phyir mi byed/ 'di 'joms par byed pa'i gnyen po yang yang bsten nas drungs phyung na dgra g.yin ltar kho slar bldab rgyu med pas/ tha mal dgra bo yul nas phyung yang ni/ /yul g.yin dag tu gnas shing yongs bzung nas/ /nus pa brtas nas de nas phyir ldog gi /nyon mongs dgra tshul de dang 'dra ma yin/ /nyon mongs nyon mongs shes rab mig gis spangs/ /bdag yid las bsal gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang du gnas nas bdag gnod bya phyir 'ong / /blo zhan bdag la brtson pa med par zad/ /ces so/ /de ltar las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba blangs pa rnams ni 'chi 'pho ba dang nying mtshams sbyor ba las ma 'das/ de la yang tshe zad nas dus la bab pa'i 'chi ba/ zas dang spyod lam sogs log pasaglo bur du 'chi ba'i rkyen dgu mdo las gsungs pa sogs rnam grangs mang na yang / 'chi kha dang shi —68

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenazin pa'i 'og tu phan gnod byed pa ni sngar bshad pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams kyis sems pa'i las dang bsam pa'i las gnyis kyi dge mi dge'i las bsags pa la brten nas bde sdug 'byung ba yin la/de yang tshe 'dir dge ba stobs cher byed pa zhig mnga' thang dang lus srog la gnod pa dang 'chi khar gnad gcod chen po 'byung ba yang srid la/ sdig pa shas cher spyod pa la bde ba phun sum tsho gos pa 'byung ba yang yod pas blun po la la/ las 'bras mi bden pa 'di lta bu'o zhes lo go rtog byed pa (44)'byung mod/ de dag ni tshe sngon ma'i dge sdig stobs chen po'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir ma smin pa'i nges pa'ang ci yod/ rnam pa gcig tu na spyod 'jug las/ bsad bya'i mi zhig lag bcad de/ /gal te thar na cis ma legs/ /gal te mi yi sdug bsngal gyis/ /dmyal ba bral na cis ma legs/ /ches/srog la 'bab pa'i nyes pa zhig lag pa bcad pas thar ba bzhin phyi ma dmyal bar skye dgos pa zhig mi'i rten la sdug bsngal myong bas go chod pa lta bu dang / sgra sgrog gi rgyal po gtsug phud can gyis 'phags pa kā t+ya ya na la thal ba gtor bas thog mar rin po che sogs kyi char babs kyang rjes su sa char babs pa'i 'og tu non pa lta bus shes nus la/ khyad par skye ba de ma thag pa de bde 'gro dang ga 'gro gang du skye ba chos ma' pa las/ las kyis 'khor bar lci gang dang / /nye ba gang dang goms pa gang / /sngon byas gang yin de dag las/ /snga ma snga ma rnam smin 'gyur/ /zhes dge mi dge'i las sna tsho gis rang rgyud la yod bzhin pa na tshe der dge sdig gang la goms pa shas che ba'i sems 'chi kha'i gnas skabs su yang 'ong bas phyi dbugs chad kha'i gnas skabs kyi 'chi sems de rags pa dang / phyi dbugs chad cing nang dbugs ma chad pa'i bar der 'chi sems phra mo yin/ 'chi sems rags pa'i skabs dgra gnyen la chags sdang sogs mi dge ba'i sems dang / dkon mchog rjes su dran pa sogs dge ba'i sems sngar goms pa gang che rang stobs kyis dran pa dang / la la nad kyi dbang gis mi gsal ba rnams la grogs kyis dge ba'i gtam sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gsos btab ste/ dper (49na sko sdig pa yang lci cha snyoms pa dang 'chi kha'i dus 'bras bu nye ring med pa la goms pa gtso che bas /sdig pa —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)chen po spyod pa'i mi yang 'chi khar dge sems mngon gyur gyi ngang nas shi na bde 'gror skye zhing / dge ba stobs chen bsags kyang 'chi khar sdig sems mngon gyur byung na ngan 'gror skye ba'i gnad 'gag cig 'dir snang mod/ 'on kyang rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur bas sngar byas kyi las rnams dran pasadaga' ba dang 'gyod pa gang rung 'ong ba'i phyir na dge sdig gi rnam dbye mi shes pa'i sdig can zhig la'ang tshe 'dir goms pa shas che ba'i sdig sems de ga 'byung ba las 'os med/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs 'i mtshan dang gzungs sngags khyad par can gyis ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las bzlog pa'i phan yon ni che'o/ /'chi sems phra mo'i dus su dge mi dge'i snang ba gang yang mi 'char bas lung ma bstan gyi sems yin/ de yang spyir btang la dge ba byed pa rnams gnad gcod chung zhing gzugs yid du 'ong ba rmi lam lta bur mthong ba dang mun pa'i khrod nas snang bar 'gro ba lta bu 'byung la/ mi dge ba byed pa rnams ni de las go ldog /dge sdig can gang yang 'chi kha'i tshe da ni 'chi ba 'dug snyam pa'i lus la chags pa drag po zhig skyes pas rgyu byas/ rnam shes 'phos pa dang mnyam du srang mda'i mtho dma' ltar bar do'i lus gang du skye 'gyur gyi byad dbyibs can du grub ste/ dmyal ba'i bar do ni sdong dum mes la sko pa/ dud 'gro'i bar do ni du ba/ yi dwags kyi bar do ni chu/ 'dod lha dang mi'i bar do gser/ gzugs khams pa'i bar do kha dog dkar (49ba)po'i rnam ba can/ lha'i bar do gyen/ mi'i bar do thad ldog song gi bar do thur du 'gro zhing / zhag zhedagu oṃ la pha ma nyal po byed pa sgyu ma bzhi du mthong ste/ der chags sdang gi dbang gis zhugs pas nying mtshams sbyor zhing / dmyal bar skye ba lta bu la srog gcod pa'i yul gyi sems can mthong bas rkyen byas te skye ba sogs mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar 'khyams tshul la nges 'byung ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /smras pa/ sngon thog med dus nas rang sems dang / dus skad cig 'bral ba med pa yi/ /grogasanyon mongs 'di go bsten bsten pas/ /mtha' mi mngon 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bskyur/ /las mi 'bod rlung gis rab bskyod nas/ /yongs sdug bsngal gsum gyi rba klong du/ /dus gtan du mgal me ltar —70

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhana'akhor ba//'di bsams kyin nyon mongs dwangs ma'i dgra//tshe 'di snang dgra zhig bsad pa la//rang go chod dpa' bor rlom byed na//dus gtan gyi dgra bo nyon mongs 'di//da gdul ba'i dus la ngesapar bab//rten dal 'byor mi lus legs thob cing //lam bslab gsum gnad 'gag shes dus 'dir/khong kun 'byung dpung tshogs ma bcom na//slar skye 'chi'i thang la 'o brgyal dogs//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gnyis pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bsam pa ni/ma rig pa ni mun pas phyi rol gyi gzhi gsami mthong bar byed pa lta bu/de la las 'bras la rmonges pa dang de kho na nyid la rmongs pa gnyis yod pa'i de gnyis gang rung las 'du byed kyi las dkar nag bsags 50na ) pa la brten nas bde 'gro dang ngan 'gror 'phen pa yin pas 'phen tshul ni/'phen byed kyi rgyu/'grub byed kyi rgyu/'phangs pa'i 'bras bu/grub pa'i 'bras bu dang bzhin yod pa'i bde 'gro la mtshon na/rang gi skye ba snga ma'i dge ba'i las kyi kun slong du gyur pa de kho na nyid la rmongs shing las 'bras la ma rmongs pa'i ma rig pa'i rten 'brel des kun nas bslang ste bsags pa'i 'dod khams kyi sa sa bsdus pa'i dge ba'i las 'du byed kyi rten 'brel de nyid kyis rgyu dus kyi rnam par shes pa'i rten 'brel la bag chags bzhag pa ni 'phen byed kyi rgyu'o//de ltar las kyi bag chags bsgos pa de la mngon par 'grub pa'i ched du tshor ba bde ba dang mi 'bral zhing sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod kyi sred pa'i rten 'brel dang /de bzhin du 'dun zhing chags par byed pa len pa'i rten 'brel gnyis kyis gsos btab pas yang srid phyi ma 'dren pa'i srid pa'i rten 'brel mthu can du gyur pa gsum po 'di 'grub byed kyi rgyu yin la/de la brten nas rgyu dus kyi rnam par shes pa skye ba 'di'i ma'i mngal du nying mtshams sbyar bas 'bras dus kyi rnam par shes pa tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnams kyi phung po ni ming gi rten 'brel/pha ma'i khu khrag gam drod gsher lta bu gzugs kyi rten 'brel te de gnyis bsdoms pas ming gzugs kyi rten 'brel/de nas mig la sogs pa'i skye mched drug grub pa skye mched drug gi rten 'brel de las cher song ba na yul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus nas yid du 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum pa la reg cing spyod pa reg pa'i rten 'brel/de ltar spyad pa la brten nas tshor ba bde sdug 50ba tha tang snyoms gsum skye ba ni tshor ba'i rten 'brel te bzhi po 'di 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu/skye gnas bzhi por rnam shes nying mtshams sbyar zin pa de phyir btsas pa skye ba'i rten 'brel/skyes pa'i phung po na rdzo smin par gyur pa rga ba dang /phung po dor ba ni shi ba ste rga shi'i rten tshol gnyis po mngon par grub pa'i gos bu yin pas de ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis la brten nas bde 'gro dang ga 'gror 'khor ba'i tshul legs par bsgoms na skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis ka'i chos skor gyi gnad rnams tshang zhing /dge ba'i bshes gnyen phu chung pa chen pos rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog la brten pa'i blo sbyong mdzad pa yin no//deng sang phyag len du skyes bu chung tshong gi lam la sngar bshad pa ltar khrid nas/blo yangs pa rnams la rten 'brel bcu gnyis gyi rim pa snying po bsdus tsam gyi dmigs skor gsung zhing /blo 'bring man chad la chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bas 'di pa'i dmigs skor mi 'bab la/gang zag gi rigs la lar rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi skor 'di 'char skyen pa zhig 'ong bas skyes bu chung pu'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung skyabs 'gro'i bar dkyus ltar la/ ga 'gro'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi la jug ldog gi skor la brten nas skyes bu chung ngu dang /bde 'gro'i 'jug ldog la brten nas skyes bu 'bring gi nyams 'khrid mdzad srol yod ces bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo //smras pa/tshe snga ma'i rnam par shes pa la//las nye sgo mongs kyi bag chags rab bsgos pa//sred len pa gnyis kyis gsos btab pas//tshe phyi ma'i yang srid 51na7thu can 'grub//ming gzugasagrub pa'i phung po la/khams skye mched rnam par bkra ba des//yul 'dod la spyod pa'i reg tshor can//skye rgas dang shi bas slar yang 'khor//lar srid pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi/khyu 'bras bur 'char ba'i snang tshul 'di//sngar lugs 'byung du grangs med nyams su myong //lugs ldog tu bsgrub na mi legs sam//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs ḍi bcad pa'o//

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhedaganyis pa de las thar pa'i lam nyams len gyi rim pa ni bshes springs las/ /mgo'am gosal slo bur me shor na/ /de dag phyir bzlog bgyi ba btang nas kyang / /yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /de bas ches mchogo dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /tshul khrims dag dang shes rab bsam gtan gyis/ /mya ngan 'das zhi dul ba dri med pa'i/ /go 'phang mi rga mi 'chi zad mi 'tshal/ /sa chu me rlung nyi zla bral thob mdzod/ /ces lam bslab pa rin po che gsum la bslab dgos pa yin la/ de yang sems rnam par g.yeng ba g.yeng ba med par byed pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas nyon mongs pa mngon gyur sun phyung nas yis bu 'dod khams kyi lha mi'i bde ba la longs spyod/ sems mnyam par ma bzhag pa mnyam bar 'jog par byed pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pas nyon mongs pa mngon gyur mgo mnan nas gos bu gzugs gzugs med kyi lha'i bde ba la spyod par byed/ sems ma grol ba grol bar byed pa shes rab kyi bslab pas nyon mongs pa'i sa bon rtsa ba nas bcad de 'bras bu thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob par byed pas shes rab kyi bslab pa rgyud la skye bar byed pa la sems las su rung ba ting (51ba ji 'dzin gyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro dgos/ de la yang sems g.yeng ba med pa'i phyir du tshul khrims kyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas 'di dag rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul du go rim ma log par nyams su blangs na 'khor ba las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ 'gog pa mngon du bya/lam bsgom par bya zhes gsungs pa'i don yang thob bya 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon du byed pa la thob byed lam gyi bden pa nyams su len pa sngar sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi tshul dang mtshungs pa yin mod/ de yang skyes bu chen po'i lam nyams su mi len par skyes bu 'bring tsam gyi gdul bya la bshad ma thag pa'i lam rnams rgyas par ston dgos na'ang / skabs 'dir skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam yin pas tshul khrims kyi slob tshul tsam las bslab ba gzhen gnyis zhi lhag gi skabs su 'byung bas 'dir spro mi dgos so/ /de ltar na sngar skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs kyi mi dge bcu spong dang 'dir bstan tshul khrims dag —73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)kyang spyod pa spyi bslab gyi tshul khrims kyi khongs su 'du bas so sor mi dgos so snyam na/ dgos te nyams mgur du/ sgo gsum sdig lhung dri mas sbags pa 'dis/ lhag par las sgrib sbyong ba gnad che bas/ /zhes skyes bu che 'bring gi lam rgyud la skye ba la mi dge bcu sogs sdig ltung 'dag thabs gal che bar gsungs shing / byang chub sems dpa' la so thar gyi sdom ldan yin min gnyis yod pa'i so thar gyi sdom ldan min pa la de'i dod thub mi dge bcu spong las dngos bstan tshang bar mi 'byung bsaskabs 'di'i nyams len du 'os pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni bshes spring las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ yon tan kun gyi (52na bzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes rang gi gnyen po che chung dang bstun te so sor thar pa rigs bdun po gang rung gi sdom pa blang / blangs ba tsam gyis mi chog par srung dgos pas mi shes pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo dgag pa'i gnyen por bslab bya phra rags rnams khong du chud par byed/ bag med pa'i gnyen por blang dor gang yin dran pas gsal 'debs shing legs nyes dpyod pa'i shes bzhin gyis bya ra blta zhing ngo tsha khrel yod dang rnam smin la 'jigs par byed/ ma gus pa'i gnyen por ston pa dang des gsungs pa'i bcas pa dang de nyams su len pa'i grogs rnams la yid ches kyi sgo nas gus par byed/ nyon mongs mang ba'i gnyen por gang shas che ba de la 'bur 'joms su byas nas nyin re zhing khas blangs pa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ma 'gal brtags nas 'gal ba rnams phyir bcos dang stobs bzhi sogs kyi sgo nas bshags sdom byed dgos te/ tshangs pas zhus pa las/ bslab pa la ni brten par bya/ /de la snying nas nan tan bya/ /phyir ni spang bar mi bya zhing / /srog gi phyir yang gzhag mi bya/ /rtag tu nan tan gnas par bya/ /'dul ba la ni 'jug par bya/ /zhes yang bas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa 'phral yun thams cad kyi bde legs kyi rtsa ba yin zhing / /lhag tu snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir phan yon lhag par che ba ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo gsogs las gsungs shing / khyad par jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams tshul khrims gtsang ba la gtso bor mdzad pas sha ra ba'i zhal nas/ spyir legs nyes ci byung yang chos la —74

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenabarten pa/de'i nang nas kyang 'dul ba nas ji ltar 52ba〉khyung ba la brten na bldab kyang mi dgosapa zhe gtsang ba brtag thub pa nyams dga' ba mtha' bzang ba yin gsung ba thugs shin tu mod par snang bas rtsa ba med pa'i yal ga 'tshol ba bzhag nas lam 'di nyid la nyams len snying por mdzad par 'tshal lo//smras pa/gzhi tshul khrims gtsang ma'i zhing sal//sems las su rung ba'i chu lud kyis//lam lhag mthong myu gu'i gos smin pas//gnas 'khor ba'i dbul phongs rtsab gcod//blo bag yod sasrung steng skrung ba'i//sgos mkho par log pa'i mig stong mā//bdag lon med kyi rdo rje rtse brgya pas//gzhi srid pa'i sa won bgrod pa bcom//'byog 'khor ba mtha' med kyi tshang tshing khrod//chos bslab gsum dpag bsam shing 'khrungs pas//yongs sdug bsngal gyi me lces sreg min pa'i//dus gto bde'i 'chi med tshal du mdzes//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//skyes bu ོ po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong tshul/phra wo rnam par dag pa'i mar rnon pos//chas pa'i dra ba ma lus spyo mdzad pa/'jam dpal rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul tsong kha pa/khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhal lung las//sdug kun nyesadamigs tshul las nges khrung ba'i//rin chen yu bas btegs pa'i bslab gsum gdugs//myang 'das nor bu'i kho gis rab mdzes pa'i//legs gad srid rtse'i bar du 'khor zin nas//ma smad snying rje'i ma dros klung ོ las//chas 'a spyod pa'i chu ga kho rnam pa bzhi//nam yang ho pa med par 'bab pa'i rgyun/kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'jug tshul 'di na bshad//53na gi sum pa skyes bu ོ po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong tshul la lam sgron las/rang rgyud rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis//gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun//yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loneskyes bu de ni mchog yin no/ /zhes skyes bu 'bring gi skabs su srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigasate de las thar 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa skyes nas/ skyes bu 'bring gi lam kho nas blo sbyong ba rnams rang nyid gcig pu zhi ba don du gnyer ba yin mod/ skabs 'dir 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyong ba ni rang rgyud kyi sdug bsngal la rjes su dpags te sems can gzhan rnams kyang de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba ma bzod par de dag sdug bsngal las thar bar 'dod nas de'i thabs sgrub pa po de ni skyes bu chen po yin la/ thabs gang gi sgo nas sgrub na/ phar phyin bsdus pa las/ 'jig rten don sgrub tshul la mthu med pa'i/ /theg pa gnyis po gtan du spangs byas shing / /thub rgyal theg pa snying rjesabastan pa la/ /g.yin phan ro gcig rang bzhin de dag 'jug /ces bden bzhi la 'jug ldog gi lam nyams su blangs pas thar pa thob kyang rang don yongs su ma rdzogs pas gzhan don rgya chen po mi 'byung bas de ltar na gzhan don rgya chen sgrub pa'i mthu med pa'i nyan rang gi lam la mi 'jug par theg pa chen po la zhugs te sems can gyi don sgrub dgos pa ni slob springs las/ shin tu rnyed sla'i rto kham 'ga' lta phyugs kyang rang nyid zla/ zhan tu sgom pas gdungs pa'ang chu zhig rnyed na dga' mgur 'thung / /'di na skyes bu gzhan don byed par brtson pa gang yin pa/ /de 'di'i brjid bag yin te de bde skyes bu'i rtsal de (53ba 'phags/ nyi ma rlabs chen rta zhen rgyu ba snang byed gang yin dang / khur la mi rtseg sa yis 'jig rten 'degs pa gang yin de/ /rang don 'ga' med chen po rnams kyi rang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /de dag 'jig rten phan dang bde ba'i ro la gcig tu gzhol/ /zhes tshe 'di'i bde ba sgrub pa tsam ni dud 'gro la yang yod pas na skyes bu mchog rnams kyi nus pa'am rtsal ni nyi zlas mun pa sel ba dang sachen pos 'jig rten 'degs pa ltar snying stobs chen pos gzhan phan gyi khur 'khyer bar byed pa yin pas de la med du mi rung ba spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes 'khor bar sdug bsngal ba'i 'gro ba —76

byang chub lam gyi ri mo pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / rton)zhig kyang sems bskyed ma thag pa nas byang chub sems dpar 'gyur bar gsungs shing / byang chub kyi sems dang mi ldan na lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che sogs yon tan ji tsam yod kyang theg pa chen po ba'i gral du mi tshud pa rgyud bla ma las/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs sna rgyas chas skyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can/ gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /zhes chu lud ni 'bru sna tsho gos bskyed pa'i thun mong gi rgyu dang / rje'u'i rigs can gyi ma ni bu rigs rgyud mi gcig pa sna tsho gos skyed par byed pa yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu sa bon nas dang / pha bram ze lta bu rigs gcig tu nges pa zhig dgos kyi/ nas btab pa'i myu gu gro skye ba dang / pha bram ze'i bu la gdol ba'i rigs mi 'byung (54na tha bzhin du theg pa che chung gang gi sgo nas 'khor ba las sgrol bar byed pa la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs gnyis ka la dgosang pa'i ma lta bu yin na'ang / byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa pha lta bu 'di nyid srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag sel bar byed pa'i rdo rje rin po che dang mtshungs pas dman pa'i rgyan mtha' dag zil gyis gnon par byed pa'i skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa nyams su len pa la byang chub kyi sems ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul/ sems bskyed nas spyod pa la slob pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i rim pa dang / sems bskyed cho gas 'dzin pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni spyir sems skyed par byed pa'i rkyen ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan dngos su mthong ba dang / dngos su ma mthong yang byang chub sems dpa'i sdosnod thos pa dang / de dag phra zhing zhib par thos pa min na'ang sangs rgyas 'thob pa la chos de med du mi rung ba sogs kyi rgyu mtshan 'ol spyi tsam thos pas theg chen gyi bstan pa nub pa ma bzod pa dang / bstan pa nub pa la mngon du phyogs pa min yang snyigs ma'i dus chesang na pa 'dir nyan rang gi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yang rnyed dka' na bla na med pa'i byang chub lta ci smos snyam du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed pa dang / rigs dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang snying brtse ba dang skyo ngal med pa ste rgyu bzhi la brten nas sems bskyed pa/—77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)rang gi stobs dang / gzhan gyi stobs dang / tshe rabs sngon ma la theg pa chen por goms pa rgyu'i stobs dang / tshe 'dir dge ba la goms pa sbyor pa'i stobs te rgyu bzhi dang stobs bzhi sogs sems bskyed (54ba)pa'i rgyu rkyen mang du bshad la/ deng sang phyag len gyi snying por jo bo chen po a ti sha nas brgyud par man ngag bdun pa dang / rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha nas brgyud pa'i man ngag gnyis la brten pa'i jo bo chen po'i lugs kyi dang po rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun la blo sbyong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ni byang chub kyi sems las 'byung / de lhag bsam las 'byung / de snying rje las khrung / de byams pa las 'byung / de drin du gzo ba las 'byung / de drin dran pa las yang /de mar shes pa las khrung ba'i go rim gyi gnad de ltar yod na'ang / snying rje chen po lhag bsam dang byams pa'i bar kho nar 'byung ba las gzhan du mi 'byung ba'i nges pa ni med de/ 'jug pa las/ gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo rta ge phun tsho gis 'di'i/ /sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes thog mar 'gro ba rnams la 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i phyir du dam bca' ba yang snying rje la rag lus par ma zad /bar du bya dka' bas skyid lug ste lam dman par mi gol ba dang / mthar sangasargyas nas kyang nyan rang ltar zhi bar mi gnas par sems can mtha' dag gi don mdzad par ngal ba med pa yang snying rje chen po la rag lus mod/ de ltar snying rje chen po skye ba la yang yid du 'ong ba zhig dgos pas sems can thams cad mar shes dgos la/ lam 'di dag la ma sbyangs pa'i skye bo rnams kyang rang gi ma la sogs pa'i gnyen rnams la drin bsam pa dang dran pa'i sgo nas byams pa dang snying rje nyi tsheb skye na'ang / mi mdza' ba'i dgra sogs la mi skye bar ma zad de'i ldog phyogs sdug bsngal (55na)dang phrad 'dod dang bde ba dang 'bral 'dod kyi blo 'byung ba'i phyir na rang re rnams kyang thog mar btang snyoms shig ma bsgrubs na lam sgom blo byas kyang byams snying rje phyogs ris can du 'gro bas de'i gnyen por thog mar btang snyoms sgom dgos mod/ 'o na ma sogs la yid 'ong gi byams pa —78

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid ga 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenasgrub dgos na da lta yid 'ong gi blo yod pa de bkag nas ci bya snyam na/ rgyu 'bras bdun gyi yid 'ong la chags pa cung zad kyang ma 'dres pa dgos la/ da lta rang cag tsho'i blo la yod bzhin pa'i byams pa ni chags pas bslangs pa yin pas/ dper na sa sgang ga9(ngas mi snyoms pa la gnas mal mi bde ba bzhin chags sdang gi mtho dma' can la byams pa 'ong ba'i skabs med do/ /de yang tshor ba btang snyoms lta bu ma yin pa'i sems can rnams la rang blo chags sdang dang bral ba'i tshad med btang snyoms shig sgom par byed pa la thog mar dgra gnyen gang yang min pa'i sems can zhig gi legs par gsal btab pas de'i byad dbyibs dang spyod tshul sogs yid la shar ba dang de la dmigs nas sdang ba dang byams pa'i rtog pa skye bcug pa na de la mi mthun par blta ba'i zhe sdang dang mthun par blta ba'i 'dod chags gnyis ka ha cang che ba mi 'byung yang / che chung cung zad 'dug na gang che ba de'i gnyen bo bsten nas sems snyoms pa ma byung gi bar du bsgom gsung /thog mar bar ma la sgom pa yul de la btang snyoms shas che bas skye ba sla ba'i dbang du btang ba yin zhing / de nas tshe 'dir snying na ba'i dgra zhig dang shin tu mdza' ba'i gnyen zhig dmigs yul du byas te de dag la chags sdang gi rtog pa mngon gyur skyes byung ba dang / dgra rnams kyang tshe sngon (55bsgo'i grogs byas nas phan mang du btags pa dang grogs rnams kyang tshe sngon ma'i dgrar gyur nas rang bsad pa sogs gnod pa byas tshul legs par bsams pa'i sgo nas chags sdang gi rtog pa mgo snyoms pa yin la/ 'on kyang skyes bu 'bring gi skabs kyi dgra gnyen la nges pa med tshul gyi skor la myong ba thon na skabs 'dir dmigs pa skyong shin tu sla bar snang ngo / /dmigs yul gsum po 'di gas bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis 'ded pa ltar 'gro ba rnams la 'bad med sgoms pa'i blo byung na des cho go la/ da dung skye dka' se ba byung tshe rigs mi gcig pa mang po la spos kyin sgom pa gnad yin no/ /de ltar dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la gcig tu sdang ba gcig tu chags pa'i blo 'go snyoms zin nas thog mar gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo'i gzhi —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nesgrub par byed pa la sems can thams cad mar shes pa'i slad du 'di ltar bsam ste/ 'khor ba la mtha' med pa bzhin du bdag gi skye ba la mtha' med pas sems can thams cad kyi mngal du bdag nying mtshams sbyar nas skye ba ma blangs pa ga la yod snyam du bsams pa na mos pa'i dbang gis 'char yang / spyi ldog tu bsgoms bas nges shes 'drongs dka' bas na rang gi mdun du da lta'i ma de nyid rgan gzhen dbyibs byad spyod tshul ji ltar yod pa gsal btab/ des tshe 'di'i ma byas pa dngos su grub pa 'di ga 'dra ba zhig skye ba g.yin mang por yang byas yod de/ dper na mdo las de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku tshe de'i yum gyi sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs kyi ma mang du byas tshul dang / gang zag gzhan gyi sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' gsungs pa tshad ma'i skyes bu'i bka' bslu (56na tha med pa yin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes su dpags te bsgoms na gting phyin pa'i nges shes khyad par can zhig rnyed 'ong / de nas tshe 'di'i pha dang nye du bar ma dgra dmyal ba sogs 'gro ba rigs gzhan la'ang bsgoms pas mthar sems can thams cad mar shes pa'i blo rang gis phar bcos pa ma yin pa'i tshe 'di'i ma dang 'dra ba'i snang ba 'char ba zhig 'ong / de la myong ba thon nas drin dran pa ni sngar ltar rang gi ma'i snang tshul mtha' dag gsal btab/ ma 'dis bdag zla ba bcu'i bar du mngal du bzung / rang gi bde ba dang stogs skom sogs khyad du bsad/ phan gnod kyi spyod lam thams cad bu'i ched du byas te dal 'byor gyi lus srog 'di nyid byin pa yin pas thog mar drin che/ mngal nas btsas zin nas 'jam pa'i gos stan la bzhag /brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ mngar ba'i nu zho bsnun/ zas lces bstod/ snabs khas phyir/ mi gtsang ba lag 'a pas phyas/ sha'i drod la bcar/ me chu g.yang sa'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs/ bu na ba las rang na ba dang bu shi ba las rang shi ba la snying thag pa nas 'dem pa sogs kyi sgo nas bskyangs pas bar du drin che/ nar son nas za lugs 'gro lugs sogs kyis mtha' rten pa'i yon tan rang gis bslab pa dang gzhan slob tu la jug pa/ sdig sdug gtam ngan khyad du bsad de sha thang thang du —80

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhena'abad pas btsal ba'i sa khang nor rdzas snying ltar gces pa mtha' dag byin pas tha mar drin che tshul rnams bsams pas mig nas mchi ma zuXgrag pa dang lus kyi ba sbu ldang ba (56ba)sems rtsad yam yam slong blong ba ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ de nas rim gyis pha nas bzung dgra'i bar dang rigs drug gi 'gro ba gzhan rnams la tshe sngon ma'i mar gyur pa grangs kyis mi chod pa byas pa'i gnas skabs su tshe 'di'i mas 'di ltar byas pa lta bu dang tshul mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bsam/ de yang bshad ma thag pa thams cad dud 'gro sogs la mi tshang yang mir gyur dus kyi ma ma byas pa med pa la dgongs par snang / drin dran pa la myong ba skyes pa'i rjes su drin gzo ba ni slob springs las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa/ /klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ /skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel por med/ /ces mar gyur sems can rnams nyon mongs pa'i gdon gyis rgyud dkrugs/ blang dor la blta ba'i mig gti mug gis ldongs/zab mo dam pa'i chos kyi 'khar ba dang bral/ thar pa'i grong du 'khrid pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bus bor/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i ngal stegs la brdeg 'chos te 'khor ba'i g.yang du lhung /sdug bsngal gsum gyi btson rar 'khyams pa 'di dag skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa ma gtogs tshe rabs mang por rang la phan btags pa'i drin can gyi pha ma sha stag yin pas ma de rnams kyis kyang bu bdag la mi re na su la re/ bu bdag la ma de rnams skyong ba'i khur ma bab na gzhan su la bab/ dper na 'di snang gi pha ma mdza' grogs shig bcon ra'am 'brog dgon pa chom rkun dang gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa yod par chud pa las thar ba'i thabs shig rang la yod bzhin du blos bor nas bde bar (57na tha sdad na de las ngo tsha dang khrel chung ba mi 'ong ba klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs bcad las/ rgya mtsho dang ni ri rab dang / /sa rnams bdag gi khur min gyi/ /byas pa mi gzo gang yin pa/ de ni bdag gi khur chen yin/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas bdag gis drin can gyi ma rnams skyob pa'i nus pa yod bzhin du dor nas rang gcig pu zhi ba don du gnyer ba'i dman pa'i lam du bzhugs na dam pa rnams thugs —81

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)gting nas khrel bar 'dug pas de spangs te 'gro ba kun la phan pa bsgrub par bya snyam du bsam/ 'o na phan ji lta bu'i tshul gyis 'dogs na bkres pa la zas/ sgom pa la btung ba/ nad kyis mnar ba la sman/ phongs pa la zang zing gi nor sogs kyang gnas skabs so so'i sdug bsngal sel zhing / rang gi tshogs gsog pa'i rgyu yin pas mi bya ba ma yin mod/ srid pa'i stobs 'byor la sbyar ba nyid 'gro ba rnams la phan btags pa'i gtso bor bzung tshe/ de dag gis tshangs pa dang 'dod pa'i lha dga' rab dbang phyug dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal kyang grangs med byas pas brtan pa ma thob bar dbul phongs tsha grang gi sdug bsngal gyi gnas skabs 'di ltar gyur na/ bdag gis kyang 'di dag zag bcas kyi bde ba la gtso bor sbyar na stobs 'byor ji tsam che ba tsam gyis bde ba de sdug bsngal du 'gyur tshabs che ba rma 'bras la 'gyur byed kyi rdzas tsha ba lta bu btab pa ltar sdug bsngal je 'phel du 'gro ba dang 'dra bar 'dug pas sems can thams cad thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang gang rung la dgod par bya snyam pa'i yid 'khul nges su bsam mo /de ltar gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo (57ba7skyed pa'i gzhi bsgrubs pa tsam gyis mi chog pas blo dngos skye ba la byams snying rje lhag bsam gsum sgom dgos pa'i byams pa dang snying rje gnyis la bde ba la sbyor 'dod dang sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod kyi blo gang mngon du gyur pa dang rjes su 'brel ba las rgyu 'bras kyi go rim nges can du med kyang / spyir btang phyag len du byams pa sngon du mdzad pas/rin chen phreng ba las/ rdze'u tshos sum brgya'i kha zas dag /nyin re dus gsum byin pas kyang / /byams pa yud tsam thang gcig gi /bsod nams dag la che mi phod/ /lha mi byams par 'gyur ba dang / /de dag kyang ni srung ba dang / /yid bde ba dang bde mang dang / /dug dang mtshon gyis gnod med dang / /'bad pa med par don 'thob dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur te/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang / /byams chos yon tan brgyad 'thob bo/ /zhes phan yon mtha' yas pa'i byams pa sgom pa ni tshe 'di'i ma la nad dang dbul phongs sogs sdug bsngal mngon gyur yod dam med na'ang 'gyur ba'i sdug —82

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / rton)bsngal dang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal tsam yin pas bde ba dang mi ldan tshul bsams la bde ba dang mi ldan pa'i ma 'di nyid bde ba la dgod 'dod kyi blo shugs drag por bskyed nas ngag tu/ bde bas phongs pa'i mi rgan 'di rnams bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung / bde ba dang phrad par gyur cig /ci nas kyang bde ba dang phrad par bya'o/ /zhes lan mang po brjod cing de ltar bsam mo/ /de bzhin du dgra gnyen sogs 'gro ba ris med rnams la yang sngar gyi go rim ltar sgom dgosapas/ ngan song gsum la sdug bsngal mngon gyur dang bde (58na〉sna gro la sdug bsngal yod med ci rigs kyang skabs dang sbyar ro/ /'on kyang dgras gnod pa 'di zhes bya ba byas pas phan btags shan 'dra snyam na rang gis skye ba sngon ma phar gnod pa byas pa'i le lan tshur la 'khor ba yin nam/ rnam pa gcig tu na kho rang la rang dbang med par nyon mongs pa des rgyud bskul bar 'dug /tshe 'di'i ma'am nye du lta bu zhig gdon gyis spyos te bdag la mtshon cha sogs rdeg tu byung na de la zhe sdang mi skye ba'i khar gdon dang 'bral ba'i thabs la brtson pa byed pa bzhin tshe sngon ma'i ma rgan 'di snang gi 'khrul ngor dgrar btags pa 'di yang nyon mongs pa'i gdon gyis smyos 'dug pas nyon mongs pa'i gdon 'di dang bral te bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa sogs sngar ltar nyams su len pa ni gnad dam sgo / yin/ 'o na gong du dgra rnams kyang mar bsgoms zin pas byams pa skye dka' ba zhig mi 'ong ngam snyam du dogs na/ shin tu ma brtags pa ste/ khrel chung gi skye bo la la tshe 'di'i ma yang gsod pa dang dgrar bltas te gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa mngon sum du grub pas so/ /sems can rnams la byams pa bsgoms nas/ snying rje ni sngar ltar tshe 'di'i ma sdug bsngal gsum po gang rung gis mnar ba la dmigs nas kye ma bdag gi tshe 'di'i ma la sdug bsngal gyis dngos su gnod/ kun 'byung gis brgyud nas gnod pas bde ba'i go sna bas cung zad kyang mi 'dug /sdug bsngal 'di las thar na ci ma rung bsamasate ngag nas/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i ma rgan sems can 'di thams cad sdug (58ba)bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /ci nas kyang sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya'o/ /—83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)zhes mang du brjod cing yid la bsam par bya'o/ /de yang dgra gnyen bar ma mtha' dag la kha spos te bsam/ 'di dag kyang skyes bu chung 'bring gi nyams len nyams 'og tu chud na rang nyams la dpags te sgom sla bar lam rim chen mo las gsungs so/ /semasacan bde ba dang ldan 'dod dang sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod kyi blo tsam theg pa dman pa la'ang yod pas/ bshad ma thag pa'i byams snying rje gnyis la de tsam gyis mi chog par de ltar bya'o snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag 'dren nus pa'i byams snying rje yin pas de gnyis kyis drangs pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag ni 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal las phral cing bde ba la dgod blo tsam min pa'i nges par bdag gis bya snyam pa'i dam bca'i tshul gyis/ kye ma yid du 'ong ba'i sems can 'di rnams bde ba la sbyor ba dang sdug bsngal las thar bar byed pa'i khur de yang bdag gis 'khyer ro snyam pa'i bsam pa dang bcas te ngag tu/ bde ba dang mi ldan pa'i ma rgan sems can 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan pa zhig bdag gis bya'o/ /sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral ba zhig bdag gis bya'o/ /zhes lan grangs mang por brjod nas yi dam bcas pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag bskyed pa'i mthus/ skyabs 'gro'i skabs su bshad pa'i sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las kyi yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas/ yon tan khyad par can 'di dang ldan pa'i go 'phang 'di thob na sems can rnams kyang 'dren nus par 'dug snyam ste (59na〉sgos pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pas grangs med gsum gyi 'go rtsom pa'i sems bskyed dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /'o na drin gzo'i skabs kyang 'gro ba rnams myang 'das la dgos par bya bsam pa yod pas lhag bsam rnam dag la lhag po med do snyam na/ dper na dngos po 'di bdag gis nye bar bya bsam pa dang / 'tshong thag bcad pa mi 'dra ba ltar drin gzo dag lhag bsam la yang khyad par de bzhin du yod pas spu ris phyed dgos/ de ltar rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas blo legs par sbyangs nas 'khrid tshul ma gtogs zhi ba lha'i lugs kyang don gyis tshang bas so sor dgos pa'i nges pa med na'ang /—84

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenalam rim che chung du lugs gnyis ka gsungs pa dang / gdul bya blo sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis phyag len du mdzad pas rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha'i gzhung la brten nas bdag gzhan brje ba ni spyod 'jug las/ gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni/ khyur du bskyab par 'dod pa des/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ /gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / /'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /de kun bdag bde 'dod lasabyung / /mang du bshad lta ci dgos te/ /byis pa rang gi don byed dang / /thub pa gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ /'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par ltos/ /bdag bde g.yin gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byasan/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces bdag gces 'dzin rgud pa kun gyi (59ba tshe na zhi dang / g.yin gces 'dzin phan bde kun gyi gzhi yin pas nyams su len pa gal che la/ da lta rang la snang tshul phra mo tsam mi bzod pa'i ngang tshul 'di la dpags na bdag gzhan brje ba tsam gyi blo mi skye snyam du mi sems te/ dka' las phyir bzlog mi bya ste/ /'di ltar goms pa'i mas yis ni/ /gang gi ming thos 'jigs pa yang / /de nyid med na mi dgar 'gyur/ /zhes mi mdza' ba'i dgra mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs shing snying du mi sdug pa zhig /slar mthun par byas na sngar mi dga' ba'i sems de phyis shin tu yid du 'ong ba zhig tu 'gyur 'gro ba ltar goms pa'i dbang gis bdag gzhan yang brje bar nus pas nyams su len pa la/ bdag gzhan brje zhes pa'i don dper na lhas byin lta bu'i ngos nas mchod spyin la nga'o snyam du sems pa min gyi/ rang lhas byin la gces 'dzin gyi blo de'i tshab tu gzhan mchod sbyin la gces par 'dzin zhing / gzhan mchod sbyin yal bar 'dor ba'i tshab tu rang lhas byin yal bar 'dor ba'i blo skyed pa de la bdag gzhan brje bar ming gis btags pa yin pas/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i dmigs skor dngos la sngar phan chad bdag gces par bzung ste rang don bsgrubs pas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho nar song snyam nas gzhan la 'char ba'i blo de rang la bkab nas sbyong / rang la gces pa'i blo de 'gro ba g.yin la spos nas sbyangs pas goms pa'i dbang —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā5)gis da lta'i yal bar 'dor ba dang gces 'dzin gyi blo gnyis go sa 'pho thub pa 'ong gsung / de yang 'char sla ba'i ched du blo sbyong don bdun ma las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin rin chen 'phreng (60na)ba las/ bdag la de dag sdig smin zhing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces pa ltar gtong len gnyis gtso bor mdzad pa phyag len du snang bas sngar ltar rang gi mdun du gsal btab ste de la mi dmigs pa'i snying rje drag po dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas rlung sangs kyas bus pa dang mnyam du rang rgyud la yod pa'i zag bcas kyi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad rlung gi rta la zhen te mdun gyi ma de'i sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs lus sems can thams cad khyab pas bde ba khyad par can dang ldan par bsam/ yang rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung rngub pa dang mnyam du ma de'i sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad rlung gis drangs te snying gi nang du nag phung nge byung ba dang / ma de sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba'i bde ba dang ldan par byas song snyam pa spel ma'i tshul du yang yang sbyang / de nas tshe 'di'i pha dang nye du bar ma dgra bo sogs 'gro ba rigs drug so sor sbyong / da ltar rang re la de tsam gyi blo nus che ba med kyang goms pa'i dbang gis zas gos gnas mal nas bzung mgo bo rkang lag sogs gtong ba la yang 'jigs pa med pa zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs so/ /smras pa/ mtha' med srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho cher/ /snying nas chen pa log pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /bslab gsum rin chen them skas la 'dzegs te/ /rang nyid zhi bde'i khang par 'jug pa rnams/ /skye bar phan pa bsgrubs pa'i mar gyur 'gro/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal drag po'i bsdun ra rtswa /chud nas nyam (60ba log cho nge 'debs mthong bzhin/ /bor nus khyod las khrel gzhung chung ba su/ /'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i drin dran pas/ /byams dang snying rje'i rlung shugs drag po yis/ /gzhan phan khur chen 'byer ba'i lhag bsam gru/ /kun mkhyen nor bu'i gling du thogs med 'gro/ /snying la tsher ltar rtsub pa'i dgra bo yang / bdag gas mnyam dang brje ba'i sems bzang pos/ /gnyen bshes mdza' grogasayin par rang ngo 'phrod/ /phyogs 'dzin 'byul ba'i blo yi gzhi rtsa chod/ /rang la gces par 'dzin pa'i blo —86

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 9)dor nas/ /gnod lan phan pas 'jal ba'i lde mig gis/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phan bde'i sgo/ /cig car 'byed pa'i skal bzang 'di med byung / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gnyis pa sems bskyed cho gas bzung ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i gzhan don don gnyer dang byang chub don gnyer gnyis kyi blo legs par sbyangs pas cho ga la ma ltos par sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo tsam zhig skye yang / yang dag pa'i lam du chud pa la cho ga phun sum tshogs pa gal che bas de'i lag len sbyor ba skyabs 'gro tsho gis bsag sems sbyong ba/ dngos gzhi smon sems cho gas 'dzin pa/ mjug tshe 'di dang skye ba gzhan du sems bskyed mi nyams pa'i slad du bslab pa brjod pa rnams lam gyi rim pa che chung las shes dgos shing / zhib cha'i phyag len mtha' dag mthong ba brgyud pa la rag las pas rang bzo dang sla chos su ma song bar bya'o/ /de yang byams pa'i rnam par thar pa'i mdo las/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob ma nus kyang sems bskyed pa tsam (61na tshe pa phan yon chen po 'byung bar gsungs mod/'on kyang rnam 'grel las/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i phyir/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad/ /thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pa/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ /zhes snying rje chen pos drangasapa'i lhag bsam gyi sgo nas smon sems bskyed pa'i dgos pa sems can sdug bsngal dang bral na snyam nga 'i sems bzang ba tsam ma yin par thabs la 'jug dgos/ de la rang nyid thog mar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i thabs su byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya rnams la sgrub pa snying por byed dgos pas spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhasapas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes yul zhig tu 'gro bar 'dod pa dang 'gro ba la brtson pa gnyis dper bzung ste smon sems dang 'jug sems kyi bye brag gsungs pa'i dbang du byas nas smon sems la legs par sbyangs pa'i myong ba sna zin rgyud la skyes pa na byang sdom gyi bslab bya rnams nyan te phyin drug sogs la bslabs pa'i phan yon ma bslabs pa'i nyes dmigs rtsa lhung dang nyes byas sogs legs par shes nas blang dor de la spro ba shugs drag po bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)dang / shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs srol gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyal sras kyi sdom pa cho ga'i sgo nas phog ste rtsa lhung dang nyes byas srung tshul phyir bcos dang bcas pa'i lag len rje bdag nyid chen pos tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad du rgyas par bka' stsal pa lam rim che chung du zhal 'phangs (61ba)mdzad cing gser zhun du yang byung mod/ deng sang phyag len du 'jug sdom len pa'i skor 'di bzhag nas phyin drug sogs kyi nyams 'khrid mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar na gzhung chen mo dag nas smon 'jug dang phyin drug gi go rim mdzad pa las 'gal ba'i skyon yod dam snyam na/ go rim de lta bu'i tshul gyis skye ba yod pa la dgongs kyi/ thams cad la de ltar ma nges pa lam du ma zhugs pa'i gang zag gis 'dug sdom blangs te de'i rjes su smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas tshogs lam chung ngu thob/tshogs lam 'bring du sleb pa dang smon sems de 'jug sems su gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis 'jug sems skyes pa yod/ yang 'jug sdom len ma myong ba zhig gis smon sems bskyed nas tshogs lam la zhugs/ tsho gos la ma 'bring du sleb pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed/ 'bring gi tha mar 'jug sdom blangs pa'ang 'ong bas mtha' gcig tu go rim gyi nges pa med pa de'i phyir na bslab btus las/ de bas na rang gi mthu dang 'tsham par dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig tsam yang yang dag par blangs te bsrung bar bya/ zhes smon sems bskyed nas ring po ma lon pa des bslab bya mtha' dag la slob mi nus pas thog mar dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig tsam 'dzin pa sogs rang blo dang bstun nas rim gyis blo sbyangs te mthar spyod pa mtha' dag la slob nus par gsungs pas de'i dbang du byas te smon sems cho gas bzung ba'i rjes su phyin drug la 'khrid pa yin no/ /'o na skabs 'dir zhi lhag gi bar gyi dmigs pa mtha' dag rdzogs par gtong bas na/ 'jug sdom ma blangs pa rang tshig dngos su 'gal lo snyam (62na sko/ sngar rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun sogasakyi sgo nas dmigs rim 'khrid pa mtha' dag nyams myong tshad ma rgyud la skye ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i myong ba rjes mthun pa tsam las mtshan nyid pa min pas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyin drug gi skor yang rgyal —88

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 'dasras kyi spyod pa la slob pa'i nyams myong la bag chags 'jog pa'i gzhi rten tsam du dgongs nas sngon gyi bshes gnyen rnams kyis skyes bu gsum gyi nyams 'khrid ring ba lo dang thung ba zla ba'i bar tsam du mdzad pa yin gyi/ de lta min par lhag bsam rnam dag 'dren nus kyi snying rje chen po mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes skyes kyi bar du bsgoms pa lta bus mtsho ni te/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung zhi lhag gi nyams len mtha' dag de ltar byas pa zhig la nyams 'khrid du ngos 'dzin dgos na/ yun ring por tshegasachen pos sgrub dgos pa dag snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'bad med du 'grub par 'gyur pa mi srid do/ /des na gong du rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi mthar sems bskyed pa de la grangs med gsum gyi 'go rtsom pa'i byang chub tu thog mar sems bskyed pa la de lta bu dgos zhes sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa'i dbang du byas nas/ lam gyi go rim ltar 'khrid dmigs su ngo sprad par 'brul te/ dmigs skor dang sems bskyed cho gas bzung ba sogs nas rang nyid byang sems tshogs lam par khas blangs shing rlom na de las shin tu rmongs pa med pas go bar bya 'tshal/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na lam du ma zhugs pa nas 'jug sdom la rings par byas kyang nyon mongs pa mang zhing gnyen po chung (62ba tha'i dus 'dir rtsa ltung sogs srung ma nus na sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa dang lta dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bslus par 'gyur ba sogs nyes dmigs mtha' klas pa bshad pas dgag bya che zhing dgos pa chung ba la dgongs te dngos brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gdul bya'i blo dang bstun te mdzad pa yin no/ /smras pa/ nyams myong go yul shar ba'i myu gu dag /dka' spyad rlan gsher drod kyis nyer smin pas/ /rtogs pa tshad ma'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /theg gsum skye 'phags bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /rkyen ngan thog tu bab pa'i mtshon rnon pos/ /'gro rnams pha mar nges blo'i srog bral yang / /snying rje'i bdud rtsis lhag bsam 'chi ba med/ /bsgrubs zin rgyal sras nam mkha'i pad+mo bzhin/ /theg chen lam —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)gyi bgrod tshul mkha' ltar yangs/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i gsung rab mtsho ltar zab/ /deng dus skye bo'i blo gros mun ltar gnag /mkhas rlome phal gyi rnam dpyod rtswa ltar phra/ /de phyir blo dman rnams la dka' ba'i mdud/ legs bshad sor mo'i 'phrul gyis rab 'grol ba'i/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bang mdzod nas/ shes ldan 'dod 'jo'i dngos po 'dzad du med/ zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed nas spyod pa la slob pa'i tshul la mdo sde rgyan las/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang / /'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang / /rtag tu nyen mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang / /bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /zhes rgyal (63na tha'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rdzogs pa la tshe rabs mang po brgyud dgos/ de la yang phyogs re tsam ma yin pa'i longs spyod lus 'khor las kyi mtha' gang brtsams 'grub pa sogs phun sum tshogs pa na nyon mongs mi 'phel ba'i 'jug ldog gi gnad shes na lam gyi sa chod shin tu che ba 'ong ba ni mngon mtho la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ rten de la bsgrub par bya ba sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa gsum gyis gzhan don dang / shes rab bsam gtan brtson khrus gsum gyis rang don te don gnyis sgrub pa la stos pa'i grangs nges/ zang zing gis phongs pa sel ba/ gzhan gnod spangs pas 'tshe ba med pa/ gnod lan gnod pa mi 'jal ba/ gzhan don gyi dka' spyad la mi skyo ba/ rdzu 'phrul sogs kyis gzhan yid 'dun pa/legs par bshad pas the tshom 'grol ba ste g.yin don rdzogs par sgrub pa la bltos pa'i grangs nges/longs spyod la chags pa med pas bslab pa la gus pa/ g.yin skyon la brten pa'i sdug bsngal la bzod pas dge ba la yid spro ba/ zhi gnas kyis lus sems las su rung bas lhag mthong gi shes rab 'phel ba ste theg chen thams cad sdud pa la bltos pa'i grangs nges/ gtong ba la goms pa ni longs spyod la mi chags pa'i thabs/ bag med las srung ba ni thob 'dod kyi g.yeng ba sdom pa'i thabs/sdug bsngal dang du len pa ni sems can mi gtong ba'i thabs/ skyo ngal med pa'i brtson pa ni dge ba —90

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / rton)'phel ba'i thabs/ lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa ni nyen mongs pa sel ba'i thabs/ phra zhib kyi rnam par dpyod pa ni shes sgrib (63ba〉spyong ba'i thabs te thabs kyi rnam pa thams cad pa'i dbang du mdzad pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ tshul khrims dang de'i 'khor gyi tshul du sbyin pa dang bzod pa ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i ngo bo/ phar phyin tha ma gnyis ni bslab pa gzhan gnyis kyi ngo bo/ brtson 'grus ni gsum ga la dgos pas bslab pa gsum la ltos pa'i grangs nges/ longs spyod la mi blta ba'i sbyin pa yod na ma chags pa'i rgyu las tshul khrims skye/ tshul khrims yod na nyes spyod bsdoms pa'i rgyu las bzod pa skye/ bzod pa yod na dka' ba la mi skyo ba'i rgyu las brtson 'grus skye/ brtson tsos yod na nyin mtshan du 'bad pa'i rgyu las bsam gtan skye/ bsam gtan yod na lus sems las su rung ba'i rgyu las shes rab skye bas phar phyin drug po de dag kyang snga ma snga ma dman zhing phyi ma phyi ma mchog la/rags pa dang phra ba'ang de bzhin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang / /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim par bstan pa yin/ /zhes grangs ngesade lta bu dang ldan pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la bslab pa la rang rgyud smin par byed pa phar phyin drug la bslab pa/ gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa bsdu pa'i dngos po bzhi la bslab pa gnyis/ dang po la sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab dang drug /dang po ni/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod la mi blta bar byang chub sems dpa'i ma chags pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i sems pa gang yin pa dang des kun nas bslang ste sbyin bya'i dngos po yongs su gtong ba'i lus (64na jig gi las de sbyin pa'i ngo bo yin la/ de btang bas sbyin pa'i phar phyin ji ltar rdzogs par 'gyur na/ lus ngag las sems gtso che zhing de yang longs spyod sogs la ser sna bcom pa tsam gyis mi chog ste de tsam ni nyan rang dgra bcom la yang yod pas 'dir phan yon dang nyes dmigs bsams pa'i sgo nas snying thag pa nas gtong sems dgos pas skyes rabs las/ bdag med 'jig sla snying po med pa'i lus/ /sdug bsngal drin med rtag tu mi gtsang ba'i/ /lus kyis g.yin la —91—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)phan thogs 'gyur ba la/ /dga' bar mi 'gyur de ni mkhas ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar lags/ 'o na sbyin pa btang bas 'gro ba rnams kyi dbul ba bor ba la brten nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs sam snyam na/spyod 'jug las/ gal te 'gro ba dbul bor ba/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin yin na/ /da dung 'gro ba yo yod na sngon/ /skyob pa ji ltar pha rol phyin/ /zhes de lta na da dung sems can phongs pa dpag tu med pa yod pa'i phyir sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis sbyin pa'i phar phyin ma rdzogs par 'gyur bar gsungs pas rang gi longs spyod dang dge ba thams cad la ser sna med par snying thag pa nas btang ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa gzhan la gtong ba'i blo goms pa yongs su rdzogs pa sbyin pa'i phar phyin te/ bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ /skye bo kun la btang sems kyis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te/ /de ltas de ni sems nyid do/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sbyin pa'i phar phyin nyams su len par byed pa la/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra bas/ nga ni (64ba tshe byed la gtong ba'i phan yon mi brjod kyi 'dzin pa'i nyes dmigs brjod pa yin/zhes rab byung gi byang sems rnams kyis thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bar chad du 'gyur bzhin du sha thang thang gi sgo nas 'bad pas zang zing gi dngos po tsam re sbyin pa bya mi rigs pas chos kyi sbyin pa nyid gtso bor bya dgos shing 'bad med lhun grub tu rnyed pa byung ba rnams chags pa med par gtong dgos na'ang gtso bor zang zing sbyin pa ni khyim pa'i byang sems rnams kyis bya dgos pa'i phyir rten gyi sgo nas sbyin pa gtong tshul spyir btang dmigs bsal legs par phyed par byas te chos dang mi 'jigs zang zing gi sbyin pa lag tu bstar ba la/ sbyin pa gsum po de byas pa la 'bras bu med do snyam pa dang chos log dang gcig gi ched du 'gro ba grangs med pa yal bar dor nas de skyob pa dang / srog bcad pa'i sha khrag gi sbyin pa chos su 'gyur ro snyam pa sogs lta ngan mchog tu 'dzin pa'i bsam pa dang /sbyin yul rnams la brnyes pa dang / gzhan la 'gran 'dod dang / chos kyi tshig don bzang ba 'di lta bu dang / sems can 'di tsam gyi srog bskyabs pa dang / dngos po khyad par can 'di tsam bdag min pa —92

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenagazhan gyis byar med do snyam pa'i khengs sems dang / sbyin pa gsum po 'di ltar byas zhes snyan grags 'ong du re ba dang / sbyin pa de tsam byar mi nus snyam pa'i zhum pa dang / byas pa la 'gyod pa'i sems dang /gnyen rnams la sbyin pa gsum po gang 'grub byed cing dgra sogs la mi byed pa'i phyogs ris can dang / chos bshad pa dang srog bskyabs pa sogs la gtang rag dang / phar dngul byin na tshur gser 'ong du re ba lta bu dang / phyi ma rnam (65na8na gyi 'bras bu rang mkhas pa dang 'jigs pa med pa dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'ong re ba sogs kyi bsam pa mtha' dag spangs te/ phar phyin bsdus pa las/ slong ba mngon du 'ongs na rgyal sras des/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tsho gos ni spel ba'i phyir/ /desagazhan 'du shes bdag la bzhag byas shing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'du shes de la bskyed/ /ces 'di la brten nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par bya'o snyam pa dgos pa la dmigs pa dang / dang po nas bdag gi chos dang gzhan skyob pa'i nus pa dang bdog pa thams cad gzhan la btang zin pa yin pas bcol ba'i rdzas len pa dang mtshudas pa yin snyam du dngos po la dmigs pa dang / 'di rnams bdag gi sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin no snyam pa'i zhing la dmigs pa ste bsam pa khyad par gsum ldan gyi sgo nas ji ltar gtong na/ chos zab pa sbas nas mi zab pa ston pa dang / 'jigs pa thams cad sel nus bzhin du phyogs re tsam skyob pa dang / dngos po ngan pa dang grangs nyung ba dang g.yin gyi lag nas phrogs te ster ba sogs kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pas ma gos shing / bzhin mdangs gsal zhing 'dzum pa/ ngag snyan par smra ba/ g.yin la 'tshe ba med cing rang gi dka' spyad khur du bzod pa'i sgo nas sbyin bya'i yul dgra gnyen bar ma yon tan can skyon can mtho dma' mnyam gsum skyed pa dang sdug pa ste/ bcur bshad pa'i dgos pa dgra la byams pa yon tan can la dang ba sogs so sor ngos zin pa'i ched de don dril na der sems can thams cad 'dus pas skabs dang (65ba thastun nas chos kyi sbyin pa ni theg pa che chung gi dam pa'i chos gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa dang / sgra tshad bzo gso la sogs pa thun slong ba'i rig gnas sogs lhag bsam —93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)dag pa'i sgo nas rang gis ji ltar shes pa bzhin ston cing bslab pa'i gzhi 'dzin du 'jug pa sogs nyan pa po'i blo dang sbyar nas 'di dag rnams kyis thos bsam sgom gsum byas nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod dgos te/ chos bshad pa'i rjes su dge ba bsngo ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi phyag len du snang ngo / /der ma zad rang nyid chos 'chad pa po'i ming du btags pa min yang grogs skye bo gzhan dag sdig pa mi dge bar 'jug par 'dug na gleng mo'i tshul gyis blang dor bstan te de las bzlog nas dge ba la sbyor ba sogs bsam pa khyad par gsum ldan gyi sgo nas chos sbyin la dngos su 'bad cing /dngos su sbyin par bya ba'i yul ma rnyed na snying thag pa nas sems can thams cad la dam pa'i chos bstan par mos shing chos kyi sbyin pa de'i mthus phan pa rgya chen po byung par bsam pa/ dper na chos kyi sgra thos pas kha dmyal ba pa rnams gnas ngan len sdug bsngal las thar bar mos pa sogs kyi sgo nas smon lam khyad par can gdab/ de bzhin du sems can rnams la rgyal po'i chad pas nag can khrims la sbyor ba/ gcan gzan dang dgra la sogs pas lus srog longs spyod la rgol ba/ me dang chu la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa rnams las dngos su rang stobs kyis nus na bskyab/ mi nus na de lasathar ba'i thabs bstan/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du sdug (66na〉bsngal 'di dag gis mnar ba dpag tu med pa yod pas de dag rnams la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa btang ba dang de'i mthus 'jigs pa las grol bar snying thag pa nas bsam/ rang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i mthu ldan du gyur par mos blos sprul te tsha ba'i dmyal bar char chen po phab nas me bsad pa sogs dmigs pa dang smon lam 'debs/ zang zing gi sbyin pa yang bza' btung gnas mal/ na ba'i gsos sman/ dar zab rin chen/ rta glang po/ sa mkhar yul zhing / mgo bo mig yan lag nying lag sogs lus longs spyod thams cad bsam pa khyad par gsum ldan gyi sgo nas sbyin zhing / rang nyid bkres shing phongs pas de ltar byar med tshe/ dper na zas g.yos su byas pa dang ma byas pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas yi dwags —94

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhenasogs bkres pas nyen pa'i 'gro ba rnams la sbyin pas sdug bsngal de las thar bar bsam pa sogs yul dang rdzas skabs thob sbyar te rgya chen por spro ba ni byang sems shes rab can gyi sbyin pa yin pas bshad ma thag pa'i sbyin pa'i nyams len gsum po de yang 'di nas bzung ste chos tshigs bcad bzhi pa yan chad ston pa/ tsha bas gdungs pa la bsil ba'i gnas khang ston pa/ ngan slong la zas gos ster ba sogs nus pa rnams dngos su bya dgos kyi/ nus bzhin du dmigs pas byed pa ni rang mgo rang gis g.yogs par gsung de ltar sngar bshad pa rnams nges par byas nas sbyin pa gtong ba'i dngos po la yid chags pa'i ser sna dang / bdag la longs spyod med pas ster mi nus snyam pa dang / dngos po yid du (66ba tshe(nga ba la dmigs bsal gyi chags sems gang 'dug pa de legs par brtag /bdag sngar yi dwags dang rnam thos kyi bu sogs mtho dma' bgrang gis mi lang bar skyes 'dug na'ang da lta'i snang tshul ni 'di ltar 'dug /dngos po 'di las lhag pa yid bzhin nor bu thob nas de dang bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab snyam yang yang bsams te mi mthun phyogs 'go gnon/ gtong sems mngon gyur skyes kyang lan dang rnam smin la re ba'i bsam pa shas che ba 'dug na/ sngar mchod sbyin grangs med pa zhig byas te brgya byin dang tshangs pa sogs kyi go 'phang thob kyang don med du song 'dug pas da res zas kham gcig sbyin par btang ba yan chad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo snyam pa'i 'dun pa du re ba dang bcas thun dngos gzhi la yid kyis sprul de sbyin pa gsum po gtong ba'i dmigs pa nan tan dang / thun mtshams su dngos su gtong ba dang yid goms pa la 'bad par bya/ des na sbyin pa gsum po de bya nus tshad nyams su blang bar bya'am snyam na/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ spyod 'jug las/ snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag par/ /lus ni btang bar mi bya ste/ sgyu nas 'di dang gzhan du yang / /don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur btang ngo / /zhes snying rje chen pos lus kyi sha gcod pa sogs kyi dka' spyad bsgribs te yid mi 'byung ba ma rnyed kyi bar dang / dgos pa chung ngu'i ched dang / bdud rigs kyis mtho 'tshams pa dang spyon pa sogs kyis slong ba la lus kyi sbyin pa dus dang dgos pa dang sbyin yul gyi —93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (15)sgo nas ster du mi rung ba ni lus kyi dngos po gtong mi gtong gi khyad par dang / phyi'i dbang du byas na blo shin tu (67na skom na pa la theg pa chen po'i chos ston pa dang / rab tu byung ba la phyi dro'i kha zas dus kyi sgo nas ster du mi rung / sdom brtson la sha chang sgog btsong lhag ma mi gtsang bas sbags pa/ pha rol gyis gnod pa byed nges pa'i srog chags nad pa la mi 'phrod pa'i zas/ tshod bgam pa dang nor gyi 'du shes can la glegs bam lta bu yul gyi sgo nas sbyin du mi rung ba/ mi 'dod pas sdug bsngal bzhin du bran ster ba lta bu dngos po'i sgo nas sbyin du mi rung ba/ mi rung ba zhig rgyal po'i phyag sbal nas 'thon na 'gro ba grangs med pa sdug bsngal la sbyor ba btson ra'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sbyin pa dang /gnod sems kyis slong ba la dug mtshon sogs sbyin pa ni dgos pa'i sgo nas sbyin du mi rung bas spyir btang dmigs bsal legs par phyed par byas nas bdag kyang myur du 'chi ba'i chos can yin pas/btang bya'i dngos po 'di rnams kyis kyang bdag 'dor/ bdag gis kyang 'di rnams 'dor bas gang la yang snying po med snyam du snying thag pa nas gtong sems la goms par bya ba lags so/ /smras pa/ yid gtong sems drag pos lus longs spyod/ /drin 'khor thabs med pa'i 'gro ba la/ /dus grangs med byin pas gtan bde'i nor/ /gter 'dzad med bang mdzod deng 'dir grub/ /lar mi bzad dbul phongs sdug bsngal 'di/ /rang gcig pu'i thog tu bab min pa'i/ /ma 'gro ba kun gyi snang tshul te/ /'di brtags na blo yis bzod thabs med/ /sngar dkar min las mang bsags pa'i mthus/ /dus da lta'i snang (67ba〉sno5 'di ltar na/ /da sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs byas nas/ /mtha' mi mngon sems can sgrol bar smon/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims kyi phar phyin ni spyod 'jug las/ nya la sogs pa gang zhig tu/ /de dag gsod mi 'gyur bar bskrad/ /spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ /ces gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las yid phyir log pa'i spong sems ni tshul khrims yin zhing / sems de la goms pa gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par —96

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zheda'agyur ba yin pas sems can thams cad gnod 'tshe dang bral ma bral la ltos mi dgos so/ /de yang nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims la lam sgron du/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi/ /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal pa yod kyi gzhan du min/ /zhesapa'i tshig la 'khrul nas so so thar pa'i tshul khrims dngos bstan la khas blangs tshe byang sems kyi bslab pa la slob pa'i rten can du gyur pa'i lha yod pas/ lam sgron 'grel par/ da ni tshul khrims kyi sdom pa'i rten khyad par can bstan par 'dod nas zhes bshad pas khyad par can ma yin pa'i thun mong ba zhig bshad pa mi rigs mod/ 'o na gang la ngos 'dzin snyam na so thar gyi sdom ldan byang semasakyi bslab pa la slob pa zhig yin na so thar gyi sdom pa dngos de dang thun mong ba'i spong sdom ni skabasa'adi'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims la ngos 'dzin la/ sgo thar gyi sdom ldan min na so thar dang a mong (6ni)ba mi dge bcu spong ba'i spong sdom de la nyes spyod sdom pa'i khrims su ngos 'dzin pa'i phyir na phar phyin bsdus pa las/ mtho ris thar ba'i bde lam gyur pa ste/ /las lam bas po 'di las nyams mi bya/ /'di la gnas pas 'gro la phan sems pa'i/ /bsam pa'i khyad par 'bras bu yod par 'gyur/ /zhesarab byung yin na mkhan slob kyi drung du khas blangs pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pas gos ma gos dang / so thar gyi sdom pa dang mi ldan na sngar skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs su bshad pa'i mi dge ba bas dbang du song ma song yang yang dran shes kyis brtag cing / bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar nyin re zhing dge sdig gang byas la rde'u dkar nag btang nas/ brtsis bas dkar po mang ba la spro ba dang nag po mang ba la 'gyod sems drag po'i sgo nas thun dngos gzhi la thog mar rde'u nag po'i grangs ji tsam byung gi sdig pa dran shes kyis zin pa rnams la phyir 'chos dang / bshags sdom gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bya ba dang bdag gi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogasapar gyur cig snyam du bsam pa dang ngag nas kyang brjod cing / chags sems kyi yul la chags pa drag po skyes pa kha rgyal du ma btang bar kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pa dang mi sdug pa dran pa'i sgo nas 'go 97

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loneganon pa sogs nye ne mongs gang che ba de la rnam smin sogs bas nas gnyan po bsten te bsgoms pas tshulu khrims dag pa zhig 'ong / mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i tshul de skyes bu gsum gang byung ba ngo bo 'dra yang bsam pa'i khyad par gyis dbye dgos so/ /dge ba chos (68ba〉sdud kyi tshul khrims ni byang sems kyi tshul khrims dang ldan pas lusang ga gi dge ba byas pa rnams yin la/ de yang bslab pa gsum dang zhing khyad par can bla ma sogs la rim gro byed pa/ dkon cog gsum la bsngags pa brjod cing gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang ba'i tshig smra ba/tshur gnod pa la sngon las su blta ba/ dge ba rnams bsngo smon rgyas 'debs pa/ dkon cog la mchod pa 'bul ba/ bag yod bas dge ba rgyun mi gcod pa/ dbang po'i sgo nyon mongs pa'i phyogs las srung ba/ zas kyi tshod rig pa/ nam gyi cha stod smad la rnal 'byor la brtson pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam ma rnyed na rang gis bshes gnyen byas te gnyen po bsten pa/ nyes pa rnams yul khyad par can la bshags pa rnams las/ ting nge 'dzin sgom pa lta bu thun dngos/ dkon cog gi mchod pa'i sta gon sogs thun mtshams/ bag yod bsten pa dang shes bzhin gyi bya ra sogs ni gnyis ka la dgos shing bla ma la bsu ba dang stan bstab pa sogs ni dus kyi nges pa med mod/ da lta phyag len la thun dngos gzhi la bshad ma thag pa mtha' dag dpyad 'jog skabs dang sbyar te dmigs pa skyong ba lags/sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni byang chub sems dpa' sems can la phan 'dogs pa ste/ de la yang rnam pa bcu gcig tu bshad pa'i/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sgo nas longs spyod rkun pos mi 'khyer ba'i thabs bstan pa ni bya ba byed pa'i grogs kyi don byed pa dang nad pa la sman dang rkang pa nyams pa la gzhon pas gnas su skyel ba lta bu ni sdug bsngal gyi grogs kyi don byed pa/ chos bstan nas(69na)nyes spyod las ldog pa'i thabs ston pa lta bu thabs la rmongs pa'i don byed pa/ bsnyen bkur sogasabyed pa lta bu phan 'dogs pas don byed pa/ seṅge dang stag la sogs pa'i gnod pa las skyob pa lta bu 'jigs pas nyen pa'i don byed pa/ pha ma dang bral ba'am chom rkun gyis nor 'phrogs pa sogs mya —98

byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / 6)ga gyis zin pa la mi rtag pa'i gtam gyi sgo nas sel ba lta bu mya ngan gyis gzir ba'i don byed pa/kha zas kyis dbul ba la yid du 'ong ba'i zad ster ba lta bu phongs pa'i don byed pa/ chos dang mthun pa'i gos ster ba dang 'dod chags can la mi sdug pa ston pa sogs gnas wo' bar 'dod pa'i don byed ba/ pha rol po dge ba la sbyor mi nus par mthong na mi 'dod pa'i lusang ga gi spyod lam spangs te sems la phan par bya ba ni blo mthun par 'dod pa'i don byed pa/ tshul khrims sogs kyi yon tan la gzengs bstod pa ni yang dag par zhugs pa'i don byed pa/ sdig pa byas pa la chad pa gcod pa lta bu ni log par zhugs pa'i don byed pa/ dmyal ba sprul nas gzhan sdig pa las ldog pa lta bu dang cho 'phrul ya ma zung bstan nas gas 'dun par byed pa lta bu ni rdzus la gyi sgo nas gdul bya'i don byed pa ste bcu gcig po 'di dag la dngos su bya nus mi nus dang dus la nges mi nges sna tsho gos kyang /thun dngos la dpyad sgom gyi tshul gyis nyams su len dgos pas tshig bshad tsam du ma song ba gnad du che/ de yang phar phyin bsdus pa las/ tshul khrims nyams pas rang don mi nus na/ /gzhan don tshulal mthu yod ga las(69bcung / /de phyir gzhan don legs par brtson pa yis/ /'di la rim gro glod pang rigs ma yin/ /zhes don gnyis sgrub pa la tshul khrims 'di rtsab lta bur gsungs pas/gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba'i tshul khrims la goms pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i thabs bya 'tshal lo/ /smras pa/ phun tsho gos dal wor rten gyi da tshal du/ /rnam gsum tshul khrims yongs 'du sa brtol la/ /myang 'das sa bu'i khur chen gyis dud par/ /phan bde'i ro brgya'i snying po ci yang 'dzag /grangasamed bskal par bsags pa'i sbyin pa yi/ /phung po gcig tu dkar ba'i longs spyod kyang / /lha mi'i rten la nyams su myong mi myong / /byed po tshul khrims kho nar rag lus na/ /lan cig thob pa'i rten bzang shing rta 'di/ /bag med lhung ba'i 'dam du nyer bying ba/ /phyir bcos snyul gyis bde ba'i thang yangasapor/ /mi 'don dal bar 'dug rnams gdon gyis brlams/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su —8

bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i phar phyin ni spyod 'jug las/ sems can mi bsrun nam mkha' bzhin/de dag gzhom gyis yongs mi lang / khro ba'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ /dgra de thams cad chomasadang 'dra/ /sa steng 'di dag kos g.yog tu/ /de snyed ko bsal langs/ /lham mthil tsam gyi kobasani/ /sa steng thams cad g.yogs dang 'dra/ /de bzhin phyi rol dngos po yang / /bdag gis phyir bzlog mi langs gi /bdag gi sems 'di phyir bzlog bya'i/ /g.yin rnams bzlog go ci zhig dgos/ /zhesarang gis (70na tsher gro ba rnams la khong khro ba la sogs pa 'gog pa'i sems kyi goms pa yongs su rdzogs pa de bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa yin gyi skye rgu mtha' dag mi srun pa'i blo dang 'bral mi dgos ba yin pas/ zhi ba lhas/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang ba nge gshegs mchode la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang/ khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ khes yul dam pa la khong khro byas pas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'joms par thams cad yod smra ba'i gzhung las kyang byung zhing /dmigs bsal 'jug par/ gang phyir rgyal sras rnams la khros pa yis/ /sbyin dang khrims byung dge ba bskal pa brgyar/ /bsags ba skad cig gis 'joms de yi phyir/ /mi bzod las gzhan sdig pa yod ma yin/ /zhes byang sems stobs chung bas byang sems stobs che ba la khros pas dge ba bskal brgyar bsags pa 'joms nus la byang sems min pa'i so skyes byang sems la khros na bskal ba stong gi dge ba'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa sogs shin tu lci bar gsungs/ rang re rnams kyis khong khro ni rkyen chung ngu re la yang 'bad med du gsog /yul byang sems ni gang zag me dong thal bas g.yogs pa ltar gang na yod cha med pas sngar byas kyi dge ba ni gtan brlag lta bur song zin 'dug pas rgud pa kun gyi rtsa bar nges shing / zhi ba lhas/ gang zhig bsgrims te khro 'joms pa/ /de ni 'di dang gzhan du bde/ /zhes khro ba spangs na tshe 'dir lus sems mi mnar bar ma zad/ skye ba mtha' dag tu bde ba'i rgyur snang bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab snyam pa'i yid du re ba dang bcas(70bsnya/ thog —100

byang chub la mo gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhedamar gnod byed kyis gnod pa byed bzhin pa yin na dang min na sngar byas ba zhig gsal btab nas zhe snang dmar lam pa skyes byung ba'i tshe de'i ngo bo la bltas nas/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe nyen mongasadabang gyur pas/ /bdag sdug nyid kyang gsod byed pa/ /de tshe de dag gzhan lus la/ /gnod mi byed par ji ltar 'gyur/ zhes dper na la la gzhan la mi dga' ba'i nyen mongs drag po skyes pa na rang lceb pa dang mtshon 'debs pa g.yang la mchong ba sogs rang srog rang gis gcod pa mngon sum gyis grub pas bdag gces 'dzin gyis rang la rang gis gnod pa bya mi nus bzhin du nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang gis de ltar byed pa la khro ba'i go skabs med na/ 'gro ba g.yin nyen mongs pa'i shugasadrag pos rang dbang dang bral te gnod pa byed ba la ci'i phyi re khro snyam du bsam/ 'o na gnod byed der rang dbang yod pas kho rang gi gnyen sogs la gnod ba mi byed do snyam na/ gnyen la phan 'dogs pa de ga 'dod chags kyi gzhan dbang du song bar 'dug /sems can rnams la rang dbang dang ldan na thams cad sdug bsngal mi 'dod pas sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can med par thag chod snyam du bsgoms pas rgyal po lta bus dbang med du gnod pa byed par btang ba'i mi de la 'char ba'i snang ba lta bu zhig 'ong gsung / gzhan yang 'gro ba kho rang gi rang bzhin la gnod pa de grub na me tsha zhing sreg pa dang 'dra la/ gal te glo bur du byung ba zhig yin na nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs par nam mkha' la khro mi rigs pa lta bu/ de bzhin du dngos su nad bskyed pa ni dbyug pa lta bu'i mtshon dang / brgyud nas(71na gi sdang gis rbad bas gang zag des byas pa ci zhig yod/ gnod pa byed pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu la khron/ rang gis sngon chad gzhan laganod pa 'di lta bu byas pa las byung ba'i tshul spyod 'jug las/ bdag gis sngon chad sems can la/ /'di 'dra ba yiganod pa byas/ /de bas sems can 'tshe byed pa/ /bdag la gnod pa 'di 'byung rigs/ /zhes so/ /der ma zad bdag la gnod byed 'dis ༅ smras dang rma phyung ba sogs gnod pa phra mo yang mi bzod pa 'di ltar na/ da lta ngan 'gro'i rgyu mang du bsgrubs pas dmyal bar skyes na sdug bsngal ji ltar —101—

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)bzod snyam du rang la zhe khrel yang yang 'debs/ gzhan yang chu thog tu char babs na gnyis ka rlan gsher yin ba las ma 'das pa ltar/ bdag lus dang mtshon cha gnyis ka sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pas zug rngu bskyed pa las 'os ci yod/ rang don sgrub pa'i nyan thos kyang khro bar mi byed na bdag semasacan thams cad pha mar shes te gzhan phan sgrub par sems bskyed nas 'di ltar bya ga la rigs snyam du bsgoms pas lus sems bde 'bol gyi 'gro ba yin gsung da dung g.yin gyis bstod pa byas pa la dga' bar 'dug na smad pa la mi dga' ba shugs kyis 'ong bas/ spyod 'jug las/ bstod dang gragasapa'i rim gro ni/ /bsod nams mi 'gyur tsher mi 'gyur/ /bdag stobs mi 'gyur nad med min/ /lusabade bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bstod pa dang snyan grags kyis phyi mar ma zad 'di'i bde ba yang 'phel bar mi byed pa'i steng du rang nyid don med kyi g.yeng bar 'jug pa dang / gzhan gyis(71ba)phrag dog byed ba'i nyes pa du ma bskyed la/ snyan grags nyams pa'i rgyur song nas des gnas skabasagazhan rkyen gyi 'tshe ba dang mthar thug g.yeng ba med pas byang chub bsgrubs te bde ba mang po zhig 'phel bar 'dug pa de sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs yin snyam du dga' ba sgom pa dang / mtshon lta bu phog na sems la ma gnod kyang lus la cung zad gnod mod ngan smras sogs kyis lus sems gang la yang mi gnod pa'i tshul bsam/ de ltar bsgom bas kyang rang la bstod smad byas pa mgo sgoms pa byung na'ang / da dung dgra la phun sum tshogs pa 'dug pa mi bzod pa'i blo thol gyi shar byung na/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te dgazhig dga' na'ang / /de la khyod dgar ci zhig yod/ khyod kyi yid smon tsam gyis ni/ /de la gnod pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur/ khyod kyi 'dod pas sdug bsngal de/ /grub na'ang khyod dgar ci zhig yod/ gal te sgongs par 'gyur zhen/ /de las phung pa'ang gzhan ci yod/ /nyon mongs nya pas btab pa yi/ /mchil ba 'de ni mi bzad gze/ /des bzung sems dmyal bum par ni/ /dmyal ba'i srung mas bdag 'tshed nges/ /zhes sems can kho rang gis rnyed pa'i bde ba la khro ba'i don med la khros kyang gnod par ci la 'gyur/ gal te gnod du zin kyang rang gzhan gnyis ka dmyal bar sreg pa'i —102

byang chus lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig 'jam pa'i zhal lung / zhedalas yin pa 'dug snyam du sdom sems drag po bya/ de ltar gnod pa byed pa po rnams la dmigs pa'i khong khro'i gnyen po bsten par nus na'ang / rang sdug bsngal thog tu babs pa 'di mi bzod par 'dug snyam na/ sdug bsngal de la bcos su med na mi dga' ba (72na)byas pas dgos nus med cing / bcosasu yod na bcos bas chog pas mi dga' ba bya yang mi dgos la/ da lta mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal 'bab pa 'di tshe sngon ma mi dge ba byas pa'i gos bu yin bas tshe 'dir sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba 'di lta bu zhig ma myong na blang dor mi 'grub par 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'khor ba kho nar zad/ da res sdug bsngal 'dis rkyen byas nas 'khor ba las yid 'byung ste thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa sgrub pa'i rtsa ba byas pas bka' drin che/ gtar sreg sogs dpyad rtsub mo'i sdug bsngal bsten pas nad kyi gdung ba zhi ba ltar phyi ma mnar med du skye dgos pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshab la tshe 'dir nad kyis thebs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal byung bas go bcad snyam du bsam/ bshad ma thag pa de rnams thun dngos gzhi la myong ba thon par byas nas/ thun mtshams la gos phyag dar khrod pa sogs tshangs spyod 'phel ba'i gnas la brten pa'i sdug bsngal dang len/ bstod smad sogs 'jig rten gyi chos la brten pa'i sdug bsngal dang len/ stan la glo mi 'bebs pa'i spyod lam gyi sdug bsngal dang len/ dkon cog mchod pa sogs chos yongs su 'dzin pa la brten pa'i sdug bsngal dang len/ gzugs mi sdug ba dang gos ga pa sogs nyams su blang zhing glu gar sogs 'dod yon las ldog pa'i slong mos 'tsho ba la brten pa'i sdug bsngal dang len/ dge ba'i phyogs la mngon par brtson pas dub pa la brten pa'i sdug bsngal dang len/ gzhan gyi srog skyob pa sogs sems can don byed la brten pa'i sdug bsngal dang len/ tshong (72ba〉(gas spangs pa 'phral gyi bya ba la brten pa'i sdug bsngal rnams dngos su dang du len zhing mi nus pa rnams kyang dang du len pa la yid kyi goms pa nan tan du byas pas/ spyod 'jug las/ gomasan sla bar mi 'gyur pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /de bas gnod pa chudagoms pas/ /gnod pa chen po'ang bzod par bya/ /zhes rim gyis goms na mthar gang la'ang ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'i —103
