gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ 'gro ba kun gyi ngal so'i stegs gcig pu par bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar mchog gsum dam pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten du 'os pa'i kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i rten grangs med pas gangs ri'i ljongs kun khyab pa las khyad par du gyur pa/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan gsang ne'u thog gi chos grwa chen po 'dir/ mkhas grub dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'od du 'bar bas rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sku gzugs sogs bstar ba ni/ dgra bcom pa sa ga lhas/ dga' ston dus ches sku gzugs/ rgan pa'i gong du rtag tu gzhag /ces pa ltar bkod pa khyad par du 'phags shing bzhugs pa lags/skad gnyis smra ba lo chen dam pa'i 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khrir/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i skyes bu'i khyu mchog shes bya mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa can mkhan chen gdan sa pas dbu mdzad/ pad+ma dkar po'i dri bsung la bung ba'i tshogs rnamasang nga gis 'du ba ltar/ mkhan chen gdan sa pa'i snyan grags kyis ring nas bsus pa'i mkhas pa 'chad na phra zhib kyi blo ldan/ rtsod na lung rigs kyi ngar ldan/ rtsom na snyan tshig gi nyams dang ldan pa'i drung chen sogs slob (3na ji pon rgyu skar gyi 'phreng ba lta bus gral gyi mgo bzung / tshul khrims chu gter chen po'i dbus nas legs par 'ongs ba'i mkhas btsun mang du thos pa'i bcu drug gi cha shas yongs su gang zhing / bsam sgom ri dwags lo14

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gtam rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / zhenakyi mtshan mas mjo zhe par mdzes pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung /lugs gnyis kyi byed pos bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde legs spel ba'i drung du nye bar gnas pa rnams kyis zur brgyan/ snyan pa'i gdangs kyis rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams bstod cing bsod nams spel ba'i dbu mdzad rnams kyis gral gyi stod mdzes/ rtsing po'i spyod pa mtha' dag gnya' ba nas gnon pa'i chos kyi khrims su bca' ba'i gzhung las pa rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' bsten/ de ltar mkhan chen ri dbang lhun po lta bur mngon par mtho ba la/ chos 'chad slob dpon gser gyi ri bdun lta bus mdzesapar bskor zhing / 'dus tshogos grangs med pa'i sa 'dzin lta bus yongs su khyab pa'i ngo mtshar gyi dbus 'dir gleng par 'os pa ni mkhas mchogo dpa' bos/ ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogasakyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar byed/ /ces pa ltar/ legs bshad kyi skyes 'os pa yin pas/ srid pa yul gyi chags lugs/ 'phags yul du bstan pa dar tshul/ bod 'dir byung tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis rlung chu sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rim gyis chags pa sogs (3ba(da kyi 'jig rten nga bcud kyi sems can byung tshul mngon pa gong 'og nas bshad pa rnams 'dir bzhugs kun gyi thugs la gsal bas zhu mi 'tshal/ dpal kyi dus 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde gzhan nas 'byung ba rnams gleng bar skabs de lags/ gnyis pa 'phags yul du dar tshul ni/ grags can gyi bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon zhing / de dag gi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ chu srin grong khyer ring nas ma bsrubs shing / /'chi med dbang po'i mdun sar ma 'ongs pa'i/ /phul byung srid 'dir sngon med bdud rtsi'i mchog /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig zas gtsang sras po rgyal/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras pos theg pa chen po ltar na 'og min du byang chub mngon du mdzad nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir la'i rgya ba'i tshul bstan cing / 'og ma ltar na zlad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes brnyes nas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor bas bka' drin che/ rgyal ba de nyid zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal ba'i rjes su lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog /dpyad gsum dag pas yongs su legs brdar bas/ /413—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nebyed po sna tshogs las bzang gnyis pa zhes/ /'phags yul paṇa grub tshogs rnams phyag gi yul/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ zab mo ltab ston pa'i klu sgrub yab sras/ rgya chen spyod pa 'chad la thogs med sku mched/ dngos stobs rigs pa smra la phyogs glang cho ge grags/ blang dang dor bya 'byed la yon shāka rnam gnyis/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son tsan+d+ra go mi/ dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa dpal ldan dpa' bo/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen 'byung gnas sogs/ 'phags yul shel gyi khang pa'i rtsig ngos la thub bstan gzugs brnyan grangs med 'char bar byed pa'i mkhas mchog 'chi ba med pa'i bdag po rnams bka' drin che/ gsum pa bod kyi byung tshul la/ lha las phul byung gi bstod pa las/ rgyal po ru pa ti dpung bcas ri kha ba can gyi khrod du zhugs pa'i rigs sam/ yang na thugs rje chen pos byin gyisabarlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin ma'i rgyud gdong dmar sha gzan gyi rigs/ rus chen bzhi las gyes pa'i khams/ ye sangs dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thag can dang gcig /ye mon nag po khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba dang gnyis/ spyang khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsum/ mon ju nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhin dbye ba las bod du mi'i 'gro ba rgya cher 'phel zhing / rje rgyal po gnya' khri btsan pos/ sman ljongs skyid pa'i yul gru yar klung gi sa'i char phyag phebs te bod spyi la dbang bsgyur ba nas bzung rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ kun tu 'gro la rjes chags bzang po'i gar/ /'phags mchog thugs rje'i mdzad pas gangs can 'dir/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'dod dgu kun gyi sgo/ /thog mar khed pa'i chos ldan rgyal por 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsun gyis dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pas bka' drin che/ de rjes 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogasabya ba byed/ /byang (4bsko phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /la byi rnams rigs su 'byung / /zhes lung bstan pa/ mchog dman skye bo'i khams kyi srad bu dag /dge bcu'i khrims kyi thags su byas pa'i dar/ /las bzang 'bras bu'i kha dog rab bkra ba'i/ /byed po srong btsan sgam po lha yi rje/ /zhes pa'i ro/sto

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gtam rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / 'dabastod yul du gyur pa/ rje btsun phyag na pad+ma'i sprul pa srong btsan sgam pos 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang rten brten pa bzhedas/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims sogs/ bstan pa'i srol gtad pas bka' drin che/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi yi zlos gar gyis/ /bod 'bangs rgyal por grub pa'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /bshad sgrub mdzad par gzigs mor mtshar ba'i blos/ /phyogs kun khyed kyi grags pa sgrog la brel/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyis mkhas grub lo paṇa spyan drangs shing bshad sgrub kyi sde btsugs pa sogs bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pas bka' drin che/ zhi ba thob pa'i sman gyis thar pa'i srog /'tsho mdzad sdom brtson shān+ta rak+ṣita/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /'jig rten mig gcig sgra sgyur lo stor 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ka ma la shī la/ lo chen be+e ro tsa na sogs mkhas grub lo paṇa rnams kyis mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas bod yul (na po kar por mdzad pas bka' drin che/ dmar ser skra yi lan tshar mi ldan zhing / /rno ngar rdo rje'i mtshon cha ma bzung bar/ /rgyal ba'i gsang gsum kun gyi bdag po mchog /mnga' bdag dam pa'i rnam thar snying la 'bab/ zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i rnam 'phrul mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis lo tsā ba ka cog zhang gsum sogs paṇa grub du ma la brten nas skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pas bka' drin che/ rang don 'ching ba'i dra bar ma chud kyang / /gzhan phan zhags pas bcings pa'i snying stobs can/ /mar me mdzad sogs mkhas grub lo paṇa gyis/ /rmad byung mdzad pa'i tshul gyis yid rab phrogs/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ bstan pa phyi dar la 'dul ba'i bstan pa stod smad nas me ro gsar du gso bar mdzad pa'i dam pa rnams dang / lha bla ma khu dbon gyis dka' ba chen pos spyan drangs pa'i jo bo chen po a ti sha /khu rngog 'byom gsum/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ 'brog mi/ mar 'gos sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu mtha' klas par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par du yang / rlung gi shing rta bdun gyis ma drangs shing / /cha shas bcu gnyis dag dang mi 417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ldan pa'i//rmonges pa'i mun tsho gos ma lus 'joms mdzad pa//blo ldan shes rab brgyud par bcas pa rgyal/zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas spel bar mdzad pa'i skad gnyis smra ba'i 5brko bang phyug rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/cha pa chos kyi seng ge sogs bka' drin che/'chi med lha yi dbang gzhu'i lding khang nas/bde bar babs pa'i 'jam dbyangasa'akhon gyi rigs//mkhas grub yongs kyi 'khor rte ba'i dpal//sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i gragasa'abar rgyal//ces pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/lugs gnyis kyi chos srid kyis mngon par mtho ba'i gdugs dkar bo srid rtse'i bar du sgreng bar nus pa'i 'khon sa skya pa zhes yongs su grags pa gang gi rigs las rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' snying po/mi thub zla ba'i rnam tshil bsad nams rtse mo/rig sngagasa'achang ba'i dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan/gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs gong ma'i ti shri bla ma chos kyi rgyal po/rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mas/sde srid phag mo gru pa'i yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mas te 'jam dbyangasarim par byon pa bdun sogs 'khon gyi gdung rabs bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/rgya chen shes bya'i kun gsal bu mo'i mtha'//mkhyen pa'i lus 'degs gcig gis gzhal nus pa'i//shong dpang bu ston stag tshang zha lu ba//don ldan mkhas pa'i grags pa rna bar 'jebs//zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/a mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas thams cad spel ba'i shing rta chen po/shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mas mgo gnyis/dpang ston lo tsā ba blo gros6na tha rtan pa/mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/lor byang tso rtse mo/thams ro ma' pa bu r+sā chos rje/rje gas dam pa gzhon nu blo gros/mkhas pa'i dbang po stag chang lo tsā ba/thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang po sogasamakhas pa ris bral gyi skyes bu rnams bka' drin che/chos srid nor bu'i yu bas cher bteg pa'i//med byung rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i gdugs dkar can//srid rtser 'khor ba'i sa yi tshangs pa che//dpal ldan ga srid phag mo gru par bsngags//zhes pa'i ba/da /la du gyur pa/thub pa'i gsung rab rnams 'chad

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gtam rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / zhenapa la/ rnam par dpyod pa'i mkhyen rab dang ldan zhing / bsod nams chen po'i dpung pas yangs pa'i sachen po thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ sde srid phag mo gru pa ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dbon bcas bka' drin che/ blo chen kun gyis rtogs dka' mkhyen pa'i nor/ /skal bzang kun la gtong ba'i grags 'bar can/ /thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag myong kha pa/ /yab srasabargyud par bcas pa spyi bos mchod/ /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa/ 'jam da byangs gzhone nu'i mkhyen pa'i mngal khur las bde bar 'ongs pa'i mi'i srid pa'i zol can/ thub bstan yongs kyi bdag po/ rgyal ba'i tog gyur chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba myong kha pa chen po bka' drin che/ gang de'i dri ma med pa'i ring lugs gser gyi shing rta blo gsal rgya mtsho'i ra bar 'dren pa'i snying stobs rgyad kyi rigasaldan/ rgyal ba'i (6ba)rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ mkhas grub chen po dge legs dpal bzang / mthu stobs dbang phyug legs pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid blo gros chos skyong / thub bstan gsal mdzad chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mang thos dbang po blo gros brtan pa/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa smon lam dpal ba ste 'jam dbyangs bdun rgyud dang / gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/ dbyangs can ngag gi dbang phyug dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i ral gri mchog legs 'od zer/ paṇa chen chos grags gnyis pa legs pa bzang po/ smra mkhasang ga gi dbang phyug blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mi yi zol can dkon mchog chos 'phel sogs dpal ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ gsung rab rin chen 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ phyogs bral mkhas mang chu klung 'du ba'i gnas/ /dpal ldan gsang phu zla ba'i ma ma gang / /spel ba'i bshes gnyen tshogs rnams rgyal gyur cig /ces pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ rngog lo tsā ba chen po nas bzung ste/ da lta gling stod smad kyi chos kyi gdan khri la mngon par 'dzegs pa'i dpal ldan gsang phu ne'u thog ces yangs pa'i sa kun du mngon par khyab pa'i 'dus grwa chen po/ bod yul gyi gzhung lugs smra ba'i nyal 'gro mtha' dag 'byung ba'i khungs/ chu gter chen po ma dres pa gzugs ga lo/mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)du byas pa'i sde chen po 'di spel ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rim par byon pa mtha' dag bka' drin che/dga' ldan sdebazhi'i sgo 'phar rab (7na8 ba'i/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang che/ /chos srid gnyis la 'khor los 'dzam gling la/ /dbang sgyur mchod yon nyi zla zung gcig rgyal/ /ces pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ rnam par dkar ba'i thigs pa 'bum du 'dzag pa'i legs byas kyi dpung pas/ brtan g.yo'i dge legs thams cad rang byon du lhun gyis grub ba'i dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod yon rnam gnyis bka' drin che/ gang zhig chung ngur bgyis pa'i bdog pas kyang / /bsod nams bye ba'i mgron kun 'gugs cus pa'i/ /snyan grags phyogs kyi 'gram pa'i thos 'dzin rgyan/ /yon gnas dam pa dge 'dun 'di med byung / /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ skabs 'dir dang ba'i nor gyis mngon par phyug pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing gi mchog kun dga' ra ba 'di nyid du phyag phebs pa'i dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams bka' drin che/ dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal las legs sbrum pas/ /dal 'byor dbyar gyi dga' ston ster byed dang / /nges par legs pa'i lam bzang ston byed pa'i/ /drin can yid kyi re skong phyag gi gnas/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa 'thob pa'i rten bzang po dal 'byor gyi lus rten rnam par dag pa skyed pa'i pha ma/ rten de yang log pa'i lam du 'phyan pa 'gog cing thar pa'i phyogs su 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan dam pa mkhan slob sogs bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon rnams bka' drin che/ stobs ldan khas (7ba)drag can gyis log min zhing / /phyug po'i nor gyis khugs par mi nus pa'i/ shes bya'i gnas lugs mthong tshe khong nas 'dzum/ /'tshor bar byed pa'i shes rab 'di med byung / /zhes pa'i bstod yul du gyur pa/ gti mug chu 'dzin gyi phreng bas ring du bsgribs na ni/ /mkhas pa'i gsung gi tsha zer ji snyed cig spros kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i pad+mo ba 'ad par mi nus pas/ /rmongs pa'i tsho gos kyi dri ma drungs nas phyung ba'i chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di nyid thub bstan rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo mdzes par byed pa la mchog tu bka' drin che/ nye lam dgos don gyi dbang du byas 420

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gto rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / 6)na shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi sras dpal ldan zla bas/gang tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas pa//gal te 'di bdag 'dzin par mi byed na//g.yang sar lhung bas gzhan dbang 'jug 'gyur pa//de las phyi nas gang gis slong bar 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar/dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnam par dag pa'i nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di thos bsam sgom pa'i rta bdun gyis legs par drangs nas/sku gsum lha lam gyi ngos su 'gog pa med par rgyu bas/don gnyis 'od stong phyogs brgyar 'gyed pa zhig snying po'i mchog yin pas/de la thog mar lung rnam 'byed las/gdul bya ma thul rnams kyi srab 'di yin//zhes pa ltar bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i sdom pas gzhi bzung /rje sa paṇa gyis/rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na//thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' las 8na ) ring //zhes gsungs pa ltar/lung sde snod gsum dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la mkhas par sbyangs/khyad par du yang /rgyal ba myong kha pa chen pos/tshad ma'i stobs kyis the tshom ma chod phyir//'dam la btab pa'i phur pa bzhin 'gyur bas//zhes gsungs pa ltar/smra ba'i dbang phyug phyogs glang yab sras kyi gzhung lugs la legs par sbyangasate rigs pas gtan la 'bebs/rje btsun byams mgon gyis/nges h+phu da yan lag dang mthong ba'i//lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la//yang dang yang du sems pa dang /'jal dang nges rtog sgom pa'i lam//zhes pa ltar/dal ba'i rten la snying po yang dag par lon pa zhig gtso bor dgos la/de yang skabasadon de ring gi dus/dad pa'i zhing sal gtong ba'i myu gu g.yur du za ba'i sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis rang gzhan gyi ched du bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur pa'i bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa/dge 'dun 'dusapa'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur ba/ dbul 'phongs la sbyin gtong sogs mdzad pa 'di dag blo gros rgya mtshosazhug pa'i mdo las/ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho chenang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad//de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang //byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad//ces gsungs pa ltar rgyu che chung la bltos pa med par bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa ni bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba yin pa/bsngo ba de la yang /bsngo ba'i rgyur zhing gi yul ༷nga du yod na'ang gtso bor gyur pa dge 8bsno 5 na/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)bsam pa mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod/ dngos po kha na ma tho bsadaben pa ste gsum po 'di gtso bor gyur pa yin pas phal po che las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang / /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ /kun nasakun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / bsngo ba ni rgyal ba'i yum las/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pas 'bras bu thun mong ba rnams zhan gyis 'byung bar nges shing / ched du bya ba ni mgon po zhi ba ltas/ dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang drang / /sems can don las gzhan mi spyad/ / sems can kho na'i don gyi phyir/ /thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ grangs med pa'i mar gyur gyi 'gro la dmigs pas dge ba bla med du 'gyur la/ rnam pa ni ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang po shing rta sna tsho gos byas/ /de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med/ /chorme rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis/ zhes pa ltar/ bsngo bya sngo byed la so gos pa thamasacad don dam par rang bzhin gyis ma grub cing / kun rdzob tha snyad du snang ba'i tshul la nges pa rnyed pa'i sgo nas bsngo dgos par gda' bas/ des na mchog gsum dam pa dpang du bzhugs te/ (9na7sngo smon gyis rgyas 'debs pa la 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis mthun 'gyur gnang ba zhu/smras pa/ nor 'dzin bu mo khur gyis ngal byed pa'i/ /grangs med nor gyis bsgrun min legasabashad gtam/ smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'di ko bla ma'i drin/ /btsos kyin lag pa'i pad+mo snying gar zum/ /deng sang kha bas bskor ba'i bod yul na/ /brjod don ldan rnams rjod byed tshig gis stong / /tshig sbyor shes kyang gzhung don smra la rdugs/ /phal cher gnyis kas dben yang chen por rlom/ /tshul 'di mthong tshe thub bstan gzugs brnyan tsam/ /mkhas pa'i skye bar rlom nas blun tshul ston/ /zang zing nor gyisarmongs pa mgo bo bskor/ /phyi mdzes nang stong lder sku gsar pa yis/ bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'di 422

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gtam rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / zhenagang bas nongs/ /mang du thos la phag rgod bzhin du bzur/ /blun po mtha' na bung bas me tog bzhin/ /chos min chos su brdzus la dga' byed pa'i/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir dbang med bzhin du skyes/ /'on kyang thub bstan yid bzhin nor/ /lnga phrag drug pa'i nang yin bas/ /lung gi bstan pa ma nyams zhes/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis rtsed 'jor rol/ /bsngo ba'i gtam du 'os pa yi/ /legs bshad gser gyi 'phreng ba 'di/ /blo gros ldan pa'i mgul rgyan du/ /spel phyir rnam dpyod srad bur brgyus/ /zhes ba 'di yang /rngog lo tsā ba'i chos kyi gdan khri la mngon par 'dzegs pa'i gling stod chos rje blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes/gzhung lugs dang gso ba rigs pa la mi 'phrogs pa'i rnam dpyod can des bskul ba'i ngor za (9ba)hor rgyi btsun pa ngag gi dbang phyug 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i zhes sbyar ba'o/ /me phag zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu la gnang / dge legs phan dang bde ba'i chu gter chen po zad mi shes pa'i 'byung gnas/ byon dang bzhugs shing 'byung 'gyur gyi mnyam med stobs bcu mnga' ba sras bcas nyan rang gi tsho gos rnams kyis/ dngos su dge ba'i bdog pa bskrun pa'i byed pos mtsho ni pa'i lus can ma lus par dgongs su gsol/ bslu med skyabs gnas dam pa'i thugs rje chen po'i mthus ma rnga zhe par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i 'dzad med kyi gter kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag tu 'jam mgon bla ma myong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba'i sgo nas yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas la kun ring du gnas par gyur cigartag par 'dzin pa'i 'gro ba kun brtson 'grus rlung gi shing rtas byang grol mkha' dbyings su thogs pa med par rgyu bas tshogs gnyis sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston zla med du spel ba'i ched du chos dbyings bde ba'i klong du mngon par mnal ba'i rgyal mchog bu ram shing pa/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan shing rta chen po rnam gnyis/ mkhan chen bstan pa'i rtsa lag zhi ba 'tsho/ dpal dī paṃ ka ra/ khams gsum gyi rnam 'dren dam pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal sogs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal sras dam pa de dag rang cag snyigs mas sbags pa'i 'gro ba blang dang (10na〉dor bya'i gnas la ches 423—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)cher rmongs pa rnams kyi thar pa'i sa mkhan du bsams bzhin mi'i srid pa'i zlos gar gyis bshes gnyen dam pa'i gzugs su byon te/ thub bstan rin po che bshad sgrub kyi phrag par khyogs la blangs nas 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad 'phrin thams cad rgyas par gyur cig /gang zhig dang por mang du thos shing de'i don tshul bzhin du rnam par dpyad cing bsams pas mthar rang gi rgyud la 'bad pa med par goms pas mi gnas pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i gling du 'khrid par byed pa'i rten gzhi grangs med yon tan gyi tshogs mtha' klas pa'i mngal khur gyis dub pa'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i gling gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling sogs phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa zab mo rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /mchog gsum dam pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byed po dang / rang cag 'dir 'phogs rnams kyi dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ sems can tshe las 'das pa rnams thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung gi tshogs rnams byang ste myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /bsod nams kyi stobs phul du byung bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas 'dzin pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po spyi dang sems can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyi sngon las kyis bskrun pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i (10ba)phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi zhing legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur cig /gzhan yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i rba klong drag pos skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por lhung ste sdug bsngal gsum gyi chu srin na kra'i sto bar chud pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag zag bcas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las ma pha par thar te/ thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rin po che'i gling du bgrod pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /mthun pa'i rkyen 'byor ba bcu yongs su tshang zhing 'gal rkyen mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral ba'i rten bzang po rgyud mar thob pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /rten de yang bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis legs par zin te mdo dang sngags kyis bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams la thos bsam sgom pa lhur len pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /'khor 424

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gtam rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / ldanab thams cad dug sgrul gyi tshang ngam me'i dong lta bur rig cing / de las thar pa tsam gyis kyang slar mi ldog pa'i chos can gtan gyi bde bar ma nges shing rang nyid gcig bu thar pa'i btsan sa zin kyang dman pa'i gol sar 'gyur ba'i skyon du mthong nas sems can thams cad mar shes pa sogs rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyis blo legs par sbyangs te/ phyin drug gi spyod pa la slob pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /de lta na'ang grangs med gsum gyi ring 'gro ba 'di dag sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba ma bzod pas nye lam zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i phra rags bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / zab mo rim pa lnga la sogs pa'i las lam nyams su (11na〉star bas zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i za ma tog mngon du byas te skye dgu mtha' dag la dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dga' ston rgyun mi 'chad du spel ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /byamasachen bla ma'i ngor bris/ grangs med pa'i dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i rnam 'dren stobs bcu mnga' ba theg pa gsum gyi sras dang slob mar bcas pa spyi dang / khyad par du yang 'dren pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po/ rgyal ba sman gyi bla/ 'phags pa phyag na pad+ma la so gos pa rnams kyis/ dngos su nye bar 'khod pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis gtso byas/ mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ mchog gsum dam pa rnams kyi bla na med pa'i thugs rje'i mas dang / rang gzhan rnams kyis bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ skye dgu kun gyi rgud pa ma lus pa sel zhing / phan pa dang bde ba'i legs tsho gis zad mi shes pa 'byung ba'i gnas dam pa/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams shing / gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes kyang / rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i ched du zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras po/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan (11bsgo nyam med jo bo chen po a ti sha 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags425

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)pa yab sras rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /thub pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe/ mdzad pa 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam bar rgyal bas thog drangs/ phyogs bcu'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde rnams su chos spyod bcu'i nyams len rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /'di ltar dmigs pa'i yul du gyur ba'i sems can tshe las 'das pa che ge mo rnams/ thog ma med ba nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams byang ste myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /der ma gyur pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du yang mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral zhing / rang gzhan gyi 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i mi lus rnam par dag pa thob par gyur cig /rten de la yang theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan pa'i mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam sgom pa lhur len byed nus bar gyur cig /de ltar thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don gyi snying po 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes te/ de bas thar 'dod kyi nges yang gis bsam pas kun nas bslang ste tshul khrimasarin bo che mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung nus par gyur (12na༄ga /rang nyid zhi ba'i go 'phang thob kyang sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub mi nus pa mthong nas/ don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes pa'i ched du sbyin sogs phar phyin drug la slob pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la zhus ba med par 'jug par gyur cig /sbyin pa'i bdag po zhal bzhugs rnams kyi gnas skabs su nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthar thug bla na med pa'i sa thob pa sogs don gnyis lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du dus kyi 'khrug pa la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing /bde skyid rgya chen po rgyun mi lar du 'byung bar gyur cig /de ltar chos dang mthun pa'i bsams don rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par byed pa la dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po phyi nang gsang gsum la sogs pa bsrung ma mthu rtsal can rnams kyis dus skad cig kyang 42sto

dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i gto rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i chu klung / 6)g.yel ba med par grogs byed par gyur cig /mdor na dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / bdag cag rnams kyi mi logs ba'i dad pa dang mos pa'i stobs las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis ji ltar sgron pa'i gnas rnams bde blag tu 'grub par gyur cig /chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /sogs migs bcad ci rigs bya'o/ /phyogs dus kun du sku gsung thugs bkod pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar gyis lus can ma lus par sman yon du skrun pa'i rnam 'dren (12bskos ba mar bcas pa'i tshogs deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag bo 'khor bcas la dgongs su gsol/ dngos su spel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis nye bar mtshon pa'i rang gzhan rnams kyi byas dang byed 'gyur byed bzhin pa'i dge ba'i tshogasarnams kyi mthu la brten nas mnyam med rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar shing / skye dgu mtha' dag bde skyid kyi bgo skal la stod par gyur cig /rtag 'dzin can thams cad brtson sa shugs drag po'i rlung gis thar pa rin po che'i gling du skyel ba'i ched zhi ba'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen dang / chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po sogs dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi thugs dgongasardzogs par gyur cig /zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor ba'i bang mdzod la mnga' bsgyur te gdul bya mtha' dag smin grol rlabs po cher 'god pa'i yongs 'dzin gyi sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las la bar du gcod ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dus rnams su mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar gyur cig /dmigs yul du gyur pa'i sems can tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba myur du stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /bzod par dka' ba'i ngan song gi 'jigs pa la grol te tshe rabs kun du mngon mtho'i rten bzang thob par gyur cig /srid pa'i 'byor pa mtha' dag snying po med pa'i rang bzhin du shes te/ bdag med pa'i don sgom pa sogs la 'bad pas zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /rang nyid gcig (13na ba'i don sgrub pa dman pa'i lam du shes nas phyin drug gi 427

nyams len la ring du 'bad pas sa bcu lam lnga rim gyis 'grod de 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe ma lus pa dag nas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod par gyur cig /dpal ldan chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis dus kun du g.yel ba med par grogs byed par gyur cig /mdor na bdag sogs rnams kyi 'phral kun kun du legs tshogs kyi dga' ston rgya chen po'i 'dod dgu'i char gyis khyab par gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rab 'byams pa dngos grub yon tan gyi ngor bris/ /

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ 6)ra༅༅//bder gshegs bdun gyi mchod pa'i chog bsgrigs yid bzhin dbang rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs the(//༄tsho//ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams bdun du mawo dpe'i dkyil 'khor rtags la yang //cher snyigs lnga bdo'i smag sum bcil la lhag par thugs rje chen po'i nyid//2na lor gsal rlung gi shing rtas rab drangs 'gro blo'i nam mkhar yongs shar bas//phan bde'i snang bas gcig tu khyab mdzad bder gshegs mched bdun gto gyi skyabs//2bskong gi khyad par smon lam tshangs pa'i dbyangs//dpal gyi mgrin pa'i g.yas la dung dkar sgras//byang chen de srid rnabar snyan po'i gtam//sbyin mdzad shākya seng ges 'gro 'di skyongs/thub gsung brgyad brgya'i 'dab stong bzhad tshal nas//rnam dpyod bung bas snying po ze'u 'bru'i bcud//legs phyung mdo chog sbrang rtsi bde skyid lus//rtas byed mkhan chen zhi 'tsho phyag gi yul//'jam dpal sgyu dra lha gcig khri srong rje//'bangs bcas 'di phyi gtan 'dun 'grub nus sman//rnam rgyal 'phreng spel mkhas grub rim brgyud pa//bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshogs la snying nas dad/khyad par chos 'di'i bdud rtsi ro bda' ba//bdag blo'i za ma kho tu 'khyil mdzad pa'i//yongs 'dzin rnam gsum bka' drin byang chub bar//gzhal ba'i snying stobs spobs pa gzengs su mtho//'khor ba mya sgo bdul ring dub pa'i 'gron//ris med 'gro kun myang 'das sim pa'i grong //'khrid pa'i samakhan bde gshegs brgyad mchod sgo//'byed pa'i lde mig chog bsgrigs 'di ko mtshar//rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar lhag bsam gyis//legs drangs thos brtson yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//dpyad bzang sri zhur bgyid las phan dang bde'i//'dzad med 'a/da9 dgu'i byu r+ṣa 'di na 'bebs//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhede yang 'o skol snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams la lhag par thugs rje che ba bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi (3nasgo chod pa'i cho ga 'di la yid ches shing khungs btsun pa lo rgyus/dad pa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir phan yon/ mdo sngags kyi khyad par dang log rtog gi bslad pa zhugs pa rnams la dpyad de zhabrul pa bsal ba/ nyams su blang bya'i cho ga dngos bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po lo rgyus la mdo gsung tshul dang bod du dar tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yangs pa can gyi rol mo'i sgra can gyi shing ljon pa'i drung na 'khor dge slong brgyad khri/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ blo gros chen po/ byams pa/ spobs pa brtsegs nas lag na rdo rje'i bar mtshan smos pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa sum khri drug stong dang g.yin yang theg pa chen po la lhag par mos pa'i lha dang lha ma yin dang dri za dang klu la sogs pa grangs med pa'i tshogs rnams la thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba'i chos gsung zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal stan las langs te g.yas phyogs su skor ba lan gsum mdzad nas/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba'i sgo nas/ gang thos pa tsam gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa (3ba tha dun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'am/ lag na rdo rjes dam bcas pa'am/las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong zhing re ba thams cad yongs su skong ba'am/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis kyis dam bcas pa'i mdo sde ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs bzhi dang ldan pa shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod zhus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyabs grol gyis nad pa dang 'chi kha ma'i don ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pa dang nad pa'i rim gro byed lugs la sogs pa gsungs/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan dang mdo sde 'dzin pa dang mchod pa'i gang zag 430

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenal bsrung skyob byed par khas kyis 'tshes/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis g.yog bdun 'bum bdun 'bum dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan 'dzin pa dang de dag la mchod pa'i gang zag dang mdo sde rin po che 'di gang na bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs der bsrung skyob byed par khas blangs/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal/ skyabs grol/ kun dga' bo la sogasapar gsungs shing phyogs gang du gtogs na gzhen nu don thams cad grub pa 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa'i lo kun dga' bo 'khrungs/ de nas lo bdun gyi bar ston pa'i zhal ma mjal pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i dogs pa med cing 'khor lo bar pa las kyang 'phyi ba'i rgyu mtshan spyod phyogs rgya chen po gtso bor ston pa shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod yin pas 'khor lo tha mar gtogs par mdo lugs gtso bor byed na khas len dgos shing sngags lugs su byed na bya rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su gtogs so/ /de yang kun dga' bos bka' bsdus pa'i mthar yi ger btab pa/gnyis pa bod du dar tshul ni/ 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon pos (4na〉sku shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa na stod mnga' ris kyi cha g.ya' ri dang gangs ris bskor zhing glang po dang ri dwags kyi yul/bar dbus gtsang brag dang spang ljongs kyis bskor zhing ri dwags dang spre'u'i yul/ smad mdo khams rtsi shing nags tshal gyis bskor zhing spre'u dang brag srin gyi yul du yod pa la 'phags pa gsum bka' bgros nas thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+ma dang 'phags ma sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las rigs drug nas 'phos pa'i phru gu drug byung ba rnams rim gyis 'phel te bod mi'i rgyal khams su gyur pa las/ rus chen bzhir gyes pa'i khams ye sang dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thag can dang gcig /ye smon nag mo khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba dang gnyis/ sbyang khrag ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsum/ man rdzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can rnams su dbye ba byung zhing de las rgyal phran sil ma mang du byung yang bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po zhig med na bstan pa mi tshugs par dgongs te de bzhin gshegs pa dang dgung zla mnyam pa'i rgyal ba shar pa'i bu tha chung sor mo dra bas 'brel ba/ mig mas 'gebs dang 431—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'gayu'i smin ma can/ dung so khor mar yod pa mi las 'das pa'i mtshan ltas khyad par can byung ba mtshan mkhan gyis dpyad mi shes par ga'ur bcug ste gaṅgā'i chu la bskyur ram yang zer/ lugs gcig la lha 'dre'i sprul par dogs nas sprugs par grags pa gang ltar na'ang skye ba skyes te byang phyogs kyi nags khrod du 'khyams pa las thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis snang ba bsgyur nas lha ri gyang tho'i rtse mor byon te gzigs pas yar klungs yul phun sum tshogs par mkhyen nas btsan thang sgo bzhir phebs pa phyugs rdzis gnya' bar khri bcas te spyan drangs pa gnya' khri btsan po yin la/ de nas rgyal rabs nyi shu (4ba〉rga lngar lha 'dre rang gis bslabs pa'i snang gshen pas lha mchod byas nas rim gro sogs kyis chab srid bon sgrung gis bskyangs par grags/ de nas kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus pho brang yum bu gla sgang du mdo sdom ma tog /dpang skong phyag rgya pa/ gtsug tor dri med/ gser gyi mchod sdong rnams babs pasadam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyengs shing rgyal po 'di sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i sprul pa yin par grags/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga na sbyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa mi rje srong btsan sgam pos sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyi rnam 'phrul kong jo dang khri btsun kha btu bzhes te jo bo rnam gnyis spyan drangs/ 'phrul snang dang ra mo chesagatsos pa'i rten brten pa mang du bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya sidha sa mtshon pa'i re gnyis gdan drangs shing thu mis bod la yi ge med par gsar du bzos/ de dag la nye bar mkho ba sum rtags sogs bstan bcos brgyad mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgyur/ rab byung gi sdom tshugs kyang 'bangasarnams dge ba bcu'i khrims la bkod de bstan pa'i srol btod/de nas rgyal rabs lnga na 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa lha btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis gsal snang spyan 'dren gyi pho nyar brdzongs pas hor gyi yul du 'byungs shing thams cad yod par smra ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa paṇa chen zhi ba 'tsho zhes bya ba thugs dam gyi lha 'jam dpal dang 'bral med du 'grogs shing zhal gzigs pa/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ sku tshe la mnga' brnyes pas dgung lo dgu brgya lhag 432

sman bla'i mdo chog yid 4r+sā dbang rgyal/ zhedabacas bzhes pa/ rdzu phrul gyis be+e ḍūr+ya'i zhing du byon pa'i ma pha shes can de gsol ba btab pa bzhin phebs/ dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad las brtsams pa'i cho sogasungs kyang bod kyi lha srin gdug pa can rnams khros te mi shis pa mang du byung bas zhi 'tshos(ldan〉rung bstan pa bzhin 'dzam bu gling na che ba'i sngags mkhan sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng gdan drangs/ lha srin dam la btags shing sagazhi btul bas zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa bzhin bsgrubs nas chos byed pa la bar chad med par brten mkhan pos sad mi mi bdun sogs shes rab can sum brgya rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po mdzad pas mkhan chen dang byang chub kyi thugs lhag par 'byongs pas bo dhi sa twar grags/ 'dis rgyal po'i sku rim la gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs ga dang sman bla'i mdo chog gnyis mdzad pa'i cho ga 'di nyid shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod mdo brgyad brgya pa las sngon 'gro bshams zhing bsgom pa la 'gal rkyen sel ba phyi nang gi khrus dang / mthun rkyen bsgrub pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa/lta ba bsgom zhing spyan drangs pa/ dngos gzhi'i skabs mdor bstan spyi'i phyag /rgyas bshad so so'i phyag mchod smon lam/ mjug chog gtang rag gi phyag sogs sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi sgo nas bsdus te lag len khrigs chags su mdzad pa 'di nyid kyi rdzas dang yo byad bshad chod bzhin du rgyal pos bsgrubs te tshes brgyad byung res kyis ma chag par gnang / sman bla'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ye shes pa gdan drangs nas bsam yas dbu rtse'i lha tshogs rnams rab tu gnas/ cho ga 'di ma chag pa'i mthus rgyal po sku tshe ring / mnga' thang mtho zhing 'jam/ bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams dar zhing lo chu legs/ mi phyugs la nad med cing dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas/ de'i dus na bod kyi bde skyid sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha dang mnyam zer/ rgyal pos mdo dang cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa dngul shog la rwa chu bo'i gser dang be+eḍūrla spel mas bris te dngul gyi sgrom bu la rin (5ba)po che du mas spras pa'i nang du dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' mang du gsol nas bzhugs te mchod pa rgya chen po ma chag par phul/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la yon mchod gnyis kyis smon lam gcig tu btab pa rang cag kha ba can pa rnams kyi bsod pha33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānenams kyi dpal du smin par mngon/ yab rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rigs kyi sras chung ba mu tig btsan po'am sad na legs mjing yon la gnang / yab kyi mdzad pa ltar sman bla'i mchod pa bzung bas nub cig be+e ḍūr snang ba'i zhing khams mthong zhes zhus pas ji ltar byung gsung bar rgyu mtshan rnams gsol ba na yang dgyes nas shin tu med par 'dug sman bla'i zhing khams su skye bar nges pas phyin chad kyang mchod pa la brtson par gyis gsung / 'dis skar ma'i tshod la brten nas brtsigs pas skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang du grags pa bzhengs/ des phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa khri lde gtsug brtan nam ral pa can la gnang / 'u shang rdo'i lha khang bzhengs shing mchod gnas sde gnyis la bsnyen bkur dang chos rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab cing mdo'i mchod pa la brtson par mdzad/ des lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje la gnang / de yang glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs nas nub par nye ba'i tshe sras mnga' bdag 'od srungs chung ngu'i dus su yab mes kyi thugs dam dngul gyi ga'u'i nang na 'dug pa gzigs pas dad nas yum la 'di ci yin dris pas 'di gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam yin/ rgyal bu rang gi yab chos la gnag pas tshe thung bde skyid ma byung zer/ da 'di sus shes byas pas lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes shes zer/ khong la zhu dgos byas bas/ ma na re rigs ga zer/ rgyal bu'i zhes nas rigs mi gtso chos gtso gsungs te slob dpon bde ba'i rdo rje spyan 'dren du btang nas pho brang du 'di'i mchod pa zhus pas nam mkha' nas me tog (6na gi char dang rol mo'i sgras mchod pa rgyal bus gzigs pas ngo mtshar skyes/ nga sman bla'i thugs kyis 'dzin par 'dug /gang smon pa'ang 'grub gsungs nas tshes brgyad byung res kyi sman bla'i mchod pa ma chag par mdzad/ mya ngan las 'das nas dbu thod la sman rgyal gyi sku gsal bar byon/'di yan la brgyud pa snga dar dang man la phyi dar zhes grags/ des sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan la gnang bar/ yab mes kyi lugs bzhin mchod pa gnang bas grongs pa'i tshe ljags la sman bla gtso 'khor gsum dang ring bsrel mang du byon/ des sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon la gnang / khong mnga' ris stod du sprugs pa'i tshe yab mes kyi thugs dam khyer nas mchod pas sku tshe mnga' thang 'phel/ yul khams 434

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenarnams bde bar 'gyur/ des sras bkra shis lde la gnang / des tshes brgyad la ma chag pa dang cho 'phrul zla ba la nar mar mdzad pa na lan cig sku khams ma bde bas rim gro la sman bla'i mchod pa dang gzungs bzlas pa'i chus khrus byas nas gzims pas mnal lam du mi dkar po zhig gis khyod kyi 'di las nad yin pas/ sman gyi mchod pa 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du yi dam du gyis gsung / de tsam 'byor pa'i cha rkyen med byas pas khyod rang gi khang pa'i phyogs nas 'dom gsum shar du gzhal ba'i sa na gser phye bre gsum yod/ de thon la mchod pa gyis gsung bar mnal sad pa dang thugs bde bar byung / mi dkar po de byang chub sems dpa' skyabs grol yin par 'dug /gser phye btan te mchod pa byas pas snyun bde zhing skye ba snga phyi shes pa'i mngon shes shar ro/ /des sras kho re laganang / de la de warā dza dang nā ga rā dzar gragasapa'i sras gnyis byung ba byang sems nyi snang dang zla snang gi sprul par grags/ (6ba〉thab sras gsum ga rab tu byung ba'i yab kyi mtshan lha bla ma ye shes 'od du grags/ dge 'dun mang po bsdus te nyan bshad sgom gsum btsugs/ bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad cing sman bla'i mchod pa mdo nas bshad tshod dang mthun par cho 'phrul dang tshes brgyad la ma chag pa dang / rgyun gyi thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad/ sku gshegs pa'i dus pur sbyangs pas nyin zhag bdun du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ thugs kyi dkyil nas sman bla mtshon gang pa zhig byon/ nam mkha' la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas be+e ḍūrla'i zhing khams su bzhud pa mthong bar grags shing / lo rgyus la lar chos kyi don du gser slong bar byon pas gar log gis btson du bzung ba dang 'ga' zhig g.yul sprad nas shor ba sogs mi mthun pa mang zhing btson nang du gshegs par mthun pas mya ngan 'da' kha'i ltas sogs kyi lo rgyus chos 'byung phal cher na ma gsal yang gdung bdag med du bskyur bar gzhan gyis zhabs tog 'dra byung ngam snyam/des gcung gi sras mnga' bdag lha lde la gnang / des sras mnga' bdag 'od lde la gnang /des sras btsan lde la gnang / lha lung dpal rdor ma gtogs 'di yan chad bod chos rgyal gyi gdung sha stag yin/ mnga' ris gnar pa dgra bcom byang chub tshul khrims zhes sde snod gsum la blo sbyangs pa 435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānedes mnga' bdag rtse lde la sman bla'i mchod chog zhuganas thugs dam du mdzad/ rang gzhan thams cad la phan 'dis thogs/ dus lan cig tsa na yon bdag cig gis gdan drangs nas nga la cha rkyen yod pa la bu gcig kyang med/ sman bla'i mchod pa zhig zhu zer mchod pa byas te khyod la bu bdun yong bar yod pas bzhi nga'i btsun pa byed gsung ba bzhin byung ste bu bzhi phul ba rab tu byung zhing phyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po re (7na jung skad mnga' ris dgra bcom pa dgung lo brgyad cu'i thog grongs pa'i tshe sman bla mched bdun dbu thod la byon/ 'dis spa gro'i dpa' gor brag nag tu bzhugs pas dge bshes brag nag par grags/ des gtsang gi lhan dung lhar byon/ rus pa zhu yin pas zhu lhan pa shes rab grags bya bar gnang / 'dis sman bla'i cho ga mdzad pas bde gshegs 'khor bcas mngon sum du spyan 'drongs pa pho rog pa mdo sde mgon gyis brag sngon phug pa nas gzigs par grags/ gser bzang dri med kyi zhing khams mjal/ tsha bo zhig btson du shor ba sman blar gsol ba btab pas thon/ des ra sachu lhad pa dar ma rgyal mtshan la gnang / skran gyi nad bdun zhugs pa sman blar gsol ba btab pas zhi/grongs pa'i tshe dung g.yas 'phyil dang ring bsrel mang du byon/ des snar thang gro mo cher mtshan thogs pa mtshan dngos gro ston bdud rtsi grags la gnang / pha ma'i don du mdo chog mang du mdzad pas sman bla'i zhing khams yang yang gzigs shing yab yum gnyis zhing khams der skye ba'i mtshan ma rnyed/ gar bzhugs kyang sman bla'i zhing khams yid la 'ong gsung / lta sgom zhig po bya bar mdze byung bas g.yu drug dmar brgya ri ma zhig phul nas nad gso bar zhus pas sman bla'i lha bshos byin/ sman gyi gzungs chus bkrus pas lo gcig na mdze bsos dad pa thun mong ma yin pa thob/ cha rkyen thams cad sman bla'i thebs su phul zhing shi tsa na 'ja' dang ring bsrel du song bas gro mo che bas mchog zung lta bu'i sras gnyis su grags pa'i sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs la gnang / mya ngan las 'da' dus sman bla'i zhing khams su 'gro gsung gshegs pa'i tshe nyin zhag bdun du me tog gi char babs shing dbu thod la (7ba)sman bla byon/ des mchims nam mkha' grags la gnang / thugs dam gyi gtso bo sman blar mdzad pas 436

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenathugs yid ches pa sha stag byung / des bshes gnyen chen po bsod nams ye shes la gnang / bla ma 'di gnyis brgyud yig gzhan nas ma rnyed kyang stag tshang ba'i nyams len bde 'jug nas byung / des tshogs chos lung mkhan chen shad ston bsod nams grags pa la gnang / 'di nyid kyi thugs la byang chub kyi sems rtsol med du 'khrungs pa sogs rnam thar 'gangs che/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa'ang 'di la bzhes/yang na sangs rgyas sgom pa nas/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/ des spru lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ des spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ de la mkhan chen bsod nams grags pas gsan/ de nas rim pa bzhin mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen tshul khrims dpal 'byor/ chos lung shar gling pa 'khrul zhig kun bzang mthu stobs dpal 'bar/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'amang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rigs kun bdag po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ de la bdag gis mdo chog gi lung nos/ yang na bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub chen po blo mchog rdo rje/ de la bdag gis zhus/gzhan yang zhi ba 'tsho nas/ bo dhi satwa chung ba/ rgyal po dge ba'i dpal/ jo bo r+ṣa po a ti sha lha btsun byang tso 'od/ ti si ba (8na 〉 jo po/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ kong po lo tsā ba/ dgra bcom pa rgyal mtshan/ gya ba dbang mdzes/ gya ba dpal mdzes/yon tan dbang phyug gangs pa 'dul 'dzin/ mkhan chen bsod grags pa'i bar du brgyud pa'ang snang /mnga' bdag rtse lde yan gyi brgyud pa rnams la kun mkhyen bu ston gyi bzhed par 'di dang mi mthun tsam 'dug pa snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa la 'khrul pa ci la mnga' na'ang gang la goms pa gtso che'am snyam snar thang pa'i bzhed pa bzhin bkod la/ gnar pa man gyi brgyud pa phyi ma la yig rnying 'dra dang gsan yig la lar mthun mi mthun ci rigs snang ba yig skyon shor ba yin nam the tshom gyi gzhir 'dug pas 437—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhethams cad mkhyen pa stag tshang pa dang kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig la yid brtan du bzung ngo / /bya rgyud dang 'brel ba'i sman bla sprul sku'i rjes gnang ni rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ de la bdag gis nos/ stag tshang lo tsā bas longasasku'i rjes gnang du grags pa rig pa'i dbang lnga tsam la rigs lnga'i sdom gzung byed pa'i phyag srol zhig 'dug pa ni ma dag par nges pas bdag gis ma zhus gsung ba dang / ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gis sman bla longs sku'i rjes gnang zer nas dbang bzhi mdor bsdus shig sbyor ba blun po rnams kyis rang bzo yin tshul gsung ba med par snang mod/ sman bla lha nga gcig gi dkyil 'khor du bya rgyud lugs kyi chu cod pan la brten pa'i dbang rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub nas/ zur chen kun mkhyen chen po nas brgyud pa bdag gis thob pa ni rgyud sde dang mthun nam snyam mo/ /gnyis pa dad pa bskyed phyir phan yon ni/ ji skad du/ dad pa (47da pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos kyi mi 'byung ste/ /sa bon me yis 'tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ 'di gnyis gtso bo shes rab ste/ /de yi sngon 'gro dad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dad pa la dkon mchog gi yon tan la dad pa/ las 'bras la yid tshes pa'i dad pa/bden bzhi'i blang dor la byed 'dod pa'i dad pa gsum las/ dang po nyid la yid ches bskyed dgos pa ni/ lung phran tshegs las/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs bcas sa la lhung yang srid/ /sa 'di ri dang nags bcas mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni bskam par 'gyur srid kyi/ /drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ /zhes yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rdzun gsung ba ni nam yang med la/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa las/gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon sum du me tog dang spos dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang na bza' dang rgyan rnams kyi mchod pas mchode pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lha'i bu dag gang sems can la las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya stong ngam bskal pa bye ba lon yang 438

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ 6)sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes mtshan nas lan bdun brjod nas nam mkha' la me tog gtor na de dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed par 'gyur ro//me rta go nam mkha' la gtor ba lta shog gi gang dag dad pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su slob pa la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul bslab pa gcig tsam 'dzin nam/nyin gcig gam/mtshan gcig gam/yud tsam zhig de bzhin gshegs9na〉 la mchod pa yid la byed par brtson na de sdug bsngal mthar byas nas rim gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro//zhes dang /lung gzhi las/mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas//sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na//'dzasbu'i chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni//stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min//zhes dang /sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/khams gsum dag na bde zhing skyid pa//thams cad dkon mchog mchod las byung bas//des na bde zhing skyid pa 'dod pas//dkon mchog gsum po mchod la brtson bya//zhes dkon mchog gsum po dngos dang de'i rten la mchod pa'i phan yon mtha' klas pa de bzhin gsungs par ma zad rang rgyal dgra bcom pa bye ba phrag brgya la lo mang du bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la dad pa'i sems kyis yud tsam zhig mig gis bltas pa bsod nams che bar gsungs shing bram ze zhig gis lam khar de bzhin gshegs pa la tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod pas bskal pa chen po nyi shu'i bar du ngan song gi sgo khegs par gsung /de yang sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus las kyang 'das rjes ring bsrel/gsung rab/de 'dzin pa'i chos smra ba la mchod pa phan yon che zhing khyad par ting 'dzin rgyal po las/bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/dang ba'i sems kyis zas dang skom rnams dang /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i 'phreng ba yis//sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro bya//gang gis dam chos rab tu 'dzin pa dang //bde gshegs bstan pa 'gags par 'gyur ba'i tshe//nyin mtshan du ni 9ba〉slab pa gcig spyad pa//bsod nams de ni de bas khyad par 'phags//zhes dngos su bslaX pa9 la sbyar na'ang dbyibs mtshungs pas dam pa'i chos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāne'ajig par nye ba na lha bsgos sogs kyi mchod pa phul ba bsod nams che zhing de las bkur sti'i phyag 'tshal dang bstod pa/ de las rten gsar du bzheng zhing rnying pa gsang/ de bas kyang thos bsam sgom gsum sgrub pa'i mchod pa lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan la nges par drang dgos zhing bye brag chos 'di pa'i phan yon mnyam med jo bo chen po di paṃ kā ras mtho lding gser gyi lha khang du zhing khams re la bstod pa re mdzad skabs bde gshegs gzhan bdun la mtshan gyi me tog sogs dang sman blar/ mtshan tsam thos pasang na 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel/ zhes sogs mdzad la/ mdo chog chung bar grags pa la drung pa grags don pas mchan bu zhig btab pa'i mjug na mtshan gyi me tog mkhan pos mdzad pa'i kha byang 'dug pa yi ge ma dag pa zhig la yid brtan du bzung ba 'dra/ thams cad mkhyen pa stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs mkhas pa'i gsung la jo bos gnang bar bshad la/ mtshan tsam thos pas ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob cing gal te ngan song du song yang dran pa tsam gyis de las thar par 'gyur bas sangs rgyas kyi spangs rtogs la khyad par med na'ang thabs mkhas pa dang smon lam dang mtshan gyi phan yon la brten nas 'gro ba'i rgyud la thugs rje 'jug che ba'i dbang du byas te dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchims chen pos bde gshegs gzhan rnams la phyag 'tshal bdun bdun/ shākya thub pa la bco lnga/ sman blar nyer gcig bya ba'i khyad par mdzad cing chos 'di'i 'gro don gyi dus kyang lnga brgya'i tha ma la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa byung ba na sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tsho gos kyis bsgribs pa/ mya ngan dang sdug (10na)bsngal sna tsho gos kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa'i skabs yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan spyir bstan pa nyamasadama' bar song na gsung rab spyi dang gzungs sngags sogs kyi mthu chung du 'gro bar gsungs mod/mdo 'di ni dus ༅ snyigs ma'i sems can gyi don du nan gyis gsungs pas nus pa cher 'gro ba smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba yin la/ de yang sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang las kyi sgrib pa yongs su byang ba dang bdud sdig can gyis mi brdzi bar bya ba sogs phan yon spyi dang bye brag tu ser sna dang tshul 'chal dang nga rgyal dang phrag dog dang phra ma dang las sbyor ngan pa 450

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhedabyas pas rnam smin cher myong ba rnams kyang sngon sman bla'i mtshan thos pa dran nas sdug bsngal las thar te bde ba phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba dang bslab pa thams cad 'chal kyang rnam smin mi 'byung zhing 'khor los sgyur rgyal sogs su skye ba dang bud med kyi skye gnas las thar zhing bu nor tshe dang dbang phyug gang 'dod 'byung la/ bu btsa' ba'i tshe nad mi 'byung ba sogs de bzhin gshegs pas phan yon rgya cher gsungs par 'jam dpal gyis mtshan bsgrag par dam bcas shing mdo sde gnas sar srung ma sbran zhing ston pas kun dga' bo la chos dkon mchog gi smon lam de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag par gyur pa sogs kyis yid ches skyed par mdzad/ nad drag pos shi ba gsos shing rgyal srid la nyer 'tsho mi 'byung zhing zhi ba/ kun dga' bos srog dbang tshang ba slar mtshams mi sbyor ba'i rtsod pa bkod pa la byang chub sems dpa' skyabs grol gyis dus min gyi 'chi ba bcu gso bar theg chen gyi lung las gsungs tshul gyi lan btab pa/ mtshan thos pas gnod sbyin bdun (10ba tsher bum phrag bcu gnyis kyis bden pa mthong nas mdo 'di bsrung bar dam bcas pa rnams ni gdan 'dzom pa'i bar gyi bka' mchid dang lha'i bu kha cig don de dag la yid gnyis skyes te ston pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad do/ /bder gshegs bdun spyan drangs nas gdan 'dzom pa la byang chub semasadapa' 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis be+e ḍūrla'i gzungs zhus par brgyad gas mgrin gcig tu phan yon rgyas pa dang bcas pa gsungs/ gsang bdag 'khor bcas kyis bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa yang thos zhes sogs kyi bka' mchid kyang bgyis/ phyag rdor gyis gzungs byin gyis brlabs shing tshangs pa la sogs par bsrung bar bka' bsgos/ kun dga' bos chos kyi rnam grangs kyis zhus pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa'i bka' mchid de/phan yon de dag la brten nas mnyam med jo bo chen po yab sras kyi bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i zhu lan nor bu'i 'phreng bar/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal dpal ldan mar me mdzad bzang po ma dag pa'i gdul bya la dus drug tu gzigs shing bzhugs pa'i tshe snyigs ma'i mgon po rgyal ba bdun dang / rang 45/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lozhegi ston pa shākya thub pa dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / zhes sogs kyis ched du bsngags pa dang jo bo yab sras nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams pa rnams bde gshegs brgyad dang gnas brtan bcu drug gi mchod pa mdzad pas phyogs de'i mos pa dang ldan pa rnams la 'brel che shing ris su ma chad pa'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dam pa'o/ /gsum pa mdo sngags kyi khyad par dang log rtog gi bslad pa zhugs pa rnams la dpyad de 'khrul ba bsal ba ni/ spyir bder gshegs (11na〉dun gyi cho ga 'di mdo sngags gang du btags tshul la/de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo sho lo ka brgyad brgya pa paṇ+ḍita dzi na mi༄/ dwa na shi la/ shā len+d+ra bo dhi/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde rnams kyis bsgyur ba dang sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo paṇ+ḍi ta sngon ma gnyis dang lo tsā ba bshad ma thag pas bsgyur ba'i sman mdo gnyis ka snyigs dus thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros gnyis kyis bsgrigs pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi sgrigs rtsom mthun par bya rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su mdzad cing / kun mkhyen bu dang zha lu lo chen gyi bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag gnyis su'ang mkhan pos mdzad pa'i mdo chog bya rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel khrod du bkod pa yin la/ rgyal ba gnyis pa shar myong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal yang bzhed par brten mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba dang paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i rgyud sdospyi rnam sogs mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i yig cha mang por yang sngags phyogs su bshad pas mkhan pos mdzad pa'i cho ga 'di nyid kyang sngags lugs su 'grel ba dang mdo lugs su 'grel ba'i lugs srol sna tshogs byung ba gnyis ka mi 'thad pa ma yin te/ bshad khungs kyi mdo 'di rgyud du gtogos pas snga ma ltar byas pa 'brel mi mtshungs pa ma yin cing / mkhan pos mdzad pa dngos bstan ltar na mdo lugs gtso bor ston pas gnas lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i don gyi paṇa chen stag tshang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i nyams len bde 'jug las/ kha cig 'di rgyud du bsdus nas rgyud kyi cho gar byed pa'ang mi rigs te sgo 4 2

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenamado'i cho ga gtan med du thal tshul/ (11ba〉do sdo las byung ba'i cho ga zhes sogs kyis khungs smos pa'i rang tshig dang 'gal tshul/ de nyid bsdus par theg pa chen po'i mdo dang gsang 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud mdo dang bsres zhes pa lta bur 'khrul nas rigs 'gre byas tshe su tra dang su tra se na'i khyad par mi phyed pas mdo sngags mi 'gal bar 'gyur ba/ rgyud sde gong ma gong ma nas 'og mar sgrub tshul thun mong ba rnams len du rung yang dbang ma thob pa'i gang zag gis 'og ma dang thun mong du spyad du mi rung ba rgyad nar son pa dang byis pa gnyis kyis rdo rje theg mi theg gi dpe dang bcas dogs sel rgyas par gsungs pa mkhan po byang chub sems dpa'i mdo dang shin tu 'byor zhing rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i legs bshad yin mod/ 'on kyang kun mkhyen bu sogs mkhas pa mang pos sngags phyogs su bzhed pa mtha' gcig tu mi 'thad par smra ba ni rang nyid chos mig ma thob pas dka' zhing rang gi gros chung ngu'i mig gis cung zad brtags na stag tshang lo tsā bas/ gzhan thams cad mdo 'dir khrigs chags su mi gsal yang slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'dis mdo gzhan nas 'byung ba dang 'ga' zhig bya ba spyi'i cho ga nasacung zad blang du rung ba rnams bsdus par gsal lo/ /zhes pa dang / paṇa chen shāka mchog pas mdzad pa'i 'chi ba med pa'i mdzod kyi rnga sgra las rnam par phye ba zhes pas thig dang phye ma gram bur brdal ba zhes pas tshon 'gyed pa bstan tshul gyi 'bru gnyer ba'ang don la 'byor zhing thig tshon rnam gzhag sngags lugs yin pas mdo rgyud so sor gsal chog pa zhig yod par mngon pas sngags lugs su byed na rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i bder gshegs brgyad kyi mchod chog ltar gzhal yas khang sngags lugs kyi mtshan nyid tshang ba 'od zer lngas bskor ba/ rang gi lha bris 'bur gang rung 'god lugs dang 'og tu gsol (12na 'debs kyi tshig brjod pa mchims dang rgya ston gyi yi ge sogs la brten cing lha'i sku mdog rnams rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal ba'i gsung gi rjes su 'brangs/ gzugasabum yang sngags lugs ltar sgrub tshul dngos gtsang zhing de'i sdom tshig kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses mdzad par/ rgyud 'di bya rgyud nam yang ma yin te/ /yin na mdo chog mtshan gzhi bstan dgos zhes/ /lha sngags 453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānedagra bzhin spong bar byed pa sogs/ /ha cang mkhas pas dpyad drags skur 'debs kyis/ /rnam par bslad kyang de ltar shes pa nyung / /sgro skur bral ba'i bya rgyud nyams len 'di/ zhes gsungs la/ sngags lugs ltar nyams su len na sgrub pa po rnams kyis rigs gsum spyi'am de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la brten pa'i bya rgyud kyi dbang mtshan nyid pa thob dgos shing lag len gyi skabs dkyil 'khor gzhan las lha sta gon nges par dgos pa 'dir dmigs kyis bsal te btang snyoms su 'jog kyang thig tshon gyi cho ga gsang ba spyi rgyud dam de la brten nas rje dkon mchog lhun grub sogs tshad thub kyi mkhas pas gnang ba'i yi ge'i steng nas nges par bya dgos/ de yang spyir bya rgyud la cho ga'i chings gong ma nas blangs te mdzad cing lha sgom tshul la yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ stong pa yi ge sgra gzugs dang / /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug yin no/ /zhes lha drug gi rnam gzhag gsungs pa thams cad mkhyen pa myong kha pa chen pos rdo rje 'chang gi lam gyi rim par rgyas par gsungs shing la la da ltar ma bsgoms na bya rgyud tshad ldan ma yin pa lta bu'i blo chung byed na'ang mtha' gcig tu ma nges te thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i tshe dpag (12ba thad la cho ga gsum bskyed las med pa sogs mtha' klas shing skabs 'di'i nyams su len tshul ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las bas yolas/ ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba dam pa dang bral ba dang bdag nyid lhar bsnyems pa dang bral bas bsgrub pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu gnas zhes pa ltar bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs gcig la de ltar bshad pas 'dir bdag bskyed med pa la lha spyan drangs nas mchod cing 'dod don zhu ba rje 'bangs su bya ba'i lugs so/ /de yang rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams la yang bsnyen sgrub lta ci dbang tsam yang ma thob par sto rgyab kyi ched du cho ga de dag la tsham tshom med par 'jug cing thob rlom 'gas lag len rnam par ma dag pa'i cho ga dri bcas dang rdzun can/ la las rgyun med bzhin du mgo bskor te bskur ba la yid brtan du gzung ba sogs bstan pa rin po che btsog chus bslad pa'i dus ngan 'dir 474—

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ 6)gsang sngags dang 'brel ba skad kyi snyan grags las rje stag tshang pa'i bzhed pa bzhin mdo lugs kho na nyams su len pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gsung bgros su/ khe che la nyen chung gsungs pa dang don mthun par mngon pas dngos bstan nyams su len tshul 'og tu ston no/ /paṇa chen shāka mchog pas mdo'i cho ga /sngags kyi cho ga /thun mong ji ltar bya ba gsum du gsungs te phyi ma la dkyus su ji ltar gsal ba bzhin bklags pas chog pa yin no/ /zhes pa mdo chog la mchims kyis lhan thabs mdzad par mi mkhas pa mang pos blun bcos kyi mdo sngags bsres pa'i nyag nyog sna tshogs yod 'dug pa de la thugs rtse gtad 'dra ba ma dag pa'i yig hrul la yid brtan ci la yong zhing mdo rgyud kyi nyams len cig car du bsgrub pa lta ci dgos mnga' ris su lo chen rin (13na ji na bzang pos mtho lding lha khang gi steng thog tu bya spyod/ bar khang du rnal 'byor rgyud/ 'og khang du bla med sogs so so'i nyams len mdzad pa ni mkhas pa mgu ba skyed pa'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal phul du byung bar mngon/ thun mong gi sa bcad 'dis seng ge dkar mo la sna gong cung zad nyag pa'i mi khar song 'tshal zhing / drung pa grags pa don grub kyis lha lung klu sdings su mdzad pa de la'ang mdo sngags gnyis mnyam bsre 'dug pa 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi brtul zhugs la rgyu mtshan gleng yul du mi sems so /gnyis ka 'gal med du nyams su len mi nus shing mdo lugs ltar nyams su len na cho ga'i 'go bor su bhā wa sogs brjod pa/ yo ga dang bla med kyi mchod pa byin brlab/ gtor bsngos kyi skabs badz+ra yak+ṣa dang phyag rgyas sbyar ba/ bum sgrub sa bon las bskyed pa/ bstod pa'i skabs gang drin ma sogs sngags dang 'brel ba'i tshigs bcad/ shar phyogs ga' na gyis mi thub zhing khams nas/ zhes sogs so so'i gnas dang sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad bskang gso la dpe blangs pa lta bu'i spyan 'dren gyi tshig sna tshogs/ dkyil 'khor gzhan dag gi mchod 'phreng mang po blangs te gdangs dang bcas gzhan snang 'drid pa lhur len thabs sogs dgon pa mang po'i bla ma dang byad 'dren gyis snang ba la gang dran bcug pa'i rang bzo 'ba' zhig tu zad cing lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu mkhan pos spang mchod spyan 'dren ring mo/ mdo bskul sgo lo3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānering mo la sogs pa mchod brjod kyi cho ga'i rim pa mtha' yas pa mdzad zer ba snang yang / sdom gsum rab dbyer/ mdo bskul ring mo zhes bya ba/ bka' la nor ba byed pa mthong / /mdo rgyud kun las 'di ma gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos 'phel na/ /(13ba tha stan pa'i rtsa ba nub par 'gyur/ sangs rgyasagasungs pa'i cho ga kun/ /sla bar gyur kyang mi byed la/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni ma gsungs na/ / dka' yang 'bad nas byed pa mtshar/ /zhes gsungs pas 'di dag kha g.yar ba las tshad ldan min nam snyam mo/ /slob dbon shī la bha dra dang gnyag dbon bsod nams bzang po sogs mkhas pa'i yig char gshin don gyi cho ga bshad pa'ang stag tshang lo tsā bas/ gshin po la rigs drug rnam dag tu grags pa'i rnying ma'i gshin chog dang bsres pa ni nam yang mi 'thad la/ zhes pa ni mi ba ched par ma zad/ ngor chen gyis/ bye brag tu gshin po'i don du byed na spyan drangs pa'i rjes ming byang ngam rten bshams nas/ de la bgegs sbyang ba nas skyabs 'gro'i bar byed cing khrus kyi skabs su khrus dang dug dbyung sogs byed pa dang mjug tu skye sa bcu gnyis kyi smon lam byed pa dang zhes ma dag pa'i grangs su mdzad de sngags lugs kyi skabs su'ang ma bzhed pas sngags lugs su khas blangs kyang rigs 'gre ha cang dpa' thal ba'i deng sang gi bla ma rnams kyis brgyud khungs med par lha dang bla ma yin tshad la 'da' kha ma'i 'pho ba'i nyams 'a sbyar ba dang 'dra bas/ rje mkhyen brtses/ la la tshom bu tsam yang mi 'god la/ /chang 'thung ngang nas blo la gang yod kyi/ /nyag nyog thams cad cho gar bsre ba dang / /ming byang dgug gzhug khrus rdzas bsreg pa sogs/ /ha cang blun pas byas pa' sgro btags dang / /zhes gsung ba thog tu babs/ la las chos dkon mchog mchod pa'i dus phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang skyabs grol gyi skabs don zhags lha lnga'i phyag mchod sbyor ba/ phyag 'tshal gyi tshe bka' gdams brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal sbyor ba sogs kyang 'don cha mang ba gtso bor bton (14na)pa'i skyon dang mdo chog 'di ga'i klags lung gi bla brgyud la/phyag 'tshal ba ded du med par dgon pa'i bla rabs sogs mos tshad bcug pa sde dgon gog po'i rnam thar kho nar mngon/ ngor chen gyis shāka thub la gnas brtan bcu drug gi phyag mchod sbyor ba mi 'thad 456

sman bla'i mdo chog yid 4sto dbang rgyal/ zhenapar gsung na'ang stag tshang lo tsā bas 'thad par gsungs pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo theg dman ltar na gnas brtan bcu drug yin pas don gyis thob par sems mod/ 'on kyang phyag mchod dngos su sbyar na tshig nyog gi rgyu che bas de las sngon gyi yig rnying la brten nas gnas brtan phyag mchod logs su byas na dngos gtsang ngo / /rmi ru bla ma brag sgo rab 'byams pa phun tshogs rgyal mtshan gyis mkhas pa bsten nas sgro 'dogs gcod pa lta ci smos klags lung mtshan nyid tshang ba tsam yang ma btsal bar rtog ge rgan po'i ham pas gnyag dpon gyi par ma de dang gzhan yang yig rnying thor bu mthong bar brten lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs gsol 'debs sogs lhan thabs ma nyungs pa zhig bris nas legs bshad du rloms te po ta la'i bka' 'gyur khang du ja gral gyi sar sman blar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum byed kyin yod ces gleng ba rgyas pa lhan thabs de sbyar ba dang ma sbyar ba'i dkyus ma 'bring po lta bu'i rtsis kyi zhe 'dod snang ba sngags phyogs su sbyar na thig tshon dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag sogs dgos pa'i dogs pa tsam yang ma shar zhing lha'i sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal por bsgom pa sngags lugs la dgos shing mdo lugs la bden pa'i stobs dang mos pa'i mthus mchod gsol byed pa ma gtogs bskyed rim lta bu'i gsal snang mi dgos la/ bum pa mdo lugs ltar bsgrub pa dang gso sbyong len yul badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa sogasa'agal 'du sna tshogs pa'i (14ba tshe sngags lugs sbyar ba de rgyas pa dang / ma sbyar ba 'bring por byed pa'i legs bshad 'di 'dra sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis ma rnyed 'dug pas 'di 'dra'i rigs la lha sa legs bshad du ming 'dogs dgos par snang / nyid lha pa sku skye'i ram 'degs par song bas gsung rab byings dang mi mthun pa'i chos skad 'ong ba med par snang ngo / /de'ang mdun gyi mchod yul du cho ga las bris 'bur gyi rten 'god par gsungs pa mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lugs dang mthun rung rje stag tshang pas/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad la shar du sman thub gnyis/ lhor mtshan zla gnyis sogs kyis bskor ba/ shar sngo/ lto ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu'am dmar skya ste/tredze7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'asman bla la ni be+e ḍūrla'i 'od ces gsungs kyang gzhan rnams kyi sku mdog nges par dka' bas mdzes tshon du gsal lo/ /zhes mdo 'di ga'i bshad khungs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan ma gsal bas ding sang byed pa rnams ni rje stag tshang pas/ bde gshegs byang sems sogs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan ding sang gi mchod 'phreng la grags pa tshor bshad pa la'ang mdo'i khungs med cing rnal 'byor rgyud nas byams 'jam dbyangs sogs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan bshad pa skabs su ma babs pa dang khyad par gnod sbyin gyi phyag mtshan ni rgyud kyi khungs kyang ma mthong bas dka'/ zhes gsung ba mdor dngos bstan la med pas thugs bden mod/ 'on kyang mdo lugs la bskyed rim ltar lha'i gsal snang dgos rung bris 'bur la gsal kha med na 'bur ma dang bris bya ba'i rngo ma thogs pas sku mdog phyag mtshan med thabs ma byung bar dgos te rje stag tshang pas/ cho ga 'di la rnal 'byor mdzad pa'i gang zag mang po byang chub sems dpa' dag pa'i snang ba khyad par can mnga' ba byin pa rnams kyi gzigs snang sogs yin srid pas mtha' gcig tu dgag par (15nas nus shing ri mor 'bri ba sogs la sku mdog phyag mtshan nges pa can byed na snga ma'i phyag len la brten pa las ma 'das pas phyag mchod kyi skabs su 'gal ba cher med par mngon no/ /zhes gsung ba sngon gyi yi ge khungs btsun la brten dgos pa'i shes byed du song zhing / snga rabs kyi yig rnying mthun mi mthun sna tshogs byung na'ang rje ngor chen gyi yi ge ltar byas na dpyad bzod par mthong de yang bzhugs tshul la shī la bha dra/ ngor chen/ stag tshang lo tsā ba/ bya rgyud lugasakyi dbang chog rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pas mdzad pa sogs nas pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa bshad cing 'god lugs dkyil chog tu gtso bo sman bla dang byang shar du yum chen mo/ ngor lugs la lte bar yum chen mo/ gzhan gnyis la lte bar chos dkon mchog /paṇa chen shāka mchog gis seṅge'i khri chen po brgyad tshar du dngar bar bsgrigs pa/ de re re'i steng du de bzhin gshegs pa re re dang mdo 'di'i po ti yang re re bzhugs/ zhes gral gcig la sbreng tshar du bsgrigs pa'i bar na po ti re bzhugs pa'i khungs cho ga rgyas pa la bcol ba 'dra zhing / mkhan pos mdzad pa'i mdo chog che bar grags par de ba'i tredze8—

sman bla'i mdo ga yid 4r+sā dbang rgyal/ zhenagayas g.yon gyi gral stod du 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon gyi gral smad du tshangs pa dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang rgyal po ོ po bzhi dang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ོ po bcu gnyis bzhugs/ gdan 'dzom pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang phyag na rdo rje dang skyabs grol gsum gdan 'dzom pa la/ zhes byung ba gzhal yas khang gi bzhugs tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bod kyi tshoms chen du grags pa dang thang la yol bas bskor ba'i nang du chang sa lta bu'i gral sgrig gi (15ba)nyams shig 'dug pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ chos 'byung dang dkar chag tu mdo chog rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tshad mar mdzad pa zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen po'i gsung la 'brul pa mi mnga' na'ang kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gtsug dgu /'chi bdag 'joms pa ma gtogasasbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi lhag ma rnams dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang mi ba ched pa sogs skabs 'gar drang don du 'grel dgos kyang snang zhing / nges par thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo chen rin chen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i bstan 'gyur dkar chag tu/ bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam cho ga dang zhes pa la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod tshul ma gsungs shing der ma zad/ 'di nyid phyogs gcig sdud pa'i byed po mchog /kha ba can gyi 'dren pa gcig pu pa/ khri med rgyal ba'i ring lugs gces 'dzin pa'i/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston kha che yin/ /'di la brten nas kha ba can ljongs 'di'i/ /phyogs phyogs dag tu thub bstan la bsams nas/ /'byor bas mngon mtho'i sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig dang / /bstan 'dzin rnams kyis rgyas par byas pa yin/ /slar yang chos kyi spyan ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /slad nasang ba rnams kyis 'di la yang / /ma sgo ma chud nor ba a pa dang / /zlos dang sho rim zhakhrugasapa la sogs pa/ /bcos par bya ba du ma yod pa rnams/ /rkang gnyis mchog gi bstan la legs bsams nas/ /rnam dag lung rigs gzu bo'i blor ldan pas/ /legs par 'chos pa'i rtsom pa mi 'dor zhu/ /zhes gsungs pas dkar chag snga ma rnams la'ang dag ma dag gi dpyad pa dgos par bstan pa'i phyir dad pa'i rjes 'brangs tsam bya mi rigs par sems la/ ngor chen gyis cho ga rgyas bsdus gnyis bka' byu9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhegadams pa zhig (16na gis byas kyi mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa ni ma yin no zhes thag bcad/ shī la bha dra/ stag tshang pa/ shāka mchog pa gsum gyi yig char mdo rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi los tsam yang mi 'dug cing shoms dang snying rje sems bskyed kyi skor rgyas pa phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba sogs lha klu spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad skor de bzhi gshegs pa bdun gyi spyan 'dren gong du yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan yid la gzung bar bya zhes pa las 'phros te/ bde gshegs bdun so so dang / bye brag tu sman bla'i phan yon rgyas bshad sogs mang tsam snang yang kha thag ring ba las dgos don lhag po cher mi 'dug pas mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i mdo chog gcig pu 'di ka las med par mngon zhing / mdo chog chung ba de la sgos kyi smon lam brgyad dor nas thog mtha' bzung ba tsam las brjod bya khyad thon ma byung mod/ 'on kyang gar lugs drung pa grags pa don grub kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam thams cad nas tshwa ran bltas pa lta bu'i sher snying sho lo ka gcig la bsdus zer ba'i dpe zla de 'dra las ni drags shas che/ slob dpon tshul khrims bzang pos/ phyogs skyong gi 'og tu mkhan po dang chos rgyal yon mchod bzhugs par gsungs pa ni ha cang thal ches te/ de ltar na rgyud sde so so'i lha tshogs kyi khrod du lo paṇa dang sbyin bdag 'jug dgos par 'gyur ram snyam zhing shāka mchog pas/ rta babs dra ba dra phyed sogs 'dul ba gnas mal gyi gzhi las kyang bshad gsungs pa legs pa'i char 'gyur na yang de 'dra bris tshe blun po rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du ga hril gzhi byung dogs pas stag tshang pas pha gu tshun bshad pa rgyas bsdus 'tsham la/ byin brlab gsum pa stan byin brlab kyi skabs (16ba)lha rnams sngo grangs su byas par 'ga' zhig la lha bskyed dam snyam pa'i log rtog 'byung srid mod/ de ni so so'i stan bshams pa lha rnams spyan drangs pa'i tshe de bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam yin la/ spyan 'dren lugs kyang shāka mchog pas/ /ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod dper mdzad pa rnam dpyod kyi rtsal yin cing chos dkon mchog la lung rtogs gnyis las ni rten sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de nyid spyan 'dren pa de nyid kyis chog la/ chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag gang gi ngo bo la spyan 450

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zheda'adren mi dgos pas spyan 'dren logs su ma bshad/ ces dang / de'i 'phros las/ yum chen mo'i sku 'bri bar mi 'thad par bshad pa mdo lugs sor bzhag na de legs par mngon te/ rje stag tshang pas/chos dkon mchog gtso bor lung la sbyar nas gsungs pa la spyir lha sku dang sgos chos spyi la sbyor rgyu sher phyin kho na dang de yang yo ga nas bshad pa'i dmar ser phyag g.yas sogs ni rang bzo kho na yin no/ /cheXs pas shes nus/ sngags lugs kyi cho ga dang dbang gi rnam gzhag byed na lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par nges par dgos shing chos thams cad kyi snying po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las lhag pa med pas skyon du mi 'gyur bar sems/ ngor chen gyis lha rnams zhal phyir bltas kyi tsa ka li la pho brang du ming btags pa bon po'i lugs kyi rten bsham pa dang / zhes gsung ba mdo chog gi tshig don la dbags kyang legs par ma mthong zhing bstan pa snga dar gyi dus chos dang 'phral gyi don tshul bzhin du ma go ba'i mi'i rigs dang ban blon cho sel gnag pa dag gi ched du/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sku la rgyal blon gyi ming 'dogs pa sogs byung 'dug pas dus der dgos dbang gi sa bon dang phyogs mthun par mdzad pa'am yang na las dang po pa 'dras lag len khong du ma chud (17na)pa'i rgyun ma goms pa'i nges pa mi 'dug /rje stag tshang pas/ pho brang du grags pa mang po'i dar sham gyi tsaka li la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgo dang sgo khyud drwa phyed sogs byas pa'ang mi 'thad de mdo'i khungs med la/ rgyud kyi khungs rnams dang skabs ma 'brel ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i gsung la dpags na mdo nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor ma grub pa'i rigs la de tshab tu byas par 'gal ba med cing dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pho brang btsugs na mi 'thad pa yin nam yang na dar sham la dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo byas pa 'dra byung srid pa la dgongs sam snyam/ paṇa chen shāka mchog pas/ gzhan dag sman bla'i pho brang du grags pa'i chos po ti dbus su bzhugs pa la lha rnams zhal phyir bstan nas bris pa 'di ni mdo sngags kyi lugs gang dang yang mi mthun mod/ bsod nams gsog pa'i yan lag tu 'gal ba med do/ /zhes par dpags na ding sang bris thang tsam re gnyis dgram pa las tshom bus mtha' brten pa'i dmigs rten gyi rigs mi 45/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānebasham pa'i sla chos gtsor brtan 'di 'dra las pho brang yang skyon du mi 'gyur ba 'dra la/ 'on kyang mkhas ba la las lha rnams rgyab sprod mdzad par brten bod kyi rgyal khrims zhig cing mi shis pa byung ba sogs 'dug pa sngags rnying ma'i sgrom khrir tsaka li mang po 'god pa ni rgyan dgod las dngos gzhi ma yin la/'dir ni rten bsham par bshad pa de ga dngos bstan yin pas mi shes pa'i dogs gnas tsam 'dra yang / ga:'i dkyil 'khor zhal sbub pa sogs la dpags na blo'i bye brag las mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing / gtso bo ni gang zag gi rtogs pa mtho dma' la rag pa 'dra'o/ /gzhan ma shāka mchog pa'i der tshad med kyi rjes su stong nyid dang sems bskyed kyi go rim gzhan dang mi mthun pas mi 'thad par sems shing (17ba)ste ṣa
