bh+yo mdo dang cho gar med gsung ba bden kyang lhan thabs cung zad dgos pa kha 'phangs pa'i mi gsal bas gzungs 'di yang mkhan po'i dgongs par don gyis 'gro bar brten mkhas pa rnams kyis sbyar ba yin cing / ma rig mun sel mdo chog na med gsung na'ang bstan 'gyur khungs btsun par yongs grags kyi cho gar 'dug pas dpe ma dag pa zhig gzigs pa 'dra/ cho gar gdugs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la de'i rnam par shes pa slar ldog cing dran pa rnyed la/ zhes par la la dag mngon pa mdzod du/ mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ /zhes phung po rnying pa la 'jug par mi srid pa'i dogs gnas byed na'ang theg pa che chung gi bshad tshul la mtha' gcig tu tshad gzung dka' bas dper na dus kyis 'chi ba la rim gro sogs kyis mi bzlog cing dus min la bzlog nus pa'i rig pas tshe zad nas shi ba'i rnam shes phung po rnying pa la mi 'jug cing ma zad na 'jug nus pa'i gnad 'gag cig yod 'dug pas 'jam dpal gyis cho ga zhus pa'i dgos pa dang gnyis kyi phyi ma'i skabs shāka mchog pas/ mthar byed kyi gshin rjes zin pa'i rnam par shes pa slar log ste tshe ring bar 'gyur ba la sogs zhes gsungs pa don dang 'byor bar mthong zhing mdo'i dngos bstan gyi tshig dang mkhan pos lhan thabs su glan pa'i khyad par la gzhud 'dir sa gzhi brlab pa nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs te bzhugs pa'i bar ni sngon mdo sde 'di gsung ba'i dus su lha'i bu shes rab chung ba rnams kyi the tshom bsal ba'i slad du de 452

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenapa bdun zhing 'dir spyan drangs/ shākya thub dang thabs cig tu bzhugs pas 'jam dpal dang phyag na rdo rje gnyis dang zhu ba zhu lan dngos su mdzad cing mdo'i don dang gzungs sngags brlab par mdzad pa la brten pa'o/ /de lta mod kyi shāka thub man chad spyan drangs pa'i tshig rnams ni mdo dang dngos su sbyor rgyu med kyang / bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag (18na thad kyi zhing gi bkod pa zhes pa nas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi la zhes pa'i bar phal cher mdor dngos su snang la/ gzhal yas khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa zhes pa nas smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ zhes pa'i bar mdor mi snang yang thogs med kyi theg bsdus las byung ba bzhin bsnan/ zhing khams de dang de dag gi dbus na gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid tshang ba yod pa sman bla'i thad kyi mdor gsal/ mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig dang longs spyod par gyur cig dang de bzhin du gyur cig /ces pa rnams mdo dang sbyar rgyu med/gzhal med khang gi dbus su seng ge'i khri chen po brgyad la de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad bzhugs pa dang bar gyi snam bu la byang chub sems dpa' gleng gzhi las byung ba zhes pa ni mdo dang sbyor rgyu yang / chos po ti bzhugs pa dang 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i gdan lhag ma bsham pa ni mdo dang sbyar rgyu med/ yang de pa bdun la phyag mchod 'bul ba dang de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam dang mthun pa'i smon lam 'debs pa ni mdo dang sbyor rgyu yod/ shākya thub man gyi phyag mchod gnyis la mdo dang sbyor rgyu med cing cho ga'i tshig gzhan rnams ni mdo'i tshig dngos bstan la yod do/ /rjes chog gi tshig rnams ni mkhan po byang chub sgos dpa' nyid kyis nye bar sbyar ba yin no/ /zhes gsung ba ni legs par snang / de bzhin gshegasapa'i bka' yang dag pa zhes sogs ni smon lam rnams 'grub byed du mdor med kyang mkhan pos mdzad pa yin no/ /bzhi pa nyams su blang bya'i cho ga la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum las/ dang po mdo chog las/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i gzungs klag pa'i chog mdo sde las btus pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /(18ba〉byag byed par 'dod pas lus legs par bkrus la gos bzang po dri ma med pa bgo zhing kha zas gtsang ma bza' bar 453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānebya/ /sems nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i dri ma med par byas te/ dkon mchog gi yon tan dang mdo sde'i phan yon la yid ches shing dad pa dang gus pa bskyed/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ khyim pa yin na bsnyen gnas kyi khrims bzung / dus bzang po chos brgyad lta bu la brtsam/ gnas yid du 'ong ba gtsang mar byas la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan mang pos legs par brgyan pa'i nang du spos kyi maṇ+ḍal chen po byas la tshon phye'am me tog gis dgram par bya'o/ lugs sku'am ras bris sam/ 'jim pa la byas pa yang rung ste ring bsrel dang bcas pa bya/ 'khor 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gdan yang bsham/mchod pa ci 'byor ba yang bshams te/ sku gzugs re re'i spyan sngar mar me bdun bdun dang tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bdun bdun bzhag /gzhan yang spos dang / me tog dang / dri dang lha bgos dang / rol mo'i bye brag dang / rin po che sna bdun dang / bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad dang / bum pa la sogs pa sta gon bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa mdo sde zab cing rgya che ba yang ci nus kyis bklag /gzungs kyi cho ga 'di zhag bdun nam zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ sum cu rtsa lnga'am/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu snyed du bklag par bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa bshams pa dang / dge 'dun tshogs nas stan bde ba la 'dug nas stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ci nus su bsgom/ zhes gsungs pa'i don bsham pa dang bsgom pa gnyis yod pa'i bsham pa la/ gnas khyad par can yid du 'ong bar phyag dar dang chag chag gdab cing sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkod pas mdzes par stegs bu'am ma 'grub na zhal ba spos dang sman gyi byug pas dri zhim par bya/ der gzhal yas (19na ming bri ba la sngags nas byung ba'i thig tshon gyi cho ga mi dgos kyang tshad mi 'phyugs pa'i phyir du thig chen brgyad nas sgo khyud kyi bar gdab/ tshon bkye lugs rta babs sogs spangs pa'i gzhaX yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su lha snam dkar po gru bzhi pa/ de'i phyi rol tu shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i lha snam gru bzhi pa gnyis byas la/lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ bar ma la pad+ma bcu drug phyi ma la nyer bzhi/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad la seng ge'i khri re re/ bar mar zla gdan re/ phyi ma'i shar sgo nas brtsams te g.yas gral sgo 54

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenal phyogs skyong bcu dang nyi ma zla bar brag ri'i gdan/ g.yon gral la sde dpon bcu gnyis la za 'og gi gdan/ sgo bzhin rgyal po chen po bzhi la pad zla'i gdan rnams rdul tshon gyis legs par bzhengs/ de'i phyi rol tu rin po che'i bye ma brdal ba dang ༄ la sogs zhing gi khyad par bshad pa rnams bde ba can gyi zhid bkod ltar thon na gang legs 'bri/ pha gu'ang sngags lugs ltar rtsig pa'i steng du ma yin par phyi rol nas mtha' bskor ba'i rgya che ba ste dper na skyed mos tshal yangs pa'i dbus su rgya gar gyi khang bzang 'dra ba dang de'i mthar lcags ris bskor ba lta bu'i don spyi shes dgos shing rtsig pa'i steng nasabre phul gyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i rgya phibs can no/ /der 'god pa'i dmigs rten ni dbus su mañdzi lta bu'i khar mdo brgyad brgya pa'i glegs bam bzhugs/ shar nas brtsams te lha rnams 'god pa la/ bris 'bur gang byed kyang mngone rtogs med bzhed du 'dug pa bzhed tshul mang yang rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyi lugs bzhin/ shar du shāka thub ser po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag can/ lhor sgra dbyangs ser po g.yas mchog sbyin (19bskong g.yon mnyam gzhag can/ nub tu mya ngan med mchog dmar skya phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag can/ byang du mtshan legs ser po g.yas mi 'jigs pa dang g.yon mnyam gzhag can/ byang shar du sman bla sngon po g.yas mchag sbyin gyi phyag rgyas a ru ra dang g.yon mnyam gzhag steng na lhung bzed can/ shar lhor gser bzang ser po phyag gnyis chos 'chad can/ lho nub tu chos bsgrags dkar dmar phyag gnyisachos 'chad can/ nub byang du mngon mkhyen dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag can/thams cad kyang chos gos ngur smrig dang mtshan bzang gis spras pa rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ bar gyi snam bu dang po'i shar dbus su 'jam dbyangs dmar ser glegs ral can/ de'i g.yas su skyabs grol dkar po phyag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur brla'i steng du bzhag nas bsnyems tshul gyis cung zad 'gying ba/ byang shar gyi grar nyi ma ltar snang byed dmar ser g.yas ut+pa la'i steng na nyi mas mtshan pa'i glegs bam g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi g.yon du phyag rdor ljang khu g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang g.yon 455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānerin po che'i 'phreng ba can/ shar lho'i grwar zla ba ltar snang byed dkar po g.yas ut+pa la'i steng du glegs bam zla ba tshes pas mtshan pa/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa/ gleng gzhi nas byung ba'i 'dzin pa bcu gcig ni/ lho'i snam bu la spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad+ma/ de'i g.yon du blo gros chen po ser po mig gis spras pa'i pad+ma/ byams pa mgon po ser po klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa ril ba spyi blugs kyis mtshan pa/ lho nub kyi grwar spobs pa brtsegs dkar po ral gri/ nub tu rnam gnon don yod dkar po ral gri/ lta na sdug dkar po pad+ma'i sdong bu'i steng na glegs bam rin po ches spras pa/ mun pa nges par (20na〉smujoms pa'i blo gros dkar po dbyug pa/ nub byang gi grwar bsam pa legs par sems pa dkar po bum pa/ byang du lhun po brtsegs dkar po zla phyed kyis mtshan pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu/ sang sang po'i dbyangasasngo skya ut+pa la rin po che 'bar ba dang rdo rjes spras pa/ lhun po rtse 'dzin rgyal po ser po rin po che'i snye ma/bcu gcig po rnams g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs ka dang g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs gsol zhing zhi ba'i nyams can sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ snam bu phyi ma'i shar sgo'i g.yon du gnod sbyin gyi sdod pon ji 'jigs ser po rdo rje/ de'i g.yas su rdo rje smug nag ral gri/ rgyan 'dzin ser po dbyug to/ byang shar gyi grwar gza' 'dzin sngo skya dbyug to/ byang du rlung 'dzin dmar po rtse gsum/ gnas bcas dud kha ral gri/ dbang 'dzin dmar po dbyug pa/ btung 'dzin ser po dbyug to/ nub byang gi grwar smra 'dzin ser po sta re/ nub tu bsam 'dzin ser po zhags pa/ g.yo 'dzin sngon po dbyug to/ rdzogs byed dmar po 'khor lo/ g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs ka dang g.yon rin po che skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin cing rin po che'i rgyan dang dar lhab lhub mnabs pa/ lto ba dang gsus khyim che ba/ 'jigs shing rngams pa'i cha byad can/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shar sgo'i g.yas su shing rta'i steng du nyi ma dmar po phyag gnyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/de'i g.yon du ngang pa'i steng du zla ba dkar po zla ba/ ngang pa'i steng du tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi pa g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon bum pa/ shar lho'i grwar brgya byin dkar po glang po la gnas pa rdo rje/ lhor 456

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhename lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa me thab/ gshin rje sngon (20ba〉tho ma he la gnas pa dbyug to/ srin po nag po ro langs la zhen pa ral gri/ chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa sbrul zhags/ lho nub kyi grwar rlung lha sngo skya sha ba la gnas pa ba dan/ nub tu gnod sbyin ser po rta la gnas pa dbyug to/ dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa rtse gsum/ sa'i lha mo ser mo phag la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis bum pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i cod pan dang dar gyis mdzes pa/ shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po phyag gnyis pi waṃ/ lto sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang dmar po sprul zhags/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po ne'u le 'dzin pa/ bzhi ga'ang rin po che'i cod pan dang dar sna tshogs kyis klubs shing zhabs gnyis mnyam stabs kyis bzhengs pa rnams kyi sku rab gser dngul/'bring sman 'dam/ tha ma'ang tsaka li bris pa gnas so sor dgod/ yig rnying tshor ras bris byed pa'i gsal kha ma byung yang chu tshon gyi pho brang la lha rnams bris na 'jug pa bde bar mngon zhing de tsam yo byad dang gnas dus kyis ma 'byor pa la maṇ+ḍal lta bur 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu gong gi 'god tshul ltar byas na de la lha bskyed pa min kyang spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gdan lta bu gnas mi 'chol ba'i gnad yod cing bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis grub pa'i gdan yangs shing rgya che bar spyan drangs pa'i lha rnams bzhugs pa ma gtogs bshad ma thag pa'i rten rnams la bstim pa ma yin mod/ sku gzugs bdun bya'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas sku gzugs bdun po nges par dgos shing 'khor rnams kyang shugs la 'byung bar brten mkhas pa tshad thub rnams kyis mdzad cing 'og tu mgron gyi tshogs gshegs su gsol bas rten gyi ye shes pa gshegs pa'i dogs pa nam yang mi 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa'i gtso (21na)bo bde gshegs re re la mar me bdun bdun tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bdun bdun dgos pa ni skyabs grol gyi smon lam nas khrung ba ltar shes nus la/ gzhan yang sman spos bzang po btab pa'i mchod yon dang byug pa/ me tog dngos sam bcos ma dang sil ma/ tsan dan a ka ru dang du ru ka sogs bsreg rdzas dang phye ma phur mas mtshon dri bzang po'i bdug spos/ zas sna tshogs sbyar ba'i lha bskos/ sil snyan 457—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonesogs rol mo sna tshogs/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ na bza'/ rin chen sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang rtags brgyad so gos dngos ra gyi mchod pa phun sum tsho gos par bsham zhing 'grub na so sor bdun tshan bya/ gnod sbyin phyogs skyong gzhi bdag sogs la gtor ma ma phul kyang rung mod/ mdo dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas 'bul na bshos re bsham/ gzungs bum dri bzang gi chus bkang ba mgul chings dang 'bras bu can gyis kha brgyan pa bstar/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dzom pa la bsnyen bkur zhing mdo brgyad brgya pa dang sher phyin sogs mdo sde zab mo mang du bklag pa'i rgyab chos bya/ dus ni nam byung la'ang byar rung la/ khyad par 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di nyid sa lug dbyar 'bring chu stod kyis nya pa'i tshes bco lnga la yum gyi lhums su zhugs/ lcags sprel sag zla ba'i tshes bdun la sku bltams/ sa byi dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes brgyad rab tu byung / shing rta sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la sangs rgyas/ lo de ga'i chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi wa ra ṇa sir bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor/ lcags byi ston zla 'bring po'i nyer gnyis la lha las babs/ lcags 'brug sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus ston rnams 'khrul med phug pa'i lugs srol bzhin bkod kyi/ chos rje sa skya pa (21ba tha yos dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes brgyad la sku bltams pa/ kun mkhyen bu shing tor bltams pa/ kha che paṇa chen dang khro phu lo tsā ba tha skar zla ba'i nyer gnyis la lha babs su ngos 'dzin pa sogs mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul zab cing brlings pas dpyad par dka' yang lo star gyi zla ba'i dus chen de dag 'byung zhing mkha yod mchod pa ni sangs rgyas dgung lo gang gi dus byung ba'i gsal cha yid brtan gyi nges rnyed ma byung rung rta chen gyi zla ba yin par yongs su grags shing la la dbo zlar yang ngos 'dzin mod bshad ma thag pa'i dus de dag dang khyad par cho 'phrul/ byang chub brnyes pa/ chos 'khor bskor ba/ lha babs rnams dus chen bzhi zhes dge ba gang byas bye ba phrag brgyar 'gyur bar lung sil bu dang myang 'das sogs las gsungs pas phan yon lhag par che'o/ /jo bo r+ṣa po'i ba lko par grags pa'i ston pa'i 'brungs lo ni stod lung jo bo zer ba zhig dang mtshan gyi 'khrul gzhi byas pa las dpal di paṃ kā ra'i dgongs pa ni min no/ /458—

sman bla'i mdo sto yid bzhin dbang sto/ zhedaganyis pa bsgom pa ni/lus legs par bkrus shing gos gtsang ma gyon pa phyi'i khrus dang sha chang sgog btsong sogs ma dag pa'i zas spangs te/dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis mtshon pa'i zas gtsang ma la brten cing sems nyon mongs pa dang bral ba nang gi khrus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas khyim pa yin na gso sbyong la gnas pa dang rab tu byung ba rnams theg pa chen po'i gso skyong la gnas dgos pas/dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang 'dir gso sbyong len pa'i zhing du 'byon par ci gnang /zhes bden pa'i mthus byon te bzhugs par mos la/cher snyigs 22na ) 'gro la thugs rje ོ po yis/man tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde'i snying po'i don//stsol mdzad dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin la sogs pa//dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa//zhesasogs sho lo ka bzhi/phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas//phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor bas//phyogs bcu'i 'gro kun yongs su skyob mdzad pa'i//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//mthun pa'i smon lam mchog tu med byung zhing //spyad pa spyod tshe nam yang mched gyur la//bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo//bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe//phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag skyob pa'i phyir//smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur pa'i//bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sogs/mtshan mchog ldan pa sogs/thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i sogs//rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang //gang du byang chub la reg dang //zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang //zag med mya ga 'das phyag 'tshal//bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang //'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang //seng ge lta bur gzims pa yis/gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo//steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang //phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ༷༷sa su yang //skur cas sku ni med pa yi//mar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//smra bsam brjod med sogs 'jam dpal dbyangs dang skyabs grol gsang ba'i bdag/spyan ras gzigs sogs rlabs chen spyod pa yis//'gro kun srid zhi las sgrol khur 'byer pa'i//theg chen dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//gang la sems 22bcu dam pa rin chen de//skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba//bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba//bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas//bstan pa 'dzin dang spel dang srung mdzad pa'i//dgra bcom gnas brtan bcu drug la phyag 'tshal//zab mo rten 'brel bcu gnyis legs bsgoms pas//rang byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni//brten pa med pa'i tshul gyis thugs chud pa'i/'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal//nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du//bstan pa rin wo bang mdzod legs bsrung ba'i//rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags bas//tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas//sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa//nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo//mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba srasabacas la//bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i//lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas//rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo//ji snyed su dag sogs nas/bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod//ces pas phyag bya/de nas rang gnas su 'khod de rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol bya zhing /me tog dam pa sogs nas/rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi//zhes brjod/rol mo bzhag ste/'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dbang gis ni//zhes sogs nas/thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o//zhes pas yan lag bdun pa byas la/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo sbyar nas don yid la dran bzhin pas/ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag 23na thar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/glang po chen po/bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/khur bor ba/rang gi don sdoXsu thob pa/srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ 6)pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs legs par rnam par grol ba'i shesarab can de rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lhag par rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis sdom pa blangs la/ de'i bslab bya 'di rnamasabaslab snyam bas/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang ma spyad cing / /brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan chen po mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang 'phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang / /bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang 'khrug 'jig rten rnams/srid pa'i mtsho las 'don par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shurnya satwa/ pad+ma bi bhu 〉ta bh+yadha/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta/ a wa lo ki te hūṃ phaṭa swāhā zhes tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs bdun nam (23bskar gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /sogs kyi smon lam gdab/ ces theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang zhing dad pa gus pa sogs bsam pa'i khyad par gyi spro ba bskyed/skyabs 'gro ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum zhes pa nas/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o yan spyi ltar la/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas pa rnamasal skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan bdun nam gsum sogs ci rigs pa brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ semasacan thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das bde bar 461—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānegashegs pa brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag mchod thugs dam bskul ba la sogs pa'i lam gyi rim pa la gnas par bya'o/ /de kho na nyid kyi ngang nas tshad med bsgom pa ni/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar bya/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags snang nye ring gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o/ /rje stag tshang bas/ bdag med kyi lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin ci nus su bsgoms pa las langs nas/ /de ma rig pa'i sems can tshad med bzhi dang byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ zhes gsung ba rgyu 'bras su mdzad pa'am tshad med de gas go bcad nas gnyis po ngo bo gcig tu ba ched pa 'dra na'ang sems bskyed legs su byed pa gsung 'di ga'i 'og tu gsal bas cho ga mkhan po'i gzhung dang mthun no/ /byin brlab bzhi skor las sa gzhi brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang / (24na)tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa dang 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba 'di rnams ci ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can gyis bsgrubs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba/ yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung dang ldan pa'i lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyi gcal bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ gser dang / dngul dang / mu tig gi phye ma gram bur brdal ba/ ut+pa la dang / ku 462

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ 6)mu da dang / pad+ma 'gying zhing ldem bas khebs par gyur cing / chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrogs pa/dga' zhing 'phyo la lding bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang rdzing dang lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa rin po che'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lha'i nor bu dang / mu tig gi rgyan 'phreng dang rin po che dpyangs pa/ me rtag gi mgo lcogs dang 'bras bu mdzes par chags pas g.yur za zhing ldem pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du sbrengs pas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi phun sum tsho gos pa 'byung bar gyur cig /khang bzang brlab pa ni/ de'i dbus su (24ba)gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri zla dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brtan pa/ sems can thamasacad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob bar byed pas nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas dran pa dang / blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba / zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhon pa yin pa/ rnam par thar ba'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa nyid dang smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /gdan khri brlab pa ni/de'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan rin po che'i seng ge'i khri stan la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par 463—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneyongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin (25na tshe/degs pa gser bzang dri med rin po chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang /de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol bas mngon par mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i bzhugs gnas 'phags pa so so'i smon lam khyad par can dang mnga' thang dang 'tsham par grub pa mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig /mchod pa brlab pa ni/ phyi nang kun tu yang cha rigs dang 'tsham par yang lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang na bza' dang / rgyan dang rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogasaphung po gsum pa'i mdo dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'phags pa thams cad kyang gdan 'dzom nas de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig /ces lan gsum bzlas/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams spro bar mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs 'di nyid lhag par phan yon che ba mdo las gsungs pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra su ra pra marda na/ ta thā ga tā ya a rta te/ sa myakle bud+dhā ya/ ta du thā/ ma badz+re badz+re/ mahā badz+re/ mahā te dza badz+re/ mahā bi sdi badz+re/ mahā bodhi tsistu badz+re/ mahā bo dhi maṇ+ḍi pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re sarba po lde ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badz+re swāhā/ zhes (25bsgon gsum mam bdun ci rigs pa brjod/ yang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig /ces lan gsum bzlas/ mchod pa'i tshogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'og tu 'phags pa spyan drangs pa ni/4yo

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenapus mo btsugs te me tog blang thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces/ zhes byung ba'i spyan 'dren gyi tshig 'di dag ngag tu brjod pa dang lhan cig par dmigs pa ni shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung bye snyed 'das pa na gzhan gyis mi thub rnam par dag pa'i zhing nas mtshan legs/ gaṅgā'i klung bdun 'das pa na rin chen ldan pa'i zhing nas rin zla/ gaṅgā'i klung lnga 'das pa na spos kyis yongs su gang ba'i zhing nas gser bzang / gaṅgā'i klung bdun 'das pa na mya ngan 'das pa na mya ga dang bral ba'i zhing nas mya ngan med/gaṅgā'i klung brgyad 'das pa na chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhing nas chos bsgrags/ gaṅgā'i klung dgu 'das pa na rin chen rgya mtsho'i zhing nas mngon mkhyen/ gaṅgā'i klung bcu 'das pa na be+e ḍūr snang ba'i zhing nas sman bla rnams 'khor grangs med pa dang bcas pa nam mkha' la thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs par mos pa brtan po byed pa ni gnad du che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs pa yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i (26na ji byangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad ma'i dus lnga brgya mtha' ma la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad rjes su bzung zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa mang po 465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānedang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa bzang zhing rlabs che ba/ mthu dang byin gyis brlabs dpag tu ma mchis pa mnga' ba la brten te/ bla ma'i rigs la dper mtshon na dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen gyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen mya ngan las 'das pa'i dgongs ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang bdag cag /des mtshon dpon chen gyi rigs la mi'i dbang po rdo rje rab brtan gyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag /mi'i dbang po rdo rje rab brtan sku gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang bdag cag /btsun pa'i rigs la gnas brtan nam rab byung ngag dbang don grub gyi rim gro dang bdag cag /'das pa'i rigs la ngag dbang don grub ngan song (26ba〉pas sgrol zhing thar pa thob pa dang bdag cag /'jig rten pa'i rigs la sbyin pa'i bdag po bsod nams dbang po'i rim gro dang bdag cag /'das pa la bsod nams dbang po ngan song las sgrol zhing thar ba thob pa dang bdag cag /ming dngos su smos ma thub pa dgon pa lta bu la chos 'khor yang rtse'i 'dus sdod pon slob kyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag /khyim pa'i rigs la sbyin pa'i bdag po dpal 'byor grags pa yab yum sras 'khor rnams kyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag /ces 'byin 'jug gang dgos rig pas dpyod/ la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / da ltar bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gdul bya'i dbang gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan kyang 'jig rten gyi khams g.yin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing bzhugs pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po dang sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can las glengs te/ bdag cag mnga' ris kyi gdul bya rnams phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i nang du gtogos te bka' drin thob pa'i 'phro mchis pa tsam la brten te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen gyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad 466—

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenadu mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur pa dang / (27na)rgyal ba'i sras po skyabs grol dang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po gang dag sngon de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i tshe gdan 'dzom par 'dus te/mdo'i don byin gyis brlabs shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' bsgrub par thugs bskyed pa de dag kyang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen gyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / sngon de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa chen pos bkas gtad cing so so nas kyang lha'i tshig bden pas mdong gsol du zhal gyi bzhes te/ dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar mdzad cing de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'di yang lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / rnam thos kyi bu la sogs pa 'phags pa chosaskyong ba thams cad kyang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen gyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / sngon de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad (27ba)par rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'chang ba mchod pa la sogs pa'i sems can de dag phyag mtshan du bzhes shing bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa gnod sbyin gyi sdod pon chen po ji 'jigs dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen 467—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()po rgyan 'dzin dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon wo po gza' 'dzin dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon wo po rma dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ོ po gnas cas dang /gnod sbyin gyi sdod pon ོ po dbang 'dzin dang /gnod sbyin gyi sdod pon ོ bo gas 'dzin dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon wo po smra won dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon r+ṣa po bsam 'dzin dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon — po g.yo ba 'dzin dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon wo po rdzogs byed de/gnod sbyin gyi sdod pon wo po thams cad la yang sngon gyi thugs dam bzang po las glengs te dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen gyi sku'i rim gro dang bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na mchod pa'i tsho gis sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang /gshegs byon skye 'bri med pa'i sku//ji ltar smon zhing yod pa ltar//dkar po 'chang ba'i tshul bzhin du//'jig rten skyabs su gshegs su gsol//bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das//bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan//bdag gis phul ba'i mchod yon 'di//bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/khyod kyi rang bzhin yongs dag pas//sred so gos 'ang ba mi mnga' yang /bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du/gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol//de bzhin gshegs 28na rkong de yi sras rnams la//rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu//yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni//rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gso le/de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o//de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i//na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul//srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos//mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la//mi phyed mos pas bdag 'bul na//bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog/'gro ba nyon mongs skom gyis gdungs pa la//chos kyi chu yis tshim par bya ba'i phyir//nyes bral sgrub pa'i don la dmigs nas kyang //bdag gis khyed la bum chu dbul bar bgyi//chos ston dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir//dpal chen dag pa'i gdan bshams te/ting 'dzin mi g.yo mnyam gaX8 pas//dgyes par dgongs te gdan la bzhugs//

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhedagatsang dang gdan khri yangs pa la/thogs dang dag pa med pa'i sku//mnyam nyid tshul gyis 'dir bzhugasal//bde bar sbyar ba bzhes su gsol//so so'i zhing khams nas rdo 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs te/gzhal med khang gi dbus su seng ge'i khri chen po brgyad la de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad bzhugs/chos po ti yang bzhugs/bar gyi snam bu la byang chub sems dpa' gleng gzhi las byung ba'am yang na byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'i gdan bshams/de'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang skyabs grol dang phyag na rdo rje gsum gdan 'dzom pa la sngon gyi thugs dam bskul zhing 'phrin las mdzad cing bzhugs par bsam/gsum pa g.yon gral du gnod sbyin gyi sdodapon r+ṣa po bcu gnyis kyi gdan bsham/ 24sko yas gral du tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi gdan bsham/sgo bzhi la rgyal po chen po bzhi rang rang gis dam bcas pa bzhin bsgrub cing bzhugs par bsam/mchod pa dang dkyil 'khor sngar bden pa bdar ba'i tshul dang 'dra bar mos par bya'o//gnyis pa dngos gzhi la de ltar bsams pa'i rjes la spyir phyag 'tshal zhing mchod de/mchod yon la sogs pa ci 'byor pas so//zhes gsungs pa ltar mdor bstan spyi'i phyag mchod/rgyas bshad so sor phyag mchod dang smon lam gnyis su yod pa'i dang po la/lhar bcas skye rgya'i 'dren pa zas gtsang sras//rgyal ba'i sras mchogo mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs//bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/khri srong lde'u btsan bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//lha yi sras po sad na legs mjing yon//gsar bcad skad kyis gtan 'bebs khri ral pa//yid srubs gshed gyur lha lung dpal rdo rje//mnga' bdag 'od srung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//dkon mchog bla mar 'dzin pa dpal 'khor bas//bstan la nyer gus skyid lde nyi ma mgon//mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po ba po shis lde//lha yi bla ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//nor 'dzin skyong ba mnga' bdag lha yi lde//mang bkur rigs kyi btsun pa 'od lde'i zhabs//gangs can gnyen gyur lha gcig rtse lde'i mtshan//mnga' ris dgra bcom bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhu lhan shes rab grags//ra sa chu lhad dar ma ༷༷ mas rje//snar thang bstan pa'i nyi ma gro mo che//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sangs rgyas sgom pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//gnyag go rigs zhakhyungs snying po rgyal mtshan dpal//mtshungs med spru lung kun dga' smon lam zhabs/spang khang bla ma grags pa 29na ji pa la bzang po//shad ston bsod grags bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//chos lung mkhan wo grags pa rgyal mas dpal//'jam dpal dbyangs dngos rin chen rgyal mas zhabs//'dul 'dzin mchog gyur rgyal ba phyag na'i mas//kun dga' blo gros bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//sdom brtson r+ṣa po tshul khrims dpal 'byor dang /zhabrul smo kun bzang mthu stobs dpal 'bar rje//nges par thams cad ma' pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs//dbang phyug rab brtan bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//khyab bdag mgon bo bsod na mas mchogo ldan dpal//rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen zha lu pa//gnas gsar chos rje'i thugs sras rab 'byams rje//rin chen rgya mtsho gsum la phyag la'i lo//gsung rab bye ba'i ga kho mdzod blo gros kyi//mkho gi rdo rje yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis las//chos 'di'i drin thob ngag dbang blo gsal sde//bskal bzang rgya mtsho gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas sgom pas rje bzung nam mkha' grags//bshes gar+sā ོ po bsod nams ye shes zhabs//thams cad mkhyen pa zhang ston bsod nams grags//mtshudas med bka' babs gsum la phyag 'tshal lo//bstan pa'i rtsa lag bo dhi sa hwa yi//rigs dbon bo dhi satwa wo ba'i khas//za hor chos kyi rgyal po dge ba dpal//di paṃ kā ra bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//bstan pa'i srog shing lha bas byang tso 'od//'gro ba'i 'dren pa ti si r+ṣa po'i mas//byang tso sems dpa' r+ṣa po zla rgyal rje//kong po lo tsā bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//wo mongs dgra gos bcom pa rgyal mas rje//gya ba dbang por mdzes pa'i grags snyan 'bar//gya ba dpal mdzes sdom brtson brtul zhugs can//29ba khon to dbang phyug bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/mkhas bas wo po shangs pa 'dul ba 'dzin//mkhan chen byang sems zhang ston bsod grags sogs//bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi mdo chog gi/brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes dang /mjug gi sho lo ka gnyis rje stag tshang pa'i gsung las/gangs can phan bde'i dpal 'byor sting ba'i //0/dman matso kun gyis sgrub tu rung ba'i lam//

sman bla'i mdo sto yid bsto dbang sto/ zhenachos rgyal thugs dam mdo sde'i cho ga 'di//'dzin skyong spel mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas//bden gnyis zung 'jug bstan pa dam pa'i chos//tshogs gnyis nyams len 'phags mchog dge 'dun te//skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo//brgyud pa 'di nged kyi bklags lung nod pa sor bzhag bris pa yin gyi rang gis bla ma gzhan la thob na zog zog min pa'i bla ma re re bzhin nas bgrang du yod tshe de don ltar bcug chog pas 'di kho na byed mi dgos la/grub mtha' so so'i phyogs zhen gyis rang gang mos bcug pa'i ngo mtshar brgyud pa yin pa skad byas tshe 'jig rten pa chos snang che ba'i rigs kha ton byed skabs rang gi pha ma sogs kyang mi 'jug pa'i nges pa mi 'dug pas dgongs 'tshal lo//phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po zham 'bring pa byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dpag tu med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//de bzhi gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba 30na ) dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs du mas kun nas bskor ba la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas kun nas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ga med mchog dpal byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod don skyabs su mchi'o//de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgraXs rgya mtsho'i dbyangs byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mas kun nas bskor ba la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//ma rdzo do skyabs su mchi'o//de bawo gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po 'khor byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma ltar rnam par snang byed la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//gang gi sku ni in+d+ra ni la'i mdog/mas dpe nyi ma'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i mkha'//kun la zhi bde'i go skabs 'byed pa'i dbyings//bcom ldan 'das sman bla'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//gang gi 30bsko sung ni dri za'i rgyud stong ltar/tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis sna tsho gos gdul bya'i yid//kun tu tshim byed gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gter//bcom ldanas na bla'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo//gang gi thugs ni ye shes rgya mtsho'i 4 //dmigasamed thugs rje'i rba rlabs cher g.yos shing //smon lam rgya mtsho mdzad pa lhun grub pa'i//bcom ldan sman bla'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sum khri drug stong dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//ma rig mun sel sgron me'i mchog/ces sogs dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhen nur 'gyur pa dang skyabs grol dang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang rgyal po wo po bzhi la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigasal sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon r+ṣa po bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/me rtag dang bdug spos/mar me dang zhal zas/rol mo dang sil snyan/gdugs ༷nga ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor ba 'di dag

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhedadang phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bzang po (31na〉spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ 'bul lo mchod do/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen zhes bya ba dang bdag cag gis thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba nas 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis bgyi bar 'os pa'i lam ma bgyis pa la sogs pa dngos sdig ci bgyis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so/ /dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag gi bsod nam thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo/'jig rten gyi sgron me gang dag mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ci mchis pa thams cad bdag gzhan ma lus pa bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du byed pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzom pa chen po dgongs su gsol/bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad ma'i dus lnga brgya mtha' ma la dam pa'i cho zlog ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad rjes su bzung zhing / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa bde ba'i slad du sngon bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang sngon gyi smon (31ba'am gyi khyad par rgyas pa rlabs po che ji ltar btab cing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / don de nyid da ltar bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pas ji ltar bka' stsal zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang skyabs grol dang phyag na 473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānerdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das de dag gi bka' lung yang dag par sgrub pa dang so so'i dgongs spyod rgya chen po rdzogs par bskang ba'i slad du mdo sde'i don sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pas 'phags pa'i bka' brtags bas zhal gyis bzhes shing ji ltar byin gyis brlabs pa dang / tshangs pa dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po bzhi dang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgya gnyis la sogs te dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i dge bsnyen wo po thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mdo sde dang mdo sde 'dzin pa'i sems can bsrung ba dang bskyab par ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa la sogs pa sngon 'phags pa rnams kyis ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' stsal ba'i mdo sde las byung ba bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcasapa de rnams gdan 'jom pa mdzad pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams/ 'byor pa'i stobs ci mchis pas mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar nas gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mtshan nas brjod de mchod pa 'bul/bka' drin nod cing mchis na gdan 'dzom pas sngon ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' stsal pa bawo du mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing phan yon ji skad du 'byung ba'i bka' drin thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen la sogs pa bdag cag gis 'phral du thob par stsal bar ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das gdan 'jom pa chen po dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la thugs (32na〉pa khyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring ba/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa/ dge 'dun rnams kyi chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa/ de dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ khyad par du yang sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas sems can thams cad sgrib gnyis byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de yang mgon po klu sgrub kyis/474

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenadapag med bzhi ldan gyi phyag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ /yul sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la/ rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul nas/ sems can dpag tu med pa 'byung / zhes shī la bha dra'i khrigs su dpag med bzhi zhes byung ba rgyu'i dpag med bzhi la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /mos pa'i khyad par mchod yon rnams yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho chen po rlabs 'phreng dal bur g.yo zhing dbu ba'i do shal 'khrigs pa grangs med pa dang rang gi lus kyang de bzhin du sprul te 'bul ba po'i tshul gyis sku la dbul/ u du mo lha ra/ mas ra ba/ pad+ma/ ut+pa la/ ba kul sogs lha mi'i me tog sna tsho gos pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba thod du/ tsan dan dkar dmar dang sbrul gyi snying po/ a ka sa du ru ka /sman sna tshogasabasregs pa'i dud pa sprin phung 'thibs pa dang phye ma phur ma'i dri ngad bzang po shangs la/ snod kyi 'jig rten tsam gyi kong bur 'bru mar dang rtsi bcud kyi mar khu rgya mtsho lta bu gtams par sdong bu ri rab tsam (32ba〉pa sbar ba'i mar me mtha' yas pa'i snang bas nyi zla zil gyis gnon nus pa spyan sngar/ bzang drug /ga bur/ tsan dan sogs dri zhim po'i sman gyis yongs su sbags pa'i dri chab gaṅgā'i rgyun lta bu thugs ka /lha klu gnod sbyin mi la sogs pa rnams kyi zas g.yos su byas pa dang ma byas pa'i bca' ba'i rim pa bzang dgu ro brgya phrag bda' ba'i lha bshos ljags/ sil snyan/ gling bu/ pheg rdob/ rdza rnga/zom rnga sogs 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su gang ba'i sgra snyan la/ gzhan yang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ba dan/ lda ldi/ rin chen sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs mchod pa'i rdzas dang yo byad ji snyed pa dngos dang gzugs su byas pa blos mang por sprul pa ni bdag pos yongs su bzung ba'i mchod pa ri rab gser ri/ rol mtsho/ gling bzhi/ nyi zla sogs yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa/ lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu la rin po che'i gzhal med khang ngam yang na 'bangs su phul te bka' bzhin du sgrub pa ni lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa/ gong du mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bklags pa'i mthus kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin du gyur pa ni gzungs kyi mchod pa/ mchod pa de dag tshad bzung dang bral te bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni mos pa'i mchod pa/ bder gshegs brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa ni rten gyi stobs/475—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānesngon chad kyi sdig pa la dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag po bskyed pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ slan chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyi snyam pa ni nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs/ bshad ma thag pa'i phyag mchod dang de yang don dam par rang bzhin med kyang kun rdzob tu rang bzhin gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bdag cag /ces brjod pa'i tshe sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi thugs ka nas byung ba'i 'od zer gyis sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba bzhin phyir drangs te rang (33na8 lus shel sgong phyis pa ltar mos pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te bshags pa/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi dus gsum gyi dge ba la sems dga' ba ste/ stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad bzung rung / /rjes su yi rang dge ba des ni de lta min/ /zhes pa ltar gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang byasan bsod nams mnyam por thob pa'i phan yon yod/ rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon pa'i tshe/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya/ /zhes chosami gsung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas gsol ba btab pa ltar 'dir yang rang gi lag tu 'khor lo lta bu thogs te gdul bya so so'i khams dang bsam pa dang dbang po dang 'tsham par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams 'gro ba'i don la dus drug tu mi g.yel na'ang sems can rnams nyon mongs pa thogs pas thugs 'byung ste zhi ba'i dbyings su 'byon par bzhed pa rnams la bskal par mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs par gsol ba gdab/ dge ba mtha' klas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba ni blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa'i mdor tshig lhug par yod pa'i don bka' gdams pa zhig gis mdzad par/ ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po chu thigs lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces dge ba byang chub kyi rgyur bsngos pa ni nam yang mi 'dzad pa'i yan lag khyad par can yin zhing de ltar yan lag bdun pa so 476

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ 6)nam (33ba)dang 'bras bu ston thog dang 'dra ba ni thugs dam bskul ba yin pas yul khyad par can rnams la gdung shugs rtse gcig pas sngon gyi thugs dam bcas pa rnams da lta bdag cag la 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes spyi'i thugs dam bskul ba zhes kyang bya/ mchod par 'grub pa'i rgyur gsol ba gdab pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad so so'i phyag mchod smon lam la bder gshegs brgyad/ chos/ dge 'dun/ zhan byung gzungs bum sgrub pa rnams yod pa las/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi dang po mtshan legs ni/ de'i 'og tu 'phags pa rnams la re re nas mchod pa dbul zhing smon lam gdab par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i mtshan nas brjod de mchod nas smon lam du gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas la zhes byung yang deng sang lan bdun mi mdzad pa'i sla chos mkhan mang ba chad lhag tu 'gyur nyan che bas nges par bldabs pa legs shing skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul zhes byung ba gong gi 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag la zhes sogs lhag ma drug pa sbyar ba 'og ma kun la 'gre/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir te rims dang gshed byed dang byad dang ro langs dang (34na 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyis gtses pa de dag thams cad kyi gnod pa dang nad thams cad 'phral du zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rims dang sdig pa can gyi gdon dang nad thams cad med par gyur cig rab tu med par gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /bdag cag la 477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā//sogs pa sems can gang dag long ba dang 'on pa dang smyon pa dang sha bkra dang nad tshabs chen pos btab par gyur pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang po thams cad yongs su tshang bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/ bya ba ma yin pa'i spyod pa mang ba dam pa'i chos spong ba sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs byed pa/ ngan song gsum dang sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba de dag sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing zad par gyur cig /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i bar du su yang sems can dmyal ba dang ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma gyur cig /lha yul ba'i lha'i bde ba dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dbul por gyur te zas dang skom dang gos dang nor dang 'bru dang mal cha dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang yo byad mi bdog pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbyig dang gos dang nor dang 'bru dang mal cha dang spos dang 'phreng ba yo byad 'phel bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bcing ba dang rdeg pa dang go rar gzhug pa dang mtshon cha'i tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir ba de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar (34ba〉du bcing ba dang rdeg pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lus kyi gdung ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mgon med par gyur pa lus la gdung ba'i me 'bar ba dang / seng ge dang stag dang dom dang dred dang sbrul gdug pa'i nang du chud de srog la bab cing nyam thag pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lus la gdung ba'i me thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /seng ge dang stag dang dom dang dred dang sprul gdug pa de dag kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /'jigs pa med pa dang zhi ba'i gnas la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sem bas can gang dag phan tshun 'thab pa 478—

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenadang rtsod cing 'gyed par gyur te 'khrugs shing 'jigs skrag nas dngangs pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /phan tshun byams pa la gnas 'gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag chu'i nang du son pa grur zhugs pa gling med par phyin pa srog 'dod pa chu klung dang rgya mtsho'i nang du son te smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du chu klung chen po de la dbugs na pa sbyin par gyur cig /'jigs pa med par rgal bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te ston pa bla na med pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig (35nayotsham ldan mtshan legs yongs bsgrags rgyal po yis /sngon tshe smon lam rnam brgyad btab pa'i 'bras/ /dpag med mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs kyis/ /deng 'dir bdag sogs 'gro bas longs spyod shog /thub pa'i bstan dar skye rgu bde zhing skyid/ /khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas pa'i/ /'gro rnams sgrib gnyis byang zhing tsho gos gnyis po/ /rab rdzogs byang r+ṣa myur du thob byin rlobs/ /gnyis pa bder gshegs sgra dbyangs rgyal po ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ lan bdun bzlas/skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas ba'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi 479

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhergyal po'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ bcom ldan 'das rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag zhing slas kyi las kyi mtha' dang tshong la dga' ste g.yeng ba sna tshogs mang bas dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams dang byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las yongs su nyams te 'khor ba na 'khyam zhing so sor 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang rgud pa dang 'chi ba dang mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug pa sna tshogs so sor myong ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du bza' ba dang bgo ba dang btung (35ba tha dang longs spyod dang yongs su spyad pa dang nor dang 'bru dang dbyig dang gser rnams 'byung zhing 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /dge ba'i chos rnams kyis rnam par 'phel bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /ngan song dang sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag grang ba dang tsha ba dang bkres pa dang skom pas lus yongs su gdungs shing sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyam thag pa de dag thams cad sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa de dag thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /skye ba de yang tha mar gyur cig /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du skye ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bud med gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir zhing bud med kyi skye gnas la smod pa dang sems can gang dag btsa' ba'i dus kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /skye ba de yang tha mar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa nyid thob par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pas gtses pa dang phan tshun pha ma dang sring mo dang mdza' 480

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ 6)bshes dang nye du'i mya ngan myong zhing sdug bsngal ba dang mya ngan gyi zug rngus lus la zug pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /mya ngan dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mtshan mo mun pa mun nag na rnam par rgyu ba las kyi mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs la zhugasang pa sdig pa can gyi gdon sna tsho gis kyis gtses ba/ 'jigs pa (36na〉nang smre sngags sna tsho gis 'don pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du mun pa mun nag thams cad med par gyur cig /sdig pa can gyi gdon thams cad las thar bar gyur cig /mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba sna tshogs la mngon par brtson par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la mos shing shes rab chung la dran pa rmongs te dge ba'i chos rnams dang stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag dang ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa las yongs su nyams pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du ting nge 'dzin dang dran pa dang stobs dang gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mngon du gyur cig shes rab chen po rjes su rgyu bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la mos shing nyan thos kyi theg pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'dod pa bskyed de/ de la gnas shing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yang dag par 'das par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bskal pa chen po zad pa'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling kun tu 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'khrugs par gyur te ngu zhing mya ngan byed la sngon mi dge ba'i las kyi rgyus sdug bsngal 'byung zhing skyabs med mgon med pa de dag thams cad sdug bsngal dang mya ngan dang bral bar gyur cig /bsil ba'i dngos po thob par gyur cig zha 'phos nas kyang 448/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānebacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa (36ba7khas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag par pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skye bar gyur cig /skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te ston pa bla na med pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po yis/ /sngon tshe smon lam rnam brgyad btab pa'i 'bras/ /man gong bzhin sbyar/ gsum pa bder gshegs gser bzang dri med ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul grub pa'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag srog gcod pa mi dge ba'i las rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa srog chags sna tsho gos kyi srog gcod pa'i las byas pas tshe thung zhing nad mang ba dang chu dang dug dang mtshon dang me dang nad sna tsho gos kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa de dag thams cad yongs su byang ste tshe ring bar gyur cig /nad med par gyur cig /su yang dus ma (37na)yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs byas te/gzhan gyi rdzas brkus phyogs pas dbul por skyes te sgren mo dang bkres pa dang sgom pas lus yongs su 482

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenagadungs shing sdug bsngal myong ba de dag thams cad 'phral du sdig pa thams cad byang ste byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang phyug phun sum tshogs shing ma tshang ba med pa thob par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gcig la gcig gnod sems dang ldan zhing phan tshun srog gcod par byed pa dang 'thab par byed pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs te tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur nas sdig pa kun tu spyod cing bslab pa dral la dad pas byin pa longs spyod pas ngan song gsum du lhung zhing sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad 'phral du las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du tshul khrims yang dag par 'dzin zhing lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdom pa la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /tar+ya thā/ sid+dhi sid+dhi su sid+dhi mo tsa ni/ mok+ṣa ṇi mu ste bi mu ste/ a ma le bi ma le ma ga skyo/ ha ra nu gar+bhe rat+na gar+bhe/ sarba a the su dha ni/ par mā tho su dha na/ ma na se / mahā ma na se/ a te/ a kyis te/ sgyi ta bha ye su brje brarmi sto tshe bra grwa khyu ṣi te/ sa rbu sna khu a pa rwadzi te/ sa rbu tra a pra ti ha te/ tsa tso khi nyi bud+dhā ko ṭi bhā ṣi te/ na maḥs spru ta thā ga (37na) nī swāhā/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa des byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs te sems can 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs pa nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba 'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pas gnod par gyur pa/ tshe bskal par thub pa'i sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba'i sems can rnams gzigs nas de dag gis don du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la dgod pa dang las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par bya ba'i phyir gzungs sngags kyi gzhi gsungs pa 'di bzlas la byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa sdig pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig /re ba thams cad yongs su 483

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānerdzogs par gyur cig /'chi ba'i tshe yang bcom ldan 'das gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pas dgongs par gyur cig zha 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te ston pa bla na med pa gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan gser bzang dri med snang ba yis/ sngon tshe smon lam rnam bzhi btab pa'i 'bras/ /man sbyor/bzhi pa bder gshegs mya ngan med mchog ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /mchod do (3ni skyobs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mya ngan dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug pa mang ba dang sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs myong ba de dag thams cad kyi mya ngan dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug pa mang ba de dag rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /su yang sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar ma gyur cig tshe ring bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byas te mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal pa chen po mun pa mun nag chen po can du skye bar 'gyur ba'am skyes pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med sa chog dpal gyi sku las 'od zer gyi snang ba byung bas reg cing mthong bar gyur te de ma thag tu sdig pa thams cad byang 484—

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenanas sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de dag thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis te gzhan gyi rdzas phyogs pas dbul po dman pa'i khyim du skyes nas gos dang bza' ba dang btung ba dang mal cha dang rgyan mi bdog pa/ grang ba dang tsha ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang bkres pa dang skom pas lus gzir zhing mdog ngan par gyur pa de dag byang (38ba〉dub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bgo ba dang bza' ba dang btung ba dang mal cha thams cad la longs spyod par gyur cig /lus la lha'i lus kyi kha dog gis brgyan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po dang sha za rnams kyis gtses shing mdangs phyogs te nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po dang sha za rnams kyis gtses shing mdangs phyogs pa thams cad rab tu zhi zhid byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te ston pa bla na med pa mya ngan med mchog dpal la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan mya ngan med mchog rgyal po yis/ /sngon tshe smon lam rnam bzhi btab pa'i 'bras/ man sbyor/lnga pa bder gshegs chos bsgrags rgya mtsho ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang 485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lonabacas pa'i tshogs gzhan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi mtshan thos te yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de (39na pog 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag log par lta ba can gyi khyim du skyes pas sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la ma dad pa byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las ring du gyur pa de dag las kyi sgrib pa de zad par gyur nas byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du yang dag pa'i lta ba can du gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la dad pa mi phyed pa dang ldan par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gang na sangs rgyas kyi sgra mi grag pa/ chos kyi sgra mi grag pa/ dge 'dun gyi sgra mi grag pa yul mtha' 'khob tu skyes te mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyus sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag de nas shi 'phos nas ngan song gsum du lhung zhing dge ba'i chos rnams las nyams par 'gyur ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi mtshan rna lam du grag par gyur te chos kyi sprin dang rgya mtsho'i sgra 'byung bar gyur cig /de dag gis chos kyi sgra de thos nas sngon gyi las zad par gyur te byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gos dang rgyan dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang mal cha dang na ba'i gsos sman dang bral zhing mi ldan pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal myong zhing sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag gos dang rgyan dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang mal cha dang na ba'i sos sman dang longs spyod rnams sems ma thag tu 'byung zhib mi ldan pa med par gyur cig /byang chub (39ba)kyi mthar thug gi bar du su yang ci dang yang mi ldan pa med par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas phan tshun 'thab mo 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed par gyur te gcig la gcig gnod par bya ba dang bsad par bya ba'i phyir rtul pa mtshon dang mda' dang dbyig pa 486

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhedadag gis bsnun te sdug bsngal bar gyur ba de dag mda' dang mtshon dang dbyig pa la sogs pa las slar log par gyur cig/phyir phyogs par gyur cig/dgra thams cad kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig/su'i srog gi dbang po yang 'gag par ma gyur cig/byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rang rang gi rdzas dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug dag gis chog shes par gyur cig/'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ston pa bla na med pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig/bcom ldan chosabasgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs mchog gis//sngon tshe smon lam rnam bzhi btab pa'i 'bras//man sbyor/drug pa bder gshegs ma mkhyen rgyal po ni/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//lan bdun bzlas/skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i 40na ) tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs par dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa'i mtshan thos te yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pasamangon par mkhyen pa de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag zhing las dang sa bon 'debs pa dang tshong byed pa dang 'thab mo dang rtsod pa la sogs pa sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag thams cad bsams ma thag tu 'tshog mas thams cad 'byor bar gyur cig/gnod sems med par gyur cig/rtag/ tu dge ༷/ chos byed par gyur cig/bdag cag la sogs pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)sems can gang dag mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs pas sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can gang yang dmyal bar 'gro bar ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gzhan gyi dbang du song ste chad pas bcad pa dang bcing pa dang rdeg pa dang go rar gzhug pa dang bsad pa'i 'os su gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcing pa dang rdeg pa la sogs pa las thar bar gyur cig /bla na med pa'i rang dbang phun sum tsho gos pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag tshe thung bar gyur pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byas te 'chi bar gyur pa de dag thams cad sdig pa'i las thams cad yongs su byang ste tshe ring zhing dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur bas nam yang 'ga' yang 'chi bar ma gyur cig /'chi khar yang de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya (40ba〉pa tsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa'i mtshan rna lam du grag cing rjes su dran nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus ste skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te ston pa bla na med pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan chos kyi rgya mtsho mngon mkhyen gyis/ /sngon tshe smon lam rnam bzhi btab pa'i 'bras/ /man sbyor/bdun pa bder gshegs sman gyi bla ma ni/ bcom lan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla be+eḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /488—

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenamachod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzla/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e byu rla'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+eḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu (41na)rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus legs par brgyan par gyur te bdag ci 'dra ba de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de 'dra bar gyur cig /lus kyi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dpag gis mi langs ba dag lham me lhan ne lhang nger gyur cig /lus nor bu rin po che be+eḍūrla ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar phyi nang shin tu yongs su dag pa dang dri ma med la 'od gsal ba dang kho lag yangs shing che ba dang dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang legs par gnas pa dang nyi ma dang zla ba bas lhag par 'od zer gyi dra ba rnams kyis legs par brgyan par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e 'i ḍūrla 'a 'od kyi rgyal po ci 'dra
