ba de 'dra bar gyur te sems can gang dag 'jig rten gyi bar dag tu skyes pa dag dang gang dag yang mi'i 'jig rten 'di na mtshan mo mun pa mun nag gi nang na phyogs tha dad par 'gro ba de dag thams cad bdag gi 'od kyis phyogs dga' mgur 'gro zhing las rnams kyang byed par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+eḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i shes rab dang thabs dpag tu med pas bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gyi khams dpag gis mi lang ba dag longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang ldan par gyur te su yang cis kyang brel ba med par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lam ngan par zhugs pa dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam du zhugs pa de dag thams cad theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i lam la zhugs par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du sdom pa gsum gyis bsdams pa dang tshul khrims nyams pa med par gyur cig /su yang tshul khrims log par zhugs te ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma 489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānegyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lus (41ba)ngan pa dang dbang po ma tshang ba dang mdog mi sdug pa dang bem po dang yan lag skyon can dang rgur bo dang sha bkra can dang zhar ba dang long ba dang 'on pa dang spyon pa dang lus la nad kyis btab pa de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang nas thams cad dbang po tshang zhing yan lag yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba skyabs med pa mgon med pa 'tshog chas dang sman mi bdog pa/ dpung gnyen med pa/ dbul ba sdug bsngal ba de dag gi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du nad med cing gnod pa med pa dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa la gnas par gyur cig /bud med gang dag bud med kyi skyon brgya dag gis kun nasanyon mongs par gyur pa bud med kyi dngos po la mi dga' ba/ bud med kyi skye gnas las thar bar 'dod pa de dag thams cad bud med kyi dngos po las log par gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa'i dbang po dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad bdud kyi zhags pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lta ba tha dad pa mi mthun pa zing zing bas mi mthun pa dag spangs te yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang su dag rgyal po'i 'jigasapas skrag pa dang / gang dag bcing ba dang rdeg pa dang go rar gzhug pa dang bsad par 'os pa rgyu du mas kun tu btses pa/ nga rgyal dang bral pa lus dang ngag dang sems sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyi mthus gnod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bkres pa dang (42nasgo skom pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba/ kha zas 'tsho me ba la rab tu brtson pa sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag bdag gis kha dog dang dri dang ror ldan pa'i bza' btung gis tshim par byas te phyis chos kyi ros shin tu bde ba la 'god par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sgren mo bgo ba med pa dbul ba sdug bsngal ba grang ba dang tsha ba dang sbrang phal

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenabu dang sha sbrang dag gis nyin mtshan du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag bdag gis gos yongs su spyad par 'os pa/ tshon sna tshogs su kha bsgyur ba dag dang rin po che'i rgyan dang spud pa dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang rol mo'i sgra dang sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyi dga' ba dang ldan par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa'i gdung bas mi brdzi bar rnam par grol ba'i bde ba la gnas par gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+eḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzung dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon to gyi tsho gis thams cad mngon du gyur te ston pa bla na med pa sman gyi bla be+eḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan sman bla be+eḍūrla 'od kyis/ /sngon tshe smon lam bcu gnyis btab pa'i 'bras/ man sbyor/brgyad pa bder gshegs shākya'i rgyal po ni/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal (42ba)rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tsho gos kyis gzir ba mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa phongs par gyur pa thams cad rjes su gzung zhing lha dang mi'i don dang sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa byin gyis brlabs shing dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ 'jam dpal de lta bsan yon tan thams cad don du 491—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneganyer ba rnams kyis nyon mongs pa rnams dang ma 'dres par de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan gzung bar bya/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum yid la bya/ gus pas dad par bya/ sku gzugs kyang bya/ me tog dang bdug pa dang mar me dang byug pa dang zhal zas dang rol mo'i sgra la sogs pas mchod par bya/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas par bya/ nyin bdun gtsang mar byas te sa phyogs gtsang mar gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar smon lam gdab par bya/sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje'i sems su bya zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang / ta du thā/ ghu me tsho me/ i me ni mi hi ma ti ma ti sa lta ta thā ga ta sa mā ju dhiṣ+ṭha ta/ a ta ma ta/ pā le pā paṃ sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ nā sha ya ma ma burnya burnya t+ta ma/ u me ku me/ burnya snye tra pa ri sha dha na/ dha me ni dha me me ru me ru shi kha re/ (43na〉bo a kā la mṛ khyu/ na pā ra ṇi/ brnye su bu rnye/ burnya a dhi nga na/ rak+ṣa skyo me/sarba de ba sa me a sa me sa man+ta ha / / sarba bzhi bo dhi satwa/ sha me sha me pra sha mas me sarba i byu pa dra ba byā ta yaḥpā ra ṇi gur ṇi pā ra ya me/ sarba ā shā ya/ be+e ḍūrla pra ta dh+wa sa sarba pā 2 k+ṣa laṅka ri swāhā/ be+eḍūrla'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs 'di rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'di 'chang ngam klog gam mchod dam lan stong rtsa brgyad du bton na de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sems par 'gyur/ rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyis yang dag par srung bar 'gyur/ lha thams cad dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang rgyal po chen po bzhi dag gis kyang yongs su skyong bar 'gyur/ mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ nad thams cad kyis mi btab par 'gyur/ ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur 'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pa dang / 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ dgra thams cad kyi dbang du 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ ci bsam pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes ji skad bka' stsal pa de dag thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen dang bdag 492

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zhenacag la sogs pa'i don du mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang ston pa bde bar gshegs pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mchod cing smon lam gsal ba dang gzungs sngags bzlas pas ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' stsal pa bzhin du byin gyis brlab cing phan yon (43ba tshe nge skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 'phral du thob par mdzad cing stsol bar ci gnang / bcom ldan mnyam med shākya thub pa yis/ /be+e ḍūrla gzungs phan yon gsungs pa'i 'bras/ /man sbyor/gnyis pa dam pa'i chos ni/ ma rig mun sel sgron me'i mchog /sdug bsngal nad sel sman gyi phul/ /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing skyabs su mchi/ lan bdun bzlas/skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pa/'gyur ba mi mnga' ba des bdag cag la bden pa mgo sum du bstan par ci gnang / mtshan thos tsam gyis skyon sel yon tan 'phel/ /zhes sogs bde gshegs bka' lung 'gyur med 'bras/ /man sbyor/gsum pa dge 'dun la 'jam dpal ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phagasapa 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur pa thugs dri ma dang skyon thams cad dang bral ba sku yon to dri ma med pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rten gyi pad+ma la lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang klu dang rigs sngags 'chang rnams kyi thor tshugs dang cod pan gyis gtugs pa/ ga song gi 'gro ba sna tshogs 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dus ngan pa'i sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ lta ba ngan pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su bsgribs pa/ lam dang sa dman par 'og nas 'og tu lhung bar 'gyur ba'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ gang thos pa tsam gyis ci nas kyang bla na med pa'i (44na)byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / sdig pa dang las kyi sgrib pa 493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānethams cad yongs su byang zhing bas par 'gyur ba dang / bdud sdig can gyis mi brdzi bar 'gyur ba dang gnod pa dang mi bde ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dang 'dod dgu'i re ba rdzogs shing bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan dang sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la dmigs kyis zhu ba mdzad cing gdan 'dzom pa'i dbus su 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na gang dag mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa dang yi ger 'bri ba dang yi ger 'brir stsal ba dang glegs bam du bris te/ me tog dang bdug pa dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnams kyis bkur stir bgyid pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag la bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan rnam pa sna tshogs su bsgrag par bya'o/ /tha na rmi lam du yang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rna lam du nye bar bsgrag par bgyi'o/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i ras kyis dkris te phyogs gtsang mar bzhag na gang na mdo sde 'di gnas pa der rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gzhan yang mchis par 'gyur/ mdo sde 'dzin pa de dag dus ma lags par 'chi bar ma 'gyur/ sus kyang mdangs 'phrog par mi nus te phyogs na yang slar 'phrog par 'gyur ro zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa gsungs shing 'phags pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te/ mchod pa bzhes shing de bzhin gshegs pa (44bkod na 'dzom pa la thugs dam las glengs te bskul ba dang mdo sde'i cho ga rdzogs par bskang ba'i 'phrin las mdzad de/ mdo sde'i phan yon ji skad bka' stsal ba thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlab cing stsal bar ci gnang / 'jam dpal gang gis zab rgyas mdo sde 'di/ /nan gyis zhu bar mdzad pa'i phan yon 'bras/ man sbyor/skyabs grol ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa skyabs grol la 'tshal 494

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ 6)lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa skyabs grol dus ngan pa'i sems can phongs shing sdug bsngal ba rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar 'di skad du/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na sems can bro nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir te kun ring por bro nad kyis lus kyi sha bas shing bkres pa dang skom pas gre ba dang mchu ni bskams/ 'gum pa la ni mngon du phyogs/ mdza' bshes dang nye du dang snag gi gnyen mtshams ngu ba rnams kyis ni bskor/ phyogs rnams ni mun par mthong / gshin rje'i mi rnams kyis ni drangs te/ de'i lus 'di na nyal yang rnam par shes pa chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i mdun du khrid cing mi de dang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha slad bzhin 'brang ba gang lags pa des dge ba'am mi dge ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad legs par yi ger bris nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje la phul ba dang chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes de la dris shing brtags nas dge ba'am mi dge ba ji ltar bgyis pa de bzhin du bsgo ba la/ gang dag nad pa de'i don du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla (45na tha ḍūrla 'a 'od kyi rgyal po de la skyabs su mchi zhing 'di 'dra ba'i sbyor bas mchod par bgyid na/ de'i rnam par shes pa slar ldog cing rmi lam rmis pa bzhin du bdag nyid kyis 'tshal ba'i gnas der mchis te yang na ni gdugs bdun/ yang na ni gdugs nya shu rtsa gcig /yang na ni gdugs sum cu rtsa lnga/ yang na ni gdugs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la de'i rnam par shes pa slar ldog cing dran pa rnyed la dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa bdag nyid kyi mngon sum du gyur te srog gi slad du yang sdig pa'i las mi bgyid do/ /mchod pa'i sbyor ba ni btsun pa kun dga' bo gang dag nad chen po las yongs su thar bar 'dod pa de dag gis nad pa de'i don du nyin bdun tshan bdun du yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang bar bya/dge slong gi dge 'dun la zas dang sgom rnams dang yo byad thams cad kyis ci nus su mchod pa dang rim gror bya/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla 495

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebe+eḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan yid la bya/ mdo sde 'di yang lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gdon par bya'o/ /zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur mar me bud par bya'o/ /sku gzugs bdun bya'o/ /sku gzugs re re'i spyan sngar mar me bdun bdun bzhag mar re re'i tshad kyang shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam du byas te ci nas kyang zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur mar me mi zad par bya'o/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu las lhag par bya'o/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba rnams la nad kyi gnod pa dang rang ngam pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi gnod pa'am rgyu skar ram gza' zla ba'am gza' nyi ma'i gnod pa'am dus ma yin pa'i rlung ngam char ram than pa'i gnod pa yang rung gnod pa dang nad 'go ba'am (45bsti5grags pa zhi ba nye bar gnas par gyur na/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba des sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems su bya/ btson du bzung ba rnams btang bar bya zhing gong du smos pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la de lta bu'i mchod pa byas na/ rgyal po de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla be+eḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par gyis yul bde ba dang lo legs pa dang char dang rlung dus su ldang zhing lo tog 'grub par 'gyur/ yul de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang nad med pa dang bde ba dang mchog tu dga' ba mang bar 'gyur/ yul der gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po dang sha za ma rungs pas sems can rnams la 'tshe bar mi 'gyur/ ltas ngan pa thams cad mthong bar mi 'gyur/rgyal po de'i tshe dang mdog dang stobs dang nad med pa dang dbang phyug rnams mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa bka' stsal pa gsungs shing 'phags pa'i bka' yang dag par tshad mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te mchod pa bzhes shing de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa'i thugs dam las glengs te bskul ba dang mdo sde'i cho ga rdzogs par bskang ba'i 'phrin las mdzad de/ mdo sde 'di las phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad pha96

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ 6)kyis thob par byin gyis brlab cing stsal bar ci gnang / skyabs grol mdzad pas nad 'chi srid rnams sogs/ /nyes zhi bde skyid dar ba'i smon lam 'bras/ /man sbyor/phyag na rdo rje sogs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po dpal phyag na rdo rje la (46na〉〈gas pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun bzlas/ tshangs pa dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po dang mig mi bzang dang ku be+e ra la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i lha'i dge bsnyen thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / tshangs pa dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po dang mig mi bzang dang ku be+e ra la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i lha'i dge bsnyen chen po rnams kyis ji ltar sngon gdan 'dzom pa chen po'i spyan sngar lha'i tshig bden par mdong gsol du gsung gcig kho nar 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa yang thos/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang mngon du mthong ste mchod pa yang bgyis so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sa phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan dang gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag spyod pa der bdag cag g.yog dang bcas te mchi bar bgyi'o/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig 'chang ba dang klog pa dang mchod par bgyid pa dang yi ger 'brir stsol ba der bdag cag mthun par lhan cig tu mchis te/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am rgyal po'am rgyal po'i blon po mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa dang 'bri ba de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i (46ba)byin gyis brlabs kyis bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /grong dang grong khyer dang phyogs kyang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /'chi ba dang dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pa dang nad 497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānethams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang sems can thams cad la byams pa/ byas pa gzo ba lags te dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /'thab pa dang 'thab mo dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang sems dang lus bde zhing longs spyod dang dbang phyug dang nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel bar bgyi'o/ /thams cad du bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rang gisabro bor pa dang dam bcas pa 'di dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo des rjes su dran par bgyi'o/ /ta du thā/ a: mo: ta ra bhu/ ma ma tsho/ su re/ ha hu he/ mra sgra mra mra/ dzu dzu re dzu re swāhā/ gang la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rnams dang gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag 'chang ba dang klog pa dang yi ger 'bri ba dang yi ger 'brir stsol ba dang rab tu gus pas mchod par bgyid pa de dag ngan song gsum du mi mchi bar rig par bgyis te/ de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las slar mi ldog par 'gyur/ ji ltar 'tshal ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyang thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs shing zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la 'di skad ces gang mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag gi don bdag gis gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams stsal bar bgyi yi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ (47na〉nga dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun po dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta du thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re badz+ra pā sha dha ra ṇi/ sam sa ma/ sa man+ta/ a pra ti ha ta badz+re/ sha ma sha ma/ pra sha ( sarba byā dha ya/ ku ru ku ru sarba skam ṇi sam ya ma nu sma ra bha ga ba na/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ sarba sha me pa ri pā ra ye swāhā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig de bzhin shegs pa 'di dag gi mtshan dang sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa dang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang klog pa de'i re ba thams cad bdag gis yongs su bskang bar bgyi'o/ /don thams cad 498

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenayongs su bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /gal te des bdag mthong bar 'tshal na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'drir stsal bar bgyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag gi sku gzugs bdun yang bgyi/ rdo rje 'dzin yang sku gdung dang bcas par bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la yang ji skad gong du smos pa bzhin du/spos dang bdug pa dang mar me dang 'phreng ba dang rgyan dang rol mo'i sgra dang sil snyan dang pheg rdob pa rnams kyis mchode de bskor bar bgyi/ gzugs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag kyang gdon par bgyi/sems can thams cad la yang phan pa'i sems dang byams pa'i sems su bgyi/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen gnas la gnas te lan gsum khrus bgyi zhing gos lan gsum brje bar bgyi/ tshes brgyad nas brtsams te zla ba phyi ma bco lnga lha'i bar du nyin gcig bzhin rig sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na de la bdag gis rmi lam du mthong ba stsal bar bgyi 'bel ba'i bka' mchid kyang bgyi/ re ba thams cad kyang yongs su bskang bar bgyi'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'phags pa'i bka' mi 'gyur bar (47ba〉da mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te mchod pa bzhes shing gdan 'dzom pas mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang ba'i 'phrin las mdzad de phan yon ji skad bka' stsal ba thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis thob par byin gyis brlab par ci gnang /lhag par yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo la sogs pa gsung rab dam pa'i chos yun ring du rgyas par bgyi ba dang / sgo thams cad nas chos spyod pa rnams la bar chad dang bgegs su gyur pa dang bdud kyi phyogs su gyur pa thams cad dang yul phyogs su mi nad dang phyugs nad gtong ba dang than pa dang sad dang ser ba la sogs pas lo tog ma rungs par bgyid pa dang gnod pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa mang po ston cing sems can la sdang bar sems pa'i gdon bgegs rigs tha dad pa mang po yul phyogs 'di na rgyu zhing gnas pa ci mchis pa thams cad dang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen dang bdag cag la sogs pa sngon gyi las pha99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kyis bdas pa'am 'phral gyi rkyen las byung ba'am yul phyogs dang pha tshan dang rigs brgyud kyi sri can du gyur pa yang rung ste dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen dang bdag cag la sogs pa rnams kyi lus dang srog dang chab srid dang dbang phyug dang 'khor dang yo byad la sogs pa gang yang rung ba la ci yang rung ba'i sgo nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i gdon bgegs ci mchis pa thams cad gang la gang 'tsham pa'i thabs kyis 'dul zhing /'khon dang gnod pa'i bsam pa 'dor du stsal te zhi ba dang dge ba dang byams pa'i bsam pa can du 'gyur zhing sngon chad bkra mi shis pa dang gnod pa'i 48na ltor ba ga pa bgyis pa rnams kyang 'jig cing 'dor du stsal/slan chad kyang gnod pa'i bag ci yang mi bgyid par so so'i rigs kyi bro dam pos bsgag cing gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dam tshig chen po stsal ba'i 'phrin las mdzad par ci gnang /gsang bdag la sogs rnams kyis dam bcas shing //gzungs stsal phyag rdor sgrub thabs bstan pa'i 'bras//zhes pa nas/khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas pa'i//bar 'dra ba la/'gro ba rnams kyi sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs shing //bgegs rigs bzlog cing mthun rkyen tshang bar mdzod/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis ni/mthu dpal dang ldan pa'i dge bsnyen bcu gnyis la/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon byu po ji 'jigs la phyag 'tshal lo//mar do skyabs su mchi'o//des 'gre/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon r+ṣa po rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon byu po rgyan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon byu po gza' 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rlung la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnas bcas la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon 'a po dbang 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon r+pā po bco 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po smra 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon r+ṣa po bsam 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo//gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon wo po g.yo ba 'dzin la phyag la'i lo//gnod sbyin gyi sdod pon ོ po rdzogasaXd la phyag la'i lo//mar do skyabs su ma0//

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ 6)lan gsum bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gnod sbyin gyi (48bsko dpon chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang sbyin bdag gi bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /mthu dpal dang ldan pa'i dge bsnyen gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis po re re la g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin bdun 'bum bdun 'bum dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar lha'i ngag bden pas gsung gcig tu 'di skad du sangs rgyas kyi mthus bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te bdag cag la yang ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /des na bdag cag lhan cig tu mthun par ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don dang sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du spro bar bgyi'o/ /bye brag tu grong ngam grong khyer ram grong rdal lam dgon pa'i gnas gang na mdo sde 'di spyod pa dang gang na de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan 'chang ba dang mchod pa dang rim gro byed pa'i sems can de dag la bdag gis bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/ gnod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes te thugs dam du bzhes shing bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / gang gi phyir khyed de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la byas pa gzo zhing rjes su dran la sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa legs so legs so zhes rjes su gnang ba ston pa de bzhin du deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir dul zhing zhi ba'i 'khor dang ldan par byams pa dang thugs brtse bas mchod pa bzhes shing mdo (49na skra'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang ba'i 'phrin las mdzad de phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis thob par byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / lhag par yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas ba'i mdo la —501—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānesogs pa gsung rab dam pa'i chos yun ring du rgyas par bgyi ba dang / sgo thams cad nas chos spyod pa rnams la bar chad dang bgegs su gyur pa dang bdud kyi phyogs su gyur pa thams cad dang yul phyogs su mi nad dang phyugs nad gtong ba dang / than pa dang sad dang ser ba la sogs pas lo tog ma rungs par bgyid pa dang / gnod pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa mang po ston zhing sems can la snang bar sems pa'i gdon bgegs rigs tha dad pa mang po yul khams dang / yul phyogs 'dir rgyu ba mchis so 'tshal dang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen dang bdag cag la sogs pa sngon gyi las kyis 'das pa'am 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur ba'am yul phyogs dang pha tshan dang rigs brgyud kyi sri can du gyur pa yang rung ste/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen dang bdag cag la sogs pa sems can rnams kyi lus dang srog dang chab srid dang / dbang phyug dang 'khor dang yo byad la sogs pa gang yang rung ba la ci yang rung ba'i sgo nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i gdon bgegs ci mchis pa thams cad gang la gang 'dul ba'i thabs kyis gdul zhing 'khor dang gnod pa'i bsam pa 'dor du stsal te zhi ba dang dge ba dang byams pa'i bsam pa can du bgyi zhing sngon chad bkra mi shis pa dang gnod pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa bgyis pa rnams kyang 'jig cing 'dor du stsal/ slan chad kyang gnod pa'i bag ci yang mi bgyid par so (49ba〉('i rigs kyi bro dam pos dgag cing gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dam tshig chen po stsal ba'i 'phrin las mdzad par ci gnang / gnod sbyin rnams kyis bden mthong mdo 'di nyid/ /bsrung bar dam bcas mdzad pa ji bzhin 'bras/ /sogs phyag rdor ltar sbyor/gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid sa'i lha mo bstan mas gtso byas bod kha ba can pa'i rgyal khams srung zhing skyob pa'i srung ma spyi dang bye brag yul phyogs 'di dag gi dgon grong gnas mal bsrung pa'i lha klu bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs mi ma yin mthu po che rnams la 'bul lo/ /mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen yid bzhin du —502

sman bla'i mdo li yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenasgrub par mdzad du gsol/re re nas mchod pa dbul zhing smon lam rdzogs pa'i skabs 'dir gzungs sngags bzlas la khrus bya/zhes byung ba ltar/bzhi pa zhan byung gzungs sgrub ni/gzungs kyi bum pa la dmigs te skabs 'dir bya/zhes gsungs pas/ta bya thā/ghu me sogs/ta ju thā/cha dzi rdzu ste ṣa rdzu mahā bhe ṣa rdzu bhe ṣa rdzu/rā dza sa mu sgo te swāhā/zhes mang du bzla/sngags bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis bde bar gshegs pa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste bum pa'i chu la thim pas byin gyis brlab par bsams pa'i chus lha la'ang khrus gsol zhing rang gzhan rnams la khrus bya/gshin po'i rus pa sogs la gtor na phan yon che ba las mi 'gal bar sems so//gsum pa mjug chog la gtang rag gi phyag 'tshal na/lhar bcas skye rgu'i 'dren pa zas gtsang sras//zhes pa nas/brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pa'i bar gong 50na skor la/mas gyi me tog rgyas shing dag pa la//dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku//gang gi mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur pa'i//ston pa mtshan legs dpal la phyag 'tshal lo//rin chen zla dang pad+masarab brgyan cing /shes bya kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas//rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i gsung mnga' ba'i//sgra dbyangs rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo//ri chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba/nyi ma stong bsalhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar//dri med gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku//gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo//mya ga 'das shing bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gdung ba sel mdzad cing //'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur pa yi//mya ga med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/chos sgra wo pos pha rol rgol ba 'joms//rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i gsung mnga' zhing //'gro ba'i dug gsum ma lus zhi mdzad pa'i//chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo//chos kyi blo grosagating dpag dka' ba'i tshul//rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las rol mdzad cing /shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa po//mngon mkhyen rgyal ༷ khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs rje kun la sgoms

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa'i bcom ldan 'das//mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel//dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla//be+e ḍūrla yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo//thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigasa'akhrungs shing //gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa//gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/shwakya'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes dang /rgyas par spro 'dod na stag tshang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'di nyid tshig sbyor legs pas yang bskyar gyi tshul du byas 50ba pa mi 'gal zhing mi byed na'ang chos dkon mchog man 'di nang bzhi sbyor/shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed na//gzhan gyis mi thub rnam dag zhing gi dpal//bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das//mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung bdun bye snyed na//rin chen ldan pa rnam dag zhing gi dpal//bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das//rin chen zla ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung lnga'i bye snyed na//spos kyis yongasagang rnam dag zhing gi dpal//bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das//gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo/shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung bdun bye snyed na//mya ga bral ba'i rnam dag zhing gi dpal//bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das//mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung brgyad bye snyed na//chos kyi rgyal mas rnam dag zhing gi dpal//bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das//chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung dgu'i bye snyed na//rin chen rgya mtsho'i rnam dag zhing gi dpal//bgrang yas sems dpas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das//mngon mkhyen rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung bcu'i bye snyed na//be+eḍūrla ra snang rnam dag zhing gi dpal//bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das//sman gyi bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs rje brtson 'grus mchog gi rtser gshegs pas//snyigs dus rgyal ba gzhan gyis mi 'dul ba'i//mi mjed tshe lo brgya pa'i zhing gi dpal//'dren maXg shākya'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo//kun 'byung mun

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenapa'i sa bon mthar mdzad cing //sdug bsngal zug rngu'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin//rgyal 51na sgom shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs//theg gsum dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo//chos kyi rgyal bu gzhon nu mkhyen pa'i gter//bdag cag nyes brgyas gzer ba'i 'gro ba la//zab yangs lam 'di mjo zhe du gyur mdzad pa//rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo//thabs mkhas thugs rje phul du byung ba'i mthus//dus min 'chi gos rgyal srid spel sogs slad//mchod pa'i sbyor ba gsal bar ston mdzad pa//'phags pa skyabs grol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//yangs pa can du bde gshegs brgyad 'dzom nas//spyi sgos bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing //rang rang bden ba'i ngag gis zhal bzhes pa//gsang bdag 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo//yangs pa can du sman bla'i mtshan thosapas//bden mthong mdo 'di bsrung bar dam bcas pa//bdun 'bum 'khor gyis bskor ba'i bcu gnyisapo//gnod sbyin sdod pon rnams la phyag 'tshar lo//mkha' khyab zhing gi phyag 'os thams cad la//yon tan zhing du lhag par mos pa'i blos//'gro kun zhing rdul grangs snyed lus sprul nas//sangs rgyas zhing mthar rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal//ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na//sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde las byung ba bzhin du mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun dang ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing de dag gis sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par smon lam btab pa dang / de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa 51ba〉skugs pa dang dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang /bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams ci mchis pa'i stobs dang /de dag gi mthu dpal dang byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs kyis/bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa dbang phyug dam pa rnams kyi thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa ci mnga' ba thams cad byang bar gyur cig/sku la snyun mi mnga' zhing sku tshe ring 0

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneb dang dbu rmog btsan pa dang chab srid 'jam dar che ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig /mthar yang tsho gos gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas g.yung drung gi sku chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang brnyes par gyur cig /chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i 'bangs thams cad kyang phyi nang gi gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi zhing bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po thob par gyur cig /yul khams thams cad du yang mi nad dang phyugs nad dang lo nyes dang dgra'i gnod pa dang bkra mi shis pa'i bag ci yang mi 'byung ba dang char chu dus su babs te lo phyugs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang bde skyid dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyang bde ba thams cad dang ldan zhing 'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu skyes nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi zhal mthong ste gdams ngag thob nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas par gyur cig /khyad par du yang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing sgo thams cad nas dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /de nas bzod par gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun 'khor dang bcas pa dang ston pa bcom ldan 'das (52na)dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen dang bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad par gsol ba'i skabs 'dir bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas ma 'tshal ba dang bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres pa dang mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa dang / gtsang sbra ma phyed pa dang mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing mchis na/ thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod par bzhes shing 'phral dang yun du bdag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / / 5)tsha

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bsto dbang rgyal/ zhenagang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni 'gyid stsal gang / /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /dusang na sems can bsod nams dman/ /ma rig nyon mongs dang 'dres pa/ /'phags pa'i thugs dgongs ma rdzogs pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /ser sna'i dbang gyur mi mkhasapas/ /mchod pa ngan zhing bsham nyes pa/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /bag med spyod ma dag pas/ /mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ /ma lcogs hrūl pa ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / /bdag gis brjed ngas ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ khyed kyis sems can don (52ba tshe/na mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang thugs rjes 'byon par mdzod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag cag dang sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa lags kyi so so'i zhing khams su rdzu 'phrul gyi 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs sho lo ka gnyis/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu sogs/ med byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub par shog mas brjod ni/ snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od/ /ches cher rab 'bar bcom ldan bde gshegs bdun/ /smon lam gsung ba don kun grub pa sogs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis shog /thos pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i sdug bsngal las/ /rnam par sgrol nus zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /snying po sman gyi mdo sdebargyad brgya pa/ /gsung mchog dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog /zhu gsol bsrung skyob mdzad pa'i sems dpa' che/ /nyan thos phyogs skyong gnod sbyin sde dpon sogs/ /chos 'di yun du 'phel zhing gnas byed pa'i/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mdo las byung ba ji ltar rigs pa brjod de me tog sil ma phyogs —307—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānekun tu dgram par bya'o/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'jug pa nam mkha'i mtha'/ /tshad ma'i srang la kun mkhyen ye shes kyis/ /gzhal min sgrib pa'i lus can blos rtogs pa'i/ /skal pa rdul phran cha yang su yis rnyed/ khol bur lus min gyur to cog son dri/ nyer bgrungs yon to mtha' (53na pog yongasardzogs par/ /gcig tu mnyam pa'i rgyal rnams skal dman 'gror/ nye ring bar ma'i khyad par ga la zhig /'on te cher snyigs bdo ba'i smag rum 'dir/ /lhag par thugs rje'i mthu dpung nyin mor byed/ /'char nub spangs pa'i snang ba dam pa'i gzi/ /bde gshegs mched bdun smon lam rlung gis drangs/ /lha gcig khri srong legs byas dzasbu'i 'bras/ /mdo chog rgya mtshor ro gcig 'dres pa las/ /phan bde'i gser gyi snye ma g.yur za mkhan/ /gangs can sku drin mtshudas med zhi ba 'tsho/ /rgyas pa'i sde snod sman mdo brgyad brgya pa/ /tshig don zab brling rin chen 'byung gnas cher/ /gangs can bsod nams ri bo bsgril ba las/ /mdo chog gnyis skyes rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor thon/ /'on te mkhas blun du ma'i sgrigs rtsom gyis/ /log rtog chu 'dzin bu mo'i phang nyal ba/ /dpyad gsum dag byed dri bzhin gyis bsal te/ /gcig tu dkar ba'i gzegs ma bsil zer 'phro/ /sras bcas rnam mkhyen srung mar bcas pa yis/ /sngon btab smon lam bgrang yas mu snyi gaḥ/ /ris med skye rgu'i nya phyis khog yangs por/ /sbrum pa'i skal bzang mngon sum myong bar shog /ces bde bar gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi cho ga 'di nyid gangs can phan bde'i rtsi sman gyi ljon pa chen po yin par mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mkhan po'i gzhung la dgos nges kyi lhan thabs mdzad pa'i khungs btsun na'ang bar skabs su mdo chog rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba sogs mkhan por kha g.yar ba dang mchims kyi chog bsgrigs ma la gzhan gyis 'brel med mang du sbyar ba'i nyi ma 'phul thabs dang gzhan mgo bskor ba lhur blangs shing / la la nyung ba tsam gyis ya mtshan (53ba lngar rloms te tshig sna bsdus pa'i shog ldebs gsum bzhi la chad pa'i yi ge mang pos lugs srol 'di nyid tshong 'dus 'o ma ltar bslad pa mthong bas rkyen byas mkha' mnyam gyi skye rgu mtha' dag la phan 'dod kyi lhag 508—

sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ 6)pa'i bsam pas drangs te snga mo nas rtsom 'dun yod pa dang dbus gtsang du chos sde gsar btsugs phal cher la'ang mdo chog tshugs yod par phan slebs che 'dra snyam pa'i steng thos bsam dar rgyas gling pa'i slob dpon pa 'phrin las rgyal mtsho/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor ba'i slob dpon don grub rgya mtsho/dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/gsol dpon ge ra ba blo bzang mkhyen brtse rnams kyis bskul ba dang phyag mdzod sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rmi ru ba tshor brag sgo rab 'byams pas snang bar gang dran gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus pa sogs sna tshogs byas tshul gyi sgyur sbyang la brten chog bsgrigs shig dgos zhes rmi ru bla ma rin chen rgya mtshos bskul bas kyang rkyen byas/ nye char chen po hor gyi rgyal khams kyi sa'i cha khal kha g.yon ru nas 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang hor gos mngags btags sogs kyi khyad nor dang bcas gsung gis bskul bas mtshams sbyar te yid ches shing spro ba bskyed pa mdo sngags kyi khyad par 'byed pa'i dpyad pa sngon du btang ba'i sgo nas thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i gsung dngos mar med du mi rung ba'i mtshams sbyar dang gsal byed kyis brgyan pa'i bde gshegs bdun gyi mchod pa'i chog bsgrigs yid bzhin dbang rgyal zhes pa 'di ni yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las chos 'di la lhag par mos pa'i dad pa thob pa za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i zhes bag yod ces pa chu glang mgos nya ba'i lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor gyi dus dge bar rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gtsug lag khang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni (54na〉na nas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa lus can mtha' dag sman gyi bla be+e ḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mtshan snyan gser gyi rnga chen brdungs pa'i sgra/ /rna bar lhung mod bdud kyi g.yul ngo rnams/ /pham byed chos kyi rgyal por grags 'bar ba'i/ /bde gshegs brgyad dang 'khor gyi mdun sa cher/ /—509

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6negadan 'dzom byang sems lha dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /mchod bskul mdo chog yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /mi 'dzad par du brkos pa'i dge ba 'di/ /mkha' mnyam lus can yongs la nyer 'jug shog /thub bstan dar zhing 'gro rnams bde ba dang / /sngon bsags sdig lhung sgrib pa'i cha kun 'dag /mi bzad snyigs mas sbags pa'i thun gsum smag /sangs nas rdzogs ldan snang ba la spyod shog zhes pa 'di ni snyigs ma'i mgon po bde gshegs brgyad mchod cing thugs dam bskul ba'i chog sgrig yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi par gsar skrun bgyis pa'i smon tshig tu shākya'i dge slong blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o// // sarba maṅga lo// //—5/0

rgyud lde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhedar༅༅/khyud sde rgya mtshor rab 'byams smra ba rnams kyi bshad pa'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs bzhugs//༄༅//e ma dpyod ldan mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i dbus//legs bshad dga' ston spro ba'i sngon 'gro'i sgo//dam pa'i yul lamachode par brjod pa'i gtam//snyan gyi bzhes spro'i bu ram 'di na mngar/1/mang por sbyangs pa'i rgan yus 'bar ba'i me//thugs kyi bum pa'i nang du ches gsal kyang //zhal gyi sgo nas smra ba'i 'od kyi zer//ma los phyi rol gzugs brnyan ci zhig ston/2/gzur gnas blo ldan mai na ka yi tshogs//ma smad spobs pa gzengs mtho'i sor mo yis//tshig don zung du 'brel ba'i rgyud bskul nas//mkhas pa'i snyan grags glur long gar gyis rol/3/de yang mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sar nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde las brtsams te rab yims smra ba'i grwa skor byed par 'dod pa rnams kyis thog mar mchod brjod kyi rim pa bya bar/dber na rgyud sde gsum tsam la bshad pa byed na dkon cog gsum gyi shis brjod yan sngon ma'i dus su song bas go bcad phyi ma rnams la nyin mo bde legs ma'i sho lo ka gcig gi rjes su yul khyad par can sogs btags 2na sko rgyas bsdus ran par mngon zhing gang ltar bshad yun sogs yul dus gnas skabs dang bstun rigs pas dpyad nas gang la gang 'tsham sbyor ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/de yang 'dus pa mdo sgrub sde gzhan dus 'khor bde mchog rnams la bshad pa byed par spro na/so so dang 'brel ba'i skabs thob kyi tshig sbyor shes dgos pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag nas/gsang sngags rnying ma la sgyu 'phrul dang phur pa/gsar ma la gsang ba 'dus pa dang brtag gnyis bshad pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāne'aphog che zhing snyan 'jebs che ba'i dbang du byas nas sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod lag thog tu blangs chog ma nag 'gros su bkod pa la/ji skad du/ ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas pa rnams dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i skyes kyi mchod pa ni legasapar bshad pa yin la/ blo gros kyi rgyud las drangs te legs bshad kyi pi wang 'khrol bar byed pa la/ji skad du/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron ma yin/ /rkun po la sogs mi 'byer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs (2ba)pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa grogs kyi mchog /ces pa ltar/ thog mar rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang phyi nang gi gtsug lag rgya mtsho chen por thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa zhig sngon du 'gro dgos pa la/ dngos cag thos byung shes rab dang spyor byung gi brtson 'grus mthu dman pas sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan chung ngur gyur pa zhig gis deng 'dir gnas phun sum tsho gis pa 'phrul snang sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi kun dga' ra bar gdan seng ge'i khri la ston pa phun sum tshogs pa khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mchog gi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po/ /gnas phun sum tsho gos pa rang byung 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra'i gtsug lag khang dmar po ri dang gnam bskos kyi rgyal khab chen po zung du 'brel par 'dzam gling dngos po kun gyi lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas btud bya'i gnas ma ga khyad par bsam gyisami khyab pa dang ldan pa'i pho brang chen po'i dbus gdan seng ge'i khri la ston pa phun sum tsho gos pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtsa ba brtan zhing mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi sdong po rgyas pa'i rtser/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i lo 'bras khur du dud pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su chos phun sum tshogs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po che ge mo 'di nyid smra ba'i brtul zhugs bzung nas mgrin pa 'degs pa'i 'os su gyur pa min na'ang / slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis/ sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ ces pa ltar mngon pa'i nga rgyal spangs te bcam ldan 'das phren las rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil gcor r+ṣa po rdul tshon dang 'brel ba zhal phye bar bla ma yid dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha gter gyi bdag po dang bcas pa mkha' la sprin —512

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenaphung gtibs pa bzhin byon na mi mthun phyogs kun pha mthar bsgrad de byin rlabs mchogo (3na)mthun dngos grub kyi nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i dus 'dir rang gi legs/'o skol gyi ston pa bu ram shing pas mu stegs btul ba'i dus phun sum tshogs pa 'dir rang gi legs byas kyi zhing 'dus pa'i tshogs la thos pa'i skyes 'bul 'dod kyi dad pa dang mos pa'i dbang gis cung zad brjod pa ni/ ji skad du/ sprin chen 'brug sgras gang na yang / /char 'dod bye'u ca co sgrog /mdzangs pa'i tshig ni mi shes kyang / /byis pa ma yi gam du smra/ /zhes pa ltar/ mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yin dag gi go sa bgags te bdag lta bus smra ba la nyes par mi 'gyur bar sems la/ 'o na rnam dpyod dang mi ldan bzhin du bshad pa'i khur khyer ba ci zhe na/ ngang pa'i rgyal po grags ldan rnams/ /chu mtshor mgrin pa'i dzornga brdung / /'on kyang chu skyar gzhen nu rnams/ /glu dbyangs sa sil 'khrol bar byed/ /ces pa ltar blo mig chung ngus ji ltar rtogs pa rang blos gang spobs kyis sgrog pa la nyes pa'i klan ka mi 'jug cing khyod kyi chos 'di dag rang bzo tsam gyis smra ba yin nam zhe na/ de ni ma yin te/ gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas byas pa/ /de yi 'dab chags rnamasakyang gser du gyur/ /zhes gser ri'i mdangs phog pa'i bya rnams kyang ser por 'gyur ba bzhin thosabasam sgom pa'i grwar gnas pa tsam gyis legs pa'i yon tan 'go ba chos nyid yin na'ang de tsam la yid brtan du ma bzung bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rgyud pa zam ma chad pa las byung ba'i lung rigs man ngag dang ldan pa'i phyir khungs dang 'brel la/ de yang slob dpon (3ba)daṇ+ḍi sa/ shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni/ /nges par bstan pa'ang de yi sgo/ /zhes bya ba khyad par can gyi tshe shis pa brjod cing yul mchog tu gyur pa la phyag 'tshal ba ni sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar yin pa'i phyir rang nyid kyang mig yar blta'i tshul gyis de'i rjes su 'jug pa lags pas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes sho lo ka gsum/ zhes shis pa brjod pa sngon du btang nas/de'i rjes su yul khyad par can ji lta bu la mchod par brjod ce na/ skabs 'dir 'chad par bya ba la/sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa'i le'u lnga bcu pa las/ gsang ba'i snying por nges pa 'di/ /gsang sngags kun gyi —513

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā5)rgyal po yin/ /thabs chen mtshon pa'i shes rab yin/ /zhes pa ltar rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ bstan pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i bzhed phugs/ 'bras bu thams cad kyi mthar thug /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gshegs la/ ma 'ongs pa rnams kyi lam/ che ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ sems dang ye shes rang snang du ston pa/ sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba snying po 'di nyid gleng ba la 'brel chags pa zhig dgos pa yin pas/ sho lo ka gcig po 'di sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsang snying ṭika'i mar brjod nas blang / rang bawo mngon byas phyogs dus bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo ṣ+ka/ /zhi dang khro mdzad mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rab snang zhing / /dbyings phyug kro ti'i tshogs dang gnyis med ston pa sku lnga'i bdag /'chad byed rigs gsum mgon por bcas (4na)la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa thog ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang po las/ longs sku zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya rgyud kyi sdud po 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon por bcas pa la bdag sogs rang rig rang ngo ye 'phrod chos nyid zad sar 'byol min de srid bar du sgo gsum gus pas mchod/'di man gyi gos yod rnams gsar rtsom/ dam pa'i rigs can dri ma lnga dang ku ku rā dza rgyal po dza/ /o rgyan dri med bshes gnyen sangs rgyas gsang ba rma gnyags 'jig rten mig /so zur gnubs zhes rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob he ru ka dpal mi yi gzugs/ /g.yung ston sgrol chen rat+na gling sogs bka' babs brgyud pa rnams la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa lha'i bu grags ldan mchog skyong / klu rgyal mgrin pa nag po/ gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po laṅka mgrin bcu/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ li tsa bi dri ma med par grags pa/ dge slong khyi'i rgyal po/ skal ldan rgyal po dza/ sangasargyas gnyis pa dpal o rgyan chen po/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra sogs 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub rnams dang lo tsā ba rma gnyags gnyis so zur gnubs gsum sogs bka' babs brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la ྾/ rdo rje 'chang dbang ngur smrig gar mdzad pa/ /'khon rigs rje btsun dpal 'byor —514

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenalhun grub zhabs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po chos dbyings rang grol dpal/ /byang chub bar du khyod zhabs spyi bor len/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa rgyud rgyal 'di nyid kyi bstan (4ba tha slar yang nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa la gsang bdag sgro sbug pa bsams bzhin du sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub dang gang de'i gsung gi mdzod 'dzin pa kun mkhyen chen po chos dbyings rang grol yab sras rnam pa gnyis mo/ khri sgong thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od kyi zer/ /theg mchog 'dab brgya bcud pa'i rig sngags yong / /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed po bzhad pa rtsal/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon dam pa gtsug na bsten/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa mnga' bdag lha btsan po tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa las bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs su shar 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gcig pu pa rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i yan lag bzhi'i dpung tshogs kyi mi mthun log lta'i g.yul ngo mtha' dag gzhom par mdzad de/ bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam bzhis ris med kyi gdul bya rnams smin cing grol ba'i zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor ba'i ston pa'i rgyal tshab bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa rje btsun rgyal ba'i dbang po shes bya ji snyed pa'i gan lugs thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho dar nga phyogs mtha' dag las rnam par rgya po ba'i sder po/ ba lta bu 'dod pa dang sbyor/ gnam sa bar gsum khor yug dge mtshan gyis/ /rab bkra lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang / /thub dbang zhal bskyin rang byon lnga ldan sogs/ /skye rgu'i legs byas lā sa bzang mngon sum bzhin/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis (5na〉(ngas su bskor ba'i ra sa 'phrul snang zhes mi rje srong btsan sgam po'i ye shes sgyu mas sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang / 7 jo shāka yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa lus can kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsi 'di nyid ྾/ zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis nyer grub pas/ gangs can bstan pa'i rtsa lag chos 'khor che/ /mthong thos dran reg rnam grol gtsug lag khang / /'dzam gling —515

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānemadzes pa'i rgyan du gyur 'di bsngags/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa sprul pa'i skyes mchog mkhas grub lo paṇa rnams dang mnga' bdag chos skyong ba'i rgyal blon gyis phyag dar ba'i dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas de nyid ྾/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i thugs rje las/ /phun tsho gos 'dod dgur rtses pasayang dang yang / /phan bde'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i chos grwa che/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i 'jug ngogs dam pa rgyal/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa dpal ldan lha gzigs rlangs kyi gdung las gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po phag mo gru pa'i phyag rjes dri ma med pa chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses dang ྾/ tshul khrims dag pa'i zhing sa gshin pa la/ /smin grol rgyud bshad gdams pa'i 'bras dud pa/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas legs bshad gter/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i gling 'di rtag tu rgyal/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa so thar khrims kyi zhing la smin byed sa bon yongs su sbrums pa las/ bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen 'bras(5ba)bus dud pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling 'di nyid྾/ dgra bgegs 'khrul mtshor rgyal dang de sras kun/ /gtum drag srin po'i gzugs su nyer shar ba/ /mthu ldan dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams kyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde ring du spel/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa dpal mgon ma ning nag po dang dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i tshogs khyad par gtsug lag khang 'di nyid bsrung ba'i dpal ldan dung skyong dbang mo/ rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / gnas chung chos rgyal chen po sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams mo/ gnam gyi mthongs nas tshangs pa'i lung las kyi/ /bsod nams stobs kyi dpung pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon la dbang bsgyur nas/ bstan la sri zhur mdzad rnams rgyal gyur cig /ces pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa rgya hor bal bod sogs su sa chen po bde bar skyong zhing dkon cog gsum la bla mar 'dzin pa'i mi'i dbang po bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams mo/ de ltar mchod par brjod nas las su bya ba gang la 'jug na rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang —516

rgyud sdo rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgro dbyangs/ zhenab snying po 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la/zhes dngos la 'jug go/phur pa la byed na g.yin rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga zhes sogs blo ka gcig po'i tshig/lhun grub phyag rgya tshe dbang rnam smin rig pa 'dzin dang lha klu mi//bra bha hasti pad 'byung bi ma la dang 'tsho rgyal sna nam pa//gnyags gnubs nyang zur mkhar chen lang lang klu dbang srung 6na〉(gas sngon byon gyi//dpal chen phur bu'i sngags 'chang gos dkar lcang lo'i phreng ba 'dzin rnams nas//phung khams skye mched tsho gos brgyad dri sbyangs dkyil 'khor rnam bzhin smin cing grol//bshad srol gdams pa'i bka' drin stsol ba'i dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la dad//ces pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa rigs 'dzin bzhi/bka' babs lha klu mi/slob dpon bra bha ha sti/o rgyan dus gsum sangs rgyas/paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra/mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal sogs rgya bod kyi dpal chen phur bu'i rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad za/chos skyong gi skabs/dkar mo nyi zla stong phreng /bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba/phur srung bcu drug rnams dang zhes pa ma ning dregs pa'i tshab la 'dug/gsang ba 'dus pa la/ji skad du/thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos/khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang gis//rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sde bye ba phrag/gnyis kyis lhag pa'i dung phyur phrag gnyis gsung //der ni sa skyong khrod na 'khor sgyur bzhi//rab stims rgyud sde'i 'bor gyisayongs su bskor//gsung rab rin chen gling la dbang sgyur zhing //rgyal sras stong gi re ba kun nasastong //gsung rab kun gyi rtse mor gang son pa//de ni rgyud rgyal dpal ldan 'dus pa'o//zhes gsungasapa ltar 'di nyid khong du chud na bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kun la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa mchog tu thob pa'i phyir rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/mdo sde thams cad kyi za ma tog 6brko pa la gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la de dang 'brel mtshungs pa zhig dgos pas/lus dang mtshan med mkha' ltar dwangs kyang mtshan dang dpe byad mdzes pa'i sku yi gzi 'od 'bar//spros pa'i sgyu ma'i sprin ltar dengs kyang sgyu mas sgruX pa'i shes rab kyis 'byud bde bas myos//bloka

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānesnyag po 'di bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgron gsal bshad sbyar gyi mar brjod/ rigs brgya'i 'jug pa me ltar zhi yang dbyings nas rigs brgya'i sprul pa dpag med spro ba po srid zhi dpyad na rdul ltar med kyang srid zhi'i khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro ba dang bsdu ba'i byed po rigs thams cad kyi bdag po drug pa rdo rje 'amang chen po de nyid bdag sogs kha spyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug gi sku mngon du ma gyur bar de srid du sgo gsums/ rim lnga gsal sgron gyi mchod brjod/ gsang ba kun 'dus sdud mdzad gsang ba'i bdag /rgyud rgyal 'dus pa'i lam gyis mchogo brnyes pa/ /in+d+ra bhū ti klu yi mkha' 'gro ma/ /bi su da lha dpal ldan sar ha/ /klu sgrub rdo rje can dang 'phags pa lha/ /klu byang shākya bshes gnyen ma ta rmi/ /zla ba grags pa slob pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ /mkha' 'gro bde ba ma dang ḍo sdi pa/ /dril bu pa dang a rna ga badz+ra/ /zhe la ba nag po spyod pa dang / /tai lo nā ro la sogs bla ma la/ khugs drag dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di man mjug las la gsar du bris/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa sdud pa po gsang ba'i bdag (7na)po dang / chos rgyal in+d+ra bhū ti nas mkha' 'gro ma rnam pa gnyis las rim par brgyud de 'phags pa'i yul du lam 'di bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i paṇa grub dam pa rnams la mo/ rgyal ba'i dam chos gsal ma na blang /'dzin pa'i smon lam sogs/ /rlabs chen dge tsho gos du mas bskul ba yi/ /dka' ba du mas 'phags pa'i yul bgrod nas/ /lam 'di gangasari'i khrod du rgyas mdzad pa/ /'jig rten mig gyur rin wo bzang po dang / /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin lho brag mar pa dang / /rab 'byams gzhud la mkhas pa'i sgra bsgyur mchog /rta nag 'gos kyi zhabaspol phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa paṇ+ḍita'i bla ma bdun cu dang / /mkha' 'gro'i bla ma gnyis la brten nas lam 'di gangs ri'i khrod du spel bar mdzad pa'i 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi thugs kyi sras bzhi dang nye ba'i sras gsum gyi nang tshan ma ta lha pa nas brgyud pa mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i brgyud pa ḍo ma bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa grub thob nyams kyi brgyud pa/—518

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenaganyis 'dres kyi bka' babs mar lo chos kyi blo gros sogs rgyud 'di nyid la zhus chen dang 'gyur bcos kyi sgo nas 'chad nyan gtan la 'bebs par mdzad pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu brgyud par bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par shes bya thams cad la mkhyen pa'i spyan mnga' ba rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i/ ma smad rnam (7ba 'di gags bris/dpyod dpung pas nyer bteg 'gro la rjes chags ut+pal rtser/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas kun mkhyen pa'i ral gri rnon po yis/ /ma rig 'ching ba gcod pa'i mthu ldan 'jam dpal rdo rje rtsod dusa'adir/ /ngur smrig gar bsgyur blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs rdul srid zhi'i gtsug na mdzes/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa rab tu byung ba'i bla gos thun mtshams gsar pa'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i mdangs kyang bsgyur nus pas dza ti'i me tog bkra ba'i yul khams nas bzung za 'og thags su bskrun pa'i shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun khyab par mdo sngags kyi bstan pa bla na blar spel zhing khyad par sgyu lus sogs la sngon med pa'i legs par bshad de lam 'di'i shing rta pa chen po snyigasadus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa ྾/shes rab 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud mang las/ /ches dkon theg mchog chos tshul glur blangs nas/ /'phel mdzad byams pa chen pos gdul bya rnams/ /'dzin mkhas rnam par rgyal ba'i mgon khyod bsngags/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon stod rgyud smad rgyud kyi 'dus pa'i grwa chen po'i srol legs par 'byed mdzad mkhas grub shes rab seng ge dang / rje kun dga' don grub sogs mkhas btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs spyi dang khyad par shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rje btsun bla ma dkon cog chos 'phel ba'i zhal (8na༄ nas dang /dam pa gang gi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin 'jam dbyangs byams pa rnam rgyal yab sras rnam pa gnyis mo/dge tsho gis la 'dun mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /bsod nams zhing gyur lung rtogs yon tan gyis/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i blo gros gter/ /dpal ldan skal pa bzang po phyag gi gnas/ /zhes pa'i —519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānebastod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi sprul pa rim pa bdun 'byung bar lung gis zin pa bzhin bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du rim par byon pa rnams mo/ rje btsun bla mas zung 'jug mngon mdzad pa'i/ /sa la gnasapa'i 'og min dga' ldan gling / /rgyal bstan mkha' la nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ /thub gzhung 'byung gnasagrwa sa phan tshun bsngags/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa zhes sa gsum na yongs su grags pa'i 'og min gnyis pa dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gis dbu mdzad chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang se ra theg chen gling pa gral zur du 'brel ba 'di nyid྾/ khyad par du yang 'phags pa'i yul gyi dha n+ya ka ṭa ka /ljongs 'di'i bsod nams yul du mngon sum bzhin/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs mkhas mang bye ba yi/ /'byung gnas 'gran zla bral 'di rgyal gyur cig /ces bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa bslab gsum ngur smig 'chang bas rnam par (8ba〉btsun pa gzhung lugs mang du thos pas mchog tu mkhas pa gzhan phan lhag bsam 'byongs pas bzang po'i ngang tshul can gyis yongs su gtams pa'i chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde 'di nyid mo/ dri med bla mas lung bstan sbas pa'i gnas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i sa/ /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i chos 'khor rgyal/ /mkhas grub dam pa'i bste gnas phyag gi yul/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa/dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bka' gdams glegs bam sogs nas lung bstan pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho 'du ba'i bsti gnas sa la'i ljongs kyi au ṇ+ḍi a na'i grong khyer chos 'khor rgyal mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gas la brten par bcas pa de nyid ྾/ rtses dang du grwa skor byed na gong ltar dang / grwa tsha sgos kyi mar brjod kyang 'dir len/ stobs li phyag drug mgon dang dus kyi dgra/ khred gsum bdag mo 'dod khams dbang phyug sogs/ /bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dkar po chos kyi ba dan ring du phyor/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du —520

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ 6)gyur pa dpal mahā kā la phyag drug pa/ 'chi bdag las gshin rje/ 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dmar zor rgyal mo/ dpal ldan lha mo dung skyong dbang mo/ /bstan skyong rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /gnasachung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams ra/ (9na ji na bdag gi mchod brjod gong gi de yin/ /bag yod rlabs 'phreng yol med mtsho chen sde/ /legs bshad mgrin rnga 'khrol ba gnyis skyes dbus/ /theg mchog gtam gyi mchod sprin spros pa'i dge /'gro kun rnam pa thams cad mkhyen rgyur bsngo/ /'jig rten rgud mun sel ba'i nyin mor byed/ shwakya seng ge'i ring lugs 'od stong can/ /rab 'bar lung dang rtog pa'i yon tan gyis/ /rtag tu skal ba bzang por spyod phyir bsngo/ /yid bzhin nor las ches dkon rnyed dka'i chos/ /smin byed dbang dang grol byed bskyed dang rdzogs/ /tshul bzhin ston pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /skye bar rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bzang po'i bag chagasamathu 'dis yang srid kun/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam skye dgu ma lus pa/ /rgya chen thos rnamasabasam pas gtan phab nas/ /sgom byung lam gyis sku bzhi mngon 'gyur shog /zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs rma med pa/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa yis/ /dzā ti'i me tog bkra nas za 'og thags/ /'thag pa'i sa chen yongs la khyab par shog /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang cher/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar rab phye bas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug tor gyis 'dud pa'i/ /dbang thang mchod sbyin brgya pa'i rjes 'gro shog /rdo rje slob dpon 'jigs med seng ge'i khrir/ /'gyur med rtag brtan g.yu drung sku brnyes shing / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas legs (9ba)par bshad pa'i gling / /srid pa'i pha mtha' yongs la 'phel bar shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'dir/ /dus chad pa mtha' dag rab zhi nas/ /brgyad khri'i tshe lor spyod pa'i skye dgu bzhin/ /bde skyid dga' ston dpal la rtag rol shog /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' nas bzung ste/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bkra shis char chen nor 'dzin kun —521 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānekhyab shog /dwangs mtshor zla gzugs ji bzhin sna tsho gos sku/ /sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan bgrang yas zhi khro'i tshul/ khyud sde rgya mtsho'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dngos grub shis pa'i dpal des ring du skyongs/ /mi bsrun gnyen por gnam lcags thog 'bebs kyang / /ci bsam re skong yongs 'du sa brtol ljon/ /bstan srung bye ba'i 'phrin las bkra shis glu/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis srid 'di 'geng bar shog zhesabasngo smon shis brjod kyi tshigs bcad 'di ni pho brang ba blo bzang skyes mchog rtses dang du grwa skor byed skabs dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /gnas phun sum tshogs pa rang byung 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra'i gtsug lag khang gnam skos rgyal po'i pho brang chen po po ta la/ dus phun sum tshogs pa lo gsar rgyal gyi zla bar nag phyogs bdud sde thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba 'phrin las phur pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas mchod cing sgrub pa/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ 'di la dang por re zhig brjod bya dang rjod byed dang 'brel ba dang (10na ji gos pa dang dgos pa'i dgos pa rnams mngon par gzigs nas/ gdul bya'i skye bo nges pa dang bral ba rnams la rang gi sems kyi bsam pas skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu rab tu ster ba bde ba chen po'i gnas mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por rdo rje seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro po'i rgyal po dang lha dang klu dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/khams gsum pas zhabs kyi pad+ma la phyag byas pa/ khams gsum gyi 'khor bye pa gcig pu/mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas ris med pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ zla ba bzang pos gsol ba btab par gyur pas/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa/ risamed pa rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pas 'byud pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha 'byed pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa la brten pa/ rdzogs—522

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ 6)pa'i byang chub pa rnam pa bzhi dang rdo rje rnam pa bzhi yongs su dag pa/ sku bzhi dang rigs drug dang bden pa bcu gnyis dang / de kho na nyid bcu drug dang stong pa nyid bcu drug dang / snying rje bcu drug gi bdag nyid kyi brjod par bya ba dang brjod par byed pa dbang bskur ba 'jig rten pa'i bcu dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcu gcig pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa/ las kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang phyag rgya chen (10ba〉du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rab tu gsal bar byed pa/'jig rten gyi khams dang nang dang mngon par dbang bskur ba dang sgrub thabs dang ye shes te le'u lnga'i bdag nyid dam brtag pa lnga'i bdag nyid ni mi la sogs pa'i sems can mtha' dag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir yang dag par bstan to/ /zhes 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa ston pa rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa 'di nyid gsung ba po bdag cag gi ston pa shākya seng ges sa mo lug lo dbyar zla 'bring po chu stod kyi nya gang ba'i tshes la lhums su zhugs/ drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo sag zla ba'i tshes bdun la sku bltams/ nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu bzhugs shing sa byar rab tu byung nas lo drug dka' ba spyad pa'i mthar/ so lnga pa shing pho rta'i lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ de nas zhag zhe dgu 'das pa'i chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la wā ra ṇa sir bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de'ang rtsa rgyud las/ ston pas bya rgod phung po sa shes rab pha rol phyin tshul bzhin/ /chos bstan dpal ldan 'bras spungs su/ /de bzhin gsang sngags tshul rab gsungs/ zhes dang / bya rgod phung po'i ri chen por/ theg pa chen po bla na med/ khres rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cher/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes dang / mdor bsdus dang (11na)po'i bshad sbyar snying po'i snang bar yang / zla ba bzang po grong dgu bcu rtsa drug gi rgyal po dang bcas pas sham bha la nas 'bras spungs su 'ongs te rgyud bstan pa'i don du gsol ba btab ces pa ltar lo zhe drug 'das —523—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānepa gya gcig pa lcags 'byug nag pas nya ba'i tshes bco lngar shrī dha n+ya ka ṭa ga'i mchod rten du chos rgyal zla ba bzang po sogs ched du bya ba'i gdul bya la/ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bka' stsal pa/ chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan grags pa'i zhal snga nas yab sras rnams kyi bzhed srol bla na med pa yin cing / yang lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa rtsod bral gyi mkhas pa chen po stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi gsung las/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston mchog de/ /chu mo phag la lhums su zhugs/ tsheng pho byi ba'i lo la bltams/ nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu bzhugs/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad pa'i mthar/ /sa mo phag la mngon sangs rgyas/ /theg pa gsum dang rim gsum gyi/ /chos 'khor rdzogs par bskor ba'i mthar/ /dgung lo don brgyad lcags sprul la/ /lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs su/ /zla ba bzang sogs 'khor mang la/ /dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes gtan tshigs kyi rnam gzhag mi mthun pa gnyis dang / der ma zad mkhas pa dang mkhas par rlom pa dang mi mkhas pa dag gi gtan tshigs mang du byung ba mtha' dag brjod pa'i yul las 'das kyang rang lugs chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i mthar zla ba gsum pa nag pa'i nya la dpal ldan (11ba 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen po'i steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug gi rnam pa can dang 'og tu chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi cha bcu drug gi rnam par phye ba dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam par spros nas phun sum tshogs pa lnga las/ ston pa phun sum tsho gos pa bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po dus kyi 'khor lo zhal bzhi phyag nyer bzhi pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ zhu ba po phun sum tshogs pa chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa lha dang mi'i tshogs/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud rdo rje rnal 'byor brjod byar ston pa de la dgongs nas/ dpal ldan rgyud las/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes sku dang nyin mor byed pa'i sku ste pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs lha'i mchog rnams kyis ni btud pa rgyal po zla ba bzang po yis/ /mgo bos rab 524

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenatu phyag 'tshal lag pa'i pad+ma sbyar ba yan lag mchog la bzhag nas zhus pa ni/ /rnal 'byor dpal ldan dus 'khor ka phreng ldan pa a 'dus la sta mi rnams dgrol ba'i don du'o/ /zhes gsungs shing /stag tshang lo tsā ba'i gsung gi 'phros las/ /chu mo lug la mya ngan 'das/ /rta lug gnyis la zla bzang gis/ sham bha la ru rtsa rgyud bstan/ /'grel chen stong phrag drug cu pa/ /gzhal med khang dang bcas pa mdzad/ mang pho sprel la de yi sras/ /lha dbang seng ge'i khrir bzhugs nas/ /lo brgya'i bar du rtsa rgyud bstan/ /de na gzi brjid can dang ni/ /(12na)zla ba byin dang lha dbang phyug /sna tsho gos gzugasadang lha dbang ldan/ /re res lo brgyar rtsa rgyud bstan/ /slar yang shing pho spre'u la/ /'jam dbyangs grags pa khri thog byon/ /rtsa rgyud lo brgyar bstan pa'i mthar/ /nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa'i/ /tshangasapa'i drang srong bye ba phrag /phyed dang bzhi la bsdus rgyud bstan/ /de sras pad+ma dkar po la/ 'grel bshad bye ba bka' stsal gnang / /de yis dri ma med pa'i 'od/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis pa de mdzad/ /bsdus rgyud lo brgya'i bar du bstan/ /de bzhin bzang po rnam rgyal dang / /bshes gnyen bzang po phyag dmar dang / khyab 'jug sbas pa nyi ma grags/ zhan tu bzang rnams re res kyang / /lo brgya lo brgyar bsdus rgyud bstan/ /de nas shing pho spre'u la/ /rgya mtsho rnam rgyal ston pa por/ gyur pa'i lo de kla klo'i chos/ /ma kha'i yul du 'byung ba dang / /kla klo sbrang rtsi'i blo gros de/ /ston par gyur pa dus mnyam yin/ /rigasaldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyis/ /lo brgyar bstan mthar rgyal dkas bstan/ /de yi dam cho sebastan nasani/ /brgyad cu rtsa gnyis 'das pa'i lo/ /me pho khyi yi lo de ni/ /byed rtsis 'di yi lo dag gi /thog ma yin par kho bos smras/ /de nas nyis brgya nyer gcig 'das/ /rab byung lo la dam chos 'di/ /chu bo shi ta'i lho ru byon/ /zhes dang / de ltar rgyal ba 'das nas ni/ /nyis stong sum brgya so gcig ni/ sngar 'das lo ru nges pa yin/ /rgyal dka'i lhag ma bco brgyad po/ /'das rjes nyi mas lo brgya dang / /sna tshogs gzugs kyi lo brgya 'das/ /(12ba)zla ba'i 'od kyis chos bstan nas/ /lo gsum lon tshe rgya gar du/ /chos 'di byung zhing de nas ni/ /de lhag go bdun rdzogs rjes su/ /mtha' yas sa skyong dpal —525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneskyong gis/ /brgya brgyar bstan nas seng ga yis/ /so gcig 'das nas so gnyis pa'i/ /steng du da lta gnas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa de dag kyang don snying por bsgril ba'i la/ rang lugs pad+ma dkar po'i zhal lung gi rjes su 'brangs par thub pa'i dbang pos rtsa rgyud gsungs nas zla ba gcig song ba sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan/ de nas lo gcig 'das pa lcags sbrul chos rgyal zla ba bzang pos rtsa rgyud kyi bka' bsdu mdzad/ de nas lo gnyis 'das pa chu lug la zla ba bzang po gshegs/ de nas lo drug brgya dang gcig 'das pa shing sprer rigs ldan gyi thog ma 'jam dpal grags pas rtsa rgyud rjes bsngags kyi sdeb sbyor las/ bsdus pa'i rgyud me tog phreng can gyi sdeb sbyor du spel/ de nas lo brgya 'das pa shing pho byi ba la pad+ma dkar po khrir phebs/ de nas lo brgyad brgya 'dasapa shing sprer rgya mtsho rnam rgyal sham bha la'i khrir byon/ lo der ma ga dhar mu stegs kyi byed pa zhugs/de nas me mkha' rgya mtsho'i drug cu skor tha ma'i mjug tu dus 'khor 'phags yul du phebs/ mu stegs kyi byed pa zhugs nas/ lo brgya dang gya gnyis 'das pa mi zad pa me phyir rtsis 'go thog ma zug /de nas lo nyis brgya bcu dgu 'das pa me yos dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel rnams bod yul 'dir 'gyur zhing dar rgyas su gyur pa yin la mkhas pa stag tshang pa ni/ chos 'di kha che zla mgon dang / tsa mi sogs kyi (13na)bod yul du/ /ston phyir chos 'di rgya gar du/ /byon nas lo brgya ma khungs par/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir byon par nges/ /'on kyang lo yis nges pa dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel ka lwa pa rigs ldan gyi grong khyer na shin tu dar rgyas che'ang / yul dus kya bskal pas yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du ring zhing ma byon pa dus nam zhig nas srol 'byed pa po ni rwa pa'i lugs la chos 'di rgyal po pā la rnam gsum gyi ring la byung ba'i rgya gar shar phyogs o bi sar 'byungs pa'i slob dpon tsi lu paṇ+ḍi tas nā lan+da la sogs pa'i gtsug lag mang po dang khyad par tu dra tshe'i gnod pa med pa rin cen ri bo'i gtsug lag khang du glegs bam rnams la gzigs pas tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya bar theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags dgos/ de yang byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa'i 'grel par —526

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenabarten dgos la/ de sham+bha la na yod do zhes gzigs nas der byon par bzhed de tshong pa rgya mtshor 'gro ba dang 'grogs te zla ba drug gi dus byas nas byang gi ri chen por 'dzegs nas byon pas mi zhig dang phrad pa la de na re gang du 'gro zer bar rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas shes pa byung na 'di gar nyan du mi rung ngam zer ba 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul par shes te gsol ba btab pas dbang rgyud 'grel mtha' dag gnang nas me tog spyi bor bzhag ste sems 'grel gyi skor thams cad khong du chud par gyur cig ces gsungs pas thugs su chud de tshong pa dang 'grogs rgya gar du byon nas biṇ+ḍi ā tsarla la gnang des dus zhabs po chen por stsal bar grags mod/ lo rgyus gcig la dus zhabs (13ba)pa chen po de rnal 'byor pa zhig gi bu yin pa phas khrid de sham+bha lar byon pa na dge slong gzugs bzang ba zhig gis byin rlabs mdzad pas zhag re la blo ka stong stong zin pa'i blo gros dang ldan par gyur nas des spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i dge slong la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bsdus pa'i rgyud/ 'grel pa rnams nos pa thugs la bzung nas rgya gar du byon te rab tu byung ba'i mtshan tsi lu par grags zhes snang la/ 'byo ba lugs kyi lo rgyus la lar yul dbus kyi rgyal rigs gnas lnga rig cing 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul par grags pa lha mo sgrol mas rjes su bzung zhing sham+bha la nas rgyud 'grel 'tshol bar lung bstan rnyed pa'i slob dpon dus zhabs pa chen pos rigs ldan pad+ma dkar por gsan la/ de'i tshul yang tshong pa dang bsdebs nas gshegs pa sprul pa'i dge slong zhig gis khrid pa'i gtam rgyud sogs snang yang / sham+bha lar 'byon par bzhed de chas pa dang / dag snang la sham+bha lar spyan ras gzigasadangos la zhus pa don la gnas par grags mod/ 'bro ba rang gi lugs la rigs ldan rgyal po dpal skyong la dus
