zhabs pas thug par mdzad kyi/ sham+bha lar des chos ston pa'i dus zhes nges pa mi 'dod la/ de'ang 'phags yul du gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa yab yum gnyis kyis gshed skor gyi rgyud nas byung ba'i rigs kyi sras bskrun pa'i cho ga byas pas khye'u zhig 'khrungs te cher skyes pa na byang phyogs na byang chub sems dpa' dngos su chos ston pa yong bar grags nas nyan du byon pas khye'u'i —527

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nelhag bsam khyad par can dang / sham+bha lar 'ongs na chu med pa'i mya ngam gyi thang la zla ba bzhi 'gro dgos pas srog gi bar chad du 'gyur bar byang chub (14na〉gims dpas dgongs te byang sems sa'i snying pos rigs ldan gyi rgyal po dpal skyong gi sprul pa bzung ste khyod gang du gang gi phyir 'gro zhes gsung ba la lan zhus pas der bgrod pa ni shin tu dka' bas shes pa byung na 'dir nyan du rung ngam zhes gsung ba na rigs ldan gyi sprul par shes te gsol ba btab pas der zla ba bzhi'i bar du dbang rgyud sems 'grel dang bcas pa dang gzhan yang rgyud sde mtha' dag gnang ba bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul du mkhyen nas rgya gar du byon no/ shes bya kun la gzigs pa'i spyan ldan 'gos lo tsā ba ye bzang rtse pa'i zhal snga nas/ dus phyi ma'i mkhas pa phal cher dus kyi 'khor lo yul dbus su byon pa dang 'das lo'i thog ma'i rab byung 'jug pa dus mtshungs par bzhed do/ /de lta mod kyi dus kyi 'khor lo ni snga rabs shig nas 'phags pa'i yul du byung bar mngon te/ grub chen dril bu zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs las dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi mchod par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa/ rnam par bcas kyang zhes bya ba la sogs pa de gsal po nyid du bris snang ba'i phyir dang / dril bu pa'i rjes su rus sbal zhabs/ des dzā lan+ta ri pa/ des nag po pa/ des bzang bo zhabs/ des rnam rgyal zhabs/ des ti khri pa/ des nā ro pa/ zhes dril bu pa nas na ro pa'i bar du bla ma'i rim pa brgyad byung zhing nā ro pa dang dus zhabs yab sras dus mtshungs pa'i yang phyir ram/ yang dpal bi rū pas/ dpal gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo'i gsal byed mdzad pa dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa yin par gzhung de nyid (14bsko snang ba'i phyir zhes dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul 'phags yul du snga mo zhig nas phebs pa phyis skye bo yongs la grags pa ni/ dus 'khor zhabs yab sras kyi ring la yin no zhes byas na 'thad do gsung ba'ang lung rigs kyis dpyad pa zhugs pa'i legs bshad du mngon zhing / de yang rgyal po shing rta can gyis ma ga dha'i rgyal po byed cing sen+ta pas o tan pu ri'i gtsug lag khang 'dzin pa'i tshe dus zhabs pa chung ba byon te nā lan+da'i sgo gong la rnam bcu dbang ldan —528

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ 'dadang de'i 'og tu/ khams le'i mdor bsdus drug pa'i 'grel chen las/ de'i phyir gang gis mchoge gi dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes pa des mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes so/ /gang gis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes pa des rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mi shes so/ /gang gis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mi shes pa des sngags kyi theg pa ma shes so/ /gang gis sngags kyi theg pa mi shesapa de thams cad ni 'khor ba pa de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam dang bral ba'o/ /de lta bas na mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas ni bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bstan par bya zhing thar pa don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams kyis mnyan par bya'o zhes bris par 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya rnams yi ma rangs par bi ka ma la shī lar tshogs nas so sor khri bshams te brtsad pa na rjo bos dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnad kyi rgyud so so'i stod smad kyi 'gal dris pa dang chos kyi rang bzhin zab cing rgya che bas thams cad spobs pa med par gyur nas khri bor zhing bsnyems pa btang ste zhabs la spyi bos phyag btsal/ da byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogos pa thams cad kyis dus kyi 'khor lo ma (15na tshes sa pa med pas mtshan yang dus 'khor pa zhes grags nas shin tu dar rgyas su gyur mod/ 'bro lugs ltar na dus zhabs pa chen pos rigs ldan dpal skyong la gsan pa dang rwa pa'i lugs la 'jam dbyangasasprul pa nas dus zhabs pa che ba'i bar bla ma gnyis song ba dang / la lar tsi lu pa dang / dus zhabasapa che ba gcig pa sogs mi mthun pa mang yang / deb sngon du spyir na rgya gar ba dag la'ang gtam ngesapa med pa srid de/ nyi ma dpal gyis mdzad pa'i yan lag drug gi 'grel pa dbang gis bsgyur bar/nyi ma dpal chos 'byung zhi ba'i slob mar byas la/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung gis nyi ma dpal ni chos yang zhi ba'i bla ma yin zhes gsung / kho bos rgya dpe gnyis mthong ba la'ang de kho na ltar snang ngo / /zhes dang / gtam mthun pa dang mi mthun pa sna tshogs yod kyang gnyan dang se lo tsā ba'i phyogs kyi a bha ya dang / rwa ba'i phyogs kyi mañdzu kirti dang /'byo pa'i phyogs kyi zla ba mgon po rnams dus zhabs pa chung ba'i dngos kyi slob ma yin par mthun zhing / dus zhabs pa chung ba dus zhabs pa chen po'i dngos —529

rgyal dbang lnga par ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kyi slob mar mthun pa'i phyir yid bde bar bya'o//zhes gsungs/de yang 'bro lugs la dus zhabasapa chung ba nas rgyal sras nā lan+da pa kha che zla ba mgon po/'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags nas rim par brgyud de/kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtsho la jo nang kun mkhyen dol bu bsags na zhing /yang kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches zhus la/rwa ba ltar na dus zhabs pa chung ba 15bskos mji kirti/paṇ+ḍita sa man+ta shrī/rwa lo tsā ba cho mer ba nas rim par skyi ston gragasargyan pa las kun mkhyen dol bu ba dang bla ma dpal ldan seng ge nas kun mkhyen bu la brgyud pa ste bu dol rnam gnyis zhes gangs ri'i khrod kyi dus zhabs pa nyi zla ltar grags pa dang /gzhan yang tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/paṇa chen shākya shrī/rgyal sras nags kyi rin chen/sa lo/shong lo sogs paṇa grub du ma las brgyud pa dang /phyogs 'dir mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' ltar yangs pa mtha' klas shing dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa 'grel bar bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal mngon sum du bstan nas zla ba bzang po dang 'dra ba/ches cher bsngags pa rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal sogs tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas grub bgrang bar dka' zhing khyad par rang lugs 'di la 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang bral ba stag tshang lo tsā ba dang /dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa yab srasakyis rigs ldan dgongs pa'i rgyan gyis kha bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir rgyas par mdzad do//de yang man ngag snye ma las/'di la gsung rab g.yin dang 'gal ba mang bas 'di byed pa po'i byang semasasu bshad pa de rnams rigs gsum mgon po dngos ma yin no//zhes mang du mkhyen pa rnams gsung zhes bkod pa'i mang du mkhyen pa ni shan+ti par grags shing /rnams zhes pas mkhas pa gzhan yang yod la/'jigs med 'byung gnas dus 'khor zhal gyis bzhes kyang rlung gi rgyu tshul bshad rgyud rdor phreng dang ma mthun pa sogs nas mang zhig drang don du 'grel/kun mkhyen bu rgyud 'di gtso bor 'dzin kyang 'jig rten bstan bzhag khrin yang don yin pa'i dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed dang bcas pa sbyar/bcom ldan ral gris/phyi nang ༷dres pa'i bstan bcos yin te//'di nas khams

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenagasum ri rab la chud pa/ stong gsum yongs su chad pa/ phyi'i rgya mtsho me'i khor yug gis 'khor ba/ ri rab kyi lho pad+ma rā ga las grub pa/ rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur ba 'byung ba/ gza' skar kha shar du bltasanas 'gro ba/ rgya nag bod kyi byang na yod pa/ zad par khams gong mar skye ba'i rgyu rnams bshad pasaso zhes gsung / rje re mda' pa e waṃ med pa sogs kyi skyon du ma bkod pa'i rtsod yig dang / skad phal cher drang ba'i don du shes zhes sogs kyi rang lan dang bcas pa mdzad pa gsung rab rgya mtshor gzigs pa'i mkhas grub de dag la zhabrul pa mi mnga' mod/ 'on kyang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni bag chags skyon/ /phyi rol tu ni sprin mthong 'gyur/ /bag chags zad pa'i dus su ni/ /sprin dang klu rnams mthong ba med/ /ces dang / lang gar gshegs pa las/ bag chagasakyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu byung / /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /zhes pa'i don dang 'gal bar ci/ /de dag ni phyi don bden med du sgrub pa ma yin nam 'dir phyi don zhal gyis bzhes pas mi mtshungs so zhe na 'dir yang phyi don bden grub tu ba ched par su zhig 'dod de/ sgrub le'i nyis brgya par/ srid gsum phra rab gzugs min 'dir ni rnam par shes pa'o de bzhin rnam par shes pa nyid med de/ (16ba〉skos sogs ma dpyad pa'i ngor/ bye smra sogs dang bstun nas rdul phran bzhed la/ cung zad dpyad na rnam shes kyi ngo bo de yang ma grub par legs par gsungs shing / sems can so so'i bsam pa so sos bag chags so sor bzhag pa'i lasasnang gi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ dngos po gcig nyid che chung mdog dbyibs bzang ngan mi 'dra ba du mar gzhi gcig tu snang ba 'jig rten kun rdzob tu mos pa sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad sna tshogs su gsungs shing don dam pa'i bden pas 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad med de/ sems can gyi bsod nams dang sdig pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs su mthong ba yin te/ ji skad du/ de la bsam pa'i dbang gis ni/ /ci yod par ni rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan las/ rgyud ni mdor bstan rnams—531—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsum dang //rgyas par bshad pa rnam gsum 'gyur//mdor bstan rab tu mdor bstan che//rgyasabashad rab tu rgyas bshad gzhan//mdor bstan rgyas par bshad pa ni//bsdus dang yang dag rgyud yin no//rab tu mdor bstan rgyas bshad pa//dka' 'grel tshig ni 'byed pa po//mdor bstan chen bo rgyas bshad pa//'grel bshad don kun ston byed pa'o//de ni mngon shes thob rnams kyis//bya yi mkhas rnams kyis min nyid//de ltar mtha' drug rnams kyis dag/rdo rje rnal 'byor rnam bzhi dang //rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzhi rnams dang //phung khams skye mched rigs drug rnams//dag pa 'jig rten khams la sogs//le'u lnga ni 17na 'dong rnams kyis//bden gnyis dang po'i sa pas rgyas 'gyur//dus kyi 'bor lo mdzo brjod byed//ces rgyud 'grel 'di nyid kyi rjod byed kyi tshig bsdu na rtsa rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa dang bsdus rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gnyis su 'dus mod kyi phye na drug tu dbyer yod pa dang /drug po de la mtha' drug tu byed de/drug ni mdor bstan dang rgyasabashad gnyis/rab tu mdor bstan dang rab tu rgyas bshad gnyis mdor bstan r+ṣa po dang rgyas bshad chen po'o//mtha' drug ces pa mdor bstan gyi mtha' dang rgyas bshad kyi mtha' zhes sogs re re la sbyar la/mtshan gzhi zhes pa mdor bstan ni bsdus rgyud rgyas bshad ni rtsa rgyud/bar pa gnyis ni rim pa ltar de gnyis kyi dka' 'grel/tha ma gnyis ni de nyid kyi 'grel bshad so so/brjod bya'i don hril gyis na phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag 'jig 'byung gnas gsum gyi sgo nas dang /nang rdo rje lus kyi rnam gzhag skye 'jig srung gsum gyi sgo nas dang /gzhan dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag smin grol 'bras gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la dbab pa'i rtsa 'grel thams cad du dbang bzhi pa'i lam gsal bar byed pa kho nas kyang g.yin las khyad par du 'phags pa gnyis med rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid kyi sgo nas legs spyo kyi yeng pa tshol pa la/par bshad pa yin la/phyi stag sgo lo sto phyo spyi don legs shad gas pa' rgya mtsho na blangs/nang dus sbyor bcu gnyis 'gags pas bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan phyir rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che//'gyur ༷'i bde ba bcu drug zad pas bden med de nyid

rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenabacu drug rig phyir rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /gnas (17bskyobs bzhi yi sgrib pa zad pas thig le bzhi po mi 'gyur 'dzin phyir sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi'i rang bzhin/ /zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor drug gisakhams drug sgrib pa zad par spangs pa'i rigs drug gtso bor gyur la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa stong gzugs phyag rgya mkha' la mkha' ye sbyor ba ji bzhin brjod bral gyi dbyings su nam yang 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po sgra gcan bla na med pa chos kyi sku las/ /nyi ma dang zla ba'i ngo mtshar gzugs sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs su 'char bar mdzad de dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i gtso bor zhal bzhi phyag nyer bzhi pa'i sprul sku'i gar mkhan rang snang mdzes sdug sgyu ma'i phyag rgya gnyis med gnyis su shar ba sna tshogs yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rgyud rgyal ston pa po 'di nyid bdag sogs stong chen yi ge lnga mthar thug pa'i bde ba dang / thig le yig drug phyag rgya chen mo e waṃ zung du 'jug par ma gyur de srid kyi bar du sgo gsum mo/ rigs gsum mnga' bdag la sogs sa bcu'i mgon/ /chos rgyal tshul bzung dpal ldan ka lwa par/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas gsal bar mdzad rnams dang / /rgya bod mkhas grub kun la gusaphyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa byang phyogs legs pa'i cha thams cad bsags pa'i pho brang chen po'i seng ge'i khri la rgyal ba'i sras po mi'i bdag po'i rnam par bstan nas rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du byon pa dang / rgyud 'grel 'phags pa'i yul du dar bar mdzad ba'i slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs pa che chung / rgyal sras nā lan+da pa/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba shesarab grags(18na)dang / 'jam dbyangs sprul pa/ tsi lu paṇ+ḍita/ piṇ+ḍi ā tsarla/ dpal dus zhabs pa che chung / mañdzu kirti/ paṇ+ḍita sam man+ta shī/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab ste sgyur byed kyi lo tsā ba rnam gnyis/'gyur bcos kyis rmad du byung ba mdzad pa po shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ slar yang sgyur byed ma ti rnam gnyis dang / smin grol rgyud bshad mkhan po jo nang kun mkhyen dol bu ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/—533—

rgyal dbang lnga spung ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānesnyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub kyis mtshon lugs srol 'di nyid kyi smin grol rgyud bshad gdams pa'i chu bo phyogs brgyar 'bebs mdzad 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub thams cad/ gsar rtsom sems 'grel dgongs don zhabrul med 'dzin mdzad mkhas grub chos kyi grags pa'i dpal/ /rgya che shes bya'i gnas kun legs gzigs shes rab rin cen stag tshang pa/ /bde stong zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dus 'khor zhabs pa nor bu bzang / /phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor la zla bral lhun grub rgya mtsho yab sras rgyal/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita 'jigs med cho so kyi rgyal po dpal ldan grags pa/ gtsug lag bye ba'i pha mthar mkhyen pa'i spyan ras mchog tu yangs pa stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang tshe gcig lus gcig la stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang mngon du gyur pa mkhas grub chen po nor bzang rgya mtsho/ shin tu cha phra'i gnas kun spyan ras gzigs kyis legs par bkral ba bzhin gtan la phab pas nang dang gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa grwa phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad za/ rab (14ji mar zhabs ho nyi ma gtsug tor rtser/ thar tshe rmongs pa'i mun sangs blo gros kyi/ /pad tshal bzhad la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyis rtag tu skyongs/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa mkhas pa dang grub pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur ba khyab bdag gnas gsar pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rab 'byams rgyud sde'i bang mdzod rdo rje 'chang zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ ji ltar ji snyed kyi shes bya'i gnas lugs mtha' dag rang byon du chud pa zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ snga phyir 'gyur ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i gsung rab kun la dbang phyug pa 'khor lo'i mgon po khra tshang pa blo gros mchogo gi rdo rje sogs dngos dang brgyud pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa thams cad mo/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa sogs bla ma'i rigs dang gnas mgon sogs gsang 'dus dang dbyibs 'dra/ chos skyong ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud 'grel legs skyong —534

rgyud dzi rgya mtsho'i sngon 'gro'i mchod brjod kyi rim pa 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ zhenabar/ /stobs chen rdo rje'i shugs 'chang khro rgyal gyis/ /bzod dka'i gzi byin rab bskyed srung ma'i tshogs/ /yid srubs las rgyal rnga chen srid rtser rdungs/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa rgyud rgyal 'di nyid kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog phyogs tsam 'dzin pa yan chad bsrung zhing skyob pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs spyi dang / gzhan yang gtsug lag 'di nyid bsrung ba'i sogasa'adra zhes bshad pa'i sngon 'gro'i lhan thabs 'di ni blo bzang thugs rjes grwa skor gyi tshe dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// //—335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)ra༅༅/ /gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs the rgo/ /༄7/ /phul byung snying rje'i ma dros las 'ongs pa/ /tshogs gnyis klung rgyun byang chen chu gter sto/ /rab 'gengs 'jig rten don kun grub pa'i rlabs/ /yol med shāka seng lha yi lhar gyur bsngags/khyod dang mnyam par bkram pa spang rtogs kyi/ /sa bon dar drag snye ma g.yur za'i khur/ /lci yang nyan thosahrūl gyis bstan pa'i mtha'/ /de srid skyong mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug rgyal/ /'khor ba'i gdung ba sil la nyer sbrengs pa/ /chad med rab 'jug thugs rje arga'i rgyun/ /mchod gsol smon pa'i sa snying zhun ma'i skyogs/ /spel legs brjod pa rin cen phra tsho mes mdzes/ /byang chub snying po kun khyab gser gyi khams/ /bsod nams mthus sbyangs ma par rtogs pa'i skongs/ /ye shes mchog gi g.yu sbyang pad+ma'i 'dab/ /gtan mdun sgra 'dzin mun stug mal nas slong / /sems kyi ri mo bag la nyal ba'i cha/ /ches phra mngon sum mkhyen pa nyi ma'i gnyen/ /mos dbang zhing gi rdul snyed dus (2na)gcig tu/ /gshegs bzhugs mdzad par nye dang ring min mnga'/ /bla gos mdangs gzigs mkha' ngos thun 'tshams mar/ /bsgyur nus dgra bcom gyis bskor thub pa che/ /bsod nams zhing du bstar pa sngon rabs kyi/ /tshad ldan mkhas mang bzhed pa'i srol las byung / /de phyir sdug btsir rngul chu mi 'dzag par/ /blo gros stong po'i sor mos nyer gzung ba/ /gnas brtan mar mchog ne'u le'i kha nang nas/ /rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu skyug 'di longs/ /zhes snyan dngags kyi tshigs su bcad pas sdun bsus te 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs —536

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po 'khor 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma tā la rgyal po bzhi sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la phyag mchod smon lam gyi rim pa khrigs su bsgrigs par yid ches ngo mtshar gyi lo rgyus/ sku che ba'i yon tan/ gsol ba ji ltar gdab tshul/ /cho ga dngos dang (2ba tha zhi las/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad brgya lon pa na yul shi pi rkar grong khyer byin gyis brlabs pa na rgyal po rig pa'i sdes dbang sgyur ba'i yul na dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhes khyad par 'phags pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa zhig mya ngan las 'da' khar dge 'dun rnams kyis mya ngan las 'da' bar brtsams pa na de ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub par 'gyur ram gsol ba'i lan du/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dusakyi tshe gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi lag tu dam pa'i chos gtad par gyur te zhes sogs kyi lan btab par/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gnas brtan de dag gi ming yang mi 'tshal lo zhes smras pa'i lan du/ gnas brtan dang po'i mtshan ni ba ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len zhes bya'o zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs shing / mtshon gyi bskal ba 'das rjes dge bcu'i mthus tshe lo bcu nas brgyad cur 'phel ba na nyan thos rnams 'dzam bu'i gling du byon nas dam pa'i chos 'phel bar mdzad skye rgu rnams kyi tshe lo bdun brgya pa'i dus nyan thos de dag gis gang sa'i steng 'di na bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i tshogs ji snyed pa de dag gcig tu bsdus nas rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten zhig byas par bskor zhing skyil krung gis 'dug ste bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la 'dud pas phyag 'tshal lo zhes gsungs nas/ /phung po lhag med du mya ngan las 'das/ mchod rten de yang 'og gi gser gyi sa gzhir (3na skonasashing rang rgyal bye ba phrag bdun byung ba'i mthar tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i dus byams pa'i bstan pa 'byung bar bshad pa sogs 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod de gnas brtan bcu drug gi lo rgyus rtsa ba lta bur snang la/ dpal ldan gros gnas brtan 'di rnams rgya gar du rgya gar gyi rab —537

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)tu byung ba'i cha lugs su byon/ bod du bod kyi rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs su byon/ rgya nag tu rgya ban snyug chas can du byon pa yin gsungs pa ltar yul so so'i khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba rnams 'dren par mdzad pa/ so so'i gnas nas spyan drangs pa'i lung la tshig rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis byung ba'i rgya gar skad du/ sba wi ro pa ni mas na/ bod skad du/ gnas brtan spyan drang ba/ thamasacad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ dgongs nas kyang shel dang nor bu dang / dngul dang / ku mud dang / kha ba'i phung po dang / zla ba'i 'od zer dang / ston gyi chu dang / nam mkha' dang / pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dri ma med par mdzod/ ces sogs dang / rgya nag nas brgyud de 'ongs pa thang hu'i rgyal pos gnas brtan spyan drangs pa'i phrin yig ni/ ma ga dha'i yul du byon pa sangs rgyas kyi dge bdun btsun pa gnas brtan chen po rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi dad pa dang / dang ba dang / 'dun pa las byung ba'i tshig gis gsal bar byed pa'i ngag shel dang / nor bu dang / kha ba'i phung po dang / zla ba'i zer dang / pad+ma'i rtsab ltar dri ma med par mdzod la zhes so gos(3bajung bas/ de yang shar rgya nag 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu rgyal po bsnyun gyis btab par thabs g.yin gyis ma phan pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpar gsol ba btab pa'i tshe nam mkha'i mthongs su 'brug gi rgyab yol la 'ja' tshon gyi gur gyis brgyan nas byon pa gzigs pas rgyal po bsnyun lasagrol/ yang bsnyun pa'i dus blon po rnams kyis chos skyong ba'i rgyal po yin na gnas brtan bcu drug dbyar gnas la gdan drongs zhus pa ltar gsol ba btab pas/ bre phul gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi dus rgya ban skrug chas can du byon nas rgyal pos khang pa bcu drug brtsegs par bzhugs nasadabyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshe rje 'bangs rnams kyis za 'og phul ba bdag gir mdzad pas dgra bcom longs sku'i cha lugs can du gyur/ rgyal pos khyod rnams chos skyong ba'i blon po yin na dgag dbye thon nas kyang bzhugs par gsol ba thob gsungs pa ltar gsol ba btab na'ang gling gzhan gyi gdul bya la dgongs nas sku tshab 'dra 'bag bzheng ba'i gnang ba stsal/ dbyar gnas kyi dus gnas brtan lung —538

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenabastan gyi mdo gsungs shing theg pa chen po shin tu dar la rgya nag longs spyod che ba'ang gnas brtan gyi byin rlabs su grags/gnas brtan rnams ha la shan gyi ri la byon pa'i dus dge bsnyen chos 'phel gyis phyag brgyar mdzad pa'i tshe srog chags ma rungs pa'i cho ga bsrung bsrung slad pus mo g.yas las stag sprul ba dang nyin re bzhin snang ba mtha' yas sprin gseb tu byon nas bzhugs/ mi lhag 'ga'i rgyal po zhig bsnyun pa'i tshe thabs gzhan gyis ma phan pa na rgyal (4na)po go shir dpe 'dul ba 'dzin pas gnas brtan gyi cho ga mthon pas rgyal po snyun las grol/ hor dmag gis mi nyag 'ga'i mkhar zhag bdun du bskor te smar chu skyil nas chu bkag pa'i tshe bla mchod gnyis kyis gnas brtan la gsol ba btab pas btsun pa skya hral le ba zhig gis chu 'di na yod zer ba ltar sa brus pas khron pa thon nas mkhar ma shor mdo smad du chos 'di dar bar phan yon chen po byung bas gnas gzhi kun tu gnas bas ga rjo la ma brtsigs pa med/ glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs rjes dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi drug gis mdo smad du byon dus gnas brtan gyi che ba gsan pas gnas gzhi kun tu gnas brtan gyi sku bzhengs skad/khyad par klu mes 'brom chung gis rgya nag tu byon nas bzhugs khang gi sku la dpe byas nas bris sku bzhedas pa nyin re la thang ka re zin pas bzo bo de sprul pa yin nam zer/ bod du gdan drangs nas yer par bzhugs pas yer pa ra ba mar grags/ rgya nag gi yig tshang las byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo khungs ma zhig rnyed cing yid ches kyi lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma bkod par/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge'i smon lam dang / /gnas brtan rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rgyal chen bzhi yi thugs dam ji ltar bskul ba'i tshul/ /sngon byung rgya nag yig tshang nyid las kho bos rnyed/ /ces sogs mchis/ jo bo chen pos bya rgyud dang 'brel ba'i thub pa gnas bcu'i rjes gnang phyag mchod dang bcas pa slob ma sems tsam gyi paṇ+ḍita ra gnang zhing / (4ba〉nad du byon pa'i 'khor du paṇa chung gsum byung ba'i gong du bshad pa'i sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa des rngog byang chub 'byung —539

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gnas la gnang bris sku yang bzhengs/khu ston gyis rngog gi lha gos bzang po 'di smu yag che bar 'dug gsungs skad/rngog gis bshes gnyen po to ba la gsungs/po to bas 'khor rnams la gnasabacu'i sku rgyu bzang ngan la ma bltos pa'i re re gzhongs gnas bcu ma bzhugs na lha khang gi go yang en mi chod/bod kun gsol ba gdab tu yod pa bsod nams che zhes po to ba rang yang gnasabartan yan lag 'byung gi sprul par don la zhal gyis bzhes/gnas brtan la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus grwa pa rnam grol sgrub par nges pa nyis stong la nye ba 'dus/de nas rim bzhin sha ra ba yon to grags kyis kyang gnas brtan la phyag mchod gtso bor mdzad pas thar pa don gnyer gyi grwa pa sum stong tsam 'dus lan cig bsnyun pa'i tshe 'chad dka' bas gnas brtan la gsol ba btab pas myur du dwangs/dge bshes 'chad dka' ba'i zhal nas 'di dag la gsol ba btab na chos dang chos byed 'phel ba 'dug ste 'di kho na ngo mtshar che/de 'phel bas gzhan thams cad shugs las 'byung /chosadang chos byed 'phel ba'i nyams su myong ba'i snyan pa la brten dge bshes se spyil bas mer pa nas ma dpe blangs te bzhengs/'di byin rlabs shin tu che kho bo'am mgo se hri ya le sdod pa 'dug gsungs pa ltar dgung lo go gnyis bzhugs/da lta 'o skol la thang sku'i rnam par snang /tsho gos la ma chen po'i dus su sprul skur na 'char/drod kyi ye shes thob nas chos gsung /sa dang po thob nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'char/sgom lam du chos gsung /sa bcu rgyun gyi tha mar gyur pa'i tshe sangs rgyas chos kyi skur byon pa yin gsungs/lha spyil bu bas se spyil bu bas bzhengs pa'i rten rnams la gsol ba btab pas phan yul rma'i grog po bya ba'i gnas chung zhig na rgya nag nas byin pa'i gnas bcu lung bstan gyi mdo dang gdams pa rnams sngon gyi ke tshang na bzhugs pa gsan nas 'bul ba bskur pas khong gi thugs la btags nyams len mkhas pas yon tan mang du 'khrungs/sde snod shes pa'i mkhas btsun lnga brgya 'dus/rgan mo lhas pa chen po'i zhal nas gnas brtan chen po rnams la gsol ba bto pas blo chos la bkol du gas pa dang //༷ pa cher 'gro ba dang /dge sbyong la brtson 'grus

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhedache bar 'gro ba'i 'phral du nges shes thon pa byung gsungs/ de nas dpal ldan gro mo che pa mchims nam mkha' grags/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ slob dpon sbas pa ston gzhon/ chos sku blo grosa'od/ mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan/ byang sems chen po shākya bsod nams/ lo pa spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ gzims 'og pa dpal ldan chosa'abyor/ lo pa spyan snga mtshungs med kun dga' don grub/ gnas gsar rdo rje la zang mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/ bka' drin mnyam med zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ desabadag za hor ban+de la bka' (5ba ji na du stsal/ dpal snar thang pa'i man ngag brgya rtsar grags pa se spyil bu ba nas/ lha spyil phug /'gre lhas pa/ dpal ldan gro/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/dbang ston grub pa shes rab/ khu ston bsod nams mchog grub/ dpal 'bar ba dpal ldan don grub/ rtses dang las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mthil brag lcog thams cad mkhyen pa/ thon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ shangs dge 'phel ba phyogs las rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhen nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje la4 pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la dgyes bzhin du gnang / mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub yig rgyas pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'gre lhas pa yan gong bzhin la/ de nas sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ slob dpon bsod ye/ byang semasabasod grags pa/ bar 'dir bla ma gnyis tsam hol khengs su lus/ de nas spyan snga lha bsod nams/spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ brag dgon spyan snga man gong bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sku che ba'i yon tan la gsum ste/ spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa dang / mtshan gyi rnam grangs kyis che ba'i yon tan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas brtan chen po 'di rnams spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i ldog pas ngo bo (6na)sangs rgyas yin pa nas/ stobs bcu dang /—541—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sogs pa ldan/ thugs rje dang 'phrin las ni yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi mdzad pas sems can la rjes su brtse bas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don rgyun ma 'chad par mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa' yin/ rnam pa ni nyan thos kyi tshul du gnas shing / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i spyod pas sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yin la/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhis yul gyi rjes su mthun par bstan pa skyong par mdzad pas cho me skyong ba'i srung ma chen po yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis gdul bya'i dbang gis sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas su bsod snyoms la byon pa'i tshe/ lha'i bu dang bu mo mang po rnam thar la dad nas 'phags pa'i rnam thar la bkod pas/ lha'i bu dang bu mo dag gis rang rang gi dbu rgyan dang ze brog phud de phul bas/'phags pas de byin gyis brlabs nas/ brog zhu gdul bya gang gi mgo la bzhag pa gang gis mthong ba de'i dgra chams pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad kyi tshig don rtogs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob pa la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i phrog zhu phyag na yod par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po lam phran bstan gyi phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa la yon tan du ma dang ldan te/ gang du mnyam (6ba)par bzhag pa'i sa phyogs der sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags kyi me dang / zhe sdang gi me dang / gti mug gi me dang / kun nas mnar sems pa'i me dang / mi shes pa'i me dang / sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i me dang / sems 'khrugs pa' me dang / log par lta ba'i me dang / log par sems pa la sogs pa'i me zhi ba dang / dbang po dul ba dang / rkyen ngan pa'i gdon nye bar zhi ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po ba ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len ni/ smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can mi khom pa'i gnas dang / ngan 'gro log par lhung ba'i gang zag thams cad la sde snod kyi glegs bam bstan pa dang / reg pa dang / mthong ba de dag gi sdug bsngal zhi ba ste/ 'on pa dang —542

gnas brtan chen po ban drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenalong ba dang lkugs pa dang dran pa nyams pa dang 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing / rang rang gi 'dod pa'i don dbang po tshang ba dang shes rab dang ngo tsha dang khrel yod dang ldan par byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / mnyam gzhag ni myur ba dang / yangs pa dang / zab pa dang /phra ba dang / gsal ba'i shes rab la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / lhung bzed ni nor bu rin po che la sogs pa'i 'byung gnas yin pa dang / bum pa bzang po'i yon tan te 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi 'byung gnas dang / 'dod yon lha mi'i bde ba thams cad kyi 'byung gnas 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po lam bstan gyi glegasabam de sus mthong reg (7na skong 'a ba'i gang zag de spobs pa rgya chen po thob pa dang / shes rab rgya chen po thob pa dang / ma rig pa'i mun pa 'joms pa dang / chos la brten pa'i las kyi sgrib pa ma lusapar dag pa dang / khom pa dang dal ba thob pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos dang mjal ba la sogasapa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa dang / chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya de sus mthong ba dang reg pa dang yid la byed pa de dag blo gros kyi snang ba chen po thob pa dang / dkon cog gsum gyi sgra thos pa dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa dang / log pa'i lta ba thams cad zil gyis gnon pa dang / sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde'i bum pa de rgyal po chen po bzhi'i sras rnams kyis dkon cog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab pa zhus te/ rin po che'i gter bum mang po phul bas des sems can thams cad kyi don du bum pa bzang po bsgrub pa dang / lha'i bdud rtsi'i chus las kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'khru ba la sogasapa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa dang / 'khar gsil gyi sgra grags pa gang gis thos pa'i nad kyi rigs su gtogos pa ma lus pa zhi ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi rigs thams cad las grol ba dang / nyon mongasapa'i zug rngu thams cad zhi ba dang / dkon cog gsum la dad pa thob par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po sbed byed kyi glegs bam de sus 543

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānemathong ba dang reg (7ba)pa dang 'chang ba de rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par du rang rgyud kyi nyen mongs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / chos kyi rgyal po thob par 'gyur pa dang / yang dag pa'i shes rab rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa ri rab kyi byang phyogs su gnod sbyin gyi gnas su byon te/ gnod sbyin pho dang / mo dang / bu dang / bu mo mang po thams cad thar pa la bkod de/ de dag gi gnod pa dang gdug rtsub zhi bar byed pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub chen po'i mchod rten zhig gnang ba de sus mthong ba dang reg pa dang yid la byed pa de'i don thams cad 'grub pa dang / bslab gsum gyis mdzes par 'gyur ba dang / bkra shis pa dang /dge ba dang / legs pa thams(cad 'byung pa dang / mi dge ba bcu spyad pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung gis gdul bya'i dbang gis spos ngad ldang la bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog tu byon pa'i tshe/ de'i lha dang lha ma yin pa gnod sbyin chen po dpag tu med pa thar pa la bkod pas/ lha rnams kyis bsil yab kyi rnga yab phul/ lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin gyis spos dri zhim po'i snod dang bcas pa phul te/ 'phags pa'i spos phor de gang gis mthong reg dri tshor ba thams cad la tshul khrims kyis phyogs bcur khyab pa 'byung ba dang / lha mi thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba dang / (8na〉skud 'phrog pa dang / nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa dang / rnga yab las phyogasabacu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang / sems can gang la reg pa dang gang gis mthong ba thams cad kyi drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa sa bon dang bcas pa zhi ba dang / lus sems kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las thar pa la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa'i phyag mnyam par gzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ gdul bya gang gis mthong ba dang reg pa dang —544

gnas brtan chen po ban drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)yid la byas pa de'i tshul khrims kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang 'phel ba dang / dpal chen po dpag tu med pa thob pa dang / grags pa snyan pa phyogs bcur grags pa dang / ting nge 'dzin brgya stong grangs med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas kyi phyag g.yas pa zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub de gang la bstad pa de'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pa zhi ba dang / 'dre dang srin po ma rungs pa dang / klu gdug pa can dang / gnod sbyin gtum bo dang gzhan yang lha ma srin gtum po thams cad kyi gdug pa zhi ba dang / dul ba dang / bka' bzhin nyan pa la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa dang / rnga yab kyis gdul bya gang la g.yabs pa'i bsil ba phog pa la phyags pas sgo gsum gyi (8ba〉steg pa dag par 'gyur ba dang / nyon mongasapa thams cad dang gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i log par rtog pa dang / chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i log par rtog pa zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po dus ldan gyis 'dod khams lha'i yul du byon pa'i tshe lha'i bu dang bu mo la sogs pa thams cad thar pa la bkod pas/rin po che'i rna rgyan la sogs pa'i rgyan mang po phul te/ des byin gyis brlabs pas/ rna kor de gang la reg pa dang mthong ba'i gang zag de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gyi spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa la gnas pa dang phyir mi ldog pa thams cad 'du bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang skal pa chen po dang ldan pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang blo gros dang dad pa shes rab dang ldan pa'i 'khor mang po 'du bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po gser be'u sa klu'i yul du bsod snyoms la byon te/ klu dpag tu med pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed du bcug pas/klu rnams kyis rin po che'i zhags pa ci dgos pa 'byung ba phul/ de la 'phags pas byin kyis brlabasapas/ gdul bya gang la reg pa dang mthong ba thams cad kyis dran pa mi brjed pa thob pa dang / sangs—545

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsungs (9na)pa'i chos thams cad thos pa dang /gzungs kyi sgo mang po 'thob pa dang / spobs pa rgya chen po 'thob pa dang / shes rab rgya chen po 'thob pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu'i phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub dang / g.yon rnga yab bsdams pa'i g.yab(pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis gdul bya gang la bstad pa de la/ bdag mthong ba dang reg pa dang thos pa dang de tshor ba dang yid la byed pa dang bsnyen bkur rim gro byed pa dang / ma dad pas phyir rgol pa la sogs pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por nges par byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa dang / dri za'i yul du bsod snyoms la byon pa'i tshe/ dri za pho mo bu dang bu mo la sogs pa du ma thar pa la bkod pas/sman dri zhim po du mas bsgos pa'i rnga yab mang pos mchod cing phul ba de 'phags pas byin gyis brlabs te/ gdul bya gang gis mthong ba dang reg pa dang de tshor bas ye shes thams cad dang ldan pa dang / dbang phyug thams cad kyis phyug pa dang / lus mtshan bzang po dang dpe byad phun sum tshogasapas brgyan pa 'thob pa dang / lus la 'od dang 'od zer mtha' yas pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'od kyis gang la reg pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges pa 'thob pa la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po bzang po'i phyag g.yasachos 'chad kyi phyag rgya'i yon tan ni/ gdul bya gang gis(9bsgo thong ba dang / reg pa de theg pa che chung thams cad kyi tshig dang don ma lus pa rgyud la skye ste rtogs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi ci bsams pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / thabs snying rje chen po dang shes rab stong pa nyid zab mo'i don khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi yon to ni/ ting nge 'dzin du ma la gdul bya mang po 'khod cing mngon shes dang rdzu rol du ma dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis lam log pa thams cad las bzlog par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas der 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / nyon mongs pa'i dgra choms pa dang / pha rol gyi rgol ba 546

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)thams cad chos dang mthun par tshar gcod cing gdul byar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po ba ra dha dza gser can gyi phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ gdul bya gang gi mdun du phyag rgya de bcas pa'i gdul bya de ngan 'gro lasathar te rab tu dga' ba dang / bde ba rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / rig pa'i ye shes rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / nam mkha' rnam par dag pa ltar dkar po'i yon tan thams cad rgyud la rgyas par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan chen po ba kū la'i ne'u le'i yon tan ni/ gdul bya gang gis mthong ba dang reg pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga phun sum tshogasapa 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / byams pa dang snying rje chen po rgyas par 'gyur pa la (10na〉(tshogs pa'i yon to du ma dang ldan par gsungs so/ /gnas brtan sto tā la la yang yon to du ma yod par bshad de/ dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs bzung nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyod pa'i dus yin par bshad gsungs/gsum pa ni/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ kha che paṇa chen la bla ma khro phu bas zhug pa ni ba ched pas/ thub pas bka' bsgo bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /mya ngan mi 'da' mngon sum yul kun tu/ /lha mi'i bsod nams dpal zhing 'tsho gzhes pa/ /rgyal tshab dgra bcom bcu drug zhabs la 'dud/ /te se'i gangs la dgra bcom yan lag 'byung / /drang srod ri ngogs shel na ma pham pa/ /lo ma bdun ris btsun pa nags na gnas/ /zangs gling dbus na rgyal sras dus ldan bzhugs/ /sing ga la ni rdo rje mo yi bu/chu bo ya mu na gling bzang po bzhugs/ kha che'i yul na thub pa gser nges /nub gling ba ra dha dza gser can bzhugs/ /sgra mi snyan na dpal chen ba kul/ pri yang kun gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin / /bya rgod spungs par dgra bcom lam phran bstan/ shar gling ba ra dha dza bsod snyoms len/ /sum cu gsum na 'phags pa lam bstan bzhugs/ /ngos yangs ri la sdom brtson klu yi sde/ /ri rgyal bhi hu la na sbed byed bzhugs/ /gangs ri'i rgyal por mi phyed pa bzhugs te/ /'phags chen gnas brtan rgyal po brgya—547

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānedrug po/ /re re bzhin yang dgra bcom (10ba'i mas bskor/ /nyan thos tshul 'dzin rgyal sras 'phrin las skyong / /chos srung 'gro don mdzad la legs skyob mdzod/ /ces pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyas 'dasakyang 'di rnams bzhugs pas rgyal tshab chen po bcu drug ces bya ba bdag gzhan gyi bkra shis dang dge legs thams cad 'byung bas dpal chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ dgra bcom pa'i tshogs chen po skyong bas gnas brtan chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ tshul khrims kyi phung po chen por bzhugs pas sdom brtson chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor skyong bas btsun pa chen po bcu drug tu mas gsol/ bslab pa rin po che gsum dang chos spyod bcu rgyas par skyong bas dge spyong chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ sgrib pa gnyis spangs shing yon tan khyad par 'phags pas 'phags pa chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa ste ngo bo sangs rgyas yin pas thub pa chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ bdud bye ba brgya yis kyang blta ba la sogs pa mi phyed pas mi phyed pa bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ dgra bcom pa chen po 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po nyan thos kyi cha lugs su bzhugs pas nyan thos chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ dkon cog gsum po thams cad kyi ngo bo yon tan gyi phung po mtha' yas par bzhugs shing gdul bya'i rgyud la yon tan 'phel bar mdzad pas dpal ldan chen po bcu drug mtshan gsol/ sdig pa dang nyon mongs pa las rgyal bar (11nasgo dzad de sangs rgyas nyid du bzhugs shing phas kyi rgol ba ngan pas mi bskyod pas rgyal po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ sku nyan thos kyi cha lugs su bzhugs nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa skyong bas byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang skyong ba dang bsrung bar mdzad pas chos skyong chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rkyen ga dang nad gdon sdig sgrib dang 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pas skyabs gnas chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ dus gsum gyi shes bya thams cad dang gang zag gi bsam pa thams cad mkhyen pas thams —548—

gnas brtan chen po bas drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenacad mkhyen pa bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ 'dod pa chung ba dang chog shes pa dang khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i mchog tu gyur cing lha mo'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du bzhugs pas bsod snyoms pa chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ thub pas bka' bsgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan chen po 'dzin pas sprul pa'i sku chen po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ dkon cog gsum gyi yon tan gyi tshogs chen po dang ldan pas rin po che'i phung po bcu drug tu mtshan gsol/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung nas sems can bslab pa gsum la 'god cing ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bas bstan pa'i sgron me bcu drug tu mtshan gsol te/ 'di rnams la gsol 'debs gdams ngag gi gnad gsum (11ba〉nga tshang zhing / kha che paṇa chen nyid kyang dge sbyong chen po 'di rnams kyi gcig yin par the tshom med pas yid ches pa'i gnas yin no/ /gsum pa gsol ba gdab tshul la go rim/ bsam pa'i khyad par/ sku gzugs/ rnam grangs bstan pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs kyis rgya che la yun ring bar mchod par 'dod pa dang / lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa brtan par bya ba dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rmi lam du lung bstan pa thob par 'dod pas/ 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung gis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad theg pa chen po'i gang zag dang chos thams cad la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus dang / mi zhum pa'i snying stobs dang / rjes su 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang ldan par 'dod pa dang / yul phyogs gang du bdag nyid 'dug kyang yul phyogs de'i ri'i lha dang / sa'i lha dang / chu'i lha dang / me'i lha dang / rlung gi lha dang /shing gi lha dang / nags kyi lha dang / tshal gyi lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po gdug pa can dang / yi dwags la sogs pa nag po gdug pa can thams cad kyang rang bzhin kyis dul ba zhi bar 'dod pa dang / rmi lam ༅ pa dang / mtshan ma ga pa dang / ltas(12na tshe na pa dang / lce 'bab pa —549

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)dang / byur 'bag pa dang / pra ngan pa dang / bram ze'i dmod pa byung ba dang / sngags kyi ma' spyod la sogs pa bzlog par 'dod pa dang / gza' dang skar ma ngan pa dang / skag dang ma mo'i byad dang / gshin rje'i zhabrul 'khor dang / lha ma srin sdebargyad kyi gdug rtsub dang / gdon chen po brgyad la sogs pa nag po'i phyogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis zhi ste/ yul phyogs bkra shis pa dang / byin chags pa dang /lo rtag rgyas pa dang / gtam snyan yang thob par 'dod pas/ 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ma pham pas thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /yul khyad par can la sdig bsags pa dang / nyen mongs pa'i kun slong drag pos sdig bsags pa dang / yun bskal pa mang por sdig bsags pa dang /dngos po lci ba dkon cog gsum dang dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bags pa dang / so sor thar pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gsum nyams pa bshags te sdom par 'dod pas/ 'phags pa gnasabartan chen po nags na gnas kyis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la brtse ba chen po dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / phyogs ba chu'i sangs rgyas thamasacad kyi zhing sbyong bar 'dod pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos thams cad gzung bar 'dod pa dang / sems can mtha' yas pa thams cad byang chub sems(12ba)dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'god par 'dod pa dang / bdag la sangasargyas thams cad kyis thugs kyis dgongs par 'dod pa dang / rtag tu mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi yid du 'ong bas thugs kyis 'dzin par 'dod pa dang / byang chub semasadapa' thams cad dang lhan cig tu 'grogs par 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po dus ldan gyis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi rten dang dpung gnyen dang skyabs bya bar 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad rtag tu sangs rgyas dang 'grogs pa thob par 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis rtag tu sdig pa spong ba dang / chos dge ba bcu spyod pa dang /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i bsam pa dang smon pa 'phel bar 'dod —550

gan brtan chen po bas drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenapa dang / dgra dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad zhi bar 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bus thog drangs te gsol ba gdab bar bya'o/ /'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / tshul bzang zhing gnyen pa'i 'khor thob par 'dod pa dang / bdag dang gzhan gyi shes rab 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / chos thams cad kyi spyi dang bye brag la ma rmo mes pa shes pa dang / mnyam par bzhag pa la sgrib pa med pa dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / rgyun du zhugs pa dang / phyir 'ong ba dang /phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang / so so skye bo'i dge 'dun thams cad la gus pa thob par 'dod (13na)pa dang / lha dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i gnas su bdag 'gyur bar 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bzang pos thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /bdag nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang mi 'bral ba dang / 'khor rnam bzhi bdag la gus pas nyan pa dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang 'byung po dang sa bla ba'i gnod sbyin la sogs pa thams cad bdag la gus pas bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub par 'dod pa dang / rgyal po dang blon po chen po dang rgyal po'i sras po dang btsun mo dang 'bangs dang khye'u dang bu mo dang skyes pa dang bud med dang bram ze'i rigs sngags 'chang dang drang srong smon lam grub pa la sogs pa thams cad bdag la gus pas 'grogs pa dang / gtam bya ba dang / bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub par 'dod ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / nad med pa dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang 'byung po dkar po la dga' ba gzi brjid che ba rnams kyis bdag gi lus kyi gzi brjid bskyed pa dang / sems kyi mthu bskyed par 'dod pa dang / gzhan yang gang zag thams cad kyi rgyud 'jam pa dang / zhi ba dang / dul ba dang dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / shes rab rgyas par 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po gser be'u sa thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /grags pa dang snyan pa thob par 'dod pa dang /bud med skye ba phyi ma la skyes pa'i lus thob par 'dod pa dang / khye'u dang bu mo yid du 'ong ba thob par 'dod pa dang / grogs gnyen bshes la (13ba〉sogs pa yid du 'ong ba dang 'grogs par 'dod pa —551—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (1//dang / rgyal po dang blon po dang rgyal po'i bu dang btsun mo dam pa la sogs pa dang dga' bas 'grogs la gtam bya bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal mthong ba 'dod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'gro ba mdzad pa blta bar 'dod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa rlabs po che mdzad pa blta bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sras thu bor bdag skye bar 'dod pa dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi phan yon 'thob par 'dod pa dang / grogs po dam pa byang chub sems dpa' dang 'grogs shing mi 'bral bar 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ra bhā dza gser can gyis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /ngan song gsum dang mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad las thar par 'dod pa dang / sems can bkres pa dang sgom pa dang gcer bu dang 'on pa dang long ba dang dbang chung ba dang lkugs pa dang dig pa dang rmongs pa dang glen pa las thar par 'dod pa dang / lha dbul po dang mi dbul bo las thar par 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba kū las thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab par 'jig rten 'dir bzhugs te chos ston par 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyen mongs pa dug gsum la sogs pa thams cad zhi bar 'dod pa dang/ mi khom pa'i gnas la sogs(14na〉pa thams cad du dkon cog gsum gyi sgra grags pas de dag gi sdug bsngal zhi bar 'dod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi 'khor 'dus par 'dod pa dang / rang dang gzhan gyi theg pa chen po'i chos la the tshom dang som nyi dang yid gnyis med par sems rtse gcig tu mos shing spyod par 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan zin gyis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa brgya stong phrag du ma la mnyam par bzhag par 'dod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu thob par 'dod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / spyan lnga dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang/ mi 'jigs pa thob par 'dod pa dang / skye ba'i sdug bsngal —552

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 'dagyis nyam nga ba dang / srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam nga ba dang / sgo gsum sdig pa spyod pas nyam nga ba dang / drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang nyi shu nye ba'i nyen mongs pas nyam nga ba dang / byis pa blun po'i spyod pa mi shes pas nyam nga ba dang / sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du song bas nyam nga ba dang / dal ba don med pa'i spyod pas dus 'da' ba'i nyam nga ba dang / dus ngan pas 'jigs shing bsod nams log par bsngos pa'i nyam nga ba ste nyam nga ba brgyad dang bral bar 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po lam phran bstan gyis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sems can nad kyis nyen pa dang / sdug bsngal gyis nyen (14ba)pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pas nyen pa dang / chom rkum gyis nyen pa dang / bsdigs pa dang gsod pas nyen pa dang / lus sems stobs dang nyam chung bas nyen pa dang /'tshe ba dang gnas med pas nyen pa dang / lce 'bar pas 'jigs te nyen pa dang / lha'i gdon la sogasapa gdon drag pos mnar te nyen pa dang / phongs pa sna tshogs kyis nyen pa ste nyen pa bcu las thar bar 'dod pas/ gnas brtan chen po ba ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len gyis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du gzhen nu la rab tu byung bar 'dod pa dang / rab tu byung ba'i bar chad thams cad dang bral bar 'dod pa dang / lha dang mi thams cad kyisarab tu byung ba'i grogs byed par 'dod pa dang / nges par 'byung ba'i sems gtan du thob pa dang /rab tu 'byung ba la brtson pa dang / gus par 'dod pa/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod pas sde snod gzung bar 'dod pa dang / rtag tu tshangs par skyod pa lhur len pa gtsang ma'i 'khor thob par 'dod pa dang /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i mdo sdebacu gnyis yod pa dang / nyan pa dang / bri ba dang / 'chang ba dang / kun chub par bya ba 'dod pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / ma god pa dang / ma sbags pa dang / skyon med pa dang / ma ral ba dang / mkhas pas bsngags pa'i tshul khrims la gnas par 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po lam bstan gyis thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sdom pa gsum yongs su dag par 'dod pa dang / theg pa chen (15na)po'i sems yongs su sbyong bar 'dod pa —553

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhedang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya chen po'i rol pas sgos pa med pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad theg pa chen po'i chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / thos pa'i don la sems pa las su rung bar 'dod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba'i dge slong 'ba' zhig dang 'grogs par 'dod pa dang / skye ba thams cad du mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par me rtag pad+ma'i kha rdzus te skye bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag par skye bar 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po klu'i sdes thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang myur du mjal bar 'dod pa dang / mchod pas mnyes par 'dod pa dang /chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid du rtogs par 'dod pa dang / chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / rang bzhin med pa nyid dang / mas nyid med pa nyid dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa nyid rtogs par 'dod pa dang sems can mya ngan dang / mu ge dang /mtshon gyi bskal pa dang / nad kyi bskal pa dang / gcan gzan gtum po dang / pha rol gyi dmag tsho gos dang / sbrul dang / me dang / chu dang / rims dang bsko dang / klu gdug pa dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po sbed byed kyis thog drangs nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /mnyam gzhag bsgom (15ba)pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / dran pa nye bar bzhag pa la sogs pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad rang gi rgyud la skye ba dang brtan pa dang 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / g.yin yang dkon cog gsum dang rtag tu mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dang / rang gi 'khor du chos nyan pa dang /'chad pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun chos byed pa 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / sems can lta na sdug pa dang gzugs bzang ba dang gcig la gcig yid du 'ong ba dang / bde ba dang / 'byor pa 'phel bar 'dod pa dang / yul phyogs kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can zhi ba la sogs par 'dod pas 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pas thog drangs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /zhes byams pa lung bstan —554

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bsam sbyor ji ltar bya ba ni/ 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rnams la rang gzhan gyi sdig pa sbyong ba'i gsol ba gdab par 'dod na/ gnas brtan chen po dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa'i rnam par byon te/ phyag na rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba bsnams nasabadag la sogs pa la khrus gsol bar bsams la/ gsol 'debs kyi yi ge 'don zhing / mthar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rgyal ba gang dag yon tan gyi klu dpag tu med par gyur pa nyon mongs pa'i chu bo'i 'dam rdzab las yang dag par brgal pa/ stong pa ldan zhing tshul khrims rnam pa dag /bzod pa chen po'i mchog (16na khong ldan pa dang / brtson 'grus sbyangs shing snying po g.yo ba mi mnga' ba'i bsam gtan chen po dang ldan pa dang / mkhyen rab rno ba thogs pa med pa dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten thams cad la thugs brtse ba/ don la mngon par brtson pa/ byams pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid can de rnams la bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba de dag gis bdag sdig pa thams cad las bdag rnam pa thams cad du skyab tu gsol/ sdug bsngal du mas gdungs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang rab tu brtson pas drang du gsol/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag ngan 'gro las drang zhing byang chub chen po la myur du bzhag tu gsol/ bdag sras gcig dang 'dra bar thugs brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ bdag slob ma sdug pa dang 'dra bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/thugs rje chen po'i chab kyis bdag bkru bar gso le/ ngo tsha mkhyen pa'i na bza' dag la dag gtu gsol/byang chub yan lag gi me tog rnams kyis bdag la gtor du gsol/ rgyal ba thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ seng ge'i sgra chen pos bdag la lung bstan du gsol/ bdag rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i drung du gzhen du rab tu byung ba dang / lkog ma yin pa'i rab tu byung ba dang / yang dag pa'i rab tu byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rab tu byung bas rab tu byung bar gyur cig /de yang —555

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)'jig rten las khyad par du 'phags pa/ skyon ma 'dres pa/ rnyog pa med pa/ lha dang mi mngon par dga' ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems(16ba'i pa' thams cad kyis bsngags pa/ sems can la sman pa'i slad du bdag rab tu 'byung bar gyur cig /bdag gi nyen mongs las rnams kyi/ /dri ma de bzhin gshegs pas gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la ni/ /snying rje'i chu yis bkru bar gsol/ zhesagasol ba gdab ste/ mdo na bzhugs so gsung / 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rnams la 'jig rten du chos kyi bshad nyan dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar gsol ba gdab par 'dod na/'phags pa nyan thos dgra bcom pa chen po rnams dang / gnas brtan chen po rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkha'am rang gi gnas su byon nas/ phyag na sde snod kyi glegs bam bsnams shing chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgyas bzhugasapa rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i sgra sgrog par bsams la/ gsol 'debs kyi yi ge 'don zhing / mthar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'gro ba'i mun sel bstan pa'i sgron ma 'dzin/ khyod kyis bdud rtsi'i grong khyer sgo dbyer gsol/ /chos kyi rnga chen dam pa rdung du gsol/ /chos kyi dung gi mchog kyang 'bud du gsol/ /chos kyi sgron ma mchog kyang spar du gsol/ /chos kyi char pa dam pa dbab tu gsol/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan dam pa bsgreng du gsol/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor du gsol/ /nyon mongs dgra tshogs rnams las rgyal bar mdzod/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sems can bsgral du gsol/ /ngan song gsum gyi lam rnams dgag tu gsol/ /srog chags na mongs mes(17na tshe dungs zhi mdzad pa/ /ye shesaral gris nyon mongs rgya dral gsol/ /chos kyi bdud rtsis sems can tshom mdzad gsol/ /byang chub yon tan rgya mtsho sgos mdzad gsol/ /sems can sdug bsngal mtsho las thar mdzad gsol/ bde ba kun gyi rgya mtsho thob mdzad gsol/ /sngon chad sus kyang ma bskor ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bo skor dug sol/ /zhes dge 'dun thams cad 'dun pa mthun pas/ snying gi khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab na chos byed pa dang chos byed kyi bshad nyan 'phel lo gsung / dge slong tshul khrims rnam par dag mang po —556

gnas brtan chen po bas drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 'dashes sa nas gtso 'debs kyi yi ge gsung bsgrag cing / skabs su tshig 'di rnams kyis gsol ba btab na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar 'gyur la tshe phyi ma la rang cag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang theg pa chen po'i chos la thos bsam sgom ngoms pa med par byed pa yin no zhes bla ma gsung ngo / gnas brtan chen po rnams la rang gi rgyud la bslab pa rin po che'i chos skye bar gsol ba gdab par 'dod na/ /gnas brtan chen po rnams dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa'i rnam par rang gi mdun na skyil krung dang mnyam gzhag tu bzhugs te bdag byin gyis rlob par bsams la/ gsol 'debs kyi yi ge 'don zhing / mthar gsol ba gdab pa ni/sangs rgyas sprul pa'i dgra bcom pa/ /'phags pa gnas brtan dge sbyong che/ /dkon cig rin cen gsum gyi dngos/ /nyan thos chen po sprul pa'i sku/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams(17brkong / /'phags pa'i dge slong dgra bcom pa/ khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya rnams/ /dgra bcom zag zad nyen mongs med/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas/ /sems shes shes rab rnam par grol/ khong shes rta dang glang chen bzhin/ khur bor rang don rab tu thob/ /srid par kun sbyor yongs zad pas/ /sems kyi dbang rnams mchog thob pa/ /mngon shes rdzu phral yon tan dang / /yon to rgya mtsho'i pha rol byon/ /'phagasapa gnas brtan khyed rnams ni/ /sems can rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /ma dul ba ni dul bar mdzad/ /ma dag dag par mdzad pa po/ /mgon skyabs med la mgon skyabs mdzad/ /ma grol grol bar mdzad pa po/ /ma zhi ba rnams zhi bar mdzad/ /sman chen sman pa'i rgyal po ltar/ /sems can rnams kyi gsos gyur pa/ /rig dang zhabs su ldan pa yi/ /sbyin gnas dul zhing dge 'dun che/ /zhugs pa rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /'bras la gnas pa bzhi rnams la/ /bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /byin rlabs chen po mdzad du gsol/ /dad ldan bsod nams gang 'dod pa/ /rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams ni/ rtag tu byed pa rnams kyi nyid / /gang la phul na 'bras che ba/ /de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag rgyud zhi dang dul ba yi/ /thugs rje thugs brtser mdzad par gsol/ /zhes rang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes —557—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)gnyen rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / 'phags pa dgra bcom ba rnams la gsol ba btab (18na)pas/ de rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa gcig pas byin gyis brlab par bsams na/ rang gi blo sna bzang po gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes gsung ngo / /nor 'dod na thams cad kyi phyag na de'i le bsnams par bsam/ nyams myong 'phel bar 'dod na thams cad mnyam gzhag tu bsam/ bkra shis par 'dod na thams cad gzi brjid dang ldan pa phyag na zasabazang pos bkang pa'i lhung bzed bsnams par bsam par bya'o/ /gsum pa sku gzugs ji ltar bya ba ni/ dge 'dun gyi longs spyod 'phel bar 'dod na/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la 'khor gnasabartan chen po bcu drug /dharma tā la dang bcas pas bskor ba'i sku gzugs legs par bzhengs la/rab gnas tshad dang ldan par byas te dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan bzhugs pa'i rtsig ngos la ngos khung legs par byas la/ der bzhugs pa la mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas par byas te/ sgo bcad nas zhal zhal legs par byas la/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa'i dus su gnas brtan gyi sku skal sder bzang dus rgyun du phul bas/ dge 'dun gyi longs spyod 'phel zhing bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa rnam grangs bsten pa ni/ gtor ma mchod pa la brten pa sogs mang na'ang rgyas par ma spros so/ /bzhi pa cho ga dngos la/ yo byad bshams pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gnas yid du 'ong ba ga bdar dang / chag chag legs par gdab/ phan gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ bla bre/ (18ba lhan khebs sogs sa rgyan gnam rgyan gyis mtshon pa bkod pas mdzes par bya/ sman bla'i mdo chog tu pho brang la bris 'bur gyis sku 'god par bshad na'ang /'dir phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu bshad pas rtsig pa lta bur 'gram pa'am stegs kyi khar bzhugs pas chog /gnas bcu'i rjes gnang sngags lugs su gtogs pas dkyil 'khor la yang thig tshon gyi cho ga nges par dgos pa rigs gsum spyi sogs dkyil chog gzhan nas kha 'geng la —558

gan brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhena'adir mdo dang 'brel ba'i gzhal yas khang 'bri bar byin rlabs kyi cho ga mi dgos/'on kyang tsan+dan/spos dkar dri zhim pa'i dkar gsum lde gus byug pa dbyibs shin tu dngas par 'gyur ba'i steng du rin po che pad+ma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa la brten pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i phyi thig dang nang du lte ba pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug gis bskor ba'i lte ba dang 'dab ma sgo bzhi shar sgo'i thad kyi lha snam la tshim bu re 'god pa ni mgron spyan 'dren pa'i gdan las brten bskyed pa min pas gzhi rten gyi dkyil 'khor zer/mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/sgor mchod kyi tshul du maṇ+ḍal zlum po bcu drug la ri rab gling bzhi sogs rgyas pa tshom bu so bdun ma bsdus par tshom bu bdun ma rdul mtshon nam ras bris gang rung de ma 'grub na 'bru'i tshom bu 'god/maṇ+ḍal ma 'grub na mdun du rgyas pa sgo r+sāg bsham/mar yon sngon du 'gro ba'i ma rdzo pa rnam lnga spro na nyer gnyis/'bring du byed na thub dbang /gnas brtan bcu drug/dge 19na〉snyen dharma dang rgyal chen bzhi bcasapar tshar gsum/de yang ma 'grub na spyir tshar gcig/rgyal chen bzhi la gtsang gtor so so'am bsdun gcig/phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag la'ang bsham gzhan yang rgyal srid sna bdun/nye ba'i rin cen sna bdun/bkra sa rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad/'dod yon lnga/gdugs/rgyal mtshan/ba dan/rnga yab/bsil yab/rnga dung sil snyan/khrus chas/sku phyis/chos gos rnam gsum lhung bzed/bsil byed/sku chings/mchil lham sogs rdzas dang yo byad ma tshang ba med pa bkod/bye brag mchod pa'i khyad par ni dngos gzhi 'dra ba la snga dro'i dus zhal zas la lha bsos rgyan ldan/'bras chan/'bur ba/dkar gsum gyi bza' ba/bca' ba/myang ba/lag pa/mur ba/btung ba la sogs pa rgyas par bcu bdun nam/bsdun gnyis slo gcig/phyi dro dkar gsum/mngar gsum/shing tog sogasalongs spyad du rung ba'i zhal zas/gas ba la snga phyi'i khyad par med pas 'o ma/mngar gsum gyi khu ba/ja dang dri bzang po'i rigs kyi mchod yon bya'o//gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa la sa gzhi dang /mchod pa gnyis las dang po ni/lus bkru ba dang /sa gtsang ma gyon pa phyi khrus/sha chang sgog btsong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)du ba ngan pa rngub pa sogs spangs nas dkar gsum la brten pa nang gi khrus/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi gnyen po bsten pa gsang ba'i khrus/ grogs tshangs par mtshudas pa'i dge slong dang / dge tshul/ dge bsnyen gtsang (19bsgo bzhugs na legs/ g.yin yang yon bdag pho mo sogs yin na skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen sdom pa lta bu dang / theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong ngam so thar gyi yan lag brgyad pa len du gzhug /dge tshul slong rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blangs na legs/ bstan pa rgyas pa/ yul khams bde ba/ nad gdon zhi ba/ tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba sogs kyis mtshon bya ba gang yin pa de nyid der 'khod thams cad bsam pa phyogs gcig par bya dgos tshul kun gyis go ba gnas brtan rgan po zhig gis brda sprad/ dkon cog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang / tsho gos gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub bas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa dang / 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad la mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'di dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon to lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba/ yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsas sbrul gyi snying po dri bsung ngad ldan (20na)pa'i lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyi bcal bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ gser dang /dngul dang / mu tig gi phye ma gram bur brdal ba/ ut+pal dang / ku mud dang / pad+ma 'gying zhing ldem pasakhebs par gyur cing / chu bya sna tsho gos skad snyan par sgrog pa dang / dga' zhing 'phyo la ldang bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang rdzing dang lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po —560

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhanache'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa/ lha'i nor bu dang / mu tig gi rgyan 'phreng dang / rin po che dpyangasapas/ me rta ge gi mgo (1gabs dang / 'bras bu mdzeb(par chags pas g.yur za zhid ldem pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du sgrengs pas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi la/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa/ rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khamasagasum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha'i lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brtan pa/ sems (20bcan thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas dran pa dang / blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhen pa yin pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa nyid dang /smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa rin po che pad+ma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma'i gdan rin po che seng ge'i khri'i stan la ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de ba chin gshegs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po dang / dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i bzhugs gnas 'phags pa so so'i smon lam khyad par can dang mnga' thang dang 'tsham par grub pa mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod do/ 56/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)gnyis pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ phyi nang kun tu yang cho ris dang 'tsham par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa/ kha dog dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg pa dang ldan pa yid du 'ong ba/ gya nom pa'i bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / myang ba dang / ldag pa dang / rngub pa dang / gzhib pa la sogs pa zhal zasabasham par bya ba sna tsho gos pa khyad par can dag dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang / rol mo la sogasaphul du phyin pa sna tsho gis pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang / bzang (21na)po spyod pa'i smon lam lasabyung ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'phags pa thams cad kyang gdan 'dzom nas de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa cho ga dngos gzhi la/ spyan drang ba/ bzhugs su gsol ba/ tshogs bsag pa/ gsol ba gdab pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngar bzhin 'dun pa rtse gcig pas spos sna rol mo dang bcas pas 'di skad du/ de ltar bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gdul bya'i dbang gis 'dzam bu gling 'dir mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing bzhugs pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can las glengs te/ bdag cag mnga' ris kyi gdul bya rnams phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i nang du gtogs te bka' drin thob pa'i 'phro mchis pa tsam la brten te/ che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / zhes dang / sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge shākya'i rgyal po 'jig rten na bzhugs shing yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i tshe 'phags pa gang dag yang dag pa'i shes rab kyi mes nyon mongs pa shing dang 'dra ba bsregs te/ (21ba/bams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad —362

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 'dalegs par bcom pa de dag las gang la la zhig la 'di lta bus/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dam pa'i chos skyong zhing lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bka' bsgos te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten na mngon sum du bzhugs shing 'phags pa'i tshig bden pas nges par zhal gyis bzhes pa thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ bri ya byu'i gling na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan zin dang / bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'phags pa gnasabartan chen po lam phran bstan dang / shar gyi lus 'phags gling na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ra dh+wa dza bsod sgoms len dang / lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po lam bstan dang / ri'i rgyal po'i ngos yangs pa na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde dang / ri'i rgyal po bhi hu la na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po sped byed dang / gangs ri'i rgyal po la 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa dang / gangs ri chen po te se la 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po (22na)yan lag 'byung dang / drang srong ri'i ngogs shel nags na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa dang / ri nags kyi ngogs lo ma bdun pa zhes bya ba'i ri phug na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas dang / zangs gling na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po dus ldan dang / chu bo ya mu na'i gling na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bzang po dang / siṅga la yi gling na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo yi bu dang / kha che'i yul na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po gser be'u dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ra dh+wa dza dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba kū la ste/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa'i tshogs brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor —563

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)ba dang / 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma tā la dang / chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po bzhi po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/chos zab mo la gnas par mkhas pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i chos kyi nges par 'byung ba/ spyod lam chen po mdzes pa/ phun sum tsho gos pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' la shin tu zhugs pa/ 'phags pa yul rnams tha dad pa dag na bzhugs pa'i dgra bcom pa thams cad dang / rgyun du bzhugs pa dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba la sogs pa 'phags pa'i tsho gis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag thugs su chud pa/ sems dri ma med par dwangs shing tshul khrims 'dren ma ma yin pa/ dge ba la rnam par rtog pa'i zla ba shar ba'i stobs (22ba)kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi mtsho 'jing rnam par g.yo ba'i rnyog pa dang bral ba dag la/ mtha' gnyis spangs pa byang chub yan lag skyon med pa'i gzugs mang po gsal bar mthong nas bris pa/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi ri bos phyogs brten pa/ 'bras bu'i bye brag thogs pa med pa thob pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dang yang dag pa'i spong ba dang / pahrūl gyi rkang pa'i shing ljon pas mdzes par byas pa/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i chu bsil po dang ldan pa/ sgrib pa'i ro mi gnas pa/ mngon par shes pa dri ma med pa'i pad+ma rgyas pas mdzes par byas pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan goms pas dag pa'i mu tig gi nya phyis kyi khog lus dang ldan pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i chos nyid gting mi dpogs shing zab pa/ rgyun ma 'chad par klog pa dang/ kha rtan byed pa'i sgra rgya cher 'byung ba/ 'phags pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi rgya mtsho chen po la bdag gsol ba ni/ srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'gro ba gcig nas gcig tu zo chun gyi khyud mo bzhin bdag gi sems ni skad cig kyang mi sdod par 'gro bas dub pa/ bdag la bsod nams kyi stegs bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i rkang 'thung gi grib bsil ye shes kyi rdzi ngad bzang po ldang ba dga' tshal te/ de dag gi don dang /che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po skyob pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom —564

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhedapa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / zhes dang / sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos thos pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i rigs la sogs pa lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / rig sngags 'chang dang / grub pa dang / mi'am ci dang / nam mkha' lding la sogs pa 'byung po chen po rnams kyang dam pa'i chos gnas par bya ba dang / sbyin bdag chen po 'di'i yang grogs bgyi ba'i slad du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na zhes sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ ji skad du/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das la sogs dge slong gi dge 'dun 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rnams ni/ bdag cag gi yon gnas su dad de/ de yang chos thams cad thugs su chud pas rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis gsal bar reg nas shes rab kyi pad+ma rgyas pa/ pad+ma'i 'byung gnas rnams la snang mdzad kyi 'od kyi 'phreng ba bye brag med par khyab pa'i ting 'dzin gyis khyab pa gang lags/ gtsug tor gyi nang nas kun tu 'byung ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis dus mtha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas ma lus pa bkra bar byas shing /gnod sbyin gyi bdag po'i gtsug tor gyi nor bu chen pos zhabs kyi sen mo la 'dres par byas nas chos ston pa/ zhi bar gzhol ba'i lam du 'dren pa/ 'jig rten 'dren pa/ mnyes gshin pa/ gnyen gcig pu dag ni me mar gyis 'phreng ba tshar du bkod pa'am/ gser gyi mchod sdong bsgrigs pa ltar gsal ba/ bdag gi sems shel gyi rang bzhin la ngo mtshar ba shar ba ji lta ba de ltar rin po che'i pho brang zad mi shes pa'i gter dang ldan pa'i gnas su rnam par brgyan pa'i khri rnams la 'khod par 'tshal te/ rin cen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri/ zhes sogs kyis gdan phul/ mchod yon dang / (23ba)zhabs bsil la sogs pa dag kyang byas kha te/ khrus kyi khang pa na tu dri zhin pa/ /zhes sogs khrus gso slo/rgyas par byed/ dri med sku la sgrib gsal mi mnga' yang / /zhes sogs kyis chos gos dbul lo/ /—565
