gsum pa tsho gos gsag pa la'ang sngar bzhin yan lag bdun pa bya ba las/dang po phyag 'tshal ba la dang por ston pa'i phyag ni/bcom ldan 'das de bzhi gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/bla na med pa/lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo//mkho med shākya'i gtso bo bcom ldan 'das//nyi ma gtso nu 'dra ba'i sku mnga' ṣ+ka //mtshungs med smon lam dag pa yid mkha' yi//rnam par snang mdzad mchog la phyag 'tshal lo//gang zhig 'byung ba kun la thugs brtse bas//sngon ho ma thos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor//skyob pa lha dang mi rnams 'dul mdzad pa/khrad pa mthar phyin de la phyag la'i lo//gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe//tsho 'di la sgom pa bdun bor te//nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mgo ces gsungs//de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba//ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra//'jig rten gsum ni bkra dang lhang nge ba//mgon po mchog khyod la yang phyag 'tshal lo mas mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal//gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ /mnyam med mkhyen 24na༄na khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/bskal pa grangs med gsum du tsho gos bsags te//bar du gcod pa'i bdud ni sil mdzad pa//bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo//stobs 'a ṣi 'dzin ye shesamache ba can//gang zhig skye ba'i rang bzhi gzeb dral nas//mya ga 'das zhi 'byog dgon zhugasagyur pa//ston pa glang po de la phyag la'i lo//gang gis sku ja rnams thams cad rab gon cing //mu stegs sa ni thams cad bcoms byas te//sdodang yos pa'i bdud ni gas nas su//byang tso mchog brnyes de la phyag 'tshal lo//mi mchog 'dul pa'i kha lo sgyur mdzad cing //kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs/dbang / spya zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas//mkha yod bzhugs

gnas brtan r+ṣa po ༅ drug gi mar pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenapa de la phyag 'tshal lo//yon to rin cen mang po'i tsho gis mnga' zhing //mas rab ye shes yongasasu dag pa'i sku//gser gyi mdog can lha dang mis mchod pa//bcom ldan lha yi lha la phyag sgol lo//nam mkha' 'dra zhing rdul bral dri ma med/shes rab sras po lus dang mas mi mnga'//yon to rgya mtsho rab zab thugs rje can//mtshungs med phyag ni bdag gi spyi bor zhog/de nas gnas brtan rnams kyi phyag la/spyan drangs zin nas so so'i gnas smos mi dgos pas/thub pas bka' bsgosabastan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan zin 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas kun nas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus 24ba / thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/'gro ba'i nyon mongs thams cad zhi mdzad cing //mi khom gnas su dkon cog gsum sgra sgrogs//stong dang tshig brgya'i 'khor bcasasgra gcan zin//rin chen brog zhu bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mas 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po lam phran bstan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong drug brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/nyam nga brgyad kyis gtses pa'i sems can rnams//sred pa'i sdug bsngal sogs las sgrol mdzad pa//stong dang drug brgya'i 'khor bcas lam phran bstan/phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ra dha dza bsod snyoms len 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/nad dang sdug bsngal chad pas nyen la sogs//nyen pa bcu las rnam par thar mdzad pa//stong phrag 'khor bcas 'phags pa bsod snyoms len//glegs bam lhung bzed bsnamasal phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po lam bstan 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyasaXskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()cad du phyag 'tshal 25na kho//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol//gang dag mi khom gnas las yid 'byung bar//de dag rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur mdzad pa//dgu brgya'i 'khor bcas 'phags pa lam bstan ni//glegs bam chos 'chad can la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mas 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan r+ṣa po klu'i sde 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol/mngal gyi dri mar yid khrung pad+ma las//brdzusate dag pa'i zhing du bskyed mdzad pa//stong dang nyis brgya'i 'khor bcas klu yi sde//bum pa 'bar gsil bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/'phags pa gnas brtan r+ṣa po sted byed 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//ma rdzo do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol//'jigasapa kun gyis gtses shing nyam thag pa//de dag thams cad bsrung zhing sba bar mdzad//stong dang bzhi brgya'i 'khor bcas sped byed ni//phyag gis glegs bam bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mas 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan wo po mi phyed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te 'tsho wo gzhes pa'i khas la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mar do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol//gdug pa'i gdon gyis25ba btses shing nyam thag pa//de dag thams cad zhi zhing bde bar mdzad//stong phrag 'khor bcas 'phags pa mi phyed pa//thal sbyar byang chen mchode rten 'dzin phyag 'tshal//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung 'khor dgra bcom pa stong sum brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol//gang dag nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis//gtses rnams de dang de las thar mdzad pa//stong dang sum brgya'i 'khor yos yan ༷ga khrung //thal spyar spos phor rnga yab 'dzin phyag

gnas brtan r+ṣa po ༄ drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhena'atshal//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa 'khor dgra bcom pa chig brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//ma rdzo do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol/rmi lam ltas dang mas ma ngan pa sogs//byur dang mi shis kun tu zhi bar mdzad//brgya phrag 'khor bcas 'phags pa ma pham pa//phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol//mi dge'i las dang nyon mongs kyis gdungs rnams//rnam dag gsal ba'i dngos nyid thob mdzad pa//26na ltang dang bzhi brgya'i 'khor bcas nags na gnas//sdigs mdzub rnga yab can la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan wo po dus ldan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/mtshams med las kyas ngan 'gror lhung ba dang //bde 'gro'i gnas su yang dag 'dren mdzad pa//stong dang tshig brgya'i 'khor bcas dus ldan ni//gser gyi rna kor bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu 'khor dgra bcom pa chig stong gis bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do/skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol//dgra dang phas kyi rgol pas gtses pa dang //zhi wo chos dang mthun par sgo gcod mdzad//swo stong 'khor bcas rdo rje mo yi bu//sdigs mdzub rnga yab can la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bzang po 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad ༷ phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()byin gyis brlab tu gsol/'dod pa'i longs spyod tshogs kyis ngoms mi shes//de dag srid pa'i sgrog las sgrol mdzad pa/ /stong dang nyis 26ba tha rgya'i 'khor bcas bzang po ni/ /chos 'go mnyam gzhag mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//thub bas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po gser be'u 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabasal dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/gang dag lus sems shin tu nyams chung ba//de yi gzi byin mthu stobs kun bskyed pa//lnga brgya'i 'khor bcas 'phags pa gser be lu/rin chen zhags pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mas 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ra dha dza gser can 'bor dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol//gang dag bud med lus kyis skyo ba rnams/rtag par skyes pa'i dngos nyid thob mdzad pa//bdun brgya'i 'khor bcas 'phags pa gser can ni/phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'phags pa gnas brtan wo po ba kū la 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do/skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/mi khom gnas su dbul ba'i sdug bsngal can//dbul dang mi khom 'gro las thar mdzad pa//dgu brgya'i 'khor bcas 'phags pa ba kū la//phyag gnyis ne'u le bsnams27na〉 phyag 'tshal lo//'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma tā la 'khor dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//brgyad dang brgyad gnyis 'jigs las kun tu skyab//dkon cog gsum la shes nas dad pa can//dge bsnyen 'phags pa dharma tā la zhes//snang mtha' rgyal ba'i sras la phyag 'tshal lo//chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung dang /'phags skyes po dang /mig mi 7༷zang dang /rnam thos kyi bu la sogs pa chos skyong

gnas brtan chen po ban drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenab lha'i dge bsnyen chen po thugs dam can thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos dang rnam bzhi'i 'khor skyong bar/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bden pa'i zhal 'ches pa/ /lha yi dge bsnyen chen po thugs dam can/ /'khor bcas rnam pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa'i tsho gos de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/ me rtag dang bdug spos/ rol mo dang sil snyan/gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor ba 'di dag dang phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ 'bul lo/ mchod do/ /bdag cag gis thog ma ma mchos pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi (27ba'i ge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ma bgyis pa la sogs pa dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so/ /dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi yang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /'jig rten gyi sgron me gang dag mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten kyi don mdzad cing yun ring du bzhugs par gsol ba 'tshal lo/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang / de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang / dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gzhal te bsdoms nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o zhes bya'o/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sangs rgyas—571

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)thams cad mnyes par bgyid par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su sbyong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyid par gyur cig /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang chos smra ba thams cad mgu bar bgyid par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing bsrung ba dang yongs su sbyong bar gyur (28na༄ga /sgrib pa'i ling tog thams cad rnam par sbyong bar gyur cig /bdud kyi rtsod pa'i dmag tshogs 'dul bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi chosathams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par gyur cig /ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang dbang thob par gyur cig /sems can dmyal ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /lha dbul po thams cad dang / mi dbul po thams cad dang / ser sna dang / 'chal pa'i tshul khrims thams cad dang / gnod sems thams cad dang / le lo thams cad dang / rnam par 'chi ba thams cad dang / 'chal ba'i shes rab thams cad rgyun chad par byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas la blta ba dang / dam pa'i chos mnyan pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang lus mnyam pa dang / ngag mnyam pa dang sems mnyam pa dang / ye shes mnyam par gyur cig /'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog can brkyang ste bdag gi spyi bor 'jog par gyur cig /ci nas kyang bdag dngos po thams cad la mi blta ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su zin pa'i sems dang mi 'bral zhing sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba thams cad rgyun chad pa'i sems kyis 'chi ba'i dus byed par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la blta zhing yang dag par smra bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par gyur cig /'di nas (28ba/ni 'phos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar pad+ma'i gdan seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skyes nas skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur cig /ces so/—372

gan brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)bzhi pa gsol pa gdab pa ni/ gral 'khor kyi dge 'dun dang / yon bdag skor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi lag tu spos dang me tog thogs/ pus mo btsugs/ thal mo sbyar/ mgo bo btud de/yid rtse gcig pas smon lam gyi gnas rnams la yid bstad de/ de la gsol ba gdab pa zhes pa ni/'dir sngon gyi thugs dam bskul ba ste/ de'ang gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs rim bskul ba tshar gcig la bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol/ khyed kyis bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu/ snyigs ma lnga'i mun par chud pa'i sems can 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nga rgyal dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna bdo ba dang / chos ma lags pa la 'dod chags kyis chags pa/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang bral ba/ bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po gsum la mi brtson pa/ theg pa gsum don du mi gnyer ba/ nyes par spyod pa gsum la brtson pa/ mi dge ba bcu'i las la brtson pa/ mtshams ma mchis par bgyid pa/ dam pa'i chos spong ba/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ mi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'grogs pa/ lta ba ngan (29na)pa'i lam du zhugs pa/ srid pa'i dba' slong dang 'khor ba'i 'byul 'khor na skyob pa ma mchis pa/ skyabs ma mchis pa/ dpung gnyen ma mchis pa/ sdug bsngal gyi snod du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bas dgongs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po'i drung du 'di skad ces/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gal te de'i tshe rtsod pa'i dus kyi mun par 'phangs shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yongs su spangs pa'i sems can rnams bdag gi snying rje'i gnas su gyur ba la lta na/ las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ brtul zhugs ngan pa sna tshogs la brtson par gyur pa de'i tshe na/ bdag sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par bgyid pa'i slad du/ dga' ldan gyi gnas las babs te/ 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rigs su btsun mo dam pa'i —573

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)mngal na gnas pa nye bar 'dzin par gyur cig /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed du sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag kyang rab tu sad par bgyid par 'gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyud la mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon 'debs par gyur cig /bdag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing gzhan yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'god par gyur cig /'gro ba rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs kyis chos ston par gyur cig /sems can gang dag mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung rnams la rin po che rnams (29brkong rol mo sna tshogs kyis mchod pa bgyid par spro ba dang / tha na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig tsam dang / phyag dang skor ba dang thal mo sbyor ba gcig dang / me tog gcig tsam gyi rgyus mchod pa bgyid par 'gyur ba de dag kyang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa gsum po dag las slar mi ldog par gyur cig /ces gsungs pa la sogs smon lam lnga brgya btab cing / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag gis ma 'ongs pa'i dus snyigs ma lnga bdo zhing rtsod pa'i dus la bab pa na 'jig rten stongs shing 'dren pa ma mchis pa/ sdug bsngal gyi mun par chud pa'i sems can rnams la sngar smos pa'i bdag gi re ba 'di lta bu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing / 'di ltar smon lam btab pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad sgrub pa'i rngo thogs pa lta na/ byang chub kyi slad du smon pa spang bar mi bgyi zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba'ang zhing gzhan du bsngo bar mi bgyid de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de ni bdag gi nges pa lags so/ /zhes dam bcas pa'i tshe/ ston pa 'khor dang bcas pas kyang snying rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod kyis smon lam chen po zab mo btab pa legs so/ khyod ni sems can rnams kyi sman dang dpung gnyen du 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams sdug bsngal las thar bar bya ba'i don du smon lam btab pa de bzhin du khyod kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /ces bden pa'i tshig brjod cing / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas kyang / skyes bu dam pa khyod la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ zhes phul nas snying rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed ni ma 'ongs (30na)pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams mi —574

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)mjed du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /lo bzhi bcu rtsa lngas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de lta bu mang po dag byed par 'gyur ro/ khyod mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos lo stong gnas par 'gyur ro/ /dam pa'i chos nub nas sku gdung rnams khyod kyis smon lam btab pa de ltar 'gyur te/ ji skad smos pa de bzhin du yun ring por sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas lung bstan pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa 'bul na/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba smin par bgyid pa'i slad du dga' ldan gyi gnas las babs te 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rigs su btsun mo dam pa'i mngal na gnas pa nye bar 'dzin par gyur cig /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur cig /de na gnas pa'i sems can dmyal ba rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / lha dang mi rnams su skyes par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyi snang ba de rig pa dang mthong zhing kun tu 'tshal bar gyur cig /'khor ba la rtog cing sdug bsngal gyis yid 'byung ba de dag kyang mya ngan las 'das par 'tshal zhing / byang chub tu sems bskyed (30ba)par gyur cig /dang por lam mchog gi sa bon bskyed pa 'di yang bskyed par gyur cig /sems mnyam par bzhag nas zla ba bcur ma'i mngal du gnas par gyur cig /ma'i mchan khung g.yas nas mngon par 'byung ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyud la mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon 'debs par gyur cig /mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin gyi myu gu bskyed par gyur cig /ting nge 'dzin gyi myu gu brtan par gyur pa rnams ni theg pa gsum po dag las phyir mi ldog —575

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)par gyur cig /bdag btsas ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / bdud rnams dang / brgya byin rnams dang / nyi ma dang zla ba dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / klu'i rgyal po dang /lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / brdzus te skyes pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / klu dang / lha ma yin rdzu phral chen po dang ldan pa thams cad kyang bdag la mchod par bgyi ba'i slad du nye bar mchis par gyur cig /bdag btsas ma thag tu gom pa bdun 'bor bar gyur cig /bdag ga 'ozhe nur rtse ba dang / bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi gnas dang / skad sna tsho gos ston pa dag dang / bslab tu rung ba dang / byang chub kyi shing drung du nye bar bgrod pa'i slad du mchi ba mthong bar gyur pa'i sems can de dag la yang theg pa gsum po dag gi chos ston par gyur cig /bdag gis sems dang po bskyed pas kyang slad ma'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po 'grub par gyur cig/yongs (31na)su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du bdag rnam par smin pa la mi re ba'i sbyin pa dang /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims dang / khro ba ma mchis pa'i bzod pa dang / dge ba'i cho sematha' dag sdud pa'i brtson 'grus/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i bsam gtan dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i shes rab la spyod par gyur cig /sems can 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang bral ba rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing stongs pa rnams dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba rnams dang / 'phags pa la skur ba 'debs pa rnams dang / log par lta ba rnams dang / mi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'grogs pa rnams dang / lasang na pas bcom par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du spro ba brtan po'i stobs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la spyod par gyur cig /sems can re re'i sems kyi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon bzhag pa'i slad du bskal pa chen po bcur yang sems can dmyal ba mnar med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba la spro bar gyur cig /de bzhin du yi dwags dang dud 'gro la sogs pa kun gyi phyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba la'ang spro bar gyur cig /sems can gcig gi rgyud la dge ba'i sa bon 'jog pa la spro ba ltar sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la dge ba'i sa bon 'jog pa —576

gnas brtan chen po ban drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenala'ang spro bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas re re la'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag bgyid par gyur cig /sangs rgyas re re las kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab snyed kyi yon tan dag rtogs par gyur cig /de na gnas pa'i sems can rnamasakyang byang chub yang dag par (31ba 'dzin du brtson par gyur cig /nyan thos kyi theg pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i sems can rnams kyang rang rang gi byang chub la 'god par gyur cig /'jig rten na sangs rgyas 'byung ba ma mchis na'ang drang srong gi brtul zhugs kyis sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las la sbyor bar gyur cig /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang mngon par shes pa la sbyor bar gyur cig /sems can lta ba la chags shing dbang phyug chen po la dad pa rnams la dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs kyis dge ba'i lam la sbyor bar gyur cig /de bzhin du sred med kyi bu dang / zla ba dang /nyi ma dang / nam mkha' lding dang / tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / khyab 'jug la dad pa rnams la de dag gi gzugs kyis dge ba'i spyod pa rnams la sbyor bar gyur cig /sems can stogs shing bkresapa rnams la bdag gi sha dang khrag gis tshim par bgyid par gyur cig /sems can sdug bsngal bar gyur pa rnams la bdag gi lus dang srog gis bskyab nus par gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dag mthong bar gyur cig /bdag gis sems can sems kyi rgyud tshig pa rnams dang nyam nga ba thosapa'i bar dag dang por sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'jig rten du brtson pa dang / rim gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar dag la 'god par gyur cig /ngan song rnams las thar bar gyur cig shes rab dang bsod nams kyi tshogs la sbyor bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i zhing de dag tu 'bul bar gyur (32na༄ga /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob par gyur cig /ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang bzod pa dag kyang thob par gyur cig /sa non par yang gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 577

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lozheyon to bkod pa'i smon lam 'dzin du brtson par gyur cig /de dag kyang ji ltar 'tsham pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod ba dag kyang 'dzin par gyur cig /de dag gis phyogs bcu'i sangasargyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed 'og na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs te chos ston pa dag kyang mthong bar gyur cig /mthong nas kyang de dag gi drung du mchi bar gyur cig /mchosanas kyang mchod pa sna tsho gos bgyid par gyur cig /zhu ba yongs su zhu bar gyur cig /rab tu 'byung bar gyur cig /tshul khrims dang thos pa dang ting nge 'dzin la mngon par brtson par gyur cig /chosakyi mchog kyang ston par gyur cig /de'i tshe sems can sems kyi rgyud tshig pa mi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'grogasapa rnams la chos kyang ston par gyur cig /bdag chos 'dul ba de dag kyang rab tu 'dzin par gyur cig /rgyal ba nyi ma nub pa de'i tshe na bdag sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bgyid par 'gyur zhing / semasacan rnams bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po gsum po dag la sbyor bar gyur cig /bud med gang dag bdag blta ba'i slad du mchis pa de dag kyang bud med kyi lus kyi tha mar gyur cig /yi dwags dang dud 'gro rnams kyang skye ba de'i tha mar gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyang slan chad kyang len par gyur cig /myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar (32ba)gyur cig /bdag skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus legs par brgyan cing sku de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gyed par gyur cig /sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dag la chos ston par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bsngags pa brjod par gyur cig /sems can rnams smon lam rnam par dag pa 'debs pa la brtson par gyur cig /sems can de dag 'gum pa'i dus kyi tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs par gyur cig /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang theg pa chen po'i sems can rnams la rang rang gi theg pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pa chos ston pa dgu bcu rtsa lnga chos ston par gyur cig /sems can dpag tu ma mchis pa la chos kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / gzungs bdun khri lnga stong la sogs —578

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 'dapa'i yon tan rab tu 'god par gyur cig /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan mthong ba dang / byang chub kyi yon tan dam pa la sogs pa rgyan sum cu rtsa bdun gyis brgyan par gyur cig /sems kyi rgyud tshig par gyur pa'i sems can rnams smon lam gyi dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar gyur cig /sems can le lo can rnams la chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ston par gyur cig /sems can theg pa chen por gyur pa rnams la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi chos rnams rgya cher ston par gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun pa'i sems can rnams kyang dkon cog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la 'god par gyur cig /slad kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug po dag la skye bar gyur cig /rnam par 'tshe ba la dga' brnams ni srog tha khod pa spong ba la (33na 'god par gyur cig /'dod pas:la gyis gnon pa rnamasani ma byin pa len pa spong ba la 'god par gyur cig /chos ma lags pa la 'dod pas chags pa rnams ni 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spong ba la 'god par gyur cig /brdzun gyi tshig smra ba rnams ni brdzun tshig smra ba spong pa la 'god par gyur cig /myos par 'gyur ba la dga' ba rnams ni bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba spong ba la 'god par 'gyur cig /sems can nongs pa lnga po bgyid par gyur pa de dag ni nongs pa lnga po spong zhing dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la 'god par gyur cig /yang dge ba'i chosal mi dga' ba de dag yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims la 'god par gyur cig /gang dag dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu la mngon par dga' ba de dag rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa bslab pa'i gzhi bcu tshangs par spyod pa la 'god par gyur cig /sems can dge ba'i chos rnams yongs su tshol ba de dag tshangs par spyod pa thams cad la 'god par gyur cig /dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen dag la chos ston par gyur cig /gang dag rtsod pa 'tshal bar gyur pa de dag bdag gis chos kyi rtsod pa'i bstan bcos ston par gyur cig /kha rtan la mngon par dga' ba rnams ni bsam gtan gyi cha gcig gi lam ston par gyur cig /bdag sems can la snying rje chen po'i dbang gis bdag yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur cig /mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos lo du mar gnas par —579

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhegyur cig /bdag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung rnams rin po che sna tsho gis dang rol mo sna tsho gis kyi mchod pa bgyid pa'am tha na sangs rgyas kyi (33ba 'tshan gcig dang skor ba gcig dang me tog tsam gyi rgyus mchod pa bgyid par 'gyur ba de dag kyang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa gsum po dag las slar mi ldog par gyur cig /ji tsam na dam pa'i chos ni nub/ chos kyi sgron ma ni gum/ cho so kyi rgyal mtshan ni 'gyel bar gyur pa na/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang mi mjed kyi zhing der rin po ches yongs par gyur pa de'i tshe/ nor bu be+eḍūrla'i tog gi blo gros zhes bya bar gyur te kun tu gnas par gyur cig /de dag la'ang me tog sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab par gyur cig /char de dag las kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang dge 'dun gyi sgra la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i sgra nyi shu rtsa bdun 'byung bar gyur cig /me tog de dag kyang rin po che sna tshogs su 'gyur zhing mi mjed kyi zhing du rin po che'i char rab tu 'bab par gyur cig /de dag tu phan tshun 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / mu ge dang / nad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / tshig rtsub dang /dug rnams thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /thams cad du bde ba dang / nad ma tshims pa dang /'thab rtsod ma mchis pa dang / lo legs pa dang kun tu gnas par gyur cig /sems can gang gisarin po che de dag mthong ba dang / reg pa dang / longs spyod pa de dag thams cad kyang theg pa gsum po dag gis slar mi ldog par gyur cig /de bzhin du mtshon gyi bskal pa bar ma'i tshon sku gdung de dag nor bu rin po che an+da rnyil dang / mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe na rin po che'i zas dang / nad kyi bskal pa bar ma'i tshe na rin po che'i sman du gyur nas/ me rtag (34na)sna tshogs kyi char dang sgra yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs 'byung bar gyur cig /sku gdung de dag kyang slar gser gyi 'khor lo'i mthar thug par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can thams cad kyang mi dge ba spangs nas dge ba spyod par gyur cig /'chi kur yang de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal mthong ste ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin —380

gnas brtan chen po ban drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenagashegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar pad+ma'i gdan seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skyes ma thag tu pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mnyes par byed cing / sems can thams cad kyang theg pa chen po'i lam la 'god par gyur cig /'phags pa sgra gcan zin la sogs pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug po re re la dgra bcom pa du mas kun nas bskor te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dag dgongs su gsol/ dusang na pa'i sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tsho gis kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa ngan song nas ngan 'gror 'og nas 'og tu lhung bar 'gyur ba'i sems can rnams thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa shākya'i thub pa'i spyan sngar mya ngan las mi mda' bar 'jig rten du mngon sum du bzhugs shing bka' lung rjes su bsgrub par 'phags pa'i tshig bden pas nges par zhal gyis gzhes pa dam pa'i chos skyong zhing 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal zhing du gyur pa 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug (34ba tshe sga thor dang bcas pa'i mthu dang byin gyis rlabs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos mtha' dag 'jig rten du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /glegs bam la bris te 'chang ba dang / mchod pa dang / bkur sti bgyid pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kha ton bgyid pa dang / gzhan dag la'ang rgya cher ston par gyur cig /nyan thos dang theg pa chen po'i gang zag thams cad kyi rang rang gi mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rgyas par gyur cig /rtag tu sde snod du mnyan pa dang / 'chad pa dang / sems rtse gcig tu mos pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad du bkra shis pa dang /gzi brjid chags pa dang / thams cad 'byung ba dang / ci bsams pa'i don thams cad 'grub par gyur cig /ngan song dang ngan 'gro las grol te rab tu dga' ba rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / rig pa'i ye shes rgyas par gyur cig /nam mkha' rnam par dag pa ltar dkar po'i yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur cig /rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad bslab pa —581—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo5)gsum gyis mdzes par gyur cig /khyad par du rang rgyud kyi nyen mongs pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs dpag tu med pas mchod par gyur cig /lhag par yang gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan zin de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dug gsum la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /mi khom pa'i gnas la sogs pa thams cad du dkon cog gsum (35na)gyi sgra bsgrags pas de dag gi sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas thams cad bskal pa bsam kyibashami khyab par 'jig rten du bzhugs te chos ston par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi 'khor dpag tu med pa 'du bar gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i chos la the tshom dang som nyi med par sems rtse gcig tu mos shing spyod par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chosathams cad kyi tshig don rtogs par gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlob par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag sred pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam nga ba la sogs pa nyam nga ba brgyad kyis gtses par gyur pa de dag thams cad 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po lam phran bstan de'i byin rlabs kyis srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam nga ba/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam nga ba dang sgo gsum sdig pa spyod pas nyam nga ba dang / drug rtsa ba'i nyen mongs pa dang / nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pas nyam nga ba dang / byis pa blun po'i spyod pas mi shes pas nyam nga ba dang / sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du song ba'i nyam nga ba dang / ngal ba don med pa'i spyod pas dus 'da' ba'i nyam nga ba dang / dus ngan pas 'jigs shing bsod nams log par bsngos pa'i nyam nga ba ste nyam nga ba brgyad dang bral bar gyur cig /gzhan yang 'dod chags kyi me dang / zhe snang gi me dang / gti mug gi me dang kun nas mnar sems pa'i me dang / mi shes pa'i me dang / sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i me dang / sems 'khrugs pa'i me dang / log par (35ba /lta ba'i me dang / ngan par sems pa'i me dang / rkyen ga pa'i gdon thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gzhan yang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin —582

gnas brtan chen po ban drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin brgya phrag du ma la mnyam par 'jog par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegasapa'i stobs bcu dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / spyan lnga dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi thob par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag rgyal po'i chad pa la sogasapas nyes pa de dag thams cad 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ nad kyis nyen pa dang / sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pas nyen pa dang /chom rkun gyis nyen pa dang / bsdigs pa dang bsod pas nyen pa dang / lus sems stobs chung bsanyen pa dang / 'tsho ba dang gnas med pas nyen pa dang lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pas nyen pa dang / lha'i gdon la sogs pa'i gdon drag pos mnar te nyen pa dang / phongs pa sna tsho gos kyis nyen pa ste/ nyen pa bstolas thar bar gyur cig /mi khom pa'i gnas dang / ngan 'gro log par lhung ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur cig /'on pa dang / long ba dang / lkugs pa dang / dran pa nyams pa dang / 'byul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur cig /dbang po tshang ba dang / dad pa dang / shes rab dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang /khrel yod pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag mi khom pa'i gnas la yid 'byung zhing / ra btu 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po lam bstan gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ dal 'byor gyi lus khyad (36na lngar can thob par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegasapa thams cad kyi drung du gzhen nu la rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / rab tu 'byung ba'i bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /lha dang mi rnams kyi rab tu 'byung ba'i grogs byed par gyur cig /ngesapar 'byung ba'i sems rtag tu thob par gyur cig /rab tu 'byung ba la brtson pa dang / gus pa dang /dkon cog gsum gyi sgra thos pa dang / sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa'i sde sdod 'dzin par gyur cig /rtag tu tshangasapar spyod pa lhur len pas gtsang ba'i 'khor thams cad thob par gyur cig /ma rig pa'i mun pa sdug po dang chos la brten pa'i sgrib pa ma lus pa dag par gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i chos dang mjal ba — —583

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhedang / sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i mdo sde bcu gnyis 'chad pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'bri ba dang /'chang ba dang / kun chub par bya ba dang / 'dod pa dang ma 'dres pa dang / ma god pa dang / ma sngags pa dang / skyon med pa dang / ma ral pa dang / ma bas pas bsngags pa'i tshul khrims la gnas par gyur cig /spobs pa rgya chen po dang / shes rab rgya chen po thob par gyur cig /sems can gang dag mngal du skye ba len pa la mi dga' ba de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde'i byin gyis rlabasakyis/ skye ba thams cad du mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par me tog pad+ma la brdzus te skye ba dang sangasakyi rgyas zhing dag par skye bar gyur cig /dkon gsum la dad pa thob par gyur cig /nad kyi rigs su gyur pa ma lus pa dang / sdug (36ba tha sngal gyi rigs thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa'i zug rngu thams cad zhi bar gyur ci/ rtag tu byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba'i dge slong 'ba' zhig dang 'grogs par gyur cig /sdom pa gsum yongs su dag pa dang / theg pa chen po'i sems yongs su ldongs par gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i snod du 'gyur ba dang / thos pa'i don la sems las su rung bar gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya chen po'i rol pas rngams pa med pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug myur du rdzogs par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyisagatses shing nyam thag par gyur pa de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po sped byed de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis mu ge'i bskal pa dang / mtshon gyi bskal pa dang / nad kyi bskal pa dang / gcan gzan gtum po dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / sprul dang / me dang / chu dang / rims dang / btsan dang / klu gdugs pa can dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa can la sogs pa 'jigs pa thams cad las thar par gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang myur du mjal ba dang mchod pas mnyes par byed par gyur cig /khyad par du rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi ba dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur cig /chos kyi rgyal por dbang thob par gyur pa dang / yang dag pa'i shes rab rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / sangasargyas kyi sras kyi thu por 'gyur par gyur cig /chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mtshan —584

gan brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / rang bzhi med pa ṣ+ka dang / /mas i med pa ṣ+ka dang / skye ba med pa nyid dang / 'gag pa med pa nyid du rtogs par gyur cig /bdag (37na7ga semasacan gang dag lha 'dre gdug pa can gyis gtses shing nyam thag par gyur pa de dag gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis yul phyogs kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can de dag zhi bar gyur cig /bkra shisapa dang bde ba dang legs pa thams cad 'byung bar gyur cig /blta na sdug pa dang / gzugs bzang ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / bde ba dang / 'byor ba 'phel ba dang / don thams cad 'grub par gyur cig /mi dge ba bcu spyad pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag pa dang / bslab pa gsum gyis mdzes par gyur cig /mnyam gzhag gi zhi gnas 'phel ba dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa la sogs pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad rgyud la skye ba dang / brtan pa dang 'phel bar gyur cig /rtag tu dkon cog gsum dang mi stsol ba dang / rang gi 'khor du chos ston pa dang / lan pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi 'khor chos byed pa 'phel bar gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag nad dang sdug bsngal sna tsho gis kyis gtses pa de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ lus kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar gyur cig khrug rtsa pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa sa bon dang bcas zhi bar gyur cig /lha mi thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba dang / tshul khrims kyi dri bsung gis phyogs bcur khyab par gyur cig /de bzhin tha shegasapa thams cad kyi lung bstan pa thob par gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa sna tsho gos dpag tu med pas rgya cher yun ring du mchod par gyur (37bcug /lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa 'phel ba dang / lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa brtan par byab dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rtogs par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag gdon dang ltasang na pa sna tshogs kyis gzir ba de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis yul phyogs gang du bdag nyid 'dug kyang yul phyogs de'i ri'i lha dang / sa'i lha dang / chu'i lha dang /—583—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)me'i lha dang / rlung gi lha dang / shing gi lha dang / nags kyi lha dang / tshal gyi lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa dang / 'byung po gdug pa dang / yi dwags la sogs pa nag po gdug pa can thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis dul ba dang zhi bar gyur cig /rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ga pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / lce 'bab pa dang / byur 'bab pa dang / bra ngan pa dang / bram ze'i dmod pa dang / sngagasakyi mngon spyod dang / gza' dang skar ma ga pa dang / skeg dang / ma mo'i byad dang / gshin rje'i zhabrul 'khor dang / lha ma srin sdebargyad kyi gdug rtsub dang / gdon chen po bco brgyad la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis zhi bar gyur cig /yul phyogs bkra shis pa dang / gzi brjid chags pa dang / lo rtag rgyas par gyur cig /g.yin yang theg pa chen po'i gang zag dang / chos la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson khrus dang / mi zhus pa'i stobs dang / rjes su 'asdug pa'i sgrub pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag mi dge ba'i las sna tsho gos la brtson pa de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis yul khyad par can la sdig pa bsags pa dang /nyon mongs(38na)pa'i kun slong drag pos sdig pa bsags pa dang / dkon cog gsum dang dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bags pa dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la sogs sdom pa gsum nyams pa dag bshags te sdom par gyur cig /sgo gsum gyi sdig pa dag par gyur cig /nyen mongs pa thams cad dang / gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i log par rtog pa dang / chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i log par rtog pa dag zhi bar gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag mtshams ma mchis pa bgyis pas ga 'gror skye bar 'gyur ba de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po dus ldan gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis bde 'gro mtho ris su skyes nas/ byams pa chen po dang / brtse ba chen po dang snying rje chen po dang ldan par gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing sbyang ba dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad 'dzin pa dang / sems can mtha' yas pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'god par gyur cig /bdag cag la —586

gan brtan chen po bas drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyis dgongs pa dang rtag tu mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi yid du 'ong bas thugs kyis 'dzin par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang lhan cig tu 'grogs par gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spobasapa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bar gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' sal gnas pa dang phyir mi ldog pa thams cad 'du bar gyur cig /gzhan yang bskal pa chen po dang ldan pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang 'grogs pa dang / dad pa dang shes rab dang ldan pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa 'du bar gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag dgra dang phas kyi rgol bas gtses pa de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu'i byin gyi rlabs kyis dgra thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /phas mi rgol ba thams cad chos dang mthun pas tshar gcod par gyur cig /bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par gyur cig /chos spyod ba bcu dang / lha dang mi la sogs pa thams cad kyi dge ba dang smon pa 'phel bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gyur cig /rtag tu sangasargyas dang 'grogs ba dang / lus mtshan bzang po dang dpe byad bzang po phun sum tsho gos pas brgyan par gyur cig /lus la 'od zer dpag tu med pa mtha' yas pa thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'od kyisagang la reg pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag longs spyod sna tshogs kyis ngoms mi shes pa de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bzang po de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 'dod pa chung ba dang chog shes par gyur cig /mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang /slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang / so so skye bo'i dge 'dun thams cad la gus pa thob par gyur cig /theg pa che chung thams cad kyi tshig don ma lus pa rtogs par gyur cig /thabs snying rje chen po dang /shes rab stong pa nyid dang / zab mo'i don khong du chud par gyur cig /mngon shes dang rdzu tshil du ma dang ldan par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par 'gro bar gyur cig /bdag (39na༄ga —587—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā5)sems can gang dag lus sems stobs chung bas nyen pa de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po gser be'u de'i byin gyi rlabs kyis lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang 'byung po mi dang sa bla'i gnod sbyin thams cad gus pas bka' bzhin du bsgrub par gyur cig /rgyal po dang / blon po dang / rgyal po'i sras dang / btsun mo dang / 'bangs dang / khye'u dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / bram ze'i rigs sngags 'chang ba dang / drang srong gi smon lam grub pa thams cad bdag gi bka' bzhin du bsgrub par gyur cig /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang 'byung po dkar po la dga' ba rnams kyis bdag gi lus kyi gzi brjid dang / sems kyi mthu bskyed par gyur cig /gzhan yang gang zag thams cad kyi rgyud 'jam pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad thob pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo mang po dang / spobs pa rgya chen po dang / shes rab rgya chen po thob par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag bud med kyi lus las yongs su skyo nas skyes pa'i lus 'tshal ba de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba ra dh+wa dza gser can gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis rtag tu skyes pa'i lus thob par gyur cig /grogs po dam pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang mi 'bral zhing 'grogasapar gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong ba dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pa blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa rlabs po che mdzad pa blta bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba dang / rig pa'i ye shes rgyas par gyur cig /(39ba〉bdag cag sems can gang dag mi khom pa'i gnas su skyes te bza' ba dang bgo ba med pa de dag 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po ba kū la'i byin gyi rlabs kyis ngan song gsum dang mi khom pa'i gnas las thar bar gyur cig /bkres pa dang / skom pa dang / gcer bu dang / 'on pa dang / long ba dang / dbang chung ba dang / lkugs pa dang / dig pa dang / rmongs pa dang / glen pa las thar bar gyur cig /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la phun sum tshogs par longs spyod par gyur cig /pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid myur du rtogs par gyur cig /—588

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenabyams pa dang snying rje chen po rgyas par gyur cig /bdag cag sems can gang dag gcan gzan la sogs pa du mas gtses pa dang / gang dag dkon mchog gsum la bkur sti bgyid pa la mi dga' ba de dag thams cad 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dharma tā la'i byin gyi rlabs kyis gcan gzan la sogs pa 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug las thar bar gyur cig /dkon mchog la mngon par dad par gyur cig /me tog dang spos dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dpag tu ma mchis pa dag gis mchod par gyur cig /rim gror bya ba sna tshogs la mngon par brtson par gyur cig /dug lnga dang bdud bzhi dang sgrib pa gnyis la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad rgyas par gyur cig /'di nas shi ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing du skye bar gyur cig /skyes ma thag tu sa dang lam thams cad (40na〉bde blag tu bsgrub pa ste/ phyogs bcur sprul pa du ma 'gyed par gyur cig /sems can dpag tu ma mchis pa theg pa chen po'i lam la 'god par gyur cig /dkon cog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mthu dang /byin gyi rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang / 'phags pa rnams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi kun tu spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi thugs dam nges pa'i bden pas de bzhin du gyur cig /ces lan gsum du bzla'o/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / spyan mi bzang dang / rnam thos sras la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba lha'i dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ sngon bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i spyar sngar bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo sbyar ba btud nas lha'i tshig bden pas 'di skad ces/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi ni chos dang ldan pa chos smra ba chos kyi rgyal po lags chos kyis lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto phye chen po rnams kyi rgyal po —589

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6zhebagyi'o/ /'byung po'i tsho gis mi bzad pa snying rje ma mchis pa gzhan gyi gzi brdzid 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tsho gos thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /mu ge dang nad kyis ya nga ba dang / mya ngan dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad rang bde ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba bgyi'o/ khyun du lha'i mig rnam par dag pas 'dzam bu'i gling thams(40ba)cad la blta bar bgyi/ bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyab par bgyi ste/ /de'i slad du bdag la 'jig rten skyongs pa zhes ming du chags so/ /gang su dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis yul 'joms par 'gyur ram/ mu ge'i ya nga ba'am nad kyi ya nga ba'am/ gnod pa sna tsho gos kyis gtses par gyur pa na/ bdag cag /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i rdzus la dang byin rlabasakyis sems can thams cad kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su bzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bde ba dang phun sum tshogs par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyisargyal po chen po dag la legs so legs so/ /khyed rnams ni rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ chos dang ldan pa/ chos smra ba/ chos kyi rgyal po/ chos kyis lha dang mi rnams kyi rgyal po byed pa'o/ khyed rnams ni yun ring por sems can thams cad la phan pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bde ba dang byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ mi phan pa thams cad 'gog pa/ sems can thams cad la bde ba thams cad nye bar bsgrub pa la brtson pa yin te/ rgyal po chen po khyed bzhis 'dzam bu'i gling kun tu bsrung bar gyis shig /yongasasu bzung ba dang zhi ba bde legs su 'gyur bar gyis shig /de nas rgyal po bzhi dpung dang g.yog 'bum phrag dang bcas la khyed bzhis/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom (41na skon 'das rnams kyi tshul du bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /yongs su bskyangs pa dang / yongasasu bzung bar yang 'gyur ro/ /lha ma yin dang g.yul 'gyed pa na khyed g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /590

gnas brtan chen po bas drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenargyal po chen po khyed bzhisanga'i bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma'am khyim pa la sogs pa de dag kun tu bsrung bar gyis shig /'dzam bu'i gling 'di'ang kun tu bsrung bar gyis shig /ces bka' stsal pa dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi stan las langs te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'dzam bu'i gling 'di dang / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa de dag kyang kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /yul de dag kyang 'jigs pa dang gnod pa dang 'khrugs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling rgyas pa dang lo legs pa dang nyams dga' ba dang skye bo mang pos gang ba dang / gza' dang rgyu skar dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba yang legs par rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /char pa'i rgyun yang dus su 'bab par 'gyur ba dang / nor dang 'bru dang / dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad rgyas par bgyi'o/ /zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa gsungs shing zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du phan yon ji ltar gsungs pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis thob par byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/ /mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po dang ldan pa 'di nyid rgyal po chen po bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu sa'i lha mo bstan mas (41ba)gtso byas bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams bsrung zhing skyob pa'i srung ma spyi dang bye brag yul phyogs 'di dag gi dgon grong gnas mal bsrung ba'i lha klu bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs mi ma yin mthu bo che rnams la 'bul lo sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten khams su bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnamasakyis chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen yid bzhin du sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ bzhi pa rjes su bya ba la lnga ste/ slar yang mchod pa/ dge ba/ bsngo ba/ cho ga bskang ba/ gshegs su gsol ba/shis par brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la zhes sogs dang / g.yin yang ci rigs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzang po spyod pa bsngo ba'i rgyal po dang bstan 'bar ma la sogs—59/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)pa'i smon lam rgya cher btab nas 'di skad du bsngo ste/ mchod pa'i tsho gis sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che 'di dag gi stobs kyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i dgongs pa lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /pho brang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad du bzang po spyod pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rgyas pas rgyan klub pa dang ldan par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos rnam pa thams cad kyi sgo nas 'jig rten du dar zhing rgyas par gyur te/ yi ger 'bri ba dang / mchod pa dang / klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / sbyin pa dang / nyan (42na)pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa la mngon du byed pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi rgyud la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad so so'i rnam par thar pa yongs su rdzogs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa rnams su thogs pa med par 'jug cing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod cing bka' lung yang dag par bsgrub ba dang / sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba la yo byad cis kyang mi gzung zhing thabs la mkhas pa dang / mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang 'byor bar gyur cig /'phags pa rang rgyal ba dang nyan thos thams cad so so'i rnam par thar pa mthar phyin nas/ theg pa bla na med pa'i sgor gzhol zhing bsgrubs te/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad rang gi 'khor yongs su smin par mdzad pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i mthu dpal dang thabs mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing thugs dam rlabs po che thams cad yongs su bskang ba dang / lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang thob pa dang / so so'i rnam par thar pa yongs su rdzogs shing chos kyi mnga' bdag chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /yon sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po sku 'khor dang bcas pa la g.yo med par lhag par 'go —592

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenazhing phan 'dogs pa'i lha'i mgon thams cad kyi lus dang sems kyi rgyud kyi sdig pa dang nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang legs (42ba)pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig /dkon cog bla na med pa gsum po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing byang chub kyi sems dam pa bskyed pa la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs nas/ rim gyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig /rang gi 'khor yongs su bskyang ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa la mthu dang thabs mkhas pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /mu med mtha' yas pa'i sems thams cad kyang sgrib pa thams cad ni byang / sdug bsngal dang gnod pa thams cad ni zhi/ byang chub kyi phyogs la sogs pa dge ba'i chos thamasacad ni yongs su rdzogs te/ 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad spangs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs te/ g.yung drung gi sku myur du thob par gyur cig /de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che thams cad ma lus par 'phags pa thams cad la phul ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad la stabs shing bsngosapa la sogs pas che ge mos thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bsags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa'i stobs dang / dkon cog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam pa dag pa'i stobs kyis ston pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa sngon gyi thugs dam bzang po lasaglengs te/ mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga bgyis pa las/ phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thamasacad kyang bdag cag rnams kyis pol du thob cing yongs su rdzogs nas mngon du gyur cig /che ge mos thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas 'khor bar brgyud pa (43na sgoms su sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyis bsgribs par gyur pa nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyi dbang gis skyang ba 'di lta ste/ las kyi sgrib pa'am/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'am/ rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa'am/ chos kyi phongs par gyur pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa las gang gis che ge mo ngan song kun tu mchi bar 'gyur ba'i mi khom par skye bar —593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)'gyur ba'am da rka ne cog gsum mngon par mi rig cing / mi gus mi 'dzin par 'gyur ba'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rjes su mi 'dzin par 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub kyi sems dang dge ba'i phyogs las nyams shing bdud kyis cho mes par 'gyur ba'am/ 'khor ba'i chos rnams kyis kun tu 'joms par 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang yon tan gyi chos thams cad bsgrub pa la mi phyogs shing / mi bsgrub par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sdig pa'i las sna tshogs che ge mo nyid kyis bgyis pa'am/bgyid du stsal pa'am/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa ci mchis pa thams cad ma lus par bsal te/ gtan zhi zhing byang bar gyur cig /sngon gyi las de lta bu'i rnam par smin pa'ang rung / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste/ da ltar gyi lus 'di la nad kyi rnam pa mang pos gdungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma lags pas ngan du bgyis shing gtses pa dang / tshe thung ba dang sdug bsngal mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / 'khor dang yo byad mi mthun pa dang / mi sbyin pa dang bsam pa mi 'grub cing bar du gcod pa mang ba la sogs pa gnod pa dang mi dge ba dang bkra mi shis pa dang / ngan pa dang sdig tor bgrang ba thams cad zhi zhing gtan mi 'byung bar gyur cig /gdon bgegs kyis gnod pa bgyid pa thams cad dang bral (43btogang grol nas gdon bgegs de dag byams shing zhi ba'i sems kyis sngar gnod pa'i sbyor ba nas bgyis pa thams cad bshig pas rang gi gnas su dong zhing / phyin chad nam du'ang gnod pa ci yang mi byed par gyur cig /'phral du'ang tshe ring zhing nad ma mchis pa dang 'khor dang yo byad thams cad mthun zhing 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal dang ldan par gyur cig /tshe rabs thams cad du'ang byang chub kyi tsho gos yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i lus dang longs spyod dang 'khor grogs dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen phun sum tsho gos pa dang ldan par gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i chos dang rtag tu 'phrad cing thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa'i sgo nas don mngon sum du bgyid par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos ma nor ba ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams —594

gnas brtan chen po bas drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ zhenadang rgyun du 'grogs shing mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mdor na sems can thams cad kyi don bgyi zhing 'phags pa'i lam bsgrub pa la yo byad cis kyang mi gzung zhing / thabs mkhas pa dang shesarab kyi mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan te byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad bde blag tu nyams 'og tu chud par gyur cig /bsod nams ye shes kyi tsho gos yongs su rdzogs pa g.yung drung gi sku sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang chen po myur du thob nas sems thams cad srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol zhing mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la 'god par gyur cig /gsum pa cho ga bskang ba ni/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag (44na)par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dgra bcom pa'i tshogs mang pos bskor ba la sogs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la sogs pa thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad par gsol ba'i skabs 'dir bdag cag dusang na pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas/ ma 'tshal ba dang bag ma mchisapa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyen mongs pa dang 'dres pa dang / mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhig ga pa dang / gtsang sbra ma byed pa dang / mdo sdo las byung ba'i chog bzhin du ma lcogasapa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing mchis na thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod par bzhesashing 'phral dang yun du bdag cag rnams kyi sgrib pa mi 'gyur bar ci gnang / zhes sogs gzhan yang ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa gshegs su gso leb ni/ maṇ+ḍal du spyan drang ba rnams te/ ston pa sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba nyam thag pa rnams kyi don mdzad cing bka' drin stsal lags te/ da dung du'ang bdag cag la thugasabartse bas yang dang yang du gdan 'dzom par mdzad pas dgongs shing so so'i gdul bya'i zhing rnams su 'gro ba mang po'i don la gshegs par stsal (44ba'i ci gnang / zhes sogs ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /—593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 65)lnga pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ sku gzugs kyi mchod rten bzhugs pa dang gnas khang la sogs pa la rol mo du ma'i sgra dang bcas shing / me tog gi char dbab pa dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad bas shin tu bkra shis par bya ste/ de'ang ji skad du/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis phyir mi ldog pa'i tshig bden pa rnams la 'jig rten gyi tshig gi mchog dang / dge sbyong rnams kyi nang na dge stong skyid de ba zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyasani 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba/ bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba ste mi skrag mi dngangs mi 'bros la/ 'jigs pa med cing 'jigs par byed pa dang bral ba/ 'jigs pa dang 'jigs par byed pa spangs pa dang / skyi bung zhes byed pa med pa'o/ /zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dag bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis rgyal khams dang / yul 'khor dang / grong dang / grong brdal dang / grong khyer dang / khyim dang / gnas dang / zhing gang dag yin pa rnams su skye rgu thams cad la yongs su bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legasasu gyur cig /rgyal khams zhes pas na 'gre'o/ /gnas brtan rgyal po lta bu'i bu thu bo dang 'dra bar rab tu byung nas yun ring du lon pa/ tshangs (45)par spyod pa mngon par spyod pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/ dge slong kun shes koṇ+ḍi rgyadang / 'dod pa nyung la sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang chog shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang / shes rab che ba dang spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog shā ra dwa ti'i bu dang / rdzu 'phrul che ba dang mthu che ba rnams kyi mchog mo sgol gyi bu chen po dang / lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gag pa dang / mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye bar 'khor dang / cho ge smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams ma'i bu gang po dang / bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog sgra gcan zin dang / mal cha dang stan bgo ba rnams kyi mchog rgyad bu'i nor dang / seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams kyi mchog ba ra dha dza bsod snyoms len dang / khyim pa dad pa bskyed pa thams cad kyi mchog nag po 'char ka dang / lha dang mis mchod pa —596

gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ 6)rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang /bden pa'i tshig de dag gis zhes sogs bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'ang /rkang gnyis pa'am/rkang bzhi pa'am/rkang mangs sam/gzugs can na'am/gzugs can ma yin pa'am/'du shes sam/'du shes med pa'am/'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag gi nang na ni de bzhin gshegs pa mchog 45ba ji sa bya ste/bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig de dag gis zhes sogs so//bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshogos pa 'am/'dus pa'am/mang po'am/'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig dag gis zhes sogs so//bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang /gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang bshad pa dang brjod pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig de dag gis zhes sogs te/'dir grong ngam gnas kyi ming /sgos su smos dgos pa'i skabs yod na ni de bzhin du bya'o//de nas ji skad du/'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa yi//mtho ris dag ni rin cen mchog yod pa//de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa//mi g.yo mchog de 'dir ni mtshudas pa med//de bas 'dir ni rin cen mchog tu gsungs//bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog/zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas//zhes pa shākya thub pa des rab skyes//bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus ma byas yin pa//chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med//de bas 'dir ni rin cen mchog tu gsungs//bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog/mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab brtan pa//ston 46na ) pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag sgrub pa//rdo rje lta bu mi gnyis lam mthong ba//ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin//de bas 'dir ni rin cen mchog tu gsungs//bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog/gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing //gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni//drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs pa 5 9 /7/bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas zhes

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā5)gsungs/ /de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'gyur te/ zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin/ /'dir ni dge 'dun rin cen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing / /go'u ta ma'i bstan la bzhug byed pa/ /de dag thob byed bdud rtsi mchog thob ste/ /mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /de bas dge 'dun rin cen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ /'jig tshogasalta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang / /the tshom dang ni nyen mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba/ /de bas dge 'dun rin cen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa 'di yisa'adir ni bde legs shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid sa kyang / /sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed cing / /glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed la/ /de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed/ /de bas dge 'dun rin cen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa (46ba8 yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de ltar dbang pos sdong po gsar btsugs pa/ /phyogs bzhi rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar/ /'phagasapa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi/ /gang zag 'phags pa'i mchoge rnams de bzhin no/ /des na /de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'phrad mi 'gyur/ /des na dge 'dun rin cen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba/ /lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa
